arcane propulsion.text: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time. You can maintain this redirected energy for 5 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while redirecting the energy. Enhancement You can maintain your flight for longer.

arcane slam.name: Arcane Slam
arcane slam.text: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground. Attempt an Athletics check against the foe's Fortitude DC.

outcomes.text: You slam the foe down and the magical energy overwhelms it. The creature is knocked prone, becomes dazzled for 1 round, and takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.
You slam the foe down. The creature is knocked prone and takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.
You are unable to slam the creature, but your hold on the creature remains.
The creature breaks free and is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

arcane slam.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

arch-gremlin's command.name: Arch-gremlin's Command
arch-gremlin's command.text: You aren’t merely a gremlin. You’re the gremlin, the arch-gremlin, a paragon of all gremlins. You’re the monarch of the gremlins, and that gets you... well, in all honesty, it doesn’t get you much, but other gremlins occasionally go where you tell them.

archaeologist's luck.name: Archaeologist's Luck
archaeologist's luck.text: You are more than just skillful; your drive to find the secrets of the past manifests as a strange kind of luck. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.
archaeologist's luck.trigger: You fail a check against a trap, such as a Thievery check to Disable the trap or a Reflex save to avoid its effects.

archaeologist's warning.name: Archaeologist's Warning
archaeologist's warning.text: You visually or audibly warn your companions of danger, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls. Depending on whether you use gestures or call out, this free action gains either the visual or auditory trait.
archaeologist's warning.trigger: You are about to roll a Perception, Society, or Thievery check for initiative.

archer's aim.name: Archer's Aim
archer's aim.text: You slow down, focus, and take a careful shot. Make a ranged Strike with a weapon in the bow or crossbow weapon group. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's concealed condition. If the target is hidden, reduce the flat check from being hidden from 11 to 5.

architect of flame.name: Architect of Flame
architect of flame.text: Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design. You create a wall of fire within 120 feet. In addition to the normal choices, you can make the wall up to 10 feet long and 60 feet high. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

armor break.name: Armor Break
armor break.text: You flex your muscles to crack your damaged armor, blasting jagged shards into nearby enemies. Each enemy in a 10-foot emanation takes 11d6 piercing damage with a Reflex save against your class DC. You can push any enemy that fails its save 5 feet away from you (or up to 10 feet on a critical failure).
armor break.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor that doesn’t have the broken condition, and your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or lower.

armor in earth.name: Armor in Earth
armor in earth.text: Stone encases you like armor. The stone armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The stone armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +4; Dex Cap +1; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –10 feet; Strength +3; Bulk 1; Group plate. You gain its armor specialization effect.

armored counterattack.name: Armored Counterattack
armored counterattack.text: With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies. After Intercepting the Attack, make your own Strike against the triggering enemy. If your Strike hits, you Taunt the target; this Taunt gains the visual trait.
armored counterattack.trigger: You use Intercept Attack against a melee Strike and are adjacent to the creature that made the Strike.

armored courage.name: Armored Courage
armored courage.text: You take comfort in the safety of your armor. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute, and you reduce your frightened condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
armored courage.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

armored rebuff.name: Armored Rebuff
armored rebuff.text: You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe. Attempt an Athletics check to Shove the triggering enemy, even if you don't have a hand free. If you succeed, you can't Stride to follow the enemy, as you're knocking the enemy back with the rebounded attack, not by physically moving towards them.
armored rebuff.trigger: An adjacent enemy critically fails an attack roll to Strike you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack.
armored rebuff.requirements: You are wearing medium armor or heavier.

army of one.name: Army of One
army of one.text: Even alone, you’re a force to be reckoned with— an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments. Spend 1 Mythic Point. If you’re not currently wielding your celestial armament, it immediately teleports into your hand.

artist's attendance.name: Artist's Attendance
artist's attendance.text: Your runes call you to better attend to your art. Stride twice. If you end your movement within reach of a creature that is bearing one of your runes, you can Trace a Rune upon that creature or another target adjacent to you.

artokus's fire.name: Artokus's Fire
artokus's fire.text: Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire. You include this additive mixture when crafting your alchemist's fire.
artokus's fire.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemist's fire, and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

as a thousand soldiers.name: As a Thousand Soldiers
as a thousand soldiers.text: Though you may have stolen from the hive, you’ve nothing but respect for the armies guarding it, and you borrow their strength to overwhelm your foes. Your body transforms into a swarm of bees.
as a thousand soldiers.source:
Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
 pg. 79

ash strider.name: Ash Strider
ash strider.text: You discorporate into a cloud of whirling ash and Stride. If you have a fly Speed, you can Fly instead. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, you can move through occupied spaces and tiny cracks, and you ignore any difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain that wouldn't impede smoke.

ashen veil.name: Ashen Veil
ashen veil.text: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead. You become concealed to undead using vision or lifesense, allowing you to Hide and Sneak without other sources of cover or concealment.

ask the bones.name: Ask the Bones
ask the bones.text: You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice. Attempt to Recall Knowledge. If the bones belonged to a person particularly knowledgeable on the subject, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check.

asp stance.name: Asp Stance
asp stance.text: You adopt a fluid, sinuous stance, swaying your body, twisting your arms, and shimmying your legs in a way that you seem almost to glide over the ground. While in this stance, your unarmed Strikes deal piercing damage, and you gain poison resistance equal to half your level.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.text: You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark. Make a Strike against your mark. If you hit, your mark takes an additional 6d6 precision damage with a basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
assassinate.requirements: You have designated a mark using Mark for Death and are completely unnoticed by your mark.

assisting shot.name: Assisting Shot
assisting shot.text: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat. Make a Strike with a ranged weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circums…
assisting shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon

assume earth's mantle.name: Assume Earth's Mantle
assume earth's mantle.text: Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body. You can Dismiss this impulse. You become Large if you were smaller. This increases your reach by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny).You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed, but you can use it only to climb surfaces of earthen matter.The armor grants…

astonishing explosion.name: Astonishing Explosion
astonishing explosion.text: Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded. Any target hit by your Strike with the bomb is fascinated by you for 1 round. On a critical success, the target is also stunned 1.
astonishing explosion.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that deals splash damage and is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

astral compound invocation.name: Astral Compound Invocation
astral compound invocation.text: Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes. You Invoke two Runes; one must be an arcane rune, and one must be an occult rune.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected by the compound invocation.
The target is stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.
The target is stupefied 2 until the end of your next turn.
The target is stupefied 3 until the end of your next turn.

astral insight.name: Astral Insight
astral insight.text: You call out to an ally, imparting an insight you acquired while stargazing. The ally can reroll the triggering check or saving throw but must use the new result.
astral insight.trigger: A willing ally you can see within 30 feet critically fails a skill check or saving throw.

astral tether.name: Astral Tether
astral tether.text: You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities. Choose a willing creature within 60 feet and connect to it. Whenever you would gain a benefit from a psychic amp, you can have the amp affect the tethered creature instead.

athlete's ally.name: Athlete's Ally
athlete's ally.text: You channel the power of your warshard through your weapon to better perform athletic maneuvers. Spend a Mythic Point. For 1 minute, when you attempt Athletics checks to Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip with your warshard weapon, you do so at mythic proficiency.
athlete's ally.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 85

attunement shift.name: Attunement Shift
attunement shift.text: The magic of your spell floods into you, overriding your connection to the land around you. You alter your terrain attunement to a terrain that matches a trait of the spell you just cast.
attunement shift.requirements: Your previous action was to cast a spell with the air, cold, earth, fire, plant, or water trait.

augment senses.name: Augment Senses
augment senses.text: You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits: you can't be flanked; when you Seek for creatures, you can scan a 60-foot cone or a 30-foot burst instead of the normal area; and when you Seek for hidden objects…

aura expertise.name: Aura Expertise
aura expertise.text: You’ve become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it’s become second nature to you. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain action for one of your battle auras.

avalanche strike.name: Avalanche Strike
avalanche strike.text: You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike with your two-handed weapon against each enemy within its melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don’t increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
avalanche strike.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

avatar's protection.name: Avatar's Protection
avatar's protection.text: In moments of danger, you can call upon your god’s form in an instant. You cast avatar from your spell slots. The triggering critical hit is reduced to a normal hit, and its damage is applied after gaining the avatar spell’s temporary Hit Points.
avatar's protection.trigger: You are critically hit by an enemy
avatar's protection.requirements: You have an avatar spell prepared

avenge ally.name: Avenge Ally
avenge ally.text: Though you know that you will eventually outlive your companions, seeing them at death's door brings clarity to your attacks. Make a Strike. Roll twice on the attack roll and use the higher result.
avenge ally.requirements: You are within 30 feet of an ally with the dying condition

avenge in glory.name: Avenge in Glory
avenge in glory.text: You honor your ally’s life, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. As long as you have these temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls.
avenge in glory.trigger: An ally within 30 feet gains the dying condition.

awake with a roar.name: Awake With a Roar
awake with a roar.text: When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting. All enemies in the area must attempt a Will save against your world rouser DC. A creature that attempts this save or observes this ability becomes temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature becomes frightened 2 and stunned 1.
The creature becomes frightened 3 and stunned 1.

banish falsehoods of flesh.name: Banish Falsehoods of Flesh
banish falsehoods of flesh.text: Your ability to manipulate supernatural energy allows you to deploy divine magic directly against a disguised enemy to reveal them as they truly are, or to cleanse an ally from an unwilling transformation.

banishing blow.name: Banishing Blow
banishing blow.text: The erratic teleportation magic you experienced in the Kortos Mounts has taught you a few tricks. You attempt an Athletics check to Shove the fiend that triggered your champion's reaction; on a success, the target can't teleport or summon creatures for 1 minute.
banishing blow.trigger: You use your champion's reaction, triggered by a fiend within your reach.

banner twirl.name: Banner Twirl
banner twirl.text: You spin your banner in an elaborate pattern that your enemies find inscrutable. You and any ally adjacent to you have concealment from ranged attacks until the start of your next turn

banner's inspiration.name: Banner's Inspiration
banner's inspiration.text: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear. Each ally currently benefiting from your commander's banner reduces their frightened condition by 1 and can immediately attempt a new saving throw against any one mental effect currently affecting them.

barreling charge.name: Barreling Charge
barreling charge.text: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe. You Stride, attempting to move through your enemies’ spaces. Roll an Athletics check and compare the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature whose space you attempt to move through during your Stride, moving through its space on a success but ending your mov…

barrier of boreal frost.name: Barrier of Boreal Frost
barrier of boreal frost.text: You form an intricate structure of ice, such as a wall of bricks made of packed snow or a screen of enormous icicles. This has the effect of a wall of ice spell with a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. It can only be a wall (not a hemisphere), and you choose whether the ice is transparent or opaque.

bashing charge.name: Bashing Charge
bashing charge.text: You smash, bust, and charge through solid obstacles without hesitation. Stride twice. Once during your movement, if your movement passes through or ends adjacent to a door, window, fence, wall, or similar obstacle, you can attempt an Athletics check to Force Open the obstacle with a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll; o…

bat around.name: Bat Around
bat around.text: Your attack moves a foe into a position that your united companion can take full advantage of. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. As long as your Strike deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to either Reposition or Shove the creature you hit.

bat form.name: Bat Form
bat form.text: You can transform into a bat. You gain the effects of a 4th-level pest form spell. At 14th level, you can choose to spend two actions instead of one to gain the effects of a 4th- or 5th-level aerial form spell instead (bat form only).

battle assessment.name: Battle Assessment
battle assessment.text: With careful observation during battle, you identify an enemy’s strengths and weaknesses. The GM rolls a secret Perception check for you against the Deception or Stealth DC (whichever is higher) of an enemy of your choice who is not concealed from you, hidden from you, or undetected by you, and who is engaged in combat…

outcomes.text: The GM chooses two of the following pieces of information about the enemy to tell you: which of the enemy’s weaknesses is highest, which of the enemy’s saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy’s resistances is highest.
The GM chooses one piece of information from the above list to tell you about the enemy.
The GM gives you false information (the GM makes up the information).

battle hymn to the lost.name: Battle Hymn to the Lost
battle hymn to the lost.text: Your movements in combat are an artistic dirge to those spirits who could not fight to see another day. You make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike succeeds, spirits of warriors who died gloriously in battle surge out to attack with you.

battle medicine.name: Battle Medicine
battle medicine.text: You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for Treat Wounds and restore the corresponding amount of HP; this doesn't remove the wounded condition. As with Treat Wounds, you can attempt checks against higher DCs if you have the minimum proficiency rank.
battle medicine.requirements: You're holding or wearing a healer's toolkit.

battle prayer.name: Battle Prayer
battle prayer.text: Calling out to your deity, you recite scripture to harm a foe. When you select this feat, choose chaos, evil, good, or law. Your choice must match one of your deity’s alignment components. This action has the trait corresponding to the chosen alignment.

outcomes.text: You deal 2d6 damage of the chosen alignment type, or 6d6 damage if you have legendary proficiency in Religion.
You deal 1d6 damage of the chosen alignment type, or 3d6 damage if you have legendary proficiency in Religion.
There is no effect.
The backlash of your foe’s will against your prayer prevents you from using Battle Prayer again for 10 minutes.

battlefield agility.name: Battlefield Agility
battlefield agility.text: Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself. Make a melee Strike against one of the enemies flanking you and Step, in any order.
battlefield agility.requirements: You’re flanked by at least two enemies.

battlefield arcana.name: Battlefield Arcana
battlefield arcana.text: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle. If the next action you use is to cast a wizard cantrip, or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest rank wizard spell slot you have, that spell does not trigger reactions that normally trigger due to a spell being cast or someone u…

battlefront sabotage.name: Battlefront Sabotage
battlefront sabotage.text: You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry. You can attempt to sabotage a siege weapon or vehicle with a Thievery check against the standard DC of the weapon or vehicle's level.

be right back.name: Be Right Back
be right back.text: You can manipulate time to produce an item in a seemingly impossible fashion. You flicker a few times as you make adjustments to your gear, then solidify again with a specific needed item that you purchased from an alternate timeline using coin you have on your person.
be right back.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

bear hug (ursine avenger).name: Bear Hug (Ursine Avenger)
bear hug (ursine avenger).text: You snatch at your opponent with your claws, pulling them close in a ferocious bear hug. You make another claw Strike against the same target. If this Strike hits, the target is also grabbed.
bear hug (ursine avenger).requirements: Your last action was a successful claw Strike.

bear hug (werecreature).name: Bear Hug (Werecreature)
bear hug (werecreature).text: You hug your opponent. You make another claw Strike against the same target. If this Strike hits, the target is grabbed until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes.
bear hug (werecreature).requirements: You’re in bear or hybrid shape, and your last action was a successful claw Strike.

beast dynamo howl.name: Beast Dynamo Howl
beast dynamo howl.text: You've incorporated beast tech from Arcadia into your dynamo, adding in components from various terrifying creatures to enhance your prosthesis's capabilities. The beast parts can unleash a disturbing howl as you make a powerful attack with your dynamo.

beastmaster's call.name: Beastmaster's Call
beastmaster's call.text: You quickly call in a primal projection of a non-active companion to provide the companion’s support benefit. The projection arrives in an unoccupied square of your choice within 30 feet of you, grants you its support benefit, and then disappears at the start of your next turn.

beasts of slumbering steel.name: Beasts of Slumbering Steel
beasts of slumbering steel.text: You conjure metal elemental mounts made of interlocking metal pieces. Target up to 5 Medium or smaller willing creatures within 30 feet. Large mounts appear underneath them, and the targets can immediately Mount the creatures. Each mount can take four different forms.

beckoning dirge.name: Beckoning Dirge
beckoning dirge.text: Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet. This turn, you can Cast one Spell that’s in your dirge without spending a spell slot or even having it prepared. The maximum rank of this spell is 1 rank lower than your highest-rank necromancer spell slot.

become as shadow.name: Become As Shadow
become as shadow.text: By tapping into your ancestral connection to the Netherworld, your corporeal form transforms into the stuff of shadow. For 1 minute, you become as insubstantial as shadow.

become destiny.name: Become Destiny
become destiny.text: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose. Spend a Mythic Point, and remove any one condition you’re afflicted with, end the ongoing effects of any one spell you’re currently affected by, or free yourself from the effects of any one trap or hazard (such as a snare or bottomless pit).

begin stampede.name: Begin Stampede
begin stampede.text: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow. You Stride up to twice your Speed and make a horns melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride up to twice their Speed, but each must end their Stride closer t…

beguiling aura.name: Beguiling Aura
beguiling aura.text: You channel your manipulative magic to subtly give off mental signals that either drive enemies away or draw them closer. You gain a 30-foot aura that lasts for 1 minute.

belay that!.name: Belay That!
belay that!.text: You can recognize when a strategy isn’t working and advise your ally to change course. The next Strike the triggering ally makes before the end of their turn has the same multiple attack penalty as the critically failed Strike, but it counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.
belay that!.trigger: An ally within 30 feet of you critically fails a Strike.

belly flop.name: Belly Flop
belly flop.text: You crush an enemy under the enormous weight of your armor. You drop prone and make a fist Strike against the prone enemy. You don't take the penalty from being prone to this Strike's attack roll, nor do you need to have a free hand to make it.
belly flop.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor and are standing adjacent to a prone enemy.

benefactor's majesty.name: Benefactor's Majesty
benefactor's majesty.text: You tap into the grandeur of your warren's benefactor. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last for 1 minute. In addition, you can immediately attempt a flat check to remove each type of persistent damage you have.

benefactor's wings.name: Benefactor's Wings
benefactor's wings.text: Calling on your draconic gift, spectral wings carry you to your destination. You Fly. If you don’t normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If your spectral dragon shares your space, this fly Speed is instead 30 feet, and your spectral dragon moves with you.
benefactor's wings.requirements: You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

benevolent spirit deck.name: Benevolent Spirit Deck
benevolent spirit deck.text: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards that seek to protect you or an ally. Select one willing target within 30 feet; the cards move through the air to surround that target, protecting them from harm and granting a +1 status bonus to AC and resistance 5 to a type of damage associated with your active harrow omen (…
benevolent spirit deck.requirements: You have an active harrow omen.

bespell strikes.name: Bespell Strikes
bespell strikes.text: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you’re wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist. Until the end of your turn, the weapon or unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage and gains the associated trait (see below) if it didn’t have it already.
bespell strikes.requirements: Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell

bestial snarling.name: Bestial Snarling
bestial snarling.text: You can convey the subtle menace of a low growl or predatory rumble. Attempt a Nature or Performance check, and compare it to the Will DC of each enemy adjacent to you. If you have an animal minion, such as an animal companion or summoned animal, you can also compare it to each enemy adjacent to them.

betraying shank.name: Betraying Shank
betraying shank.text: While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception. In a flash, you draw a sheathed or concealed agile or finesse weapon and make a melee Strike. The target is off-guard against your Strike. You then roll Deception for initiative.
betraying shank.requirements: You are within melee reach of a target, but it is not in combat with you.

big debut.name: Big Debut
big debut.text: Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it. You strike a dramatic pose, deliver a snappy quip, or reveal a shocking new costume, captivating everyone who can see you. You don't roll initiative. Instead, you voluntarily go last.

bizarre transformation.name: Bizarre Transformation
bizarre transformation.text: The forms you take on defy belief—chimerical sights of twisted antlers or acidic drool. If your next action is to cast untamed form, you can change the damage type of a single unarmed attack granted by untamed form to one of the following: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, poison, piercing, or slashing.

black cat curse.name: Black Cat Curse
black cat curse.text: You hiss a spiteful curse. The target rerolls the triggering saving throw and use the worse result.
black cat curse.trigger: A creature within 30 feet you can see would succeed at a save.

black powder blaze.name: Black Powder Blaze
black powder blaze.text: You learn to take advantage of every shot, flying across the battlefield with the help of your weapon's recoil. Stride and use Black Powder Boost. Make a melee Strike with the required weapon at any point during the Black Powder Boost.

black powder boost.name: Black Powder Boost
black powder boost.text: You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther. You Leap and discharge your firearm to add a +10-foot status bonus to the distance traveled. If you spend 2 actions for Black Powder Boost, you High Jump or Long Jump instead.

black powder embodiment.name: Black Powder Embodiment
black powder embodiment.text: You merge your body with your ammunition, enabling you to travel the same path as your bolt or bullet. Strike a creature with the required weapon. On a success, if the target was within 120 feet, you and all your gear are teleported to an open space of your choice within 10 feet of the target.
black powder embodiment.requirements: You're wielding a loaded magical firearm or crossbow.

black powder flash.name: Black Powder Flash
black powder flash.text: You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face. Choose an adjacent creature. It must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC.
black powder flash.source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can rub its eyes as an Interact action to end this blinded condition.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

blade brake.name: Blade Brake
blade brake.text: You plow your weapon into a floor, wall, or another sturdy surface, anchoring yourself in place. If you would be moved 20 feet or more, you are moved only 5 feet. Otherwise, you don’t move at all.
blade brake.trigger: You would be moved by a forced movement effect
blade brake.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon and are within reach of a hard surface

blade of justice.name: Blade of Justice
blade of justice.text: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed harming an ally or innocent. The Strike deals two extra weapon damage dice if the target of your Strike is unholy.

blade of law.name: Blade of Law
blade of law.text: You call upon the power of law against a foe who would dare stand against you. Make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the target. This counts as two Strikes for your multiple attack penalty. The Strike deals one extra weapon damage die and 1d8 spirit damage. At 18th level, this spirit damage increases to 2d8.
blade of law.requirements: The target has attempted a hostile action against you since your previous turn.

blade of the crimson oath.name: Blade of the Crimson Oath
blade of the crimson oath.text: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe. The Strike deals two extra weapon damage dice, and you can convert all the physical damage from the attack into positive damage.

blade of the heart.name: Blade of the Heart
blade of the heart.text: The bonds of the heart are stronger than any steel, more powerful than any magic. You plunge your transformed weapon into the heart of a willing adjacent ally, where it phases harmlessly into their body.

blanket defense.name: Blanket Defense
blanket defense.text: You become a bulwark against foes' attacks that target you and your allies. Raise a Shield. Until the start of your next turn or until you no longer have your shield raised, each ally that ends their turn adjacent to you gains the benefits of your raised shield.

blast lock.name: Blast Lock
blast lock.text: Sometimes taking the shortest distance between two points involves removing an obstacle or two. You shoot your firearm at a lock within 10 feet. Make an attack roll against the DC required to Pick the Lock.

outcomes.text: You open the lock, or you achieve two successes toward opening a complex lock.
You open the lock, or you achieve one success toward opening a complex lock.
You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a –2 circumstance penalty.
You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it much harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a –4 circumstance penalty.

blast tackle.name: Blast Tackle
blast tackle.text: You throw yourself at an enemy, bracing your weapon against it and pulling it close before releasing a destructive shot. Attempt to Grapple; if you're wielding your weapon in both hands, you Release one hand to do so.
blast tackle.requirements: You're wielding a two-handed crossbow or a firearm that has the kickback or scatter trait.

blasting beams.name: Blasting Beams
blasting beams.text: A directed beam of heat or an arc of lightning is one of the simplest ways to project energy. You fire a blast or beam from one hand. Make an attack roll against a creature within 30 feet. If you succeed, the beam deals 1d6 damage to the target for every 2 levels you have, or double damage on a critical success.

blaze of revelation.name: Blaze of Revelation
blaze of revelation.text: Your mind and body can, for a short time and with great peril, surpass the final limits of your curse. For 1 minute, you shed torrential flames, become surrounded by spirits, or otherwise overflow with divine power in a way that suits your mystery.

outcomes.text: You aren’t otherwise affected.
You are drained 2 and can't reduce or remove this condition until your next preparations.
You are drained 4 and can't reduce or remove this condition until your next preparations.
You die.

blazing aura.name: Blazing Aura
blazing aura.text: You explode in flame. Enemies in a 20-foot emanation take 7d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). Allies in the area are quickened for 1 round and can use the additional action to Strike or Stride.

blazing spirit.name: Blazing Spirit
blazing spirit.text: Your apparition grants fiery defenses. You gain resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage, and the triggering creature takes 1d6 fire damage and 1 persistent fire damage.
blazing spirit.trigger: A creature damages you with a melee attack
blazing spirit.requirements: Your attuned apparition grants Battlegrounds Lore or Volcano Lore as an apparition skill.

blazing streak.name: Blazing Streak
blazing streak.text: Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement. Flashing sparks Strikes made during Blazing Streak deal fire damage instead of slashing.

blazing talon surge.name: Blazing Talon Surge
blazing talon surge.text: You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire. Stride once. If you end your movement within reach of at least one enemy, you can make a fire talon Strike against that enemy that deals an additional 1d4 persistent fire damage.
blazing talon surge.requirements: You are in Rain of Embers Stance.

blazing wave.name: Blazing Wave
blazing wave.text: Flames flow out of you in a cascade, engulfing everyone in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 4d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails its save is knocked prone. Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

bleak humorist.name: Bleak Humorist
bleak humorist.text: You’ve watched dozens of morbid comedies depicting Beldam I, Taldor’s prankster emperor whose wife accidentally killed him when she struck him with a marble bust after he jumped out from behind curtains to frighten her.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is distracted by giggles and can’t use reactions until the beginning of your next turn.
The target laughs uncontrollably. It can’t use reactions until the beginning of your next turn and is slowed 1.
As failure, but the target also immediately falls prone.

bleak humorist.trigger: You are reduced to 0 Hit Points by a creature within 30 feet, but not immediately killed

bleed out.name: Bleed Out
bleed out.text: You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the AC of a target within 60 feet. This attack deals persistent bleed damage equal to the rank of the spell you just cast.
bleed out.requirements: Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell that granted you a blood magic effect.

bleeding finisher.name: Bleeding Finisher
bleeding finisher.text: Your blow inflicts profuse bleeding. Make a slashing or piercing Strike. If you hit, the target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to your precise strike finisher damage.

bless shield.name: Bless Shield
bless shield.text: Your uttered prayers become an aegis, drawing the blessing of your deity across the surface of your shield. Until the beginning of your next turn your shield, any shield boss, or shield spikes gain the effects of a ghost touch property rune.

blessed counterstrike.name: Blessed Counterstrike
blessed counterstrike.text: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction. The Strike deals one extra weapon damage die. If this Strike hits, until the start of your next turn, the target gains weakness equal to half your level to all Strikes made by you and your allies.
blessed counterstrike.requirements: An enemy triggered your champion’s reaction since the end of your last turn.

blessed denial.name: Blessed Denial
blessed denial.text: You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally. Reduce the value of the condition your ally would take by 1 (to a minimum of 0). If the ally has more than one eligible condition at the same time, choose one to reduce.
blessed denial.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would become frightened, drained, enfeebled, sickened, or stupefied.

blessed sentinel.name: Blessed Sentinel
blessed sentinel.text: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of Ketephys and attack. Make a Strike. This Strike gains the holy trait and deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, or 2d4 spirit damage against fiends. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

blessed spell.name: Blessed Spell
blessed spell.text: When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell slot, and that spell targets only a single ally, you can also attempt to remove a harmful condition from that ally.

blessed thorn strike.name: Blessed Thorn Strike
blessed thorn strike.text: When you see a foe hurt one of your allies, your righteous retribution causes your weapon to sprout holy thorns. Make a Strike against the triggering enemy. If you hit and deal damage, the target must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become enfeebled 1…
blessed thorn strike.requirements: You witnessed an enemy harm an ally with a Strike or spell last round.

blood calls blood.name: Blood Calls Blood
blood calls blood.text: The magical potency of your blood will not be denied. You finish Casting the Spell, then become drained 1 or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.
blood calls blood.trigger: You fail a flat check to Cast a Spell or your spell would be disrupted by another creature’s reaction.

blood frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood frenzy.text: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. While in the frenzy, your eidolon is affected by boost eidolon and gains temporary HP equal to your level, but takes a –1 penalty to AC. The temporary HP last until the frenzy ends. They can’t voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy.
blood frenzy.requirements: Your eidolon’s last action dealt bleed damage to a living creature.

blood in the air.name: Blood in the Air
blood in the air.text: Once you've locked on to a target, little can obscure your aim. Make a ranged weapon Strike against the required target. This Strike ignores the target's concealed condition and reduces the flat check for the hidden condition from 11 to 5.
blood in the air.requirements: An enemy you've damaged with a ranged weapon during the last minute is concealed or hidden from you.

blood pool.name: Blood Pool
blood pool.text: You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies. You pool the blood of the creature on the ground in a space adjacent to the triggering creature, infusing it with healing properties. The pool lasts for 1 minute or until absorbed by an ally.
blood pool.trigger: A creature with blood within 30 feet of you dies or takes bleed damage.

blood rising.name: Blood Rising
blood rising.text: The magic in your blood surges in response to your foe's spell. You generate a blood magic effect you know, even if you are already under the effects of blood magic. The target must be either you or the creature that triggered Blood Rising.
blood rising.trigger: A creature targets you with a spell of the same tradition as your bloodline.

blood shield.name: Blood Shield
blood shield.text: You raise a defensive barrier of your own blood to protect you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, increasing to a +2 bonus if you spend 10 or more sanguimancy Hit Points. While this bonus is in effect, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your blood shield.

bloodline conduit.name: Bloodline Conduit
bloodline conduit.text: Your inborn magical nature lets you redirect ambient energies to fuel your spells. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the spell's slot when you cast it.

bloody denial.name: Bloody Denial
bloody denial.text: You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the result of the save is one degree of success worse. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success Choose an ally.

bloom cabaret entrance.name: Bloom Cabaret Entrance
bloom cabaret entrance.text: In socially exclusive venues like the Ivy District's Bloom Cabaret, you've learned how to make an entrance. This confidence doesn't betray you when you find yourself about to enter combat, allowing you to throw enemies temporarily off-balance. Once per day, you can choose to not roll initiative.

bloom of health.name: Bloom of Health
bloom of health.text: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom’s protectors. All your knights who hear your cry gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute.

boaster's challenge.name: Boaster's Challenge
boaster's challenge.text: You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat. Select one creature you can see and declare a challenge. For your challenge, attempt a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against that creature’s Will DC.

bodily disintegration.name: Bodily Disintegration
bodily disintegration.text: You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material. You focus on your physical body and will the parts of it to disassemble momentarily. You Stride. You can pass through creatures and tiny cracks during this movement.

body barrier.name: Body Barrier
body barrier.text: When your allies are in danger, you don’t hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them. You grant all allies in the area standard cover against the triggering effect, and you gain weakness to all damage against the triggering effect equal to twice the number of allies that gain cover in this way.
body barrier.trigger: You and at least one ally are in the area of an effect that requires a Reflex save.

body of air.name: Body of Air
body of air.text: Your gathered air consumes your body, leaving only a cloud of living vapor. This has the same effects on you as vapor form. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the form up to 5 minutes. If you activate your kinetic aura, Body of Air ends.
body of air.trigger: An enemy you can observe targets you with an attack or other damaging effect.

body shield.name: Body Shield
body shield.text: You throw an adjacent thrall in between you and the attacker. The thrall grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack still hits, you gain resistance to the triggering attack’s damage equal to your level. Regardless of the result, the thrall is destroyed.
body shield.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.
body shield.requirements: You are adjacent to at least one of your thralls.

bold defiance.name: Bold Defiance
bold defiance.text: You harden your form as you dance between shapes. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.

bolera's interrogation.name: Bolera's Interrogation
bolera's interrogation.text: You focus your attention on a single creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a Will save against your Perception DC. On a failure, the creature finds itself unable to speak any deliberate and intentional lies and takes a –2 penalty to Deception checks.
bolera's interrogation.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

bolster ally.name: Bolster Ally
bolster ally.text: You shout encouragement to your embattled ally. The ally can use your saving throw modifier instead of their own against the triggering spell.
bolster ally.trigger: One of your allies within 30 feet is targeted by a spell or ability that allows a saving throw.

bombing run.name: Bombing Run
bombing run.text: Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force. You Fly and can Interact to draw a bomb. At any point during your movement, you can also make a Strike with an alchemical bomb. The bomb deals its splash damage to every creature within 10 feet of the target.
bombing run.requirements: You currently have a fly Speed.

bon mot.name: Bon Mot
bon mot.text: You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them. Choose a foe within 30 feet and roll a Diplomacy check against the target's Will DC.

outcomes.text: The target is distracted and takes a –3 status penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 minute. The target can end the effect early with a retort to your Bon Mot. This can either be a single action that has the concentrate trait or an appropriate skill action to frame their retort.
As critical success, but the penalty is –2.
Your quip is atrocious. You take the same penalty an enemy would take had you succeeded. This ends after 1 minute or if you issue another Bon Mot and succeed.

bond conservation.name: Bond Conservation
bond conservation.text: By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker. You gain an extra use of Drain Bonded Item.
bond conservation.requirements: The last action you used was to Cast a Spell enabled by Drain Bonded Item

bonds of death.name: Bonds of Death
bonds of death.text: You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time. You Sustain your previous casting of animate dead, binding the necromantic energy of the two spells together with metaphysical twine.
bonds of death.requirements: You have cast animate dead this turn.

bone burst.name: Bone Burst
bone burst.text: You destroy the thrall in an explosion of bone shards that fly toward the triggering creature, dealing 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. The damage increases to 3d10 at 12th and to 4d10 at 18th level.
bone burst.trigger: A creature adjacent to one of your thralls uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using, and you are within 30 feet of the thrall.

bone spikes.name: Bone Spikes
bone spikes.text: Sharp shards of bone tear forth from your elbows, wrists, or other parts of your body. For 1 minute, you can make bone spike unarmed Strikes that deal 1d6 piercing damage and have the versatile S and sweep traits.

bone swarm.name: Bone Swarm
bone swarm.text: You scatter your body and transform into a whirling storm of bones for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape. You become Huge, gain the swarm trait, and gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. As a swarm, you have the following characteristics.

borrow time.name: Borrow Time
borrow time.text: You reach ahead and make use of time that's yet to be. You become quickened and can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike. You gain this extra action immediately and can use it this turn. At the end of your turn, you become stunned 1.

borrowed ability.name: Borrowed Ability
borrowed ability.text: Your touch opens a conduit into the mind of your target, the emptiness within you pulling skills and memories through. You touch an adjacent creature and choose any skill you believe they are trained or better in.

outcomes.text: The target resists your touch completely.

Your borrowing is unstable. At the beginning of each of your turns, you must either relinquish your hold on the borrowed skill (as a free action), or attempt another backlash check for your deviation; the ability ends if you fail.
Borrowed Ability lasts for its full duration.

boulder roll.name: Boulder Roll
boulder roll.text: Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern. Take a Step into the square of a foe that is your size or smaller, and the foe must move into the empty space directly behind it. The foe must move even if doing so places it in harm's way.

bounce back.name: Bounce Back
bounce back.text: You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience. Don’t increase the value of your wounded condition due to losing the dying condition.

bounce boost.name: Bounce Boost
bounce boost.text: You’ve learned to use your own athletic abilities and springy legs to help others who need a boost with their leaps. The triggering ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check to High Jump or Long Jump.
bounce boost.trigger: An adjacent ally attempts to High Jump or Long Jump.

brain drain.name: Brain Drain
brain drain.text: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own. One non-mindless creature within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute, and you regain 1 Focus Point, up to your normal maximum. You can't use Brain Drain again until after the next time you make your daily preparations.
As failure, but the creature is stupefied 2.

brains!.name: Brains!
brains!.text: You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor. You gain a +1 status bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge for 1 hour.
brains!.trigger: You Feast upon a humanoid's brain. The humanoid can't be mindless (or, if you're Feasting on a corpse, can't have been mindless while alive).

branding spell.name: Branding Spell
branding spell.text: The flames of your magic mark a target as an enemy of order. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that deals fire damage, that spell brands the target with a mark only you can see if it fails its saving throw. This brand lasts for 1 week.

brandish authority.name: Brandish Authority
brandish authority.text: With a terrifying pronouncement, you manifest a visible sign of your authority and fiendish power, such as a crown of flame upon your brow, a scepter forged of solidified souls, or a throne comprised of a dozen dragon skulls. This object appears in your space or in your hand, as appropriate, and remains for 1 minute.

brandishing draw.name: Brandishing Draw
brandishing draw.text: You draw and attack with the same motion. You Interact to draw a weapon, then either Strike or use a one-action finisher. You must still meet any other requirements to use a finisher, and any Strike you make must be made with the weapon you drew.

bravo's determination.name: Bravo's Determination
bravo's determination.text: Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds. Attempt a Deception check against the attack DC of the triggering Strike. You take a penalty to this check equal to twice your wounded value, if any.

outcomes.text: You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point.
You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, but you increase your wounded value by 1.

bravo's determination.trigger: A foe’s Strike reduces you to 0 Hit Points; you were not at 1 Hit Point and you would not be killed.

break the causal chain.name: Break the Causal Chain
break the causal chain.text: Something terrible has happened. A beloved ally has fallen, a last stand has failed, or a tyrant has beaten you to a crucial goal. Whatever it is, your heart sinks. How can this be? No, this can’t be. You spend a Mythic Point to alter reality as if you got a success (but not a critical success) with the wish ritual.

breath of hungry death.name: Breath of Hungry Death
breath of hungry death.text: You have uncovered occult mysteries that allow you to unleash the devastating hunger of Kabriri upon your foes with a single exhalation, releasing a massive cloud of flesh-eating gas that glows with a sickly green light.

breath of the dragon.name: Breath of the Dragon
breath of the dragon.text: Tapping into the physiology of your draconic ancestor, you can exhale a torrent of energy in a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line, dealing 1d4 damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

bring into the fold.name: Bring into the Fold
bring into the fold.text: Not all who oppress are irredeemable, and given encouragement and some time, they will abandon their cause and join your fight against the very system they used to uphold.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target’s attitude toward you improves by one step.
The target’s attitude toward you improves by two steps.

bristle.name: Bristle
bristle.text: You curl into a posture that splays out your bone spines. You gain a +1 circumstance to AC until the start of your next turn. Special If you have the Barbed Quills reaction or a quills unarmed attack, each gains a +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls until the start of your next turn.

brutal crush.name: Brutal Crush
brutal crush.text: You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks. Make an unarmed Strike against the same target. If the Strike hits and deals bludgeoning damage, the target is stupefied 2 for 1 round (stupefied 3 on a critical hit).
brutal crush.requirements: Your last action dealt bludgeoning damage using an unarmed Strike granted by a morph or polymorph effect.

brutal finish.name: Brutal Finish
brutal finish.text: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe’s defenses. Make a Strike with a melee weapon you’re wielding in two hands. After the Strike, your turn ends. The Strike deals one additional weapon damage die, or two additional weapon damage dice if you’re at least 18th level.

outcomes.text: You deal damage equal to one weapon damage die of the required weapon. Increase this to two dice if you’re at least 18th level.

brutal finish.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon in two hands

brutish shove.name: Brutish Shove
brutish shove.text: Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back. Make a Strike with a two-handed melee weapon. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is off-guard until the end of your current turn, and you can automatically Shove it, with the same…

outcomes.text: The target becomes off-guard until the end of your current turn.

brutish shove.requirements: You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon

buckler dance.name: Buckler Dance
buckler dance.text: You spin your buckler defensively toward every attack. You constantly have your buckler raised as if you'd used Raise a Shield, as long as you meet that action's requirements.

build the first walls.name: Build the First Walls
build the first walls.text: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall. You create a wall of dirt with the effects of wall of stone with the following exceptions. The wall can be up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high and must stand vertically, preventing you from building other structures with it.

bullet and a broadside.name: Bullet and a Broadside
bullet and a broadside.text: You’re familiar with ranged weapons of all sizes, and can efficiently move to use them in tandem. If you spent one action, you Launch the siege weapon and Strike with your firearm or crossbow in any order, using the same multiple attack penalty for both attacks.
bullet and a broadside.requirements: You’re wielding a firearm or crossbow and are adjacent to a siege weapon.

bullet dancer reload.name: Bullet Dancer Reload
bullet dancer reload.text: You've learned to reload your simple firearms with uncanny grace, the ammunition simply falling into place as though part of a well-practiced kata. You Strike with a simple firearm, and then Interact to reload that same firearm. You don't need a free hand to reload your simple firearm in this way.

bullet split.name: Bullet Split
bullet split.text: You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets. Make two Strikes, one each against two separate targets. The targets must be adjacent to each other and within your weapon's maximum range.
bullet split.requirements: You're wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand and a slashing (or versatile S) melee weapon in the other.

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.text: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe’s concealment and cover. On your next Strike with a thrown weapon before the end of your turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and ignore your target’s concealed condition, as well as the target’s lesser cover or standard cover; if the target had greater cov…

burn identity.name: Burn Identity
burn identity.text: You transport yourself up to 1 mile, as a 5th-rank translocate spell. Everyone who has seen you in the last 24 hours must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or forget your physical appearance as though affected by a 6th-rank rewrite memory spell.

burning demand.name: Burning Demand
burning demand.text: You create a faintly glowing sigil (shedding normal light in a 5-foot radius) on the target’s body, after which you command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the fleeing condition), release what it’s holding, drop prone, or stand in place.

outcomes.text: The sigil immediately vanishes, and the creature is unaffected.

The sigil acts as a magnet for your fiery attacks, granting the creature a –1 penalty to its saves and AC against your fire impulses. The sigil lasts until the end of your next turn or until the creature spends at least 1 action obeying your command, whichever happens first.

At the start of the creature’s next turn, if it doesn’t use their first action to obey the command, the sigil ignites as it vanishes, dealing 8d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent fire damage to the creature.

The creature must spend the first action of its next turn to obey your command; it can’t Delay. The sigil vanishes at the end of its turn; it ignites if the creature didn’t use all its remaining actions to continue to obey your command, dealing 8d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent fire damage to the creature.

burning jet.name: Burning Jet
burning jet.text: A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force. Stride up to 40 feet in a straight line. Movement from this impulse ignores difficult terrain and doesn't trigger reactions. Level (6th) The maximum distance of the Stride is 60 feet.

burning spell.name: Burning Spell
burning spell.text: You enhance your spell with elemental fire, causing it to set the target on fire. If the next action you use is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that deals damage at a single target, the spell deals additional persistent fire damage equal to the spell rank, in addition to its other effects.

burning surge.name: Burning Surge
burning surge.text: You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it. The triggering creature and all creatures adjacent to it take 1d6 damage per rank of the spell (basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).
burning surge.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell within your spellsurge aura.

burrowing shot.name: Burrowing Shot
burrowing shot.text: You tune your light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces. You Launch your light mortar, dealing half the normal amount of damage to creatures in the area of the blast but double damage to objects and structures.

bushwhack.name: Bushwhack
bushwhack.text: You appear from seemingly nowhere to grab an unsuspecting victim. Stride up to 10 feet and attempt to Grapple a creature you are undetected by. If you succeed, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier to the target (double damage if you critically succeed).
bushwhack.requirements: You are undetected by a creature.

by your name.name: By Your Name
by your name.text: In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name. Attempt a Crafting check against a standard DC of the target creature’s level.

outcomes.text: You understand the target’s runic name and temporarily learn how to write their name as a special diacritic rune. This diacritic rune magnifies the effects of the base rune when targeting the named creature.
As critical success, but the rune doesn’t grant a bonus to damage.

by your name.requirements: You must know the target’s name.

cadence call.name: Cadence Call
cadence call.text: You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm. Each willing ally in your marshal’s aura is quickened until the end of their next turn, and they can use the extra action only to Stride.

calaca's showstopper.name: Calaca's Showstopper
calaca's showstopper.text: You've spent many an evening learning songs and tales featuring calacas, death's wandering minstrels. You dramatically unleash a stunning blast of sound by smashing an instrument you hold or belting out a discordant note. This has the effects of synaptic pulse, but the effect is auditory rather than mental.

calcifying sand.name: Calcifying Sand
calcifying sand.text: Your flesh gives way as you're struck, becoming coarse sand that can magically turn your enemy to stone. You gain resistance equal to your level to physical damage from the triggering attack. The attacking creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.
The creature is petrified until the end of its next turn.

calcifying sand.trigger: A creature damages you with an attack using an unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon.

call and response.name: Call and Response
call and response.text: Your composition takes the form of a call-and-response chant that lets your allies continue the effect without you. If your next action is to cast a composition cantrip with a duration of 1 round, it becomes a call.

call from death's door.name: Call from Death's Door
call from death's door.text: Even death halts in the face of your power. Spend a Mythic Point; the triggering ally loses the dying condition, their wounded condition doesn’t increase, and they heal a number of Hit Points equal to twice your level.
call from death's door.trigger: The dying condition of an ally you’re observing would increase.

call hellfire.name: Call Hellfire
call hellfire.text: You unleash a blast of hellish fire. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation around you takes 6d6 fire damage and 1d4 persistent spirit damage, with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

call implement.name: Call Implement
call implement.text: You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you. You look down and find that your implement has mysteriously appeared in your free hand, as long as the implement was within 1 mile and on the same plane of existence.

call sprite swarm.name: Call Sprite Swarm
call sprite swarm.text: You erupt into a swarm of even tinier bodies or call up hidden compatriots from nearby, rallying countless sprites to a common cause. You become a swarm, returning to your normal form after 1 minute or by Dismissing the effect.

call the first tools.name: Call the First Tools
call the first tools.text: You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment’s notice. You conjure forth a simple tool, such as a shovel or hammer, into your hands. This tool remains conjured until your next daily preparations so long as it’s on your person.

call the hunt.name: Call The Hunt
call the hunt.text: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey. Until the start of your next turn, whenever your hunted prey is within reach of you and at least one of your allies, it is off-guard to all melee attacks.
call the hunt.requirements: You are observing your hunted prey.

call the hurricane.name: Call the Hurricane
call the hurricane.text: Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane. The waves appear in a 20-foot emanation, or a 30-foot emanation if you're in a body of water. Each creature in the area takes 6d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

call the swarm.name: Call the Swarm
call the swarm.text: You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet. The rats scurry over the ground and climb up walls and surfaces, biting and clawing as they deal 6d8 piercing damage to all enemies in the area.

call to battle.name: Call to Battle
call to battle.text: You channel the undying spirit of the einherjar to join to fight. You Stand. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions.

call wizardly tools.name: Call Wizardly Tools
call wizardly tools.text: You’re mystically connected to your wizardly tools, ensuring you can always find them when you’ve misplaced them. You teleport your bonded item or spellbook to you. It arrives in your hand if you have a free hand or at your feet if you don’t. The item must be within 1 mile and have 1 Bulk or less.

call worm spirit.name: Call Worm Spirit
call worm spirit.text: You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit. Choose an intersection on the ground within 60 feet; the ghostly maw of a worm emerges from the ground, attacking all creatures in a 10 foot burst. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.
call worm spirit.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes 1d10+13 bludgeoning damage as it is battered by the worm's body.
The target takes 3d10+15 piercing damage as it is bitten by the worm. The target is immobilized until the end of its next turn.
As failure, but the damage increases to 6d10+30 and the target is knocked prone.

called shot.name: Called Shot
called shot.text: You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect. Declare a part of your foe's anatomy to target and make a ranged weapon Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target takes one of the following effects, based on the body part you targeted.

can't fall here.name: Can't Fall Here
can't fall here.text: You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds. Your ally doesn't fall unconscious and remains at 1 Hit Point. The ally also gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.
can't fall here.trigger: An adjacent and willing ally would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed.

cannibalize magic.name: Cannibalize Magic
cannibalize magic.text: The fey magic inside of you is a vital part of your body, and you can steal other sources of magic to replenish yours. You can draw power from your magical equipment to replenish your health. You drain one of your invested items, in the process regaining Hit Points equal to double the item's level.

cannonball fall.name: Cannonball Fall
cannonball fall.text: You’ve learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy. You intentionally fall onto an enemy within 10 feet of you horizontally and can accurately target them from up to a height equal to 5 feet times your level.

outcomes.text: The enemy takes no damage.
The enemy takes bludgeoning damage equal to one quarter the falling damage you took.
The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to half the falling damage you took and is knocked prone.
The creature takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage you took from the fall, is knocked prone, and is stunned 1.

cantorian rejuvenation.name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
cantorian rejuvenation.text: The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you. You recover 4d6 Hit Points and gain 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute. At 15th level, you instead recover 6d6 HP and gain 15 temporary HP.

cantorian restoration.name: Cantorian Restoration
cantorian restoration.text: The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times. You prevent the creature from dying and restore 6d8 + your Constitution modifier Hit Points to it. You can't use Cantorian Restoration if the triggering effect was a death effect or an effect that leaves no remains, such as disintegrate.
cantorian restoration.trigger: A living creature within 60 feet would die.

capture magic.name: Capture Magic
capture magic.text: When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use. You enter your Arcane Cascade stance, using the triggering spell to determine what damage type your Arcane Cascade deals. Alternatively, if you’re already in Arcane Cascade, you can instead amplify its effects temporarily.
capture magic.trigger: You succeed at your save against an enemy’s harmful spell, or an enemy fails a spell attack roll against you from a harmful spell.

caretaker's restoration.name: Caretaker's Restoration
caretaker's restoration.text: The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you. The triggering item is restored to a number of Hit Points that is 1 higher than its Broken Threshold. For example, a steel shield with a Broken Threshold of 10 is restored to 11 Hit Points.
caretaker's restoration.trigger: An item you’re holding, wearing, or wielding becomes broken but not destroyed.

cartwheel dodge.name: Cartwheel Dodge
cartwheel dodge.trigger: You succeed or critically succeed at a Reflex saving throw.

cascade bearer's flexibility.name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility
cascade bearer's flexibility.text: You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation. Until the end of your turn, you gain a single metamagic feat from the druid class or the wizard class that has a level requirement of no more than half your level.
cascade bearer's flexibility.requirements: You haven’t yet acted on your turn.

cascading ray.name: Cascading Ray
cascading ray.text: Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck. The flowing energy forms a ray with a range of 120 feet originating from the creature you damaged. You can’t target any of the creatures you damaged with your Spellstrike with the ray.
cascading ray.requirements: Your last action was a successful Spellstrike, and the spell you cast dealt energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void).

cast down.name: Cast Down
cast down.text: The sheer force of your faith can bring a foe crashing down. If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal to damage one creature, the target is knocked prone if it takes any damage from the spell.

cast out.name: Cast Out
cast out.text: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing. Roll a counteract check against the possession effect; you must be within 30 feet of the possessed creature or object to do so.

cat's luck.name: Cat's Luck
cat's luck.text: You instinctively twist away from danger. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
cat's luck.trigger: You fail a Reflex saving throw

catch and kill.name: Catch and Kill
catch and kill.text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. When you've decided to quash a story, no one can escape from you with any incriminating information. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the triggering creature is Grabbed, and on a critical hit, they're slowed 1.
catch and kill.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

catchy tune.name: Catchy Tune
catchy tune.text: You create a tune so catchy your foes can’t help but dance along. Attempt a Performance check and compare it to the Will DCs of all enemies in a 30-foot emanation.

outcomes.text: The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds and is off-guard, both until the start of your next turn.
The creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.
The creature is unaffected.
The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Catchy Tune for 1 hour.

caterwaul.name: Caterwaul
caterwaul.text: You give a daring yowl, calling your companion back from the brink of unconsciousness. Your ally isn't knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point. Their wounded condition still increases by 1 as though they had been dying and recovered.
caterwaul.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 HP but not immediately killed.

catfolk dance.name: Catfolk Dance
catfolk dance.text: You have a habit of always being in the way when other creatures attempt to move. Attempt an Acrobatics check against an adjacent creature's Reflex DC.

outcomes.text: The target creature gains a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and is off-guard until the start of your next turn.
The target creature gains a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.

cauterize.name: Cauterize
cauterize.text: You use the smoking barrel of your firearm to sear shut a bleeding wound. Make a Strike with your firearm. You then press the heated barrel to the wounds of you or an ally within reach that is taking persistent bleed damage, giving an immediate flat check to end the bleed with the lower DC for particularly effective as…
cauterize.trigger: You're wielding a loaded firearm and you or an adjacent ally are taking persistent bleed damage.

cautious word.name: Cautious Word
cautious word.text: You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge. You immediately cast shield and gain its bonus to AC even though you normally couldn’t cast it, and you become slowed 1 for 1 round.
cautious word.trigger: An enemy hits you with a Strike.
cautious word.requirements: You’re currently unable to cast shield because you used Shield Block with it.

cavalier's charge.name: Cavalier's Charge
cavalier's charge.text: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride twice. At any point during this movement, you can Strike one enemy within reach or within the first range increment of a ranged weapon. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.

cavorting accompaniment.name: Cavorting Accompaniment
cavorting accompaniment.text: When you move particularly acrobatically, your twirling movements vibrate your legs like an instrument, producing beautiful music. You Step or Tumble Through and use Catchy Tune at any point during your movement.

celestial cacophony.name: Celestial Cacophony
celestial cacophony.text: Your weapon contains a detonation chamber that launches fireworks, sparklers, and black powder pellets that sizzle, twist, and scatter on the ground in a cacophonous manner liable to annoy the entire Celestial Court.

cellular reconstruction.name: Cellular Reconstruction
cellular reconstruction.text: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die. You regain Hit Points equal to your level. For the next 2 rounds, at the start of your turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level.
cellular reconstruction.trigger: You fail a recovery check while dying.

cenotaph stance.name: Cenotaph Stance
cenotaph stance.text: You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall. When you enter this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in Cenotaph Stance, you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of your next turn.

ceremony of protection.name: Ceremony of Protection
ceremony of protection.text: You manipulate your exoskeleton to overlap itself. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

certain strike.name: Certain Strike
certain strike.text: Even when you don’t hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow. Make a melee Strike. It gains the following failure effect.

outcomes.text: Your attack deals any damage it would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes damage dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, in addition to weapon damage dice.)

chain infusion.name: Chain Infusion
chain infusion.text: The elemental matter in your blast keeps reconstituting itself to travel onward, no matter how many bodies it collides with. If your next action is an Elemental Blast and it hits, attempt a new ranged Elemental Blast from the target against a different creature that's within the blast's range, measuring from the creatu…

chain of words.name: Chain of Words
chain of words.text: You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another. You Invoke two Runes within 60 feet.

chain reaction.name: Chain Reaction
