chain reaction.text: You fire your gun once, creating a devastating and unpredictable chain of events; perhaps your bullet strikes exactly the right spot on a water tower, causing it to flood and incite a stampede of horses which knock over a lantern that sets a city on fire.

challenge insight.name: Challenge Insight
challenge insight.text: Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering spell. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up.
challenge insight.trigger: A creature you can see Casts a Spell that is from the divine or occult tradition.
challenge insight.requirements: The triggering caster must be able to hear and understand you.

chance death.name: Chance Death
chance death.text: Your previous life ended due to sheer poor luck, struck by lightning or choking on a fish bone. You can reroll the triggering recovery check or saving throw, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse. Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
chance death.trigger: You would die as a result of a failed recovery check or saving throw.

channel divine spark.name: Channel Divine Spark
channel divine spark.text: You embrace your divine spark, unleashing your full potential. Your nimbus automatically activates (if it isn’t already) and the area of your nimbus doubles; you shed bright light for 60 feet (and dim light to the next 60 feet). You can’t suppress your nimbus while Channeling your Divine Spark.

channel smite.name: Channel Smite
channel smite.text: You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike. On a hit, you cast the 1-action version of the expended spell to damage the target, in addition to the normal damage from your Strike.

channel the godmind.name: Channel the Godmind
channel the godmind.text: You tap into the collective consciousness of the Godmind, the governing entity of axiomite society, to rapidly parse near-infinite variables to read your surroundings.

channeled protection.name: Channeled Protection
channeled protection.text: Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you. You and all adjacent allies gain a +1 status bonus to your AC and to your Reflex saving throws until the start of your next turn. If the spell was at least 7th rank, the status bonus increase to +2.
channeled protection.requirements: You are in Channeler’s Stance and your last action was to Cast a Spell from your spell slots

channeler's stance.name: Channeler's Stance
channeler's stance.text: You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you. While in this stance, whenever you cast or Sustain an apparition spell or vessel spell that deals energy damage, you gain a status bonus to the spell’s damage equal to the spell’s rank.

chaotic spell.name: Chaotic Spell
chaotic spell.text: This is the secret of chaotic magic — your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, roll a d6.

charmed life.name: Charmed Life
charmed life.text: When danger calls, you have a strange knack for coming out on top. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering save. If you succeed on the triggering saving throw, you gain panache until the end of your next turn.
charmed life.trigger: You attempt a saving throw, but you haven’t rolled yet.

charred remains.name: Charred Remains
charred remains.text: Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an area and the fire trait, for 1 minute, your spell's area becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing 1 fire damage for each square a creature moves through.

chastise.name: Chastise
chastise.text: With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe’s fear to see their inner being brought low. You chastise the spirit of a foe within 30 feet that has the frightened condition. The target must attempt a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes 2 persistent spirit damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.
The target takes 4 persistent spirit damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.
The target takes 6 persistent spirit damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

cheat death.name: Cheat Death
cheat death.text: Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth. You avoid being knocked out or killed and remain at 1 Hit Point and gain panache, but you become doomed 1 (or increase your doomed value by 1 if you were already doomed). You can't reduce or ignore the doomed condition from Cheating Death.
cheat death.trigger: You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

chemical purification.name: Chemical Purification
chemical purification.text: You developed a method to chemically purify and consecrate your bombs on the fly. You include this additive mixture when crafting your alchemist's fire or ghost charge. The created bomb deals 1d4 persistent positive damage in addition to whatever damage it would normally cause.
chemical purification.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemist's fire or ghost charge, and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

chromotherapy.name: Chromotherapy
chromotherapy.text: You firmly believe in the technique of strengthening one's life force, spiritual energies, and bodily fluids through the application of colored light. When using a torch, lantern, or other artificial light source to illuminate an area of dim light or darker, you use a combination of alchemical reagents, medicinal compo…

circle of spirits.name: Circle of Spirits
circle of spirits.text: With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit. Choose another apparition from among those you’ve attuned to; it becomes your primary apparition, replacing your current one.

clan's edge.name: Clan's Edge
clan's edge.text: By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively. Make two clan dagger Strikes against different targets. Your multiple attack penalty applies normally to these Strikes.

clang!.name: Clang!
clang!.text: You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor. Either Strike the triggering enemy or Stride up to your Speed toward the triggering enemy. If you Stride and end your movement adjacent to the triggering enemy, it's off-guard until the end of your next turn.
clang!.trigger: An enemy critically misses a Strike or spell attack roll against your AC.

clarify hellfire.name: Clarify Hellfire
clarify hellfire.text: An obscure loophole in your contracts allows you to create hellfire that burns even devils. Until the end of your current turn, fire damage you deal to a devil bypasses that devil’s immunity to fire and gains the holy trait.

clashing compound invocation.name: Clashing Compound Invocation
clashing compound invocation.text: As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash. You Invoke two Runes, which must be from opposed traditions of magic; either 1 arcane and 1 divine rune, or 1 occult and 1 primal rune.

outcomes.text: The target is sickened 1, but if it spends a single action attempting to recover, it automatically succeeds.
The target is sickened 1.
The target is sickened 2.

claw and talon flow.name: Claw and Talon Flow
claw and talon flow.text: You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).
claw and talon flow.requirements: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.

claw snag.name: Claw Snag
claw snag.text: You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh. Shift into claw stance if you aren't in it already, then make a frenzied claw Strike against the triggering creature.
claw snag.trigger: A creature attempts to Escape while you have them grappled or restrained.

clean take.name: Clean Take
clean take.text: Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable. Even when your impressions don’t quite hit the mark, you’re able to refine and tweak your performance on the spot. Reroll the triggering check and take the second result.
clean take.trigger: You fail, but don’t critically fail, a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure.

cleansing light.name: Cleansing Light
cleansing light.text: A burst of light from your horn cleanses your allies of ailments and sends your foes reeling. You and all allies in a 20-foot emanation benefit from a 4th-level restoration spell. All enemies within the emanation are dazzled until the end of your next turn.

cleansing spell.name: Cleansing Spell
cleansing spell.text: Infused with celestial light, your magic can more effectively heal wounds and purge afflictions. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the healing trait on a living creature, one target of that spell regains a number of Hit Points equal to your level (in addition to any Hit Points they would normally gain).

clear as air.name: Clear as Air
clear as air.text: Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day. You become invisible until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse. If you use a hostile action, the impulse ends after that action is completed.

clear the way.name: Clear the Way
clear the way.text: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path. You attempt to Shove up to five creatures adjacent to you, rolling a separate Athletics check for each target and ignoring the requirement that you have a hand free. Then Stride up to half your Speed.
clear the way.requirements: You’re wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: You swing clear through one foe and into another. Make a melee Strike against the second enemy.
cleave.trigger: Your melee Strike reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points, and another enemy is adjacent to that creature.

clever gambit.name: Clever Gambit
clever gambit.text: Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe’s capabilities and range. You Step or Stride; this movement doesn’t trigger reactions from the triggering creature.
clever gambit.trigger: Your Strike critically hits and deals damage to a creature you’ve identified with Recall Knowledge

clinch strike.name: Clinch Strike
clinch strike.text: Your opponents can’t slip your grasp without punishment. Make an unarmed melee Strike against the triggering creature.
clinch strike.trigger: A creature you had grabbed or restrained successfully Escapes.

cling.name: Cling
cling.text: You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission. If your target moves while you're hanging onto it, you can choose to move with the target. The target is released if you choose not to move with it, at the start of your next turn, or if the target Escapes.
cling.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike and you have a free hand

clinging to life.name: Clinging to Life
clinging to life.text: This life still holds much for you, and you aren’t ready to fall back into the River of Souls just yet. When you’re reduced to 0 Hit Points and not immediately killed, you go to 1 Hit Point instead, fall prone, and are unconscious, and you don’t gain the wounded condition.
clinging to life.trigger: You are reduced to 0 HP and don’t immediately die.

cloak of poison.name: Cloak of Poison
cloak of poison.text: You secrete a cloak of concentrated poison that harms any who dare attack you. For 1 minute, any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or melee weapon without the reach trait takes 3d6 poison damage.

clobber.name: Clobber
clobber.text: With a mighty blow, you send an enemy flying backward and onto the ground. Strike a foe. This Strike deals an extra die of weapon damage. If you hit and deal damage, you can automatically Shove the target, with the same benefits as the Shove action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical h…
clobber.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

clockwork celerity.name: Clockwork Celerity
clockwork celerity.text: You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly. You are quickened for this turn. How you can use the extra action depends on your innovation.

close contract.name: Close Contract
close contract.text: You’re bolstered when a plan comes together. You Dismiss your current course of action and gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. The number of temporary Hit Points increases by 5 at 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
close contract.requirements: You have completed your active course of action but haven’t Dismissed it or chosen a new one.

cobra envenom.name: Cobra Envenom
cobra envenom.text: You slightly dislocate your joints to lash out with devious intent and the power to envenom your foe. Make a cobra fang Strike. Your reach with this Strike is 5 feet greater than normal.

cobra stance.name: Cobra Stance
cobra stance.text: You enter a tightly coiled stance, with your hands poised as venomous fangs. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are cobra fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d4 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, deadly d10, finesse, unarmed, and venomous traits.

coerce the current.name: Coerce the Current
coerce the current.text: With a flick of your tail, you direct the water around you to move creatures. You move water in a 20-foot line; this line must be entirely in water. Each creature in this line must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. A creature can choose to fail the save.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is pushed or pulled 5 feet in the direction of your choice. All creatures must be moved in the same direction.
As success, but the creature is pushed or pulled 10 feet.
As success, but the creature is pushed or pulled 10 feet, and the creature is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

cognitive loophole.name: Cognitive Loophole
cognitive loophole.text: You can find a loophole in a mental effect to temporarily overcome it. Until the end of your next turn, you ignore a single mental effect. You can suppress a particular effect using Cognitive Loophole only once. You can’t use Cognitive Loophole to suppress an effect you chose to have affect you.
cognitive loophole.requirements: You are currently affected by a mental effect

collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.text: You collapse into a pile of bones, mitigating the worst of the damage you would have taken, and the triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage). Any other effects caused by a critical hit still occur.
collapse.trigger: An enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit.

collapse armor.name: Collapse Armor
collapse armor.text: You've modified your armor innovation to collapse into a more compact form so you can don or remove it in an instant. If you’re wearing your innovation when you Collapse your Armor, you remove it instantly, and it compresses into its compact form, after which it latches onto your body, typically by attaching to a belt,…
collapse armor.requirements: You are wearing your armor innovation, or holding it in both hands in its compact form (see text).

collapse construct.name: Collapse Construct
collapse construct.text: You've modified your construct companion and built it out of light materials, enabling you to collapse it into a carrying case or other compact and innocuous form. Either your construct or you (if you're adjacent to it) can Collapse your Construct to turn it into its compact form or back into its normal form.

collapse wall.name: Collapse Wall
collapse wall.text: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature. If your bombs deal enough damage to reduce the wall's Hit Points below its Broken Threshold, the wall partially collapses on the creature.
collapse wall.trigger: A creature moves into the bombs' splash area.
collapse wall.requirements: You're within 30 feet of an area where you rigged bombs on a wall, cliff face, or similar vertical surface with Set Explosives or Demolition Charge.

collateral reinforcement.name: Collateral Reinforcement
collateral reinforcement.text: With a combination of bony armor, extra flesh layers, and tactical incorporeal phasing, you protect your thralls from collateral damage. For 1 round, your thralls become immune to area and splash damage.

combat assessment.name: Combat Assessment
combat assessment.text: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe. Make a melee Strike. On a hit, you can immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the target. On a critical hit, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check to Recall Knowledge. The target is temporarily immune to Combat Assessment for 1 day.

combat grab.name: Combat Grab
combat grab.text: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent’s guard, you take another swing and grab them. Make a melee Strike while keeping one hand free. If the Strike hits, you grab the target using your free hand. The creature remains grabbed until the end of your next turn or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.
combat grab.requirements: You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand

combat reading.name: Combat Reading
combat reading.text: You use a performer’s cold reading techniques, aura reading, and other tricks to discover your foe’s strengths and weaknesses. The GM rolls a secret Occultism check for you against the Deception or Stealth DC (whichever is higher) of an enemy of your choice who is not concealed from you, hidden from you, or undetected…

outcomes.text: The GM chooses and tells you two of the following pieces of information about the enemy: which of the enemy's weaknesses is highest, which of the enemy's saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy's resistances is highest.
The GM chooses one piece of information from the above list to tell you about the enemy.
The GM gives you false information (the GM makes up the information).

combined form.name: Combined Form
combined form.text: Cooperation and coordination are the secrets to getting by in tanuki society. When the triggering ally transforms, you Stride to their square and join shape with them, melding into their transformation.
combined form.trigger: An ally within 30 feet uses a polymorph effect.

come and get me.name: Come and Get Me
come and get me.text: You open yourself to attacks so you can respond in turn. Until your rage ends, you are off-guard, and damage rolls against you gain a +2 circumstance bonus. If a creature hits you, that creature is off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.

come in from the wilderness.name: Come in From the Wilderness
come in from the wilderness.text: A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth. For each source of persistent damage it is taking, the creature can immediately attempt a flat check to recover, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.

comforting presence.name: Comforting Presence
comforting presence.text: Your occult connection to your allies lets you take on fear and confusion they feel. Focus on your calmness and pull in nearby allies’ emotions. Reduce the frightened and stupefied condition values of adjacent allies by 1, and increase your frightened and stupefied condition values by the same amount.
comforting presence.trigger: An adjacent ally becomes frightened or stupefied.

comical recovery.name: Comical Recovery
comical recovery.text: When you're about to fall, you twirl your arms comically to attempt to keep your balance. Attempt a Performance check against the same DC of the triggering skill check that you critically failed or the enemy's skill DC for the skill it used to knock you prone.

outcomes.text: You don't fall prone. A creature of your choice adjacent to you finds your performance so funny it can't use reactions for 1 round; this is a mental and emotion effect.
You don't fall prone.

comical recovery.trigger: You critically fail a skill check that would cause you to fall prone, or an enemy succeeds at a skill check that would cause you to fall prone.

command attention.name: Command Attention
command attention.text: You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn. Whenever a creature in a 30-foot emanation around you attempts a saving throw against a different visual effect, it gets a result one degree of success better than it rolled.

command elemental.name: Command Elemental
command elemental.text: You grasp the animating force within an elemental creature and bend it to your will. Choose a trait matching one of your kinetic elements and target an elemental creature within 30 feet that has the chosen trait.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.
The target is unaffected.
The elemental creature is controlled or slowed as long as you Sustain the impulse, up to 1 minute. This effect ends if you or an ally attacks the elemental.
As failure, but you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 hour.

command undead.name: Command Undead
command undead.text: You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will. If the next action you use is to cast harm targeting one undead creature, you transform the effects of that harm spell.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.
The target is unaffected.
The undead creature becomes a minion under your control. The spell gains a duration of 1 minute, but it is dismissed if you or an ally attacks the minion undead.
As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

commitment to equality.name: Commitment to Equality
commitment to equality.text: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage. You rally a creature within 30 feet in an attempt to reduce its frightened or stupefied condition. If a creature has multiple conditions from this list, choose one.

outcomes.text: Reduce the condition’s value by 2.
Reduce the condition’s value by 1.
Increase the condition’s value by 1.

commitment to justice.name: Commitment to Justice
commitment to justice.text: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution. Make a Strike against the required creature. If this Strike hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to three times the number of weapon damage dice.
commitment to justice.requirements: You witnessed a creature kill or reduce an ally to 0 Hit Points since your last turn.

commitment to liberty.name: Commitment to Liberty
commitment to liberty.text: You can’t abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip. Make a Strike against the required creature. If this Strike hits, the grabbed or restrained ally can immediately attempt to Escape as a free action. If the Strike was a critical hit, that ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Escape attempt.
commitment to liberty.requirements: A creature has an ally grabbed or restrained.

commitment to protection.name: Commitment to Protection
commitment to protection.text: You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger. Attempt a Warfare Lore check against the hard DC for the level of a creature or hazard you can see. An ally of your choice within 30 feet gains an effect based on the outcome.

outcomes.text: The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.
As critical success, but the bonus is +1.
The ally takes a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.

commitment to valor.name: Commitment to Valor
commitment to valor.text: While fear might distract you from your duty, it'll never cause you to abandon it. Instead of becoming fleeing, you become stupefied 1 for as long you would be fleeing. If you have the frightened condition, decrease its value by 1.
commitment to valor.trigger: You would gain the fleeing condition.

commitment to vigilance.name: Commitment to Vigilance
commitment to vigilance.text: Your foes find it difficult to maneuver around you without attracting your attention. While in this stance, all spaces within your melee reach are difficult terrain for your enemies.

communal sustain.name: Communal Sustain
communal sustain.text: Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect. You must be within 30 feet of the chosen ally. The ally can Sustain the Spell once as a free action, triggered at the start of their next turn.

community knowledge.name: Community Knowledge
community knowledge.text: You commune with the psychic echoes of your ancestors and community, channeling their experiences into yourself. You gain a +2 status bonus on the triggering skill check.
community knowledge.trigger: You attempt a skill check requiring 3 actions or fewer.

complete the hero's journey.name: Complete the Hero's Journey
complete the hero's journey.text: As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon. You Spark Transcendence of your final ikon, but instead of its normal effect, the item casts the 3-action version of harm or heal heightened to half your level rounded up.
complete the hero's journey.requirements: You have Sparked Transcendence of at least two different ikons in the last 10 minutes, and your divine spark currently dwells in a third ikon.

conceal spell.name: Conceal Spell
conceal spell.text: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the shining runes, sparks of magic, and other manifestations that would usually give away your spellcas…

condemn soul.name: Condemn Soul
condemn soul.text: With a quick flourish, you draw together runes and legal bindings to condemn a creature’s soul and bring it to justice. Select a creature within 30 feet of you; that creature must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
Your condemnation frays the fabric of the target’s soul. The target gains weakness to fire and spirit damage equal to half your level for 1 minute. Only you can trigger this weakness.
As failure, but any creature can trigger the creature’s weakness.

conductive sphere.name: Conductive Sphere
conductive sphere.text: A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity. It can't be targeted or damaged. Any of your allies adjacent to it gain resistance to electricity equal to your level and add the shock rune to all their Strikes with metal objects.

conductor's redirection.name: Conductor's Redirection
conductor's redirection.text: You conduct the damage through your body, taking damage as normal (if applicable) and redirecting it at one target within 10 feet that you can see. That target takes an equal amount of damage with a basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
conductor's redirection.trigger: You are hit by an attack, spell, or other effect that deals electricity damage.

conduit of void and vitality.name: Conduit of Void and Vitality
conduit of void and vitality.text: You use the unstable energy of your curse to manipulate the most basic of divine magic. You cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, expending the slot as normal. If the spell restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, then one creature healed by this spell regains a number of additional Hit Points equal to 1d8 × your cu…
conduit of void and vitality.requirements: You have heal or harm as a signature spell and an available spell slot to cast it with.

confusing commands.name: Confusing Commands
confusing commands.text: You shout out bewildering but authoritative commands while imitating the voices, linguistic quirks, and speech patterns of your opponents. Each enemy within the aura of your commander's banner must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or become confused for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

conjure hell.name: Conjure Hell
conjure hell.text: Though you might not worship Asmodeus or other devils, you've studied enough of Hell to call forth a brief burst of its fire. Each creature in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet takes 9d6 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

connect the dots.name: Connect the Dots
connect the dots.text: Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade. Choose an ally and a non-allied creature. You must be able to see both of them.

outcomes.text: You spot a way for your ally to take advantage of the other target's flaws and let them know about it. Your ally gains your Pursue a Lead investigation bonus as a circumstance bonus to all its Strikes or skill checks against the creature until the start of your next turn.
As critical success, but your ally gains the bonus only for their next Strike or skill check against the creature.
You fail to make a connection.
You misconstrue a vital piece of information, which temporarily disconcerts you. You are stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.

consecrate spell.name: Consecrate Spell
consecrate spell.text: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that targets a single undead, you can expend a Focus Point, channeling the power of your focus spells into the primary spell.

consolidated overlay panopticon.name: Consolidated Overlay Panopticon
consolidated overlay panopticon.text: You volunteered for a controversial experimental procedure to install clockwork prosthetic eyes. These eyes relay what you see to shieldmarshal headquarters, which consolidates and analyzes environmental data—Bronzetime/Surgetime probabilities, pressure, temperature, wind, and so on—and feeds them back to you.

constricting hold.name: Constricting Hold
constricting hold.text: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon’s level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.
constricting hold.requirements: Your eidolon has a creature grabbed or restrained.

consume energy.name: Consume Energy
consume energy.text: Your connection to energy is so much stronger than the offending display in front of you, allowing you to claim it for yourself. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect as you draw it into your body.
consume energy.trigger: An enemy within 60 feet uses an ability that has the trait corresponding to your deviation damage type.

consume magic.name: Consume Magic
consume magic.text: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modi…
consume magic.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against an area effect from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

consume power.name: Consume Power
consume power.text: You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage—choose one eligible type of resistance. If this reaction prevents any damage, you gain a status bonus equal to half your level to the damage roll of the next metal impulse you use before the end of your…
consume power.trigger: You would take acid, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

contagious spell.name: Contagious Spell
contagious spell.text: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals. Spend a Mythic Point. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that inflicts damage or debilitating conditions and targets a specific number of creatures, you can target one additional creature.

contingency leap.name: Contingency Leap
contingency leap.text: When imperiled by a fall, you swiftly transport yourself out of danger. You teleport to any edge or handhold in range, stopping your fall. If your destination is one you couldn’t normally stand on (such as a handhold), you must succeed at your choice of an Acrobatics check or a Reflex save, usually at the Climb DC, as…
contingency leap.trigger: You fall, and there is an edge or handhold within 30 feet.

controlled bullet.name: Controlled Bullet
controlled bullet.text: You create a direct magical connection with your beast gun, allowing you to guide the beast gun's next shot by taking control of the projectile directly, steering it through the air, and swerving and veering it to continue to hit target after target.

converge.name: Converge
converge.text: Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time. Your ally can make a melee Strike against the triggering foe as a reaction.
converge.trigger: You make a successful ranged attack against an opponent who is within your overwatch field, and who is within reach of one or more of your allies who is also within your overwatch field.

convincing illusion.name: Convincing Illusion
convincing illusion.text: You use your deceptive skills to make your illusions seem even more real. Attempt a Deception check against the target’s Perception DC. If you succeed, the target fails to disbelieve the illusion.
convincing illusion.trigger: A creature succeeded, but didn’t critically succeed, at a Perception check or Will save to disbelieve an illusion from a spell that you cast
convincing illusion.requirements: You are within 30 feet of the observer and the illusion

convocation of earth and moon.name: Convocation of Earth and Moon
convocation of earth and moon.text: You call upon Mother Earth and Father Moon to fill you with light. A cocoon of moonlight momentarily envelops you, and you emerge in a towering form made of swirling energy, tattooed in stardust and clad in regalia of silver and mother of pearl.

coordinated charge.name: Coordinated Charge
coordinated charge.text: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow. You Stride up to your Speed and make a melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride, but they each must end their Stride closer to the creature you hit than where they sta…

coordinated distraction.name: Coordinated Distraction
coordinated distraction.text: With a sharp whistle or wave of your hands, you distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them. Choose a target and an ally, both of whom must be within 30 feet.

coral detoxification.name: Coral Detoxification
coral detoxification.text: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration. Attempt a saving throw against a single poison affecting you with a +2 circumstance bonus.

coral reserve.name: Coral Reserve
coral reserve.text: Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed. You suppress your enfeebled or fatigued condition. (If you're affected by both, choose one to suppress.) After 1 minute, the condition returns with any remaining duration it had when you suppressed it.

core cannon.name: Core Cannon
core cannon.text: Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon. While immobile as a cannon, you can fire blasts of energy directly from your core, devastating your foes. You become immobilized until you use an Interact action to revert back to your standard form.

core rejuvenation.name: Core Rejuvenation
core rejuvenation.text: Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and unconscious conditions, and can act normally on this turn.
core rejuvenation.trigger: You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

cornered animal.name: Cornered Animal
cornered animal.text: You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies. You make unarmed Strikes against two different creatures flanking you. The attacks take a –2 penalty if the unarmed weapon is not agile. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.
cornered animal.requirements: You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.

corpse-killer's defiance.name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
corpse-killer's defiance.text: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies. Allies that can see you gain a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 1 round, or a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 2 rounds if the undead foe destroyed was a creature of your…

correct the story.name: Correct The Story
correct the story.text: You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly. Spend a Mythic Point. The enemy must reroll the triggering attack roll or save and take the new result.
correct the story.trigger: An enemy critically succeeds at an attack roll or saving throw.

corrupted ground.name: Corrupted Ground
corrupted ground.text: The ground on which you stride is mere fuel that you burn with unholy void energies, scarring the earth in your wake. When a holy creature or psychopomp ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes 2 spirit damage. If it’s a holy living creature, it takes an additional 2 void damage.

counter curse.name: Counter Curse
counter curse.text: You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect, using half your level rounded up as your counteract rank and the higher of your class DC – 10 or spell DC – 10 as the counteract modifier.
counter curse.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aware.
counter curse.requirements: You’re in a curse maelstrom state.

counter element.name: Counter Element
counter element.text: Your absolute dedication to a single element lets you attempt to gain control over it, even when the element is in service to another entity. You attempt to counteract the effect, using your kineticist class DC – 10 as your counteract check modifier and half this impulse's level rounded up as the counteract rank.
counter element.trigger: You're targeted by or in the area of an effect that has the trait matching your kinetic element and originates from an enemy or hazard.

counter thought.name: Counter Thought
counter thought.text: When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it. You expend one of your spell slots to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell with the mental trait.
counter thought.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.
counter thought.requirements: You have an unexpended spell slot you could use to Cast a Spell with the mental trait.

countercharm.name: Countercharm
countercharm.text: Your charms and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others. When a foe casts a spell with the illusion or mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own innate magic to disrupt it.
countercharm.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell with the illusion or mental trait.
countercharm.requirements: You must have a non-cantrip innate captivator spell with the same trait.

counterclockwork focus.name: Counterclockwork Focus
counterclockwork focus.text: You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana. Your training in special weapons and tactics give you access to unusual techniques to respond to clockwork- and magic-related crimes. You apply special additives to a loaded firearm.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.text: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it. You expend a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of that same spell. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.
counterspell.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared

courageous advance.name: Courageous Advance
courageous advance.text: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance. If your next action is to cast the courageous anthem composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride.

courageous assault.name: Courageous Assault
courageous assault.text: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack. If your next action is to cast the courageous anthem composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to make a melee Strike.

courageous onslaught.name: Courageous Onslaught
courageous onslaught.text: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies. If your next action is to cast the courageous anthem composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride and then make a melee Strike.

coursing weave.name: Coursing Weave
coursing weave.text: Your easy movements mock those who try to shoot you down. Stride up to your Speed. If you have a fly Speed, you can instead Fly up to your fly Speed.
coursing weave.trigger: A creature misses you with a ranged attack.

courteous comeback.name: Courteous Comeback
courteous comeback.text: You grew up in the proud Padishah Empire, where even insults have a certain poetic wit. Reroll the triggering Diplomacy check, using the second result.
courteous comeback.trigger: You critically fail a Diplomacy check.
courteous comeback.requirements: You’re in a settlement or community, and you haven’t used Courteous Comeback in this settlement or community within the past month.

coven spell.name: Coven Spell
coven spell.text: You rhyme with your ally’s incantations or echo their movements, linking your magic to empower their spell in one of two ways: If their spell deals damage and doesn’t have a duration, you grant that spell a status bonus to damage equal to its rank.If their spell doesn’t have a spellshape effect applied to it, apply the…
coven spell.trigger: An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell

cover fire.name: Cover Fire
cover fire.text: You lay down suppressive fire to protect allies by forcing foes to take cover from your wild attacks. Make a firearm or crossbow Strike; the target must decide before you roll your attack whether it will duck out of the way.
cover fire.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

covering stance.name: Covering Stance
covering stance.text: Your very presence on the field of battle protects nearby allies from harm. At the end of each of your turns while you're in this stance, choose one ally adjacent to you to gain lesser cover until the start of your next turn.

cracked mountain.name: Cracked Mountain
cracked mountain.text: You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1. Make a melee Strike at an enemy within reach. You immediately end your Tenacious Stance.
cracked mountain.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

crafter's instinct.name: Crafter's Instinct
crafter's instinct.text: You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw. If the triggering Strike was a misfire, you get a normal failure instead.
crafter's instinct.trigger: You misfire with a firearm or you roll a failure on a Strike with a ranged weapon.

crane flutter.name: Crane Flutter
crane flutter.text: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent. Your circumstance bonus to AC from Crane Stance increases to +3 against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you and the attacker is within your reach, you can immediately make a crane wing Strike against the attacker at a –2 penalty.
crane flutter.trigger: You are targeted with an attack by an observed attacker.

crane stance.name: Crane Stance
crane stance.text: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, but the only Strikes you can make are crane wing attacks. These deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

cranial detonation.name: Cranial Detonation
cranial detonation.text: As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head. Each enemy you reduced to 0 Hit Points dies and its head explodes. Each exploding head generates a shock wave in a 15-foot emanation around that enemy.
cranial detonation.trigger: You successfully reduce one or more non-mindless enemies to 0 Hit Points with a spell.

cratering drop.name: Cratering Drop
cratering drop.text: You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent. You Fly straight down, increasing the amount the enemy falls by your Fly speed. If you reach the ground, you drive the enemy into the ground, dealing double the normal falling damage.
cratering drop.requirements: Your previous action was Pluck from the Sky using a melee Strike, and the target failed or critically failed its saving throw.

crawling fire.name: Crawling Fire
crawling fire.text: You mimic the motions of a beast of your devising, and it becomes real, with a flaming pelt and searing claws. It is Small and appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. You can sense from the crawling fire's space as well as your own, using your senses.

creature comforts.name: Creature Comforts
creature comforts.text: You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
creature comforts.requirements: You’re under a morph or polymorph effect.

crimson breath.name: Crimson Breath
crimson breath.text: You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm. You breathe a blast of flame in a 30-foot cone that deals 12d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (basic Reflex save). This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
crimson breath.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

crimson shroud.name: Crimson Shroud
crimson shroud.text: You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute. While the shroud is active, you gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can Interact with your shroud, swirling it around you, to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.

cringe.name: Cringe
cringe.text: With pitiful posturing, you cause your foe to pull back a deadly attack. The attacking creature takes a circumstance penalty to the damage of the triggering Strike equal to your level + 2. This penalty applies after doubling the damage for a critical hit. The attacker is then immune to your Cringe for 24 hours.
cringe.trigger: A creature you are aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.

crop protection.name: Crop Protection
crop protection.text: While you prefer to keep a low profile, you are quick to attack to protect your crop. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy. If your attack is successful, the member of your crop gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
crop protection.trigger: An enemy within your reach attacks a member of your crop.

cross the final horizon.name: Cross the Final Horizon
cross the final horizon.text: You Stride up to your Speed and your ki enshrouds your limbs in a terrifying stormy energy, increasing the reach of your Sky and Heaven Stance unarmed attacks by 5 feet. At the end of your movement, make up to three Strikes against a target you can reach, each at a –2 penalty.
cross the final horizon.requirements: You are in Sky and Heaven Stance.

crossbow ace.name: Crossbow Ace
crossbow ace.text: Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire. Either Create a Diversion or Take Cover, then Interact to reload.
crossbow ace.requirements: You are wielding a crossbow with reload 1 or higher

crossbow terror.name: Crossbow Terror
crossbow terror.text: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt. Interact to reload a crossbow and then attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check if you succeeded at a Strike with a crossbow this turn.

crosscurrent counter.name: Crosscurrent Counter
crosscurrent counter.text: You counter the creature with the power of elemental water, a tendril of it encasing your limb or weapon. You attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the triggering creature, even if it’s outside your reach or you don’t have a free hand.
crosscurrent counter.trigger: You become grabbed or restrained by a creature.

crowned in tempest's fury.name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury
crowned in tempest's fury.text: You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air, placing a crown of lightning upon your brow. Sparks flash in your eyes, and lightning strikes constantly in the air around you as howling winds lift you from the ground.

crusader's masquerade.name: Crusader's Masquerade
crusader's masquerade.text: Your mask can hide you from the undead. You become concealed to undead using vision or lifesense, allowing you to Hide and Sneak without other sources of cover or concealment.
crusader's masquerade.requirements: You’re wearing your mask familiar in its mask form, and it has the skilled (Religion) familiar ability.

cry of rebellion.name: Cry of Rebellion
cry of rebellion.text: You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes. Allies within 60 feet who can hear you gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute.

cryptic spell.name: Cryptic Spell
cryptic spell.text: You hide your magic in the croak of a frog, in the sway of the trees, in the howl of the wind, and the flicker of the will-o'- wisp. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, masking the spell's manifestations in the natural sights and sounds of the environment.

crystal luminescence.name: Crystal Luminescence
crystal luminescence.text: Your horn glows with bioluminescent color, casting bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light for the next 20 feet). This light can be any color. The most common colors are blue and purple, except for trogloshi, who normally shed white light.

culvert's collapse.name: Culvert's Collapse
culvert's collapse.text: Under your foes’ onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs. Your killing intent swells, your agonies marshaling your inevitable resurgence. Make a flooded river Strike against the enemy who dealt damage to you since your previous turn. That Strike deals an additional 1d8 persistent bleed damage.
culvert's collapse.requirements: You are in Flood Stance and were damaged by an enemy since your previous turn.

current spell.name: Current Spell
current spell.text: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the air or water trait, until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC or a +2 circumstance bonus against ranged attacks.

curse of the saumen kar.name: Curse of the Saumen Kar
curse of the saumen kar.text: You activate the runes on your body to create an icy prison around a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet. The prison is a sphere made of unmelting ice, just large enough to fit your target.

cursed effigy.name: Cursed Effigy
cursed effigy.text: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body. You incorporate the material into a premade doll, paper figure, or other effigy to create a sympathetic link that makes it harder to resist your abilities.
cursed effigy.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability, and the Strike dealt physical damage.

cushion landing.name: Cushion Landing
cushion landing.text: As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue. Your mount Strides up to its Speed, positioning itself below you. Rather than falling on your mount, you Mount your mount.
cushion landing.trigger: You fall from a height of 15 feet or higher.
cushion landing.requirements: Your mount can reach your landing location with a single Stride.

cut from the air.name: Cut from the Air
cut from the air.text: You can knock aside ranged attacks. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you knocked or cut it out of the air.
cut from the air.trigger: You are the target of a physical ranged Strike
cut from the air.requirements: You’re aware of the attack, not off-guard against it, and either have a hand free or are wielding a melee weapon

cut the bonds.name: Cut The Bonds
cut the bonds.text: Your belief in freedom can even sever magic. Select a magical effect that has made an adjacent member of your crop clumsy, grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, or slowed. You attempt to counteract that effect using your attack modifier with the required weapon as your counteract modifier.
cut the bonds.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon with which you have expert proficiency.

cut them down, burn them out.name: Cut them Down, Burn them Out
cut them down, burn them out.text: Inspired by the sixth line of the Crimson Oath, when you oppose the enemies of Lastwall, you aim to excise the rot from the land itself. Make a Strike against an undead creature using a weapon with which you have master proficiency.

cutthroat grapple.name: Cutthroat Grapple
cutthroat grapple.text: You can punish a creature that tries to escape your blades. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the creature takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its Escape attempt and 1d6 bleed damage.
cutthroat grapple.trigger: A creature attempts to Escape from your Sawtooth Grapple.

cycle of souls.name: Cycle of Souls
cycle of souls.text: Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought. You Step, then enter an animist stance you know.

cyclonic ascent.name: Cyclonic Ascent
cyclonic ascent.text: Whorls of wind surround your lower body, forming a cyclone that lifts you into the air. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 30 feet, whichever is greater, for 10 minutes. Unlike with a normal fly Speed, you can move upward without treating it as difficult terrain.

dad joke.name: Dad Joke
dad joke.text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. Using the power of punnery, you deliver a lovingly tailored joke at a creature within 60 feet. Attempt a skill check using the skill that would be used to identify the creature (e.g.

outcomes.text: The joke is so blindingly perfect-yet-awful that the target dissociates from reality. The creature is dazzled and stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn. Double the mental damage dealt to the target.
The target is stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn or until the creature targets you with a hostile effect, whichever happens first. The target takes full mental damage.
The target is unaffected.
The target is unaffected. Your allies who hear the joke are so embarrassed by it that they can’t treat you as an ally for any effects until the end of your next turn.

dalang's ally.name: Dalang's Ally
dalang's ally.text: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, your shadow darts around with your foes, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach.

dance against fear.name: Dance Against Fear
dance against fear.text: You bring a sense of ease and joy with you in the world, causing the creatures around you to feel settled and calm. You and all allies in a 60-foot emanation reduce your frightened condition by 1.

dance of bloody ink.name: Dance of Bloody Ink
dance of bloody ink.text: As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target’s flesh. You Invoke a Rune on a melee weapon you are wielding and Strike. Then, you can Step and Strike again with the same weapon. If the second Strike hits, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike.
dance of bloody ink.requirements: You’re wielding a melee weapon that bears a rune.

dance of intercession.name: Dance of Intercession
dance of intercession.text: You either performed in or stood witness to the dance used to invoke the Celestial Dragon and can harness a sliver of their power. You Stride in a dance up to half your Speed, attempting a DC 35 Performance check. You can perform this dance up to three times per day.
dance of intercession.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 75

outcomes.text: You perform the movements of the Dance of Intercession so gracefully that you evoke a glimmer of the memory of the Celestial Dragon's awesome power. You cast the 3-action version of either 9th-level harm or heal at any point during your Stride. This does not use any spell slots.
As critical success, but the spell is 7th level instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.
As critical success, but the spell is 5th level instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.
You fail to remember the steps of the dance. You gain no additional effect beyond Striding half your Speed, and you can't attempt the Dance of Intercession again until your next daily preparations.

dance of the eclipse.name: Dance Of The Eclipse
dance of the eclipse.text: Just as the celestial bodies of the sun and moon align in perfect synchronicity, so too can you perform two steps of the stellar dance at once. You take any action you have from the stellar dancer archetype that requires your dance to not be at its zenith, ignoring that requirement.
dance of the eclipse.requirements: You’re in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance is at its zenith.

dance of the galactic whirl.name: Dance Of The Galactic Whirl
dance of the galactic whirl.text: The vast streak of light in the night sky is made of stars so numerous that it confounds the mind, and so too does your dance. You Feint and Stride in either order. You don’t need to be trained in Deception to Feint this way, and you can attempt a Performance check instead of a Deception check.
dance of the galactic whirl.requirements: You’re in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn’t at its zenith.

dance of the jester.name: Dance of the Jester
dance of the jester.text: Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement). Attempt a Performance check against the Fortitude DC of a single enemy within 30 feet.

outcomes.text: Your shadow and the opponent’s synchronize, forcing your target to match your movements step for step. You perform any two of the following actions: Drop Prone, Release an object, Stand, Step, or Stride. You must perform two different actions.
As critical success, except you can take only one action, not two, before your target becomes temporarily immune to your dance, and you cannot move the target into hazardous terrain.

dance of the mousedeer.name: Dance of the Mousedeer
dance of the mousedeer.text: You move your body in a pattern that evokes the small and clever Sister Mousedeer, misdirecting enemies and filling their vision with shadows to hide behind. Attempt a Performance check against the Perception DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check.

outcomes.text: Imaginary shadows rise up in the target’s vision, hiding you from sight. You gain greater cover against that enemy, which provides a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and to Stealth checks to Hide, Sneak, or otherwise avoid detection.
As critical success, except you gain only standard cover (a +2 circumstance bonus instead).
The opponent grasps the movements of your dance, becoming temporarily immune to your Dance of the Mousedeer for 1 day.

dance of the tiger.name: Dance of the Tiger
dance of the tiger.text: Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey. Your dance embodies the character role so well you can trail an opponent from its own shadow. Attempt a Performance check against the Will DC of a single adjacent enemy.

outcomes.text: You step on the foe’s shadow, bringing a cold dread. The opponent is frightened 2; its shadow remains pinned underfoot, stretching and deforming to remain connected to your square, and indicates where it has gone even if you lose sight of the foe.
As critical success, except the creature is only frightened 1 and your connection to its shadow breaks at 60 feet instead of 120.

dance of the wanderers.name: Dance Of The Wanderers
dance of the wanderers.text: Like those celestial wanderers who defiantly cross the sky in the opposite direction of the rest of the stars, you move gracefully across the battlefield. You Leap twice; neither action triggers reactions.
dance of the wanderers.requirements: You’re in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn’t at its zenith.

dance of thunder.name: Dance of Thunder
dance of thunder.text: Your steps echo with the thunderous retort of exploding black powder as you dance a dance of death. Take any of the following actions you choose in any order: Step, Strike against a target within your firearm's first range increment, and Interact to reload.
dance of thunder.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow and are not fatigued.

dangle (vanara).name: Dangle (Vanara)
dangle (vanara).text: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

danse macabre.name: Danse Macabre
danse macabre.text: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward. Your horde Strides up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Large and smaller creatures, but it must end its movement in an unoccupied space.

daring act.name: Daring Act
daring act.text: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies. Select one foe within reach and attempt either an Acrobatics or Athletics check against your target’s Reflex DC.

dark persona's presence.name: Dark Persona's Presence
dark persona's presence.text: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain—the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution—come along with it. The force of your dark persona's negativity batters constantly against all creatures in a 30-foot emanation when you Unleash your Psyche and for as long as your Psyche is Unleashed.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The target is frightened 1.
The target is frightened 2.
The target is frightened 3.

dart between.name: Dart Between
dart between.text: In the blink of an eye, you transport yourself and any items you’re wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you’re carrying it in an extradimensional container—you cannot Dart Between.

dash of herbs.name: Dash of Herbs
dash of herbs.text: A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature. The type of herbs depends on which malady you decide to treat: confused, disease, poison, sickened, or injuries. Target one living creature within 30 feet, who regains 2d8+4 HP and can attempt a new save against one malady of the chosen kind.

dashing pickup.name: Dashing Pickup
dashing pickup.text: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type). At any point during this movement, it must move adjacent to you. As it passes you, you Mount your mount.

dashing pounce.name: Dashing Pounce
dashing pounce.text: With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands. You Leap, and if you end your movement adjacent to an enemy, you make two frenzied claw unarmed strikes against it. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. If both Strikes miss, you fall prone at the end of your Leap.
dashing pounce.requirements: You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

dashing strike.name: Dashing Strike
dashing strike.text: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another. Stride up to your Speed, but you must end that movement within melee reach of a different enemy. At the end of your movement, make a melee Strike against an enemy now within reach.
dashing strike.requirements: You are adjacent to an enemy

dastardly dash.name: Dastardly Dash
dastardly dash.text: You dash past an opponent, confounding them with underhanded tactics. Stride up to half your speed. You can attempt a Trip or a Dirty Trick (if you have that action) against one opponent you pass within range of at any point during your movement.

daunting spell.name: Daunting Spell
daunting spell.text: Your enemies feel the inevitability of defeat once they feel the potency of your magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that allows a saving throw, your spell gains the emotion, fear, and mental traits.
daunting spell.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected by the daunting spell.
The target is frightened 1.

The target is frightened 2 and stupefied 1 for as long as they remain frightened. If the daunting spell has a duration, the affected creature can’t reduce their frightened condition from this effect below 1 until the spell’s duration ends.
As failure, but frightened 3 and stupefied 2.

dazing blow.name: Dazing Blow
dazing blow.text: You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them. Make a melee Strike against a creature you have grabbed. The weapon damage from this Strike is bludgeoning damage. If the Strike hits, the creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC; this is an incapacitation effect.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is stunned 1.
The creature is stunned 2.
The creature is stunned 3.

dazzling block.name: Dazzling Block
dazzling block.text: As your shield blocks an assault, you create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC, with the following effects.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end this blinded condition.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

dazzling bullet.name: Dazzling Bullet
dazzling bullet.text: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes (or other visual organs). Attempt a Performance check against the target creature's Will DC and make a ranged firearm Strike against that target.

dazzling display.name: Dazzling Display
dazzling display.text: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes. Attempt Intimidation checks to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet.

dazzling dragonet disappearance.name: Dazzling Dragonet Disappearance
dazzling dragonet disappearance.text: A brilliant sheen on your scales flashes when you’re hit, then you’re nowhere to be found. The triggering enemy becomes dazzled for 1 round, and you become affected by a 4th-rank invisibility spell.
dazzling dragonet disappearance.trigger: An adjacent enemy hits you with an attack.

dead reckoning.name: Dead Reckoning
dead reckoning.text: You've trained yourself to maintain a strong sense of direction at all times, even when you can't use a compass or see the sky above. You immediately intuit which direction is north (assuming the concept of north exists at your current location).

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.text: You relax your eyes, taking in the smallest movements of objects, stirring of grass and leaves, and other signs of the presence of hidden things, granting you the ability to locate invisible creatures.

deadly aim.name: Deadly Aim
deadly aim.text: You aim for your prey’s weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit. Make a ranged Strike against your hunted prey at a –2 penalty. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to damage on that Strike. This bonus increases to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 15th level.

death dive.name: Death Dive
death dive.text: You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe. You command your mount to Fly twice. It must end this movement at a lower altitude than it began its turn at. You and your mount gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.
death dive.requirements: You are riding your dragon companion and are airborne.

death from above.name: Death from Above
death from above.text: Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain. Stride up to half your Speed upward on the required surface; if you have a climb Speed, you may use your full climb Speed instead.
death from above.requirements: You are adjacent to a climbable surface at least 10 feet tall.

death of hope.name: Death Of Hope
death of hope.text: You create an aura of absolute despair around you, causing your enemies to struggle against their lamentations. For 1 minute, each enemy entering or beginning their turn within 30 feet of you must attempt a Will save against the greater of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The enemy is unaffected.
The enemy is unable to use reactions until the start of their next turn.
As success, and they are slowed 1 for 1 round.
As success, and they are slowed 2 for 1 round.

death roll.name: Death Roll
death roll.text: You corkscrew your body, twisting your victim. You attempt a jaws Strike against the grabbed creature, with a +2 circumstance bonus if you're fighting in water. If the Strike hits, you knock the creature prone; if it misses, they escape your grab.
death roll.requirements: You are in your crocodile or hybrid shape and have a creature grabbed.

death's door.name: Death's Door
death's door.text: You continue to fight when others would fall. Just before taking the triggering damage, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level. If you have Hit Points remaining after gaining these temporary Hit Points, you aren’t knocked unconscious, nor do you suffer the other effects of being reduced to 0 Hit Points…
death's door.trigger: You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

deathblow.name: Deathblow
deathblow.text: Your carefully prepared and placed shot brings instant death to your target. Attempt a Strike with a blowgun or sling using ammunition that you have poisoned with your simple injury poison.

debilitating dichotomy.name: Debilitating Dichotomy
debilitating dichotomy.text: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well. You and one creature within 30 feet each take 9d6 mental damage with a basic Will save, and the target is stunned 1 if it critically fails its save.

debilitating shot.name: Debilitating Shot
debilitating shot.text: Aiming for a weak point, you impede your foe with a precise shot. Make a ranged weapon Strike. If it hits and deals damage, the target is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

deceptive deduction.name: Deceptive Deduction
deceptive deduction.text: You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields. You learn what skill the creature was using to Recall Knowledge and whether that creature is trained in the skill.
deceptive deduction.trigger: A creature you can see uses Recall Knowledge.

declare anathema.name: Declare Anathema
declare anathema.text: You declare a creature you are aware of within 30 feet anathema, causing their friends and strangers to shy away from them. Attempt a Religion check against the target’s Will DC.

outcomes.text: Any creature that attempts to target the anathema creature with a beneficial effect must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the action is disrupted. This curse remains until removed by cleanse affliction or a similar effect, or an atone ritual. In addition, the creature gains weakness 10 to spirit damage for 1 minute.
As critical success, but the curse lasts for 1 minute.
As critical success, but the curse lasts for 1 round and the target doesn’t gain weakness to spirit damage.
The target is unaffected.

decree of banisment.name: Decree of Banisment
decree of banisment.text: You assume a demeanor of authority and decree banishment upon a foe who has defied your authority. Speak your decree; a creature you designate within 60 feet who can hear your decree must succeed at a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or spend its next turn moving as far away fro…

decree of execution.name: Decree of Execution
decree of execution.text: You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die. Speak your decree; a creature you designate within 60 feet who can hear your decree must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Once targeted, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 year.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
If the target is 14th level or lower, it drops to 1 Hit point. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes 50 spirit damage.

If the target is 14th level or lower, it dies instantly. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes 50 spirit damage; if this damage brings it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly. Otherwise, it gains weakness 20 to all damage for 1 minute.
As failure, but a target who survives the damage is stunned 1 for 1 minute.

decree of prosperity.name: Decree of Prosperity
decree of prosperity.text: You speak with a gentle encouragement that inspires confidence and competence in your followers. Speak your decree; all your knights who hear your decree treat failures (but not critical failures) on non-attack skill checks as successes for 1 minute.

decree of war.name: Decree of War
decree of war.text: You declare your current foes as irredeemable enemies, calling your allies down upon them. Speak your decree; all your knights who hear your decree can use their reaction to Stride up to twice directly toward an enemy and then Strike that enemy if it’s within their reach or range.

deep freeze.name: Deep Freeze
deep freeze.text: You vent a jet of supercooled fluid from your innovation, damaging a foe and slowing it down. Target one creature within 60 feet. That creature takes cold damage equal to your level, with effects depending on its Reflex save.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes half damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
The target takes full damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

The target takes double damage, is slowed 1 for 1 round, and takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. Unstable Function Your innovation discharges an enormous cone of supercooled fluid, potentially causing cascading failures. Add the unstable trait to Deep Freeze.

defend mount.name: Defend Mount
defend mount.text: You interpose yourself between an attacker and your mount, defending your mount from harm. Use your own defense against the triggering attack instead your mount’s defense. If the triggering attack hits, you take the effects of the attack instead of your mount.
defend mount.trigger: An enemy makes a Strike or spell attack against your mount while you’re riding it.

defend our union.name: Defend Our Union
defend our union.text: You can protect your companion from danger with a welltimed attack. You can immediately Stride toward the triggering enemy and can make a Strike against them if they would be in the first range increment of your ranged weapon or within your melee reach.
defend our union.trigger: You and your companion are within 15 feet of each other, and a foe successfully Strikes your united companion.

defend summoner.name: Defend Summoner
defend summoner.text: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you. After your eidolon uses this action, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus applies only while you’re within your eidolon’s reach (in most cases, this means your eidolon is adjacent to you or in your space).

defensive advance.name: Defensive Advance
defensive advance.text: With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

defensive coordination.name: Defensive Coordination
defensive coordination.text: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line. If your next action is to cast the rallying anthem composition cantrip, you can Raise a Shield, and one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Raise a…

defensive dismissal.name: Defensive Dismissal
defensive dismissal.text: You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow. You Dismiss the polymorph effect you're under, and the result of the triggering Strike becomes a success instead of a critical success.
defensive dismissal.trigger: A creature you’re aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you.
defensive dismissal.requirements: You’re under a polymorph effect that you can Dismiss.
