defensive growth.name: Defensive Growth
defensive growth.text: You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack. If you would take damage from the attack, you immediately Shield Block. This is a wooden shield.
defensive growth.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75
defensive growth.trigger: You’re the target of a physical attack.

defensive instincts.name: Defensive Instincts
defensive instincts.text: Your body tenses up when surrounded, putting you on edge just enough to anticipate an attack. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn and Step.
defensive instincts.requirements: you are adjacent to at least two enemies

defensive recovery.name: Defensive Recovery
defensive recovery.text: Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing. If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

defensive roll.name: Defensive Roll
defensive roll.text: Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious. You take half damage from the triggering attack.
defensive roll.trigger: A physical attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points

defensive swap.name: Defensive Swap
defensive swap.text: You and your allies work together selflessly to protect each other from harm. You and the required ally immediately swap positions with each other, and whichever of you was not the target of the triggering attack becomes the target instead.
defensive swap.trigger: You or an adjacent willing ally are the target of an attack.

defiant banner.name: Defiant Banner
defiant banner.text: You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure. You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner when you use this action gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn.

define \"report\".name: Define "Report"
define \"report\".text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life. Sometimes you have to give a sheepish smile and apologize for what you've done. When you fail a Deception check, reroll with your Diplomacy modifier.

define the canvas.name: Define the Canvas
define the canvas.text: You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas. The canvas is a 20-foot burst on the ground centered on a corner in your space.

deflect projectile.name: Deflect Projectile
deflect projectile.text: You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you have deflected it. You cannot use this feat to deflect unusually massive ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).
deflect projectile.trigger: You are the target of a physical ranged attack.
deflect projectile.requirements: You’re aware of the attack, are not off-guard against it, and have a hand free.

deflecting cloud.name: Deflecting Cloud
deflecting cloud.text: You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist. You become momentarily hidden from the triggering attack if vision is the attacker's only precise sense.
deflecting cloud.trigger: You are the target of a ranged attack.
deflecting cloud.requirements: You are aware of the attack and currently have dragon wings active.

deflecting jewel.name: Deflecting Jewel
deflecting jewel.text: You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates. Your dual nature has attuned your head gem to the half moon, and it has manifested the power to ward away attacks by drawing a line between them and you.
deflecting jewel.trigger: You're the target of a ranged attack while you possess your head gem.
deflecting jewel.requirements: You're aware of the triggering attack.

deflecting shot.name: Deflecting Shot
deflecting shot.text: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target. The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack.
deflecting shot.trigger: An ally within the first range increment of your firearm or crossbow is hit by an attack, and you can see the attacker.
deflecting shot.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

deflecting wave.name: Deflecting Wave
deflecting wave.text: A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack. You gain resistance to damage from the triggering effect equal to your level if it's bludgeoning or slashing, or double your level if it's acid or fire damage.
deflecting wave.trigger: You would take acid, bludgeoning, fire, or slashing damage from an enemy's attack, spell, or other hostile effect.
deflecting wave.requirements: You're aware of the hostile effect, and you aren't off-guard against it.

defy chains.name: Defy Chains
defy chains.text: You turn to face a fiend that attacked you, looking them squarely in the eyes (if it has them) and showing no fear. You increase the amount of damage you take by 4d6, and deal 4d6 spirit damage to the triggering fiend. The damage you take and deal increases to 5d6 at 18th level.
defy chains.trigger: A fiend within 15 feet of you damages you with a Strike.

defy hell.name: Defy Hell
defy hell.text: Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength and courage to withstand the enemy's attacks. As long as you're in this stance, you gain a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects and can make Hellbreaker Strikes. Hellbreaker Strike (holy) Make a weapon or unarmed Strike.

defy sorrow.name: Defy Sorrow
defy sorrow.text: You draw on this spiritual pain to push your body to greater heights. You gain the quickened condition until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.
defy sorrow.trigger: You’re dealt mental damage or spirit damage or you fail or critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

deific font.name: Deific Font
deific font.text: Your life force can fuel the stuff of miracles. You become drained 1 or increase the value of your drained condition by 1 if you already have the drained condition.

deimatic display.name: Deimatic Display
deimatic display.text: Imitating animal threat displays, you make yourself appear larger and more imposing. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. This attempt has the visual trait, loses the auditory trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.

delay trap.name: Delay Trap
delay trap.text: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects. Attempt a Thievery check to Disable a Device on the trap with the following results instead of the normal ones for the action.

outcomes.text: You either prevent the trap from being triggered or delay the activation until the start or end of your next turn.
As above, but the GM chooses whichever is worse for you.
No effect.
You're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

delay trap.trigger: A trap within your reach is triggered

deliberate death.name: Deliberate Death
deliberate death.text: Once, you died because someone—murderer, monster, or soldier— chose to strike you down. Just before losing consciousness, make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
deliberate death.trigger: You are about to gain the dying condition as a result of another creature's attack or ability, and that creature is within your melee reach.

demand surrender.name: Demand Surrender
demand surrender.text: Confident in your victory, you command your opponent's surrender. Choose one opponent you are observing. You command that opponent to surrender in a strong voice. They must attempt a Will save against your class DC, with the following results. Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
demand surrender.requirements: You and your allies currently outnumber enemies on the battlefield, and you or an ally has either restrained an opponent or reduced an opponent to 0 Hit Points since the start of your last turn.

demolish defenses.name: Demolish Defenses
demolish defenses.text: With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks. Make a melee Strike. This Strike deals one additional weapon die of damage; if the target is your taunted enemy, this increases to two additional weapon die of damage.

demolishing knockback.name: Demolishing Knockback
demolishing knockback.text: You make a forceful attack that has the power to push your foe through walls. Spend a Mythic Point and make a Strike at mythic proficiency. If you hit and deal damage to the target, you push them up to 15 feet away from you.

demon slayer.name: Demon Slayer
demon slayer.text: You can deliver a melee blow to a demon that creates an explosion of holy light to try to finish the demon off. In addition to the normal damage from your melee Strike, you also inflict 10d6 spirit damage to the demon. The demon can resist this additional damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.
demon slayer.source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 81

outcomes.text: The demon takes no damage.
The demon takes half damage.
The demon takes full damage and is dazzled for 1 round.
The demon takes full damage and is permanently blinded.

demonblood frenzy.name: Demonblood Frenzy
demonblood frenzy.text: Just the taste of fiendish blood is enough to send blood rushing through your veins in a supernatural fury. You become quickened until the end of your next turn and you can use the extra action to make a tusks Strike, Stride, or Step.
demonblood frenzy.trigger: You successfully Strike a living creature that has the fiend trait with your tusks unarmed attack

denier of destruction.name: Denier of Destruction
denier of destruction.text: You can manipulate the same energies that the aeon orbs use to sustain life. You cast heal on the triggering target. Instead of its normal effects, the heal spell reduces the triggering damage by an amount equal to the Hit Points a 1-action heal spell of that level would have recovered.
denier of destruction.trigger: Any ally within 30 feet that you can heal with your heal spell would take damage from an attack or effect from a source you can observe.
denier of destruction.requirements: You have a heal spell prepared and you aren't flat-footed to the source of the damage.

denounce tyranny.name: Denounce Tyranny
denounce tyranny.text: You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it. Attempt a Diplomacy check and compare the result to the Will DCs of up to three of the triggering creature's allies within 30 feet of you.
denounce tyranny.requirements: You witnessed a creature harm an ally, harm a noncombatant, or commit a wantonly evil act in the last round.

desert wind.name: Desert Wind
desert wind.text: A vortex of sand and dust surrounds you. Each creature inside your kinetic aura (including you) is concealed from any creature outside your kinetic aura, and creatures outside the aura are concealed from creatures inside the aura other than you. Your air impulses carry sands that cut at great speed.

desiccating inhalation.name: Desiccating Inhalation
desiccating inhalation.text: You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds. Creatures in a 30-foot cone take 6d8 negative damage, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails this saving throw is also drained 1.

desperate finisher.name: Desperate Finisher
desperate finisher.text: You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press. Use a single action that you know with the press trait. You forgo the ability to use reactions until the start of your next turn. This press uses your multiple attack penalty, as normal.
desperate finisher.trigger: You complete the last action on your turn, and your turn has not ended yet

desperate prayer.name: Desperate Prayer
desperate prayer.text: You call out to your deity in a plea for their aid. You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a devotion spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it is lost.
desperate prayer.trigger: You begin your turn and have no Focus Points.

desperate resuscitation.name: Desperate Resuscitation
desperate resuscitation.text: You can use your training in combat medicine to revive the recently deceased. Attempt a DC 40 Medicine check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds.
desperate resuscitation.requirements: You are holding a healer's toolkit or are wearing one and have a free hand; the target's body is mostly intact; the target was not killed by a death effect.

desperate revival.name: Desperate Revival
desperate revival.text: On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. Each creature in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes void damage equal to half its level.
The target takes void damage equal to its level.
The target takes void damage equal to double its level.

desperate revival.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed.

desperate surge.name: Desperate Surge
desperate surge.text: You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations. You can attempt to Grab, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a creature using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

desperate wrath.name: Desperate Wrath
desperate wrath.text: Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, a –1 penalty to AC, and a –1 penalty to saves. These bonuses and penalties last until your Rage ends or until you are above half Hit Points, whichever comes first.
desperate wrath.trigger: Your turn begins, and your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or less.

destroy resistance.name: Destroy Resistance
destroy resistance.text: Few gremlins achieve their full destructive power. You reduce all resistances of the creature you just hit by 5 for 1 minute.
destroy resistance.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against a creature.

determination.name: Determination
determination.text: Your training allows you to shrug off your foes’ spells and conditions when the need is dire. Choose a single nonpermanent condition, spell, or magical effect that is affecting you. If you chose a condition, its effect on you ends.

determined dash.name: Determined Dash
determined dash.text: Nothing can keep you from your enemy. Stride twice. During this movement you ignore difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and any effects that would impose a penalty to Speed.

detonating spell.name: Detonating Spell
detonating spell.text: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage to a single target and the spell successfully damages that target, the spell explodes, dealing splash damage equal to the level of the spell cast to adjacent creatures.

devastating duelist.name: Devastating Duelist
devastating duelist.text: You pointedly note your enemy's deficiencies, filling them with fear and dismay. Strike an opponent with your Aldori dueling sword. If the Strike is successful, attempt a Dueling Lore check against the target's Will DC. On a success, the target becomes frightened 2. This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

devastating manifestation.name: Devastating Manifestation
devastating manifestation.text: Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them. You Manifest Soulforged Armament. If you manifested a weapon, make up to two Strikes with that weapon, each targeting a different creature and each dealing an additional 1d6 spirit damage.
devastating manifestation.requirements: At least one of your soulforged armaments is not manifested.

devastating spellstrike.name: Devastating Spellstrike
devastating spellstrike.text: Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they smash into nearby foes. Make a Spellstrike with a spell that can deal damage. Enemies in a 5-foot emanation around the target (not including the target) take 2 damage of the same damage type your spell could deal.

devastating weaponry.name: Devastating Weaponry
devastating weaponry.text: You release a volley of projectiles from your weapon, or power it to fly in every direction across the battlefield and Strike multiple creatures. Make a Strike with your weapon innovation against each foe within 30 feet of you. Don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after making all the attacks.

devil in plain sight.name: Devil in Plain Sight
devil in plain sight.text: You've learned to draw your fiendish nature into a small ball of corruption and hide it in your soul. Your obviously fiendish traits disappear, including any tails, horns, and cloven hooves, though hints remain (claws turn into jagged nails or eyes retain an odd hue, for instance).

devoted guardian.name: Devoted Guardian
devoted guardian.text: You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward. Select one adjacent creature. As long as your shield is raised and the creature remains adjacent to you, the creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the shield you raised was a tower shield.
devoted guardian.requirements: Your last action was to Raise a Shield.

devrin's cunning stance.name: Devrin's Cunning Stance
devrin's cunning stance.text: You've learned Devrin Arlos's guileful ways, and his sly teachings help you remind your allies to keep their wits about them. When you use this action, attempt a Deception check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances.

outcomes.text: Your marshal's aura increases to a 20-foot emanation, and it grants you and your allies a +1 status bonus to skill checks. When you or an ally in the aura successfully Strike a flat-footed enemy, that enemy can't use reactions until the beginning of its next turn.
As critical success, but your aura's size doesn't increase.
You fail to enter the stance.
You fail to enter the stance and can't take this action again for 1 minute.

diabolic certitude.name: Diabolic Certitude
diabolic certitude.text: Your Hellknight training drilled details of Hell's denizens deep into your mind. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a devil you're observing. If you critically fail this check, you fail instead. If you succeed at this check, you critically succeed instead.
diabolic certitude.trigger: Your turn begins, and you can observe a devil.

diacritic fluency.name: Diacritic Fluency
diacritic fluency.text: When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed. The next time you Trace a Rune this turn, you can also Trace a diacritic Rune on that rune.

dig quickly.name: Dig Quickly
dig quickly.text: Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole. You dig a shallow pit in the square you currently occupy, turning the square into difficult terrain (including for you). In addition, you also kick up a cloud of grit in a direction of your choice.
dig quickly.requirements: You are standing on dirt, sand, snow, or similar particulate material.

dimensional pilfer.name: Dimensional Pilfer
dimensional pilfer.text: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners’ noses. Attempt a Thievery check to Palm an Object or Steal an object you can see within 60 feet. If you are veiled, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.

dire growth.name: Dire Growth
dire growth.text: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape. If you aren't already in your animal shape from Werecreature Dedication, you Change Shape into it. As long as you stay in animal shape, you have the effects of enlarge.

dirty trick.name: Dirty Trick
dirty trick.text: You hook a foe's bootlaces together, pull their hat over their eyes, loosen their belt, or otherwise confound their mobility through an underhanded tactic. Attempt a Thievery check against the target's Reflex DC.

outcomes.text: The target is clumsy 1 until they use an Interact action to end the impediment
As critical success, but the condition ends automatically after 1 round.
You fall prone as your attempt backfires.

dirty trick.requirements: You have a hand free and are within melee reach of an opponent.

disarming assault.name: Disarming Assault
disarming assault.text: You attack with enough force to knock the weapon out of your foe's hands. Make a melee Strike; if you hit, you can attempt an Athletics check to Disarm that enemy.

disarming block.name: Disarming Block
disarming block.text: With deft and practiced movement, you block at an angle to potentially dislodge the weapon. You attempt to Disarm the creature whose attack you blocked of the weapon they attacked you with. You can do so even if you don’t have a hand free.
disarming block.trigger: You Shield Block a melee Strike made with a held weapon.

disarming intercept.name: Disarming Intercept
disarming intercept.text: When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp. After Intercepting the Attack, attempt to Disarm the weapon used for that attack. You don't need to have a hand free, and you gain an item bonus to the Athletics check equal to the value of your armor's potency rune.
disarming intercept.trigger: You Intercept an Attack that was made with a melee weapon by a creature you’re adjacent to.

disarming smile.name: Disarming Smile
disarming smile.text: With a wide and sincere smile, you give your attacker pause. You attempt a Diplomacy check against the triggering attacker’s Will DC. After you use Disarming Smile, all creatures who witnessed you use it are temporarily immune to your Disarming Smile for the next 24 hours.

outcomes.text: Your enemy ceases their attack, momentarily taken aback by your disarming smile. The attack fails and the triggering target can’t attempt hostile actions against you until the beginning of its next turn or until you (or your allies) take hostile actions against the enemy (or its allies).
Your foe pauses momentarily. Their attack fails, but they can attempt further attacks against you.
The target’s attack is unaffected.

disarming smile.trigger: You are the target of a melee attack and the attacker has not rolled yet.
disarming smile.requirements: You are aware of the attacker, the attacker is an intelligent humanoid creature, and you have not attempted to harm the attacker.

disarming stance.name: Disarming Stance
disarming stance.text: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon. While you are in this stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Disarm and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to Disarm you.
disarming stance.requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

disarming twist.name: Disarming Twist
disarming twist.text: After your initial attack redirects your foe’s defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp. Make a melee Strike with a one-handed melee weapon. In addition to its other effects, this Strike gains the success and critical success effects of the Disarm action.
disarming twist.requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

discerning strike.name: Discerning Strike
discerning strike.text: Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses. Attempt a Strike against the target; if successful, you deal an additional 1d6 precision damage.
discerning strike.requirements: You have successfully identified the target with Recall Knowledge during this combat.

disciple's breath.name: Disciple's Breath
disciple's breath.text: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus. This has the effects of your dragon breath sorcerer bloodline spell, though it deals 9d6 damage instead of its usual damage, and you don't have to cast it or spend a Focus Point. You can't use Disciple's Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

disengaging twist.name: Disengaging Twist
disengaging twist.text: Your ability to twist your opponents’ bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments. Attempt an Athletics check to Escape the triggering condition. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.
disengaging twist.trigger: A creature gives you the grabbed or restrained condition.

dismal harvest.name: Dismal Harvest
dismal harvest.text: The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. The temporary Hit Points you gain increase by 5 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
dismal harvest.trigger: Your last action was a Mobbing Assault made by your horde that reduced at least one living creature to 0 Hit Points.

dismounting strike.name: Dismounting Strike
dismounting strike.text: You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon. You use the Mount action to dismount your horse but can move to any space within 10 feet of your mount, as long as your horse moved at least 15 feet. You then make a melee Strike.
dismounting strike.requirements: You are mounted on your horse, and your last action was to Command an Animal to order your horse to Stride at least once.

dispelling slice.name: Dispelling Slice
dispelling slice.text: Your sneak attack slices through the threads binding magic to a target. Make a Strike against an off-guard creature. If your Strike deals sneak attack damage, you attempt to counteract a single spell of your choice active on the target.

dispelling spellstrike.name: Dispelling Spellstrike
dispelling spellstrike.text: The spell you deliver tries to force out magic affecting your enemy. Make a Spellstrike. If it hits, you also attempt to counteract a single spell of your choice that is active on the target.

disperse into petals.name: Disperse into Petals
disperse into petals.text: You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals. You’re amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency modifier for unarmored defense.
disperse into petals.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

dispute terms.name: Dispute Terms
dispute terms.text: By questioning the terms of your contract, you temporarily stave off your doom at the cost of fiendish misfortune. Reduce the value of your doomed condition by 1. You roll your next attack roll, skill check, or saving throw twice and take the worse result.

disrupt prey.name: Disrupt Prey
disrupt prey.text: Make a melee Strike against your prey. If the attack is a critical hit, you disrupt the triggering action.
disrupt prey.trigger: Your hunted prey is within your reach, and it uses a manipulate action, uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using

disrupt qi.name: Disrupt Qi
disrupt qi.text: You carefully target a creature's pressure points to block its inner life force. Make an unarmed Strike. If it deals damage to a living creature, that creature takes 2d6 persistent void damage and is enfeebled 1 until the persistent damage ends.

disrupting strikes.name: Disrupting Strikes
disrupting strikes.text: You call forth positive energy from within to help you destroy undead. Your weapon and unarmed Strikes gain the effects of a disrupting property rune until the start of your next turn. If you're 14th level or higher, your Strikes instead gain the effects of a greater disrupting property rune.
disrupting strikes.source: Pathfinder #166: Despair on Danger Island pg. 79

disruptive stance.name: Disruptive Stance
disruptive stance.text: The slightest distraction can provoke your wrath, and you’re prepared to foil enemies’ actions. As long as you are in this stance, you can use Reactive Strike when a creature within your reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to manipulate and move actions.

disruptive stare.name: Disruptive Stare
disruptive stare.text: Your frigid gaze can turn a foe's blood to ice. The triggering creature must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. It then becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The triggering spell takes a –2 status penalty to its spell attack rolls and DCs.
The triggering spell is disrupted.

disruptive stare.trigger: A creature within 30 feet attempts to Cast a Spell with the concentrate trait.

dissolution's clarity.name: Dissolution's Clarity
dissolution's clarity.text: The Dissolution teaches that darkness can bring clarity and focus, serenity and strength—and so you draw on nearby shadows to replenish your magic. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.
dissolution's clarity.requirements: You're in an area of darkness.

dissolution's sight.name: Dissolution's Sight
dissolution's sight.text: Accepting your inner darkness means that no outer darkness can obscure your sight. You gain greater darkvision for 1 minute.

distant wandering.name: Distant Wandering
distant wandering.text: Your body falls unconscious and your spirit projects out of it. While in spirit form, you can’t consciously move your body, and you are invisible and inaudible, though a creature still might notice the signs of your presence and passing, just like for an invisible creature affected by silence, or a scouting eye.

distant waterbird's poise.name: Distant Waterbird's Poise
distant waterbird's poise.text: You flow around your foe, using the magic of your attack to carry you away. You Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump, and this movement doesn’t trigger reactions from the creature you hit. If you High Jump or Long Jump, you don’t have to perform the initial Stride (nor do you fall if you don’t Stride 10 feet).
distant waterbird's poise.trigger: You hit a target with a Spellstrike.

distracting explosion.name: Distracting Explosion
distracting explosion.text: Your enemies think they can concentrate on something else while you're nearby? Oh, you'll give them a distraction, all right! Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature with a weapon or unarmed attack that is benefiting from your offensive boost.
distracting explosion.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a concentrate action.

distracting flattery.name: Distracting Flattery
distracting flattery.text: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company. Make a Deception check against the target’s Will DC. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your Distracting Flattery for 10 minutes.

outcomes.text: The target’s attitude doesn’t decrease as a result of
The target’s attitude decreases as normal.
Your attempt makes matters worse, decreasing

distracting flattery.trigger: You observe a target’s attitude toward yourself or your allies decrease as a result of an ally’s behavior.

distracting performance.name: Distracting Performance
distracting performance.text: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to Sneak away with ease. You Create a Diversion, except you roll a Performance check instead of Deception, and the benefits of successful checks apply to an ally of your choice instead of you.

distracting pratfall.name: Distracting Pratfall
distracting pratfall.text: Your stumbling and bumbling can provide a brief distraction that renders an enemy unprepared for an attack. You Drop Prone, then attempt a Deception check against the Perception DC of a target within 30 feet who can see you.

outcomes.text: The target is completely distracted by your fall. It's off-guard against attacks from creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.
The target's attention is momentarily diverted to you. It's off-guard against the next attack a creature other than you attempts against it before the start of your next turn.
The target is unaffected.
Your pratfall turns into a real fall. You take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

distracting spellstrike.name: Distracting Spellstrike
distracting spellstrike.text: You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike. Make a Spellstrike and Feint against the target of your Strike. Execute your Feint immediately before making the Strike, but after choosing your target.
distracting spellstrike.requirements: You have a hand free, and your Spellstrike is charged.

distracting toss.name: Distracting Toss
distracting toss.text: You toss one weapon into the air as a distraction as you throw another. Choose a creature within 30 feet and Feint against it; you can attempt this Feint even if the target is not within melee range, and if the target becomes off-guard as a result of the Feint, this applies to your thrown weapon attacks for the duratio…

disturbing knowledge.name: Disturbing Knowledge
disturbing knowledge.text: You utter a litany of dreadful names, prophecies, and descriptions of realms beyond mortal comprehension, drawn from your study of forbidden tomes and scrolls. Even those who don't understand your language are unsettled by these dire secrets.

outcomes.text: The target becomes confused for 1 round and frightened 1.
The target becomes frightened 1.
The target is unaffected.
You get overly caught up in your own words and become frightened 1.

dive of the divine.name: Dive of the Divine
dive of the divine.text: You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you. You Fly straight down, landing safely in the nearest unoccupied space directly below you. When you land, all creatures in a 10-foot emanation take 8d10 spirit damage (basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC).

diverse recognition.name: Diverse Recognition
diverse recognition.text: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats. Attempt to Recall Knowledge against a different kind of creature you can see using the same skill. You must still meet the requirements to attempt this check.
diverse recognition.trigger: You successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, using a skill in which you are a master.

divert destiny.name: Divert Destiny
divert destiny.text: You defy the fate before you, calling on wells of mythic vitality to sustain your life and allow you to persevere. You expend 1 Mythic Point and survive the triggering attack or effect, lose the wounded or dying conditions entirely, don’t increase your doomed condition, and are conscious and standing with a number of H…
divert destiny.trigger: An attack or effect would reduce you to 0 Hit Points or kill you outright.

divert streamflow.name: Divert Streamflow
divert streamflow.text: With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream. Attempt an Athletics check to Reposition the creature who dealt the triggering damage. If you’re successful, you can Step as a free action.
divert streamflow.trigger: You’re damaged by a melee Strike by a creature in your reach.

diverting vortex.name: Diverting Vortex
diverting vortex.text: You use vestiges of magic to create a protective vortex. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC against ranged weapon attacks and physical ranged unarmed attacks.
diverting vortex.requirements: Your most recent action was to cast a noncantrip spell.

divide and conquer.name: Divide and Conquer
divide and conquer.text: When you face multiple foes, you wield your warshard weapon with vigor. Spend 1 Mythic Point, then Step to a space where you threaten at least two opponents with your warshard weapon. Attempt two Strikes at mythic proficiency, each against a different target.
divide and conquer.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86
divide and conquer.requirements: You are wielding a melee warshard weapon.

divine aegis.name: Divine Aegis
divine aegis.text: A barrier offers protection against other magic but leaves you exposed to divine energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against nondivine magical effects, but you also take a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against divine effects.
divine aegis.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, but you haven’t rolled yet.

divine disharmony.name: Divine Disharmony
divine disharmony.text: From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects—such as the religious symbols of two deities that are hated enemies—and combine them in a display that causes discordant clashes of divine energy that are especially distracting to the faithful.

outcomes.text: The creature is off-guard to your attacks until the end of your next turn.
The creature is off-guard to your attacks until the end of your current turn.

divine grace.name: Divine Grace
divine grace.text: You call upon your deity's grace, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to the save.
divine grace.trigger: You attempt a save against a spell, but you haven’t rolled yet.

divine infusion.name: Divine Infusion
divine infusion.text: You pour energy into the subject of your healing to empower its attacks. If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal to restore Hit Points to a single creature, the target then deals an additional 1d6 damage with its melee weapons and unarmed attacks until the end of its next turn.

divine invulnerability.name: Divine Invulnerability
divine invulnerability.text: Though you are not yet a god, you can invoke a measure of omnipotence that makes you high invulnerable. Spend a Mythic Point. You gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level for 1 minute as your aura smolders with power.

divine presence.name: Divine Presence
divine presence.text: Your spirit becomes one with your deity, granting you the bearing of a god. As long as you are in this stance, you have a 5-foot emanation that has the aura trait. Whenever you take an action, you can take it from your space or any space within the emanation as if it were the space you occupy.

divine rebuttal.name: Divine Rebuttal
divine rebuttal.text: You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually. You can Strike the adjacent creature with your deity’s favored weapon. If you are holy or unholy, the Strike gains that trait.
divine rebuttal.trigger: Your ally is about to roll a saving throw against a magical ability of a creature you’re adjacent to
divine rebuttal.requirements: You are wielding your deity’s favored weapon

divine weapon.name: Divine Weapon
divine weapon.text: You siphon residual spell energy into a weapon you’re wielding. Until the end of your turn, the weapon deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage. If you are holy or unholy, Strikes with the weapon also gain that trait, and the additional damage increases to 2d4 against creatures of the opposing trait.
divine weapon.trigger: You finish Casting a Spell using one of your divine spell slots on your turn

divine wings.name: Divine Wings
divine wings.text: With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings. These wings remain for 10 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while you’ve manifested your wings.

dizzying spell.name: Dizzying Spell
dizzying spell.text: Your spell leaves a foe’s head spinning and unable to concentrate. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a Will saving throw and targets a single creature, the target is stupefied 2 for 1 round if it fails its saving throw (or stupefied 3 on a critical failure).

dizzying spin dance.name: Dizzying Spin Dance
dizzying spin dance.text: You’re practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed. Tumble Through an opponent’s space, and then Strike that opponent. If both the Tumble Through and Strike are successful, the opponent is off-guard to the next attack made against it before the start of your next turn, and you can attempt to Tumble Through…

do you know who i am?.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
do you know who i am?.text: Your reputation casts a long shadow, allowing you to throw your cultural weight around, especially in larger settlements. With a well-timed tirade or attention-getting shout, you can break a foe's mind and bring them low. Choose a foe within 30 feet, and attempt an Intimidation check against the target's Will DC.

outcomes.text: The target takes 12d6 mental damage and becomes frightened 3. It can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 if it ends its turn adjacent to you.
The target takes 6d6 mental damage and becomes frightened 2.
The target is unaffected.
The target is unaffected, and the embarrassment causes you to take 6d6 mental damage.

doctor's visitation.name: Doctor's Visitation
doctor's visitation.text: You move to provide immediate care to those who need it. You Stride, then use Battle Medicine or Treat Poison. You can spend 2 actions for Doctor’s Visitation to instead Stride and then use either Administer First Aid or Treat Condition (if you have that feat).

dodge away.name: Dodge Away
dodge away.text: You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving if you choose. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you, you can Step after the Strike. If you're a master in Acrobatics, you can move 10 feet for this Step instead of 5 feet.
dodge away.trigger: You are the target of a melee attack.
dodge away.requirements: You're aware of the attack and aren't off-guard.

dodging roll.name: Dodging Roll
dodging roll.text: You dodge a blow at the last possible moment. You Step and gain resistance to all damage equal to your level against the triggering effect. If your Step moves you out of the triggering effect's area, this resistance is instead equal to your level plus your Dexterity modifier.
dodging roll.trigger: You take damage from an area effect that allows a Reflex save.

dominion aura.name: Dominion Aura
dominion aura.text: For a short time, you fully manifest the expectations of the god destroyer within you. All creatures within a 10-foot emanation take 8d6 force damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails this save is also knocked prone.

domino effect.name: Domino Effect
domino effect.text: You've learned to pull the invisible strings of magic to affect targets that wouldn't normally be. A creature you choose within 15 feet of the triggering creature is affected by the same snare as if they had also triggered it.
domino effect.trigger: A creature triggers a magical snare you crafted.

don thy fervor.name: Don thy Fervor
don thy fervor.text: With a thought, the passion of your fiendish desires becomes evident in your eyes and posture. For the next minute, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill checks. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to counteract checks.

don't stop dancing.name: Don't Stop Dancing
don't stop dancing.text: You encourage others to keep moving, despite obstacles that might prevent them from dancing fully, showing them ways to keep their feet moving. Choose an ally within 60 feet. That ally can ignore difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

doom of sailors.name: Doom of Sailors
doom of sailors.text: Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again. You sing a song that foretells the fate of a creature you can see within 60 feet.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes half damage and is frightened 1 as it glimpses its demise.

The target takes full damage and is frightened 1. In addition, it rolls twice for all skill checks and saving throws it attempts until the end of its next turn and takes the worse result; this is a misfortune effect.
As failure, except double damage and frightened 2.

double shot.name: Double Shot
double shot.text: You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession. Make two Strikes, each against a separate target and with a –2 penalty. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both of them.
double shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0

double slice.name: Double Slice
double slice.text: You lash out at your foe with both weapons. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two melee weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If the second Strike is made with a weapon that doesn’t have the agile trait, it takes a –2 penalty.
double slice.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

double take.name: Double Take
double take.text: You performatively throw a disinterested glance at danger before looking away. The triggering effect is suppressed until the beginning of your next turn, at which point you melodramatically return your attention to it.
double take.trigger: You fail, but don’t critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait.

dousing spell.name: Dousing Spell
dousing spell.text: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell targeting a single creature, you soak the target of the spell with water.

draconic fury.name: Draconic Fury
draconic fury.text: You briefly summon spectral claws that lash out in a flurry. All creatures in a 15-foot cone take 2d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that critically fails the save also takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.
draconic fury.requirements: You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

draconic resilience.name: Draconic Resilience
draconic resilience.text: Energy reminiscent of dragon scales shimmers over you, making it more difficult for attacks to penetrate your defenses. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and gain resistance equal to half your level to bludgeoning damage.
draconic resilience.requirements: You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

drag down.name: Drag Down
drag down.text: While swimming in water at least 10 feet deep, you grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the creature.
drag down.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 395

dragging strike.name: Dragging Strike
dragging strike.text: You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer. Make a melee Strike. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is flat-footed until the end of your current turn, and you can move it 5 feet toward you.

outcomes.text: The target becomes flat-footed until the end of your current turn.

dragon roar.name: Dragon Roar
dragon roar.text: You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies. Enemies within a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a Will save against your Intimidation DC or be frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure).

dragon stance.name: Dragon Stance
dragon stance.text: You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail. You can make dragon tail attacks that deal 1d10 bludgeoning damage. They are in the brawling group and have the backswing, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

dragon transformation.name: Dragon Transformation
dragon transformation.text: You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank dragon form except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from Rage, and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC.

dragon's flight.name: Dragon's Flight
dragon's flight.text: You have grown a small pair of draconic wings or have honed your use of the wings you've had since birth. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

dragon's journey.name: Dragon's Journey
dragon's journey.text: Your movements are like that of a dragon weaving a serpentine path between your enemies and allies. Using your fans, you slice the air and create a path of least resistance, allowing you to move across the battlefield with an ethereal grace.
dragon's journey.requirements: You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

dragon's rage breath.name: Dragon's Rage Breath
dragon's rage breath.text: You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d6 damage per level to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. The damage type matches your instinct's dragon breath, and this action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.

dragon's rage wings.name: Dragon's Rage Wings
dragon's rage wings.text: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon. While you are raging, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. If you are flying when your rage ends, you start to fall, but your transformation doesn't revert until the last moment, so you take no damage from the fall and land standi…

dragonet breath.name: Dragonet Breath
dragonet breath.text: You have developed your magical breath. You expel the dragonet breath associated with your heritage. Dragonet Breath gains the traits listed in parentheses, and the DC is your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. After you use Dragonet Breath, you can’t use it again for 1d4 rounds.

drain emotion.name: Drain Emotion
drain emotion.text: You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion. Attempt a counteract check against a single emotion or fear effect affecting the touched creature. If you succeed, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

drain vitality.name: Drain Vitality
drain vitality.text: You draw out the bestial magic energy within your bonded beast gun to fortify yourself, purge ongoing harm, and bolster your life force with a sheath of swirling life essence.
drain vitality.requirements: You have possession of your bonded beast gun.

draining strike.name: Draining Strike
draining strike.text: You draw the life out of your target using both your weapon and your thralls as a conduit. Make a Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

draining touch.name: Draining Touch
draining touch.text: You reach out your arm, grasping hungrily for a source of energy. Attempt a melee Strike. If you succeed, you deal 1d8 cold damage for every 2 levels you have to the target, or double damage on a critical success.

draw from the land.name: Draw from the Land
draw from the land.text: You pull strength from the surrounding terrain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. They last for 1 round. If you previously gained the plains terrain attunement effect this turn, combine the temporary Hit Points together.
draw from the land.requirements: You gained a terrain attunement benefit this turn, and it matched the terrain you're in.

drawn in vital ink.name: Drawn in Vital Ink
drawn in vital ink.text: After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood. For the next minute, you can Trace a Rune targeting the creature you drew blood from at a range of 60 feet (even if you’re Tracing a Rune as a single action).
drawn in vital ink.requirements: During your last action, you succeeded at a melee Strike that dealt physical damage to a creature that can bleed.

draxie dust.name: Draxie Dust
draxie dust.text: You blow a cloud of magical dust and tiny scales, enchanting those who inhale it. Roll 1d6 to determine the dust's effects. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC, and is affected as if it got the same outcome on a Will save against the rolled spell…

dread marshal stance.name: Dread Marshal Stance
dread marshal stance.text: Putting on a grim face for the battle ahead, you encourage your allies to strike fear into their foes with vicious attacks. When you use this action, attempt an Intimidation check. The DC is usually an easy DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances.

outcomes.text: Your marshal’s aura grants you and your allies in the aura a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. When you or an ally in the aura critically hit an enemy with a Strike, that enemy is frightened 1.
You fail to enter the stance.
You fail to enter the stance and can’t take this action again for 1 minute.

dream guise.name: Dream Guise
dream guise.text: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you. Then, either you or your ally Strides. You each maintain the merged appearance.

drifter's juke.name: Drifter's Juke
drifter's juke.text: You move in and out of range to complement your attacks. You Step, make a Strike, Step, and make another Strike. One Strike must be a ranged Strike using your firearm or crossbow, and the other must be a melee Strike using your melee weapon or unarmed attack. You can choose not to take one or both Steps.
drifter's juke.requirements: You're wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand, and your other hand is either wielding a melee weapon or is empty.

drifting pollen.name: Drifting Pollen
drifting pollen.text: A haze of pollen floats around you. A creature in your kinetic aura when you enter the stance, or who later enters the aura or ends its turn in the aura, attempts at a Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure, it's sickened 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure) and dazzled until it's no longer sickened.

drive back.name: Drive Back
drive back.text: You push the enemy back and attempt to intercede between the foe and your ally. You attempt to Shove the triggering enemy with your shield just as it attacks, pushing it back just after the attempt. Your shield has the shove trait for this Shove attempt.
drive back.trigger: An enemy within your reach Strikes an ally adjacent to you.

drive-by attack.name: Drive-By Attack
drive-by attack.text: You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control. You Drive, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack. At any point during your vehicle's movement, you Strike.

driving rain.name: Driving Rain
driving rain.text: Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision. Each creature in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

drowning mist.name: Drowning Mist
drowning mist.text: Though not unique to Chelaxian kineticists, this sarglagon-inspired technique floods enemies’ lungs. Your elemental gate exudes a faint mist that feels as thick as standing water. The moisture doesn’t just tug at limbs; it forcibly seeps into the nostrils and lungs of air-breathing creatures.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of this impulse for 24 hours.
The creature is unaffected.
Moisture seeps into the creature’s lungs, making the creature sickened 1.
As failure, but sickened 2.

dual finisher.name: Dual Finisher
dual finisher.text: You split your attacks. Make two melee Strikes, one with each required weapon, each against a different foe. If the second Strike is made with a non-agile weapon, it takes a –2 penalty. Increase your multiple attack penalty only after attempting both Strikes.
dual finisher.requirements: You wield two melee weapons, one in each hand.

dual-handed assault.name: Dual-Handed Assault
dual-handed assault.text: You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent. Make a Strike with the required weapon. You quickly switch your grip during the Strike in order to make the attack with two hands.
dual-handed assault.requirements: You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon and have a free hand

dual-weapon blitz.name: Dual-Weapon Blitz
dual-weapon blitz.text: You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield. Stride up to your Speed. During this movement, you can Strike once with each of the two one-handed melee weapons. Each of these Strikes can be made at any point during your movement.
dual-weapon blitz.requirements: You are wielding two one handed melee weapons, each in a different hand.

dualistic synergy.name: Dualistic Synergy
dualistic synergy.text: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit. If the spell is arcane, you can attempt a skill check to Recall Knowledge with a +1 status bonus to the check after casting the spell, or a +2 status bonus if the spell is 7th level or higher.

dueling dance (fighter).name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)
dueling dance (fighter).text: Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon. While you are in this stance, you constantly have the benefits of Dueling Parry
dueling dance (fighter).requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

dueling parry (fighter).name: Dueling Parry (Fighter)
dueling parry (fighter).text: You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn as long as you continue to meet the requirements.
dueling parry (fighter).requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

dueling riposte.name: Dueling Riposte
dueling riposte.text: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy. Make a melee Strike against or attempt to Disarm the triggering creature.
dueling riposte.trigger: A creature within your reach critically fails a Strike against you
dueling riposte.requirements: You are benefiting from Dueling Parry

duelist's challenge.name: Duelist's Challenge
duelist's challenge.text: Select one enemy you can see and proclaim a challenge against it. That enemy is your dueling opponent until it's defeated, it flees from the encounter, or the encounter ends.

duelist's edge.name: Duelist's Edge
duelist's edge.text: You hone your reaction time through duels and learn to draw your weapon seamlessly as you begin a fight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering initiative roll, and you can immediately Interact to draw an Aldori dueling sword.
duelist's edge.trigger: You roll initiative, and you are observing at least one opponent.

duelist's form.name: Duelist's Form
duelist's form.text: Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction. This could not be further from the truth.
duelist's form.requirements: You are wielding only an Aldori dueling sword and have your other hand or hands free; you are not fatigued.

duo dragon kick.name: Duo Dragon Kick
duo dragon kick.text: You’ve practiced an impressive spin technique with your construct, automatically attacking in tandem as you launch each other through the air. You Command your construct companion to fight alongside you, after which you both Leap in the same direction, making an unarmed Strike at the start or end of the Leap; this uses…
duo dragon kick.requirements: Your construct innovation is adjacent to you.

duo's aim.name: Duo's Aim
duo's aim.text: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack. Make a ranged weapon Strike against a foe either within your spotter's melee reach or the first range increment of a ranged weapon your spotter is wielding.

dust cloud.name: Dust Cloud
dust cloud.text: Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight. All creatures within your waking world become concealed, and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it until the start of your next turn.

earth to heavens strike.name: Earth to Heavens Strike
earth to heavens strike.text: Your blows hamper both a foe’s mobility and cognitive functions by focusing first on their lower extremities and then their head. Make a Strike; if you hit and deal damage, the creature is also clumsy 1 until the end of your next turn. Then, make another Strike against the same creature.

ease the burden.name: Ease the Burden
ease the burden.text: You wash away a creature’s pain with a touch. An adjacent creature regains 100 Hit Points and reduces their drained, clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, and stupefied conditions by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

eat fortune.name: Eat Fortune
eat fortune.text: As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference. The triggering effect is disrupted. If it's a misfortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the fortune trait; if it's a fortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the misfortune trait.
eat fortune.trigger: A creature within 60 feet uses a fortune or misfortune effect.

ebb and flow.name: Ebb and Flow
ebb and flow.text: You can pull forth both vitality and the void simultaneously to harm your enemies and heal your allies. If your next action is to cast a 1-action or 2-action heal or harm spell, choose one creature in range that would be harmed by the spell, and choose another creature within range that would be healed by the spell.

echoes in stone.name: Echoes in Stone
echoes in stone.text: You pause a moment to attune your senses to the stone around you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet.
echoes in stone.requirements: You are standing on a stone or earthen surface

echoing channel.name: Echoing Channel
echoing channel.text: When you pull forth vitality or void energy, you also create a smaller pocket of that energy. If the next action you use is to cast a 2-action harm or heal to heal or damage a single creature, choose one additional creature in range. Target that creature with a 1-action version of the same spell.

echoing spell.name: Echoing Spell
echoing spell.text: You time the components of your spell with exacting precision, setting up a resonance that duplicates the spell's effects. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 4th rank or lower that has no duration, the spell's energy reverberates and echoes.

echoing violence.name: Echoing Violence
echoing violence.text: Your powerful attack causes damage that reverberates through your opponent’s body, shaking muscle from bone. The creature takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. If it critically fails, it immediately dies as your blow tears apart its body internally.
echoing violence.trigger: You critically succeed with an unarmed Strike against an opponent.

eclectic obsession.name: Eclectic Obsession
eclectic obsession.text: Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions. You reflect on snippets you’ve learned to temporarily become trained in one Lore skill of your choice.

eclectic sword mastery.name: Eclectic Sword Mastery
eclectic sword mastery.text: You instinctively learn how to use a sword with just a few practice swings. You change one of the swords designated in your Tengu Weapon Familiarity to a new one that you're wielding, provided the sword meets the specifications of Tengu Weapon Familiarity.

ectoplasmic aura.name: Ectoplasmic Aura
ectoplasmic aura.text: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm. Additionally, any enemy that ends its turn in this aura must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC.

edict of mortality.name: Edict of Mortality
edict of mortality.text: You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: “Let no mortal be beholden to a god.” Attempt an Intimidation check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC.

outcomes.text: The target becomes frightened 2. Until the start of your next turn, if the target attempts to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, it must succeed at a DC 7 flat check or the action is lost.
As critical success, but frightened 1, and the DC of the flat check is 5.

edifying trace.name: Edifying Trace
edifying trace.text: When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you. Trace a Rune onto an adjacent enemy and then attempt a skill check to Recall Knowledge about that target.

educate allies.name: Educate Allies
educate allies.text: You tweak the properties of your composition spell to convey a bit of your defensive knowledge. All allies affected by your composition spell gain your +1 circumstance bonus from Well-Versed until the start of your next turn.
educate allies.trigger: An ally benefiting from one of your composition spells is subject to an effect with the auditory, illusion, linguistic, sonic, or visual trait

educated assessment.name: Educated Assessment
educated assessment.text: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature’s Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment. You might get a different degree of success on the Recall Knowledge check than what you get for the Battle Assessment.

eerie flicker.name: Eerie Flicker
eerie flicker.text: Your body flickers momentarily into the Ethereal Plane. You become concealed for 1 round, and the flat check for concealment applies to the Strike that would have hit you. If the flat check fails, the Strike misses you.
eerie flicker.trigger: An enemy’s Strike would hit you and you weren’t already concealed, hidden, or undetected by that enemy.

eerie proclamation.name: Eerie Proclamation
eerie proclamation.text: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched. You can spot these places, and you can awaken them.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.

Something goes horribly awry for the victim in the cursed ground. The details are up to the GM—it can be a purely “natural” accident (they step into an old bear trap, perhaps) or something stranger and more spectral. The target gains a condition for 2 rounds.
As failure, but the effect is astonishingly gruesome. Use the critical failure column, and the condition lasts for 1 minute.

eerie proclamation.requirements: You must be in either natural terrain or in abandoned or relatively unused artificial terrain (such as a darkened alley or haunted house).

effortless captivation.name: Effortless Captivation
effortless captivation.text: You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought. You Sustain an innate captivator spell.

effortless concentration.name: Effortless Concentration
effortless concentration.text: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain action, allowing you to extend the duration of one of your active spells. Special This can only be used on a cantrip or spell from the class matching the one you gained this feat from.

effortless impulse.name: Effortless Impulse
effortless impulse.text: A steady ripple from your kinetic gate maintains one of your impulses. You immediately Sustain one of your active impulses that can be sustained.

eidetic memorization.name: Eidetic Memorization
eidetic memorization.text: Pathfinders are often asked to study the intricacies of ancient history under less than ideal conditions, and you've trained your brain to make the most of your limited time. You quickly memorize an inscription, scroll, or other piece of writing you can clearly see whose length is equivalent to no more than one page.

eidolon's retort.name: Eidolon's Retort
eidolon's retort.text: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, your eidolon disrupts that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.
eidolon's retort.trigger: A creature within your eidolon’s reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

eidolon's trample.name: Eidolon's Trample
eidolon's trample.text: Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter. They can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample.

elaborate flourish.name: Elaborate Flourish
elaborate flourish.text: You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, creatures with the ability to Cast that Spell don't automatically know what the spell is.

elbow breaker.name: Elbow Breaker
elbow breaker.text: You bend your opponent’s body or limbs into agonizing positions that make it difficult for them to maintain their grip. Make an unarmed melee Strike against the creature you have grabbed or restrained. This Strike has the following effects in addition to its usual effects.

outcomes.text: You knock one held item out of the creature's grasp. It falls to the ground in the creature's space.

You weaken your target's grasp on the item. Further attempts to Disarm the target of that item gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks with the item or other checks requiring a firm grasp on the item.

elbow breaker.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

eldritch reload.name: Eldritch Reload
eldritch reload.text: You integrate your talent for magic into your use of reloading weapons. You Interact to reload a weapon you are wielding.
eldritch reload.requirements: Your last action this turn was to make an Eldritch Shot, Cast a Spell from a spell slot, or activate a piece of magical ammunition; this can't have been a free action or reaction.

electric counter.name: Electric Counter
electric counter.text: You gain resistance to electricity equal to your level until the start of your next turn. If the triggering damage was electricity, this resistance applies to it. If the triggering damage was from a melee attack, the attacker takes 3d6 electricity damage.
electric counter.requirements: You are in Wild Winds stance.

electrify armor.name: Electrify Armor
electrify armor.text: You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you. For 1 round, any creature that touches you, or that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon attack, takes 1d4 electricity damage. The effect ends if you cease wearing your armor innovation.
electrify armor.requirements: You are wearing your armor innovation.

electrogenesis.name: Electrogenesis
electrogenesis.text: Some animals and beasts have electric organs in their body that they can use to jolt their prey. You may not have the requisite physiology to do the same, but a touch of primal magic can achieve the same effect. Make a melee unarmed Strike against a creature.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is clumsy 1 for 1 round.
The creature is clumsy 2 for 1 round.
The creature is clumsy 3 for 1 round.

elemental artillery.name: Elemental Artillery
elemental artillery.text: Spinning wood and metal together, you create a rugged wooden ballista. The ballista is Medium and appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It immediately shoots a bolt with a jagged tip of elemental metal. Make an impulse attack roll against the AC of a target within 120 feet.

elemental assault.name: Elemental Assault
elemental assault.text: You shroud your arms and held weapons in elemental magic. Choose one element. Until the end of your next turn, your Strikes deal an additional 1d6 damage of the indicated type and have the trait corresponding to the element: electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, or cold for water.

elemental bulwark.name: Elemental Bulwark
elemental bulwark.text: You call upon the corresponding elements of your suli heritage to resist the effect. You gain resistance 5 against the triggering damage.
elemental bulwark.trigger: An enemy is about to damage you with cold, electricity, or fire, or with a spell that has the air, earth, fire, or water trait.

elemental defense.name: Elemental Defense
elemental defense.text: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has at least one element trait (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood), you gain resistance to effects that have the element traits of your spell equal to twice the spell’s…

elemental explosion.name: Elemental Explosion
elemental explosion.text: You unleash the energy roiling within you, exploding elemental matter in a 15-foot emanation. Each creature in the area takes 1d8 damage per level you possess, with the same type you chose for elemental rage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save against your class DC.
elemental explosion.requirements: You're raging, and you haven't used this ability since you last Raged.

elemental revision.name: Elemental Revision
elemental revision.text: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels. You touch an adjacent corrosive, flaming, frost, shock, or thundering rune on an unattended item or one held or worn by a willing creature, and you change it to any other rune from that list.

elemental transformation.name: Elemental Transformation
elemental transformation.text: You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy. You're affected by an elemental form spell with the same trait as your kinetic element. You can heighten it to any spell rank up to half your level rounded up.

elf step.name: Elf Step
elf step.text: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad. You Step 5 feet twice.

elucidation.name: Elucidation
elucidation.text: You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well. Whenever you disbelieve an illusion, all allies within 15 feet can use a free action to attempt a saving throw to disbelieve the illusion as well.
elucidation.trigger: You succeed at a saving throw to disbelieve an illusion.

elude trouble.name: Elude Trouble
elude trouble.text: Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the creature that missed you.
elude trouble.trigger: A creature missed you with a melee attack.

elven persistence.name: Elven Persistence
elven persistence.text: Elves don’t give up easily on their pursuits. Instead of the result you received for the triggering skill check, you receive a result of 12 + your proficiency bonus (don’t apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).
elven persistence.trigger: You fail a skill check you’re at least trained in.

embrace the pain.name: Embrace the Pain
embrace the pain.text: Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the triggering creature or to Disarm the creature of the weapon it damaged you with.
embrace the pain.trigger: A creature within your reach damages you with a melee attack.

emergency medical assistance.name: Emergency Medical Assistance
emergency medical assistance.text: You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires.
emergency medical assistance.requirements: An adjacent ally is suffering persistent damage.

emergency regeneration.name: Emergency Regeneration
emergency regeneration.text: You have battled against foes whose bodies naturally regenerate, and while yours doesn't do so all the time, it can happen in a pinch. You gain the effects of a 7th-rank regenerate spell. At 20th level, you gain the effects of a 9th-rank regenerate instead.
emergency regeneration.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 hit points from damage that’s neither acid nor fire.

emergency targe.name: Emergency Targe
emergency targe.text: You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield. The circumstance bonus applies to your defenses when determining the outcome of the triggering attack or spell.
emergency targe.trigger: An enemy you’re aware of hits you with a Strike or a spell attack, or you fail a save against an enemy’s spell.
emergency targe.requirements: You are wielding a shield or have the shield spell prepared.

emissary of peace.name: Emissary of Peace
emissary of peace.text: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender. You attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression against a single foe whose Hit Points are at less than half of their maximum value, followed by an immediate Request to convince that creature to cease fighting.

emit defensive odor.name: Emit Defensive Odor
emit defensive odor.text: While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes 2d6 poison damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.

emotional push.name: Emotional Push
emotional push.text: You prepare to take advantage of your enemy’s sudden change in emotions. The target is off-guard against your next attack before the end of your next turn.
emotional push.trigger: An enemy you’re aware of fails its save against an emotion spell

emotional surge.name: Emotional Surge
emotional surge.text: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment. You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks until the start of your next turn.

empathetic plea.name: Empathetic Plea
empathetic plea.text: The way you cringe or use those puppydog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker. Attempt a Diplomacy check against your attacker's Will DC.

outcomes.text: The creature pulls its attack, wasting its action, and can't use hostile actions against you until the beginning of its next turn.

The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to damage on the triggering Strike and all its Strikes against you until the beginning of its next turn. The penalty is –4 if you're an expert in Diplomacy, –6 if you're a master, and –8 if you're legendary.
