The creature's attack is unaffected, and the creature is temporarily immune to your Empathic Pleas for 24 hours.

empathetic plea.trigger: You are attacked by a creature that you haven't yet acted hostile toward. You must use this reaction before the creature rolls its attack.

emphatic emissary.name: Emphatic Emissary
emphatic emissary.text: You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your initiative roll. During your first turn in combat, you can use your Disarming Smile, targeting every hostile intelligent humanoid creature that can see you but has yet to act.

empowered onslaught.name: Empowered Onslaught
empowered onslaught.text: When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results. You channel your combat focus into the power of your battle auras. Choose one active battle aura you have; that battle aura’s status bonus or penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.
empowered onslaught.trigger: You critically hit and Sustain a battle aura.

enchanting shot.name: Enchanting Shot
enchanting shot.text: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks. Make a bow or crossbow Strike. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target also becomes stunned 1.

encouraging words.name: Encouraging Words
encouraging words.text: You give an ally within 30 feet a quick pep talk, helping them recover. Attempt a Diplomacy check. The DC is usually 15, though the GM might adjust it based on the circumstances.

outcomes.text: The ally recovers 2d8 Stamina Points.
The ally recovers 1d8 Stamina Points.
The ally takes 1d8 mental damage, but this can reduce only Stamina Points, never Hit Points.

encouraging words.requirements: The target ally lost Stamina Points within the last round.

endure death's touch.name: Endure Death's Touch
endure death's touch.text: Your conviction redirects the undead’s attack through your armor and then harmlessly away. You gain resistance 5 to physical damage and resistance 10 to negative damage against the triggering attack.
endure death's touch.trigger: An undead hits you with an unarmed attack.
endure death's touch.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor in which you have expert proficiency.

enduring debilitation.name: Enduring Debilitation
enduring debilitation.text: You can make your debilitation last an exceptionally long time. The triggering debilitation lasts for 1 minute instead of until the end of your next turn.
enduring debilitation.trigger: You apply a debilitation to a creature.

energetic resonance.name: Energetic Resonance
energetic resonance.text: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells. Expend one of your spell slots of a level equal to or higher than that of the triggering spell. You gain resistance to one of the triggering effect's damage types equal to twice the expended spell slot's level.
energetic resonance.trigger: You would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage from a spell.
energetic resonance.requirements: You have an unexpended spell slot of a level equal to or higher than the triggering spell.

energize bite.name: Energize Bite
energize bite.text: The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks. Until the end of your turn, your jaws unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of a type matching that of your draconic benefactor. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.
energize bite.requirements: Your most recent action was to use Breath of the Dragon.

energized font.name: Energized Font
energized font.text: You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

energy ablation.name: Energy Ablation
energy ablation.text: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you gain resistance to an energy damage…

energy fusion.name: Energy Fusion
energy fusion.text: You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals energy damage, select a non-cantrip spell in your spell repertoire that deals a different type of energy damage, and expend an additional spell slot of the same rank as this secondary spell.

energy ward.name: Energy Ward
energy ward.text: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward. Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance to one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void) equal to 4 + the rank of the spell.
energy ward.requirements: Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell that dealt energy damage.

enervating wail.name: Enervating Wail
enervating wail.text: You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby. All living creatures in a 20-foot emanation take void damage with a basic Fortitude save. The damage is 4d6, plus 1d6 for every level you have beyond 6th.

enforce oath.name: Enforce Oath
enforce oath.text: You call on your oath to embolden you in combat. Select one creature you can see that you’ve sworn an oath against (per the terms of your oath feat). You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against attacks and effects by the chosen creature.
enforce oath.requirements: You can see a creature you’ve sworn an oath against.

engine of destruction.name: Engine of Destruction
engine of destruction.text: Your construct unleashes a broad swath of devastation by separating its limbs, deploying hidden armaments, or using a similar technique to wreak havoc. You Command your innovation.

engraving maneuver.name: Engraving Maneuver
engraving maneuver.text: After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon. Attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip a target; your weapon must have the corresponding trait.
engraving maneuver.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon with the disarm, shove, or trip trait.

engraving strike.name: Engraving Strike
engraving strike.text: You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact. Make a melee Strike with the weapon. On a success, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike
engraving strike.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon.

enhance spell.name: Enhance Spell
enhance spell.text: You attune your senses to the magical frequencies generated by an allied spellcaster, allowing you to amplify or modify their spells to suit the needs of the moment.

ensnaring disarm.name: Ensnaring Disarm
ensnaring disarm.text: You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it. Instead of the item falling to the ground in the target's space, you aim your blow to send the disarmed item flying, allowing your student to immediately catch it as a free action; they must have a free hand to do so.
ensnaring disarm.trigger: Your last action was a critical success to Disarm.
ensnaring disarm.requirements: Your student is within 15 feet of the Disarmed creature.

ensnaring wrappings.name: Ensnaring Wrappings
ensnaring wrappings.text: Some of your wrappings come loose to ensnare a creature you recently damaged. You attempt to Grapple the creature you damaged.
ensnaring wrappings.trigger: Your Strike deals physical damage to a creature that is within reach of your arms and isn't more than one size larger than you.

envenom fangs.name: Envenom Fangs
envenom fangs.text: You envenom your fangs. If the next fangs Strike you make before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, the Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent poison damage. The poison becomes inert after you hit, or at the end of your next turn, whichever comes first.

envenom strike.name: Envenom Strike
envenom strike.text: You spit venom onto a weapon you're holding or a weapon held by a willing creature within 30 feet; you can also use this ability to envenom your nagaji fangs unarmed attack.

epiphany at the crossroads.name: Epiphany at the Crossroads
epiphany at the crossroads.text: The crossroads between life and death is a place that can reveal many secrets. You gain the effects of an augury spell in a strange, near-death vision. Empowered by the realization, you then lose the dying condition (becoming wounded 1 or increasing your wounded value by 1, as normal), regain a number of Hit Points equ…
epiphany at the crossroads.requirements: You are unconscious. and have the dying condition.

equitable defense.name: Equitable Defense
equitable defense.text: Gritting your teeth through the pain, you position yourself to counterattack. You gain resistance to the damage from the critical hit equal to half your level. As long as you're still conscious after the attack, you can Interact to reload a weapon you currently wield or Stand.
equitable defense.trigger: You take damage from a critical hit.

escape timeline.name: Escape Timeline
escape timeline.text: You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers. Your physical form stops existing momentarily, and you can't be targeted or affected until the start of your next turn— you simply don't exist at that moment in time.

essence overflow.name: Essence Overflow
essence overflow.text: Uncontainable power explodes from your spectral dragon. Your Channel Draconic Essence ends, and all creatures (except you) in a 10-foot emanation from your spectral dragon take 6d6 damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

eternal memories.name: Eternal Memories
eternal memories.text: You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now. You examine your memories, changing the skills you selected with Ancient Memories and Endless Memories.

eternal torch.name: Eternal Torch
eternal torch.text: You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow. You create a magical, torch-like flame within 120 feet in any color you choose. It's as bright and hot as a torch.

evanescent wings.name: Evanescent Wings
evanescent wings.text: You’ve manifested wings that can flutter for brief spurts. You Fly. If you don’t normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren’t on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

evangelize.name: Evangelize
evangelize.text: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl. Attempt a Diplomacy check and compare the result to the Will DC of a single target that can hear you and understands your language; that target is then temporarily immune to Evangelize with respect to your deity or phi…

outcomes.text: The target is stupefied 2 for 1 round.
The target is stupefied 1 for 1 round.
The target is unaffected.

even the odds.name: Even the Odds
even the odds.text: You shine brightest in desperate moments. You flash a confident smile or pose, and you gain panache until the end of your turn.

everdistant defense.name: Everdistant Defense
everdistant defense.text: The spatial barrier of Syndara's Island has taught you that distance can foil enemies better than any armor. You warp space, causing each square within your aura that the attack or creature would move through to count as triple the distance.
everdistant defense.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 75
everdistant defense.trigger: A creature within your aura is targeted by a ranged attack or a creature moves through your aura.
everdistant defense.requirements: You have at least one aura from a champion feat or feature.

everstand stance.name: Everstand Stance
everstand stance.text: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense. When in this stance, you wield the shield with both hands. When wielding a shield this way, increase the weapon damage die of the shield’s boss or spikes by one step, and increase the shield’s Hardness by 2 when using the Shiel…

everstand strike.name: Everstand Strike
everstand strike.text: Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield. Make a Strike with the wielded shield. If the Strike hits and deals damage, you also Raise your Shield.
everstand strike.requirements: You are wielding a shield in two hands.

everyone duck!.name: Everyone Duck!
everyone duck!.text: You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap’s effects. For the next 2 rounds, if the trap rolls a critical success on an attack roll, it gets a normal success instead, and if anyone rolls a critical failure on their saving throw against the trap…
everyone duck!.trigger: You fail, but don’t critically fail, an attempt to Disable a Device on a trap.

exacting strike.name: Exacting Strike
exacting strike.text: You make a controlled follow-up attack, fully accounting for your momentum. Make a Strike. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

outcomes.text: This attack does not count toward your multiple attack penalty.

exaltation overwhelming.name: Exaltation Overwhelming
exaltation overwhelming.text: Raising your weapon or fist aloft, you begin to gleam with dazzling radiance. You fulminate with power and glory, making it clear to all who see you that your legend is real and possibly even greater than purported. Spend a Mythic Point.

execution.name: Execution
execution.text: You swing wide, attempting to behead your condemned foe. Make a melee Strike against your condemned foe. If you hit, your condemned foe takes 8d6 extra precision damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
execution.source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65
execution.requirements: You have condemned a foe with Harsh Judgment.

expand aura.name: Expand Aura
expand aura.text: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection. Expand the radius of your champion's aura to 30 feet until the start of your next turn. At 10th level, the expansion lasts for 1 minute, and at 16th level, it lasts until you Dismiss it.

exploding bullet.name: Exploding Bullet
exploding bullet.text: You load your gun with a bullet forged of magic instead of matter, barely contained in an arcane shell. Interact to reload your firearm, creating an arcane round made from your choice of fire or sonic energy. When you shoot this round, the Strike gains the arcane trait and the corresponding energy trait.

exploit blunder.name: Exploit Blunder
exploit blunder.text: By watching your foes closely, you can make the most out of their mistakes. You Step.
exploit blunder.trigger: A creature you Devised a Stratagem against on your most recent turn fails or critically fails a Strike against you.

exploit opening.name: Exploit Opening
exploit opening.text: You take advantage of your spotter’s devastating attack to unleash your own follow-up attack. Make a ranged Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus using a loaded crossbow or firearm against the target of the triggering attack.
exploit opening.trigger: Your spotter critically succeeds at a Strike against a creature, and that creature is within your crossbow or firearm’s first range increment.

explosive arrival.name: Explosive Arrival
explosive arrival.text: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the summon trait, all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the creature you summoned take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank.

explosive death drop.name: Explosive Death Drop
explosive death drop.text: You lift your enemy into the air before bringing them crashing down with a fiery detonation. Roll an Athletics check against your target's Fortitude DC. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –3 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that.

outcomes.text: The target takes 12d6 fire damage and falls prone in an unoccupied adjacent square of your choice. The target is no longer grabbed. The target and any creature adjacent to it also each take 1d6 persistent fire damage.
As critical success, but the target takes 6d6 fire damage instead of 12d6, and creatures don't take persistent fire damage.
The target is no longer grabbed.
As failure, but you fall prone.

explosive death drop.requirements: You are in Rain of Embers Stance and have a target grabbed or restrained.

explosive entry.name: Explosive Entry
explosive entry.text: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance... by detonating a bomb to produce a devastating explosion, of course! You Set Explosives on a door, window, container, or heavy gate. When the explosives detonate, you can attempt an Engineering Lore check to Force Open the target.

explosive leap.name: Explosive Leap
explosive leap.text: You aim an explosion from your innovation downward to launch yourself into the air. You jump up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground. You must land on a space of solid ground, or else you fall after using your next action.

explosive maneuver.name: Explosive Maneuver
explosive maneuver.text: Thanks to a hidden experimental feature you built into your weapon, your weapon explosively deploys levers, tangling hooks, or similar mechanisms to provide significant assistance when you perform a combat maneuver. When you use Explosive Maneuver, choose Grapple, Shove, or Trip.
explosive maneuver.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against a foe using your weapon innovation.

explosive metamorphosis.name: Explosive Metamorphosis
explosive metamorphosis.text: You use additional primal energy to transform, creating a burst of elemental energy to complement your transformation. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip morph or polymorph spell, select acid, cold, electricity, or fire.

exsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
exsanguinate.text: After one of your attacks, you direct your foe’s blood to spray upon you, infusing you with life energy. You gain a number of sanguimancy HP equal to half your level that last only until the end of your next turn. Exsanguinate works only against active foes who are able to act and aren’t restrained.
exsanguinate.requirements: On your last action, you dealt damage to a creature that isn’t immune to bleed damage and is within 10 feet. The damage must have come from a piercing or slashing Strike. You must have succeeded at your attack roll, or the creature must have failed its saving throw, as applicable.

extend surge.name: Extend Surge
extend surge.text: You tap deeper into the vortex of magical energy within you. Until the start of your next turn, the radius of your spellsurge aura increases to 30 feet. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, the radius increases to 60 feet instead until the start of your next turn and is then 30 feet for the duration of t…

extinguish light.name: Extinguish Light
extinguish light.text: You wrap shadow around a single unattended light source within 120 feet that’s no larger than a torch. Any non-magical light source you target is automatically extinguished. For magical light sources, attempt a counteract check using your Fortitude or Thievery modifier against the target’s DC.

extract vow of nonviolence.name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
extract vow of nonviolence.text: You entice or threaten a weapon, making it swear not to harm you. Attempt a Diplomacy check to Request or an Intimidation check to Demoralize against one weapon within 60 feet—even though most weapons are inanimate and mindless, your words somehow still can affect it as if it were living and you shared a language.

outcomes.text: The object swears not to hurt you. You gain resistance to all damage dealt by that specific weapon as the weapon attempts to mitigate harm to you. The resistance is equal to half your level and lasts for 10 minutes.
As critical success, but the remaining duration decreases by 1 minute each time the weapon hits you (even if it deals no damage).

extraplanar haze.name: Extraplanar Haze
extraplanar haze.text: Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze. You become concealed, though you can’t use this concealment to Hide or Sneak, as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious.

extravagant parry.name: Extravagant Parry
extravagant parry.text: You use one-handed weapons to parry with style. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you have a free hand or are wielding a weapon with the parry trait. You lose this circumstance bonus if you no longer meet this feat's requirement.
extravagant parry.requirements: You’re wielding one or more one-handed weapons

exude demonic corruption.name: Exude Demonic Corruption
exude demonic corruption.text: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your weapons are covered in toxic sludge or another similar manifestation of the demonic corruption; your melee Strikes…

exult in violence.name: Exult in Violence
exult in violence.text: You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy. A pillar of light deals 4d6 spirit damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC to a different enemy selected at random within 30 feet of the target struck.
exult in violence.requirements: You critically hit an enemy this turn.

eye for numbers.name: Eye for Numbers
eye for numbers.text: You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance. You immediately learn the number of visually similar items in a group you can see, rounded to the first digit in the total number.

eye of the arclords.name: Eye of the Arclords
eye of the arclords.text: You open an incandescent third eye upon your forehead. The eye can remain open for 1 minute, and you can close it before then with a single action with the concentrate trait. It can remain open for 2 minutes if you’re a master in Arcana, or 5 minutes if you’re legendary.

eyes that see eternity.name: Eyes that See Eternity
eyes that see eternity.text: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain the effects of truesight and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.

fabricate truth.name: Fabricate Truth
fabricate truth.text: You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others. Choose a creature within 30 feet that you're aware of. Attempt a Deception check against that target's Will DC.

face your fears.name: Face Your Fears
face your fears.text: A lifetime of facing Nidal's terrors has taught you to fight through fear. Although you aren't immune to it, you can subdue the emotion to such an extent that many believe it doesn't affect you. Reduce the value of your frightened condition by 1.

fading.name: Fading
fading.text: You partially fade from reality. The attacker must attempt a DC 11 flat check; on a failure, the attack passes harmlessly through the image of your body that remains behind. An instant later you return to reality, and your Crimson Shroud ends
fading.trigger: You are targeted with a Strike by someone you can detect.

faithful stride.name: Faithful Stride
faithful stride.text: Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride). During this movement, your mount can Stride across liquid and other surfaces that don't support its weight.

fake out.name: Fake Out
fake out.text: With a skilled flourish of your weapon, you force an enemy to acknowledge you as a threat. Make an attack roll to Aid the triggering attack. If you dealt damage to that enemy with the same weapon since the start of your last turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this roll.
fake out.trigger: An ally is about to use an action that requires an attack roll, targeting a creature within your weapon's first range increment.
fake out.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

falcon swoop.name: Falcon Swoop
falcon swoop.text: Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds. Fly twice. At any point during this movement, you can make a Strike against one enemy within reach or within the first range increment of a ranged weapon. That enemy is off-guard against the Strike if you're attacking them from above.
falcon swoop.requirements: You currently have a fly Speed.

familiar conduit.name: Familiar Conduit
familiar conduit.text: Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, the spell uses the familiar as its origin point.
familiar conduit.requirements: You have line of effect to your familiar.

familiar's eyes.name: Familiar's Eyes
familiar's eyes.text: You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own. You project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body, but you can sense through your familiar's body until you Dismiss the effect.

familiar's resolve.name: Familiar's Resolve
familiar's resolve.text: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, you or an ally within 30 feet gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to be doomed or frightened for 1 round.

fane's escape.name: Fane's Escape
fane's escape.text: A good getaway requires a good distraction. You Interact to draw a deck of cards and flip it in a fluttering explosion, causing you to become briefly hidden to all other creatures using vision as their precise sense, and then you Sneak. You have enough cover to Sneak until the end of your turn.
fane's escape.requirements: You have a deck of playing cards in your possession.

fane's fourberie.name: Fane's Fourberie
fane's fourberie.text: Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic. When you enter this stance, choose whether to treat playing cards in your possession as daggers or darts; you can wield a playing card in all ways as the chosen weapon until the stance ends.

fantastic leap.name: Fantastic Leap
fantastic leap.text: You launch yourself through the air at a foe. Attempt a High Jump or Long Jump. If you attempt a High Jump, determine the height of your jump as though determining the length of a Long Jump. At the end of your jump, you can make a melee Strike. After your Strike, you fall to the ground if you’re in the air.

farabellus flip.name: Farabellus Flip
farabellus flip.text: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures. Flinging your body into a twisting somersault, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the triggering attack.
farabellus flip.trigger: An enemy targets you with a melee Strike.

fatal shot.name: Fatal Shot
fatal shot.text: You modify an arrow or bolt to bring death to your target in a single potent hit. Make a bow or crossbow Strike. On a hit, you deal an additional 10d10 precision damage.

fated duel.name: Fated Duel
fated duel.text: You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it’s a monarch’s duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon. Spend a Mythic Point, and choose one opponent within 30 feet; you declare a Fated Duel against that opponent.

fautless defense.name: Fautless Defense
fautless defense.text: As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale. Spend a Mythic Point to gain resistance equal to half your level to the triggering damage, and then attempt a Strike at mythic proficiency against the creature that attacked you.
fautless defense.trigger: You would take damage from a Strike made by a creature.

favorable winds.name: Favorable Winds
favorable winds.text: You wrap a shell of favorable wind around a weapon you wield. On your next Strike with a ranged weapon before the start of your next turn, you don't take circumstance penalties on the attack roll due to wind.

fear no pain!.name: Fear No Pain!
fear no pain!.text: You have learned to endure pain without complaint and are capable of steeling your allies with similar resolve. When you give them a shout of encouragement, the triggering ally can reroll their failed save with a +2 circumstance bonus.
fear no pain!.trigger: An ally within 30 feet fails a save against a mental effect.

fear of god.name: Fear of God
fear of god.text: You embed a divine fear into the triggering foe that lasts for 10 minutes. During that time, you ignore that creature’s temporary immunity to your Demoralize attempts and whenever you successfully Demoralize the triggering enemy, you can instead increase their existing frightened condition by 1 (or 2 on a critical succ…

fearful symmetry.name: Fearful Symmetry
fearful symmetry.text: You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly. All enemies within 30 feet of the creature you critically hit must attempt at a Will save against your class DC. Enemies that fail their saves become frightened 1 and are fascinated with you for 1 round.
fearful symmetry.requirements: You’re in hybrid or tiger shape and your last action was a critically successful Strike with your unarmed attack.

fearsome familiar.name: Fearsome Familiar
fearsome familiar.text: Your familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane. Summon a common creature that has the elemental trait and a level no greater than your level – 4. This creature gains the summoned trait. This creature appears in the same space as your familiar, which disappears for the duration of this impulse.

feast.name: Feast
feast.text: You feast upon an adjacent restrained or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the past hour. If the creature is alive, you deal damage equal to your jaws damage. Whether it's alive or not, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last for 1 minute.
feast.requirements: You are adjacent to a restrained or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the past hour.

feathered flechettes.name: Feathered Flechettes
feathered flechettes.text: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions. Creatures in a 15-foot emanation take 6d6 slashing damage (basic Reflex save against your class DC).

feed on pain.name: Feed on Pain
feed on pain.text: The psychic feedback of another creature's pain fills you with false life. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the mental damage you dealt from the triggering effect.

feed the void.name: Feed the Void
feed the void.text: The void within you manages to manifest itself temporarily, a black hole opening over your heart and threatening to draw everything in. A 60-foot cone becomes filled with screaming winds that rush in toward you. All creatures in the cone must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward you. Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward you. Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward you.

feeling your oats.name: Feeling Your Oats
feeling your oats.text: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it. In this moment, you are living your fantasy, and no one can shake you out of it. Roll a Deception check. You can substitute the result of your Deception check for one Will save you would be required to attempt in the next minute.

feign innocence.name: Feign Innocence
feign innocence.text: You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side. Choose an enemy within 60 feet, and attempt a Deception check against its Will DC. The target is then temporarily immune to Feign Innocence for 1 hour.

outcomes.text: You and the target are considered allies until the end of your next turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first. In order to take a hostile action against you, the target must succeed at a Will save against your Deception DC or it loses the action.
As critical success, but lasts until the end of your turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first.
No effect.
The target knows you attempted to fool it and plays along. You're off-guard to the target until the beginning of your next turn.

feline dance.name: Feline Dance
feline dance.text: You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging. Roll the save twice and take the higher result. If you were in claw stance, you shift to talon stance, and vice versa.
feline dance.trigger: You attempt a basic Reflex save.
feline dance.requirements: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.

felling shot.name: Felling Shot
felling shot.text: Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air. Make a ranged Strike against an off-guard creature. If the Strike is a success and deals damage, the target must attempt a Reflex save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target falls up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it takes no damage from the fall.
As failure, and the target can't fly, jump, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground until the end of your next turn.

felling strike.name: Felling Strike
felling strike.text: Your attack can ground an airborne foe. Make a Strike. If it hits and deals damage to a flying target, the target falls up to 120 feet. The fall is gradual enough that if it causes the target to hit the ground, the target takes no damage from the fall.

feral lunge.name: Feral Lunge
feral lunge.text: You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth. You Stride up to 10 feet and make a jaws Strike at the end of that movement. If you began this action hidden, you remain hidden until after this Strike. If you have a fly or swim Speed, you can Fly or Swim up to 10 feet instead of Stride.
feral lunge.requirements: You’re in hybrid or animal shape.

feral mending.name: Feral Mending
feral mending.text: You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh. You regain 1d6 Hit Points for every 2 levels you have (minimum 1d6).
feral mending.requirements: Your previous action was to Change Shape.

feral scramble.name: Feral Scramble
feral scramble.text: Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed. You Climb up to your land Speed and make a claw Strike at any point during that movement. After you finish the movement, attempt an Athletics check against the surface's Climb DC.

outcomes.text: You maintain your position.
You slide down 60 feet or to the ground without taking falling damage.

feral scramble.requirements: You’re in hybrid or animal shape.

feral toss.name: Feral Toss
feral toss.text: You hurl foes away with a shake of your head. You Strike with your antler, horn, or tusk. If you hit and damage a creature of your size or smaller, push it 5 feet from you (10 feet on a critical hit). This is forced movement.
feral toss.requirements: You’re in hybrid or animal shape.

fermenting liquors.name: Fermenting Liquors
fermenting liquors.text: You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day. You serve your liquor to a willing adjacent creature. The creature recovers Hit Points equal to twice your level. Additionally, for 1 hour, all Diplomacy checks to influence the creature gain a +1 status bonus.

ferocious gust.name: Ferocious Gust
ferocious gust.text: With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents. This air blast has the effects of gust of wind with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

ferocious will.name: Ferocious Will
ferocious will.text: You send a blast of magical feedback at the effect's source, dealing 5d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If the target critically fails, it’s also slowed 1 for 1 round. At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
ferocious will.trigger: You succeed at a saving throw against a magical mental effect.

ferocity mimicry.name: Ferocity Mimicry
ferocity mimicry.text: You have trained yourself to continue fighting even when your body is screaming for you to stop. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1.
ferocity mimicry.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

ferry through waves.name: Ferry Through Waves
ferry through waves.text: The waters around you permit you passage, a privilege you can share with a willing ally. You hold on to an adjacent ally and Swim, carrying them along with you. If you spend three actions Ferrying through Waves, you instead Swim twice.
ferry through waves.requirements: You are swimming and have a free hand.

feverish enzymes.name: Feverish Enzymes
feverish enzymes.text: Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly. Strike with your claw or jaws.

fey flicker.name: Fey Flicker
fey flicker.text: As you get hurt, your body releases a glint of First World energy that overwhelms your foe. The triggering creature becomes dazzled until the end of its next turn. The creature can use an Interact action to acclimate and remove the dazzled condition.
fey flicker.trigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet deals damage to you.

fey prankster.name: Fey Prankster
fey prankster.text: You have learned a little something about trickery from fey creatures and gain their favor when you prank someone. You become quickened on your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Create a Diversion, Feint, or Tumble Through.
fey prankster.requirements: Your last action was a successful Dirty Trick.

fey snare.name: Fey Snare
fey snare.text: You tap into the energies of the First World to temporarily change the world around a creature within 30 feet and capture them with a conjured vine, mass of stone, or some other natural feature. The creature must attempt a Reflex saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.
The creature is off-guard and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.

The creature becomes immobilized and off-guard until the start of your next turn. The creature can attempt to Escape against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, to remove the immobilized condition.

fey's trickery.name: Fey's Trickery
fey's trickery.text: You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight. This has the effects of invisibility.

field artillery.name: Field Artillery
field artillery.text: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless. You can Interact with an adjacent mounted siege weapon to increase its Speed by 10 feet for one round.

fiend slayer.name: Fiend Slayer
fiend slayer.text: Your attack tears through a fiend, possibly sending it back to where it came from. The fiend you just struck takes 80 void damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, the target is also stunned 1.
fiend slayer.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against a fiend that dealt damage.

fiendish brand.name: Fiendish Brand
fiendish brand.text: Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage. If it's successful and deals damage, you carve bleeding words into your target. The target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage, which has the unholy trait.

fierce competitor.name: Fierce Competitor
fierce competitor.text: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition. This competition must involve accomplishing a specific goal for a specific use of the Acrobatics or Athletics skill, such as Climbing to the top of a wall, Tripping a specific foe, or Long Jumping across a chasm.

fierce grasp.name: Fierce Grasp
fierce grasp.text: Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away. Your opponent takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next attempt to Escape from being grabbed or restrained by you, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against any attacks they make against you while you have them grabbed.
fierce grasp.requirements: You have an opponent grabbed or restrained.

fiery rebirth.name: Fiery Rebirth
fiery rebirth.text: When you escape death, you return to life with retributive fire that burns those who harmed you. You expend 1 Mythic Point, return to consciousness, Stand, and regain additional Hit Points equal to your level.
fiery rebirth.trigger: You regain Hit Points while you are unconscious.

fiery retort.name: Fiery Retort
fiery retort.text: Ignoring your pain, you sear your attacker with a wave of flame. The triggering opponent takes fire damage equal to your level.
fiery retort.trigger: An opponent adjacent to you hits you with a melee weapon or a melee unarmed attack.

fight or flight.name: Fight or Flight
fight or flight.text: You’ve learned to make use of the surge of adrenaline that comes with fear. You can make a melee Strike against a creature that gave you the frightened condition if it’s within range, or you can Stride up to your speed away from the effect or creature that gave you the frightened condition.

figure of dawn's respite.name: Figure Of Dawn's Respite
figure of dawn's respite.text: Like the dawn cuts through the night, your dance lances through distractions. If your next action has the manipulate or concentrate trait, it doesn’t trigger reactions due to those traits.

figure of the celestial truth.name: Figure Of The Celestial Truth
figure of the celestial truth.text: You understand that as the moon guides the tides, so too do the stars guide fate itself. You reroll the triggering check but must take the new result.
figure of the celestial truth.trigger: You are in Stellar Dance Stance and fail or critically fail a Performance check.

figure of the lunar embrace.name: Figure Of The Lunar Embrace
figure of the lunar embrace.text: Like the moon drawing the ocean up the shore, you can draw your foes into danger. Attempt a Performance check against the Reflex DC of a creature in reach.

outcomes.text: You Stride and move the target up to 10 feet in the direction of your movement. Your movement doesn’t trigger reactions from the target. Your dance also reaches its zenith, and you can choose for the additional damage to be cold instead of force.
As critical success, but you move the target up to 5 feet in the direction of your movement.
The target doesn’t move. You can Stride if you choose, but your movement triggers reactions normally.
You misstep. You don’t move, and you’re off-guard until the start of your next turn.

figure of the lunar embrace.requirements: You’re in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn’t at its zenith.

final form.name: Final Form
final form.text: You embrace your monstrous blood and make it your own, screaming out to the heavens and hells alike in rage, pain, and defiance. Reality buckles and twists under your sudden power—each tiefling has a unique transformation, but it might include sulfurous flames, choruses of shrieks, or twisting, serpentine lightning.

final shot.name: Final Shot
final shot.text: You jam a triple charge of black powder into your weapon to unleash a devastating but risky and inaccurate attack. Interact to reload, expending three doses of black powder in addition to your normal black powder or ammunition, then Strike with your firearm against a creature within the weapon's first range increment.

final shot knows the way.name: Final Shot Knows the Way
final shot knows the way.text: You judge a foe’s defenses after attacking them and channel that knowledge into your warshard weapon and its ammunition. Spend a Mythic Point, then Stride twice. At any point during this movement, attempt a ranged Strike at mythic proficiency with your warshard weapon against the same foe you already attacked this roun…
final shot knows the way.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87
final shot knows the way.requirements: You are wielding a ranged warshard weapon and used it to make a ranged Strike against a foe this round.

final spite.name: Final Spite
final spite.text: You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite. The triggering creature takes 4d4 persistent poison damage with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC. If the creature kills you or your ally as part of the trigger, the creature gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolls on this save.
final spite.trigger: A creature reduces you or a living ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points. You can trigger this action even while dying.

fine print.name: Fine Print
fine print.text: The text of the contracts written across your papery blade contain hidden clauses that can cause great pain for an unsuspecting foe. You deal an additional 2d4 precision damage to the off-guard creature.
fine print.trigger: You Strike and deal damage to an off-guard creature with your contract blade.

finish their story!.name: Finish Their Story!
finish their story!.text: Though your tale is immortal, your foes aren’t afforded such an advantage and mainly serve only to further your legend. When the time is right, you can shepherd a weaker opponent off this mortal coil. Spend a Mythic Point and make a Strike at mythic proficiency against an enemy.

firebrand braggart dedication.name: Firebrand Braggart Dedication
firebrand braggart dedication.text: Your Firebrand training has taught you that achieving something is more satisfying if you boast about it first. You declare a boast about a particular skill action, such as Balance, Demoralize, or Recall Knowledge.

fish from the falls' edge.name: Fish from the Falls' Edge
fish from the falls' edge.text: Seeing your ally fall, you let out a cry, sending your divine spark to them temporarily to keep them from tumbling down the River of Souls. You prevent the triggering creature from dying and restore 5d8 Hit Points to them.
fish from the falls' edge.trigger: A living creature within 30 feet would die.
fish from the falls' edge.requirements: Your divine spark is empowering one of your ikons.

five breaths, one death.name: Five Breaths, One Death
five breaths, one death.text: You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack. Strike the target using the unarmed attack associated with your current elemental stance, then Cycle Elemental Stance. Then, Strike the target with the unarmed attack associated with your new elemental stance.
five breaths, one death.requirements: You're in an elemental stance, and the target is under the effects of Induce Imbalance.

five-gods ram.name: Five-gods Ram
five-gods ram.text: You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts. Stride or Climb and then make a ramming horn Strike. If the Strike is successful, you immediately push the target back 10 feet, then Stride or Climb and make a second ramming horn Strike against them.

flair rider stance.name: Flair Rider Stance
flair rider stance.text: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks. While mounted and in this stance, your mount always provides you with lesser cover and you don’t take the –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.

flamboyant leap.name: Flamboyant Leap
flamboyant leap.text: You stylishly leap and deliver a powerful finisher. Make a Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump and attempt one single-action finisher at any point during your jump; the finisher can't be one that includes other movement, such as Mobile Finisher.
flamboyant leap.requirements: You are capable of using a finisher.

flash forge.name: Flash Forge
flash forge.text: An artificial metal object forms in the hands of you or a willing ally within 30 feet. You can choose a level 0, common, handheld weapon or piece of adventuring gear of 1 Bulk or less. The item is entirely made from metal, making some items impossible or impractical to use (if it's unclear, the GM decides).

flash of omipotence.name: Flash of Omipotence
flash of omipotence.text: For but a moment you hold the power of a god. You spend a Mythic Point. Until the end of your turn, any damage you deal ignores all the target’s resistance and immunities or triggers the target’s highest weakness if they have no resistance or immunities.

flash of omnipresence.name: Flash of Omnipresence
flash of omnipresence.text: Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally’s side in the blink of an eye. You teleport to an empty space adjacent to an ally within 100 feet. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you can teleport to anywhere within a mile, and when you arrive, any enemies adjacent to you must succeed at a Will s…

flash of omniscience.name: Flash of Omniscience
flash of omniscience.text: You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment. You spend a Mythic Point to immediately learn the resistances, weaknesses, and immunities, including the amounts of the resistances and weaknesses and any unusual weaknesses or vulnerabilities of a single creature you…

flash your badge.name: Flash your Badge
flash your badge.text: You make a fearsome show of your authority. Roll Intimidation checks to Demoralize each creature in a 30-foot cone. When you do so, Demoralize gains the visual trait, and creatures are affected if they can see you.
flash your badge.source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

flashing shield.name: Flashing Shield
flashing shield.text: Your shield flares with holy light as you block the attack, searing the undead with the power of your faith. The triggering undead takes positive damage equal to half your level and becomes flat-footed for 1 round.
flashing shield.trigger: You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered the Shield Block is undead and adjacent to you.

flashy dodge.name: Flashy Dodge
flashy dodge.text: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the Strike misses, you gain panache until the end of your next turn.
flashy dodge.trigger: A creature you can see targets you with an attack.

fledgling flight.name: Fledgling Flight
fledgling flight.text: You can fly through the air in short bursts. You Fly. If you don’t normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren’t on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

fleeing shriek.name: Fleeing Shriek
fleeing shriek.text: You let out an ear-piercing screech. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation takes 5d6 sonic damage, with a basic Fortitude saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You then Stride, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions from any creature that failed or critically failed its saving throw.

fleet tempo.name: Fleet Tempo
fleet tempo.text: To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone. You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 minute.
fleet tempo.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

fleeting shadow.name: Fleeting Shadow
fleeting shadow.text: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies. You Hide, then Sneak twice.

flensing slice.name: Flensing Slice
flensing slice.text: When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot. The target takes 1d8 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die of whichever of the weapons you used that has the most weapon damage dice (maximum 4d8 for a major striking weapon).
flensing slice.requirements: Your last action was a Double Slice, and both attacks hit the target.

flesh wound.name: Flesh Wound
flesh wound.text: You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage. Make a ranged Strike. It gains the following effect on a failure (though not a critical failure).

outcomes.text: Though your attack misses, it still deals one die of damage plus any damage from your weapon specialization class feature. This uses your weapon's normal damage die and damage type. This attack doesn't add extra damage from any other sources or abilities.

flickering twirl.name: Flickering Twirl
flickering twirl.text: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur. You gain concealment until the beginning of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can’t use this concealment to Hide.

fling head.name: Fling Head
fling head.text: You Interact to remove your head, if it isn’t already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body. Your target must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2 and can’t reduce their frightened value below 1 while they remain within 30 feet of you.
As failure, but the creature is frightened 3.

flinging blow.name: Flinging Blow
flinging blow.text: You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away. Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you (or 20 feet, on a critical failure) and fall prone.

flinging charge.name: Flinging Charge
flinging charge.text: You throw a weapon to distract your opponent as you close the gap to begin your assault. You Stride twice; at any point during this movement, you can make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon.

flinging updraft.name: Flinging Updraft
flinging updraft.text: A speeding wind heeds your call, picking someone up and depositing them nearby. Choose a creature within 60 feet of you. The target jumps in any direction, up to a maximum of 30 feet.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
You make the creature jump up to half the maximum distance.
You make the creature jump up to the maximum distance.

float free.name: Float Free
float free.text: You move 5 feet or up to half your swim Speed vertically through the water. This movement doesn't trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.

flood stance.name: Flood Stance
flood stance.text: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water. While in this stance, you hold your breath for up to 10 minutes and leave the stance if you stop holding your breath.

floral restoration.name: Floral Restoration
floral restoration.text: You request that nearby plants share their vitality with you to replenish your body and magic. You regain 1 Focus Point and 4d8 Hit Points. You must be in a location of at least 15 feet by 15 feet of healthy plant life, though this can be grass, lichen, seaweed, or any other form of naturally occurring flora.

flourishing finish.name: Flourishing Finish
flourishing finish.text: Attempt a Performance check, comparing the result to the Will DC of each foe within 30 feet who can see you. Regardless of the result, each target is immune to your Flourishing Finish for 10 minutes.

outcomes.text: The target is frightened 2.
The target is frightened 1.

flourishing finish.requirements: Your last action was a Strike that dropped an opponent to 0 Hit Points.

flow of war.name: Flow of War
flow of war.text: Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed. You become quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Strike or Stride.

flower street infamy.name: Flower Street Infamy
flower street infamy.text: Your history of coquetries, flirtations, dalliances, and liaisons is so lengthy that, even in a city as large as Absalom, you're bound to run into your past at inopportune moments. Fortunately, the individual involved might be just as shocked as you are by the unexpected encounter.

outcomes.text: The target is stupefied 3 for 1 minute.
The target is stupefied 2 for 1 minute.
The target is stupefied 1 until the start of your next turn.
The target is unaffected.

flowering path.name: Flowering Path
flowering path.text: Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life. When you walk, you leave blooming flowers and sprouting vines in your wake. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create difficult terrain in each square you leave during your movement.

fluttering distraction.name: Fluttering Distraction
fluttering distraction.text: You’re trained in snapping and fluttering your fans to draw the eyes of observers around you. You manipulate your fans to create a distraction. The enemy must roll its attack twice and take the lower result.
fluttering distraction.trigger: An enemy attempts a ranged or melee Strike against an ally within 30 feet.
fluttering distraction.requirements: You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

fly on shadowed wings.name: Fly on Shadowed Wings
fly on shadowed wings.text: Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings. Choose one of your attuned apparitions; for 10 minutes, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and resistance to precision damage equal to your level, but your chosen apparition is dispersed for the duration, automatically…

flying flame.name: Flying Flame
flying flame.text: A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice—such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere. It Flies from you up to 30 feet in a path you choose. Each creature it passes through takes 1d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

flying kick.name: Flying Kick
flying kick.text: You launch yourself at a foe. Make a Leap or attempt a High Jump or Long Jump. At the end of the jump, if you're adjacent to a foe, you can immediately Strike that foe with an unarmed attack, even if the foe is in midair. You fall to the ground after the Strike.

flying tackle.name: Flying Tackle
flying tackle.text: You barrel forward, gathering enough momentum to take down a threatening foe. Stride and then Leap, or attempt to High Jump or Long Jump. If you end your movement adjacent to a foe, you can attempt to Trip that foe. If you succeed at the Athletics check to Trip, you get a critical success instead.

focus ally.name: Focus Ally
focus ally.text: You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight. Your ally rerolls the failed saving throw. That ally must take the second result.
focus ally.trigger: An adjacent ally fails, but doesn't critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the incapacitation trait.

focus beauty.name: Focus Beauty
focus beauty.text: You lock eyes with a target creature that can see you, overwhelming it with your ethereal beauty. You attempt an Intimidation check against the target’s Will DC. On a success, the target can’t take any hostile actions against you until the end of its next turn.

focused fire.name: Focused Fire
focused fire.text: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy. You Launch your light mortar, targeting a single square. The blast is limited to the targeted square but deals one additional die of damage.

focused juggler.name: Focused Juggler
focused juggler.text: You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn. Increase the maximum number of items you can Juggle by one.
focused juggler.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

focused shot.name: Focused Shot
focused shot.text: You achieve a state of perfect calm before unleashing your attack, opening your mind to the minute movements of the world around you to increase your accuracy. Make a ranged weapon Strike against a target within your weapon's first range increment. This Strike ignores the target's concealed condition and all cover.
focused shot.requirements: You are in Monastic Archer Stance.

foeseeker stance.name: Foeseeker Stance
foeseeker stance.text: Your charmed shots twist around branches and leaves, leaving your hapless prey without shelter from your barrage. While in this stance, your ranged attacks ignore concealment and cover from natural sources, such as foliage or mist.

follow the threads of fate.name: Follow the Threads of Fate
follow the threads of fate.text: A norn’s thread—spun from fate itself—runs through or wraps around your ikon. Transcendence—Unravel the Future (fortune, transcendence) You pluck a single thread from your ikon, which ties itself in three loops about your wrist, where it remains for the next minute.
follow the threads of fate.source:
Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
 pg. 79

follow-up assault.name: Follow-up Assault
follow-up assault.text: Even in the face of failure you press the attack, determined to succeed. Make a Strike with the same weapon, adding the backswing and forceful weapon traits to that Strike.
follow-up assault.requirements: You used your previous action to make a melee strike that missed.

follow-up strike.name: Follow-up Strike
follow-up strike.text: You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage. Make another Strike with a melee unarmed attack, using the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike, if any.
follow-up strike.requirements: Your last action was a missed Strike with a melee unarmed attack.

following smite.name: Following Smite
following smite.text: You call upon your deity’s power and channel it through your weapon. The creature you hit in your previous action must attempt a Reflex saving throw against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes spirit damage equal to half your level.
The target takes spirit damage equal to your level and is knocked prone.
The target takes spirit damage equal to twice your level, is knocked prone, and becomes clumsy 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

following smite.requirements: Your last action was a Strike made with a weapon or unarmed attack empowered by Herald’s Weapon.

for the fallen!.name: For the Fallen!
for the fallen!.text: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed. Whether they were killed or disappeared, you vow to honor their memories by succeeding where they failed. This drive allows to push forward after you've already made an attack. You Step and then Strike.

forceful shot.name: Forceful Shot
forceful shot.text: Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies. Make a ranged Strike, adding the following effects in addition to the normal effects of the Strike.

outcomes.text: The target is pushed 10 feet away from you.
The target is pushed 5 feet away from you.
The target is flat-footed for 1 round.

forcible energy.name: Forcible Energy
forcible energy.text: You perform complex manipulations to make the energy from your spells so powerful that your enemies remain vulnerable to it afterward. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, you can select one target that was damaged to gain weakness 5 to that damage type until…

foresee danger.name: Foresee Danger
foresee danger.text: You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.
foresee danger.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

foreseen failure.name: Foreseen Failure
foreseen failure.text: You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell. Your spell is expended, but you can Cast a Spell that requires the same number of actions as the triggering spell or fewer to cast.
foreseen failure.trigger: A spell you cast has no effect because you critically failed all your spell attack rolls or because all targets critically succeeded at their saving throws.

forest stealth.name: Forest Stealth
forest stealth.text: You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage. You Take Cover and then use that cover to Hide.
forest stealth.requirements: You are in a forest or jungle environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to Take Cover.

forest's heart.name: Forest's Heart
forest's heart.text: You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf. You call forth roots, vines, or other plant growth native to the region and can use them to make unarmed attacks.
forest's heart.requirements: Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Herbalism Lore as one of its apparition skills.

forestall curse.name: Forestall Curse
forestall curse.text: You've learned to hold back your curse. If the next action you use is a cursebound ability, your cursebound value doesn't increase.

foretell harm.name: Foretell Harm
foretell harm.text: Your magic echoes ominously as you glimpse injury in the target's future. At the beginning of your target's next turn, it takes damage equal to twice the triggering spell's rank as a seemingly random and minor misfortune finds it.
foretell harm.requirements: Your previous action was to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that dealt damage

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.text: Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your ally's AC.
forewarn.trigger: An enemy within your overwatch field attempts an attack against an ally who is also within your overwatch field.

forge-blessed shot.name: Forge-Blessed Shot
forge-blessed shot.text: You intone a prayer to the dwarven deities Torag or Angradd, willing a higher power to guide your aim in the heat of battle. On your next Strike with a ranged weapon before the end of your turn, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and ignore your target's concealed condition, as well as your target's l…

form a flock.name: Form a Flock
form a flock.text: You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side. The flock grants you 25 temporary Hit Points that last up to 1 minute. The flock disperses and the effect ends when the temporary Hit Points are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss Form a Flock.

form control.name: Form Control
form control.text: With additional care and effort, you can take on an alternate shape for a longer period of time. If your next action is to cast untamed form, the spell’s rank is 2 lower than normal (minimum 1st rank), but you can remain transformed for up to 1 hour or the listed duration (whichever is longer).

form lock.name: Form Lock
form lock.text: Your ability to control your own qi empowers you to pressure other creatures into resuming their true forms. Attempt an Athletics check to counteract a polymorph effect currently affecting your target.
form lock.requirements: You have a foe grabbed or restrained.

form of the bat.name: Form of the Bat
form of the bat.text: You can transform into a harmless bat. You gain the effects of a 4th-rank pest form, except you always transform into a bat.

form up!.name: Form Up!
form up!.text: You’ve trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations. Choose a formation. Allies within your aura can use their reaction to Stride up to their Speed and take a place in the chosen formation. Allies can’t benefit from this movement if there isn’t room for them in the chosen formation.

fortify shield.name: Fortify Shield
fortify shield.text: You reinforce your shield with a rocky outgrowth of metal and stone. You Raise your Shield. If you use the Shield Block reaction before your next turn, add your character level to your shield's Hardness when determining how much damage is blocked.

fortifying knock.name: Fortifying Knock
fortifying knock.text: Your shield is a natural canvas for your art. In one motion, you Raise a Shield and Trace a Rune on your shield.

fortune's favor.name: Fortune's Favor
fortune's favor.text: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.
fortune's favor.trigger: You’re about to reroll a failed skill check or saving throw due to a fortune effect.

forward gaze into life.name: Forward Gaze into Life
forward gaze into life.text: Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life. You release two 15-foot cones, aimed exactly opposite each other, one ahead of you that deals 5d10 vitality damage and one behind you that deals 5d10 void damage, each with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.
forward gaze into life.source:
Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
 pg. 79

fountain of secrets.name: Fountain of Secrets
fountain of secrets.text: You constantly remember details about the world. You attempt a check to Recall Knowledge. If you succeed, you gain additional information or context. If you critically succeed, at the GM's discretion you might gain even more additional information or context than normal.

four winds.name: Four Winds
four winds.text: Mimicking the anemoi—monarchs of the four winds—you propel four creatures. Target up to four willing creatures within 30 feet of you. Each of those creatures can Stride up to half its Speed. If it has a fly Speed, it can instead Fly up to half its fly Speed.

four-armed aspect.name: Four-armed Aspect
four-armed aspect.text: You intone vows to shoulder others’ pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens. For the following minute, you can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

fox trick.name: Fox Trick
fox trick.text: You always have time for a joke or prank. You Create a Diversion, Conceal an Object, or Hide. All creatures who witnessed your Fox Trick then wise up to it, becoming temporarily immune to your Fox Trick for 24 hours.

freeze it!.name: Freeze It!
freeze it!.text: You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you. Frigid ice runs through your veins, and you can expel frost from your body to freeze your foes. Attempt an Athletics check against the Fortitude DC of an adjacent foe.

outcomes.text: The target becomes clumsy 2 for 1 round.
The target becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round.
The target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

frenzied dance.name: Frenzied Dance
frenzied dance.text: Bounding jumps and whirls spin you out of control and set aside all restraints. Attempt to Escape. If you succeed, you can immediately Step as a free action and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your DCs to avoid being grabbed or restrained until the start of your next turn.
frenzied dance.trigger: You gain the grabbed or restrained condition.

fresh produce.name: Fresh Produce
fresh produce.text: You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit. Choose a creature in your kinetic aura. The produce grows in their open hand, or at their feet if they have no open hands. The produce has light Bulk. A creature can eat it with an Interact action to regain 1d4 + 1 HP; this is a healing vitality effect.

friendly fling.name: Friendly Fling
friendly fling.text: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet. Since you are using your horns, you don't need to have any hands free to do this.
friendly fling.requirements: You are adjacent to an ally.

friendly nudge.name: Friendly Nudge
friendly nudge.text: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself. Attempt an Athletics check to Shove an ally. You don't need to have a free hand to attempt this check. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher.

friendly toss.name: Friendly Toss
friendly toss.text: You toss your friends around the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent ally of your size or smaller and throw them to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. Their movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall.
friendly toss.requirements: You are adjacent to an ally and have one or more hands free.

frighten undead.name: Frighten Undead
frighten undead.text: Your very presence chills creatures of the night down to their core and you can use the spiritual power and faithful life force of religious verses to frighten even mindless undead. Attempt to Demoralize an undead target using your Religion modifier instead of your Intimidation modifier if it's higher.

frightening indignation.name: Frightening Indignation
frightening indignation.text: Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy. An enemy that ends its turn within a 15-foot emanation around you must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This aura lasts for 1 minute.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to your Frightening Indignation for 1 minute.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2 and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while it's in your aura.
As failure, but frightened 3.

frightening power.name: Frightening Power
frightening power.text: Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes. Each enemy in a 20-foot emanation must attempt a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If you are Channeling Draconic Essence, your spectral dragon can be the origin of this emanation.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2.
The creature is frightened 4.

frightening power.requirements: You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

frightful condemnation.name: Frightful Condemnation
frightful condemnation.text: Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned, and they begin to dread what you will do to them next. Your condemned foe is frightened 1, or frightened 2 if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.
frightful condemnation.source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65
frightful condemnation.trigger: You hit your condemned foe with a melee Strike in the same turn during which you condemned it with Harsh Judgment.
frightful condemnation.requirements: You have condemned a foe to death with

frightful moan.name: Frightful Moan
frightful moan.text: You lament your fate, forcing each living creature in a 30-foot emanation to attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to Frightful Moans for 1 minute.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2.

frog geyser.name: Frog Geyser
frog geyser.text: You can spray a powerful steam of water from your mouth to push your foes around. Filling your mouth with water for your stream requires using an Interact action while next to a source of at least 1 gallon of water. You can hold water in your mouth indefinitely, but while you do, you’re unable to speak.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is pushed back 5 feet.
The creature is pushed back 10 feet.
The creature is pushed back 10 feet and knocked prone.

frog geyser.requirements: Your mouth is full of water.

frog tide.name: Frog Tide
frog tide.text: You have a connection to water and are able to call upon it to batter your foes and carry them away. You create a massive wave of water that crashes in a 20-foot burst within 120 feet that moves in the direction of your choice. All creatures in the area take 14d6 bludgeoning damage and could be swept away.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage and is moved 10 feet in the direction of the wave, but not swept away.
The creature takes full damage and is fully swept away by the wave. The creature moves along with the wave until it Escapes.
As failure, except the creature takes double damage and must hold its breath or begin suffocating (unless it can breathe in water).

fulminating shot.name: Fulminating Shot
fulminating shot.text: You channel potent magic into your next shot, empowering it with a blast of crackling energy. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. If you hit with your next attack roll using a firearm or crossbow before the end of your turn, you deal 1d6 additional damage of this type.

fumigate.name: Fumigate
fumigate.text: Sometimes you must dispose of a threat to your crop for good. Strike the required enemy. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die. On a critical hit, the target also drops anything they’re holding and releases anyone they have grabbed or restrained.
fumigate.requirements: You are adjacent to an enemy that harmed a member of your crop during their last turn or has a member of your crop grabbed or restrained.

furious finish.name: Furious Finish
furious finish.text: Desperate to finish the fight, you pour all your rage into one final blow. Make a Strike. If it hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of rounds remaining in your Rage (maximum 10). After this Strike, your Rage immediately ends, and you are fatigued until you rest for at least 10 minutes.

furious grab.name: Furious Grab
