furious grab.text: You grab your foe while it's distracted by your attack. The enemy you hit becomes grabbed by you, as if you had succeeded at an Athletics check to Grapple it.
furious grab.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike, and either you have a hand free or your Strike used a weapon with the grapple trait.

furious sprint.name: Furious Sprint
furious sprint.text: You rush forward. Stride up to five times, or up to eight times if you used 3 actions. All this movement must be in a straight line (though the GM might allow reasonable variance).

furious vengeance.name: Furious Vengeance
furious vengeance.text: Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy.
furious vengeance.trigger: An enemy within your melee reach critically hits you with a melee Strike.

furnace form.name: Furnace Form
furnace form.text: Opening your kinetic gate, you allow flames to consume your form and leave you a living flame. You gain the benefits of the fiery body spell (except the ability to cast ignition) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute, and when you do, you can Fly up to half your fly Speed.

galloping launch.name: Galloping Launch
galloping launch.text: You use your mount’s momentum to hurl your weapon beyond normal limits. Make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon. The weapon’s range increment increases by 15 feet for this attack, or 20 feet if your mount’s Speed is 40 feet or greater.
galloping launch.requirements: You’re mounted, and your mount moved closer to your prey this round.

galvanize spell.name: Galvanize Spell
galvanize spell.text: You reabsorb the magic of your spellsurge aura to power a piece of powerful magic. Spend a Mythic Point. Your spellsurge ends. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that’s at least 2 ranks lower than the highest spell slot you have, you reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

gaping flesh.name: Gaping Flesh
gaping flesh.text: Your wound yawns open, appalling your attacker. The attacker must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become sickened 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure). It can't recover from the sickened condition while it's adjacent to you.
gaping flesh.trigger: A creature you are aware of damages you with a melee Strike.

gardener's resolve.name: Gardener's Resolve
gardener's resolve.text: The Gray Gardeners are known for having nerves of steel and an unbreakable resolve. When you would be overwhelmed by terror, you can draw upon this resolve to keep your composure and remain undaunted. You take mental damage equal to twice your level, and the saving throw is a success.
gardener's resolve.source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65
gardener's resolve.trigger: You roll a failure (but not a critical failure) on a Will save against a fear effect

garland spell.name: Garland Spell
garland spell.text: If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fungus or plant trait, a garland of plants grows in a 10-foot burst in the spell’s range. The plants are difficult terrain and hazardous terrain, covered in your choice of thorns or poisonous vines.

gathering moss.name: Gathering Moss
gathering moss.text: By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster. You gain fast healing equal to your level. This fast healing remains for 1 minute or until you end your Tenacious Stance, whichever comes first.

general's gambit.name: General's Gambit
general's gambit.text: You move strategically forward to draw the enemy’s attention away from your allies. You Stride toward an enemy and attempt to Create a Diversion, except you can use Society or Warfare Lore instead of Deception.

geobukseon retaliation.name: Geobukseon Retaliation
geobukseon retaliation.text: Your armor has a retractable spike-covered shell reminiscent of Hwanggot’s heavily armored geobukseon, or “turtle ships.” The shell unfolds across your body, giving you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

geologic attunement.name: Geologic Attunement
geologic attunement.text: You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves. You gain tremorsense (imprecise) in your kinetic aura. Once per round, you can Point Out a creature you can sense with tremorsense as a free action. Level (13th) The tremorsense becomes precise.

germination of resolve.name: Germination of Resolve
germination of resolve.text: Vitality floods your trammeled soul, offering you rejuvenation, if not quite rest. For each effect that causes the enfeebled or fatigued conditions to affect you, attempt a Nature check to counteract that effect. The counteract rank of Germination of Resolve is equal to half your level rounded up.

get used to disappointment.name: Get Used to Disappointment
get used to disappointment.text: You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent. You attempt to Demoralize the opponent. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.
get used to disappointment.requirements: Your turn begins, and one target within 30 feet failed an attack roll or skill check against you on its last turn.

ghost blade.name: Ghost Blade
ghost blade.text: You alter your weapon's phase so it can more easily strike incorporeal creatures. Your mind weapon gains the effects of a ghost touch property rune for 1 minute.

ghost flight.name: Ghost Flight
ghost flight.text: You can suppress your tether to the ground, overcoming your resistance to fly free. For 10 minutes, your fly Speed doesn't restrict you to only a few inches off the ground, allowing you to travel to any height you choose.

ghost strike.name: Ghost Strike
ghost strike.text: Once per day, you can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead. The weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune for 10 minutes. At 10th level, you can apply this effect to two weapons instead of one.

ghost wrangler.name: Ghost Wrangler
ghost wrangler.text: Spirits around you coalesce upon your fists, enabling you to seize and harm other ghosts and spirits. Until the beginning of your next turn, your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune, and you can make Strength-based skill checks against incorporeal creatures.

ghostly condemnation.name: Ghostly Condemnation
ghostly condemnation.text: You shriek a death sentence upon a single target within 120 feet, forcing it to experience the final moments of your mortal life as you were dragged through a howling mob and forced to kneel before the final blade that took your life and head.

ghostly grasp (deviant).name: Ghostly Grasp (Deviant)
ghostly grasp (deviant).text: An invisible arm extends from you to grab and manipulate objects. The arm reaches up to 15 feet, grabs an unattended object of 1 Bulk or less, and immediately deposits it in one of your free hands or at your feet.

ghostly stride.name: Ghostly Stride
ghostly stride.text: You fade into a slightly incorporeal form as you move. You Stride up to half your Speed. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions, and you can move through enemies’ spaces during it. If you have a fly Speed, you can instead Fly up to half your fly Speed.

ghosts in the storm.name: Ghosts in the Storm
ghosts in the storm.text: Clouds, like eager pets, are drawn to you and to those in your good graces. Fast-moving gray clouds surround you, as well as your allies while they're in your kinetic aura. Anyone surrounded by these clouds gains a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

giant's lunge.name: Giant's Lunge
giant's lunge.text: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach. Until your rage ends, all your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain a reach of 10 feet.

giant's stature.name: Giant's Stature
giant's stature.text: You grow to incredible size. You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the clumsy 1 condition until you stop raging. Your equipment grows with you.

glacial prison.name: Glacial Prison
glacial prison.text: Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice. Target a creature you can observe within 120 feet. It must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC. The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

The target is frozen solid. It can't act, its AC is 9, it has Hardness 5, and it's immune to other cold effects, critical hits, and precision damage. This lasts until the end of your next turn, but if the target is affected by a hostile action, this effect ends immediately after that action.
As failure, but after becoming unfrozen, the creature is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

gladiator's roar.name: Gladiator's Roar
gladiator's roar.text: You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes. Your roar can be heard twice as far as normal, and creatures within a 15-foot-cone take 6d10 sonic damage and must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage and becomes frightened 1.
The creature takes full damage and becomes frightened 2.
The creature takes double damage, becomes frightened 3, and is stunned 1.

glean lore.name: Glean Lore
glean lore.text: You tap into the collected lore of the divine, accessing a variety of potentially useful information. Attempt a Religion check to understand the information you gain. The GM sets the DC (similar to the DC to Recall Knowledge), potentially adjusting the DC of the check for topics far removed from your mystery.

outcomes.text: You comprehend the lore accurately or gain a
You learn two pieces of information about the topic, one true and one erroneous, but you don’t know which is which.
You recall incorrect information or gain an erroneous or misleading clue.
You recall two pieces of incorrect information or gain two erroneous or misleading clues.

glider form.name: Glider Form
glider form.text: Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent. They glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as they spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, they remain in the air at the end of your turn.

glorious gamtu.name: Glorious Gamtu
glorious gamtu.text: You can access the mystical power that dokkaebi refer to as a hat. You conjure a magical gamtu hat, which is a magic item of light Bulk. The gamtu persists for 1 hour, and you can give the gamtu to another creature to wear.

glory and valor!.name: Glory and Valor!
glory and valor!.text: You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first.

glory on high.name: Glory on High
glory on high.text: You take to the skies to unveil the full magnificence of your deity’s power. Fly straight upward up to your fly Speed and Interact to draw a weapon or to gesture with your hand or a worn holy symbol. Each enemy within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.
The creature is blinded for 1 round, dazzled for 1 minute, and takes 10d6 mental damage.
The creature is blinded for 1 minute, dazzled for 1 hour, and takes 20d6 mental damage.

gnaw.name: Gnaw
gnaw.text: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything. You deal double your jaws damage to an unattended, inanimate object.

go with the flow.name: Go With the Flow
go with the flow.text: You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you. Attempt an Occultism check against the creature’s Perception DC. On a success, the creature mistakenly identifies another creature within 30 feet of you as you instead.
go with the flow.trigger: A creature detects your attempt to Impersonate, and you’re within 30 feet of at least one other creature.

goblin club.name: Goblin Club
goblin club.text: You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you. You conjure forth a spectral bangmangi club for 1 minute, which appears in your hands, though you can give it to another creature to wield. This weapon is a +1 striking ghost touch club.

goblin scuttle.name: Goblin Scuttle
goblin scuttle.text: You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position. You Step.
goblin scuttle.trigger: An ally ends a move action adjacent to you

goblin song.name: Goblin Song
goblin song.text: You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics. Attempt a Performance check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing.

outcomes.text: The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.
The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.
The target is temporarily immune to attempts to use Goblin Song for 1 hour.

godbreaker.name: Godbreaker
godbreaker.text: You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes. You hurl the creature 20 feet into the air, following behind it with a powerful jump, and then make an unarmed Strike.
godbreaker.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

gods' palm.name: Gods' Palm
gods' palm.text: You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy’s physical defenses. Make a fist Strike; on a success, you can choose to either deal all damage from the attack as spirit damage, or deal damage as normal but gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half y…

godspeed.name: Godspeed
godspeed.text: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are quickened. You can use the extra action each round to Stride, Step, or Leap.

golden dragon's bounty.name: Golden Dragon's Bounty
golden dragon's bounty.text: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, that damage is your choice of cold iron, silver, or steel for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, vulnerabilities, and the like.

golden erinys stance.name: Golden Erinys Stance
golden erinys stance.text: Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh. In this stance, you can make fury's fang unarmed attacks.

gorilla pound.name: Gorilla Pound
gorilla pound.text: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize, then make one gorilla slam Strike against the same target. If your Strike hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to the damage roll equal to triple the value of the target's frightened condition.

gorilla stance.name: Gorilla Stance
gorilla stance.text: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are gorilla slam unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the backswing, forceful, grapple, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

goring charge.name: Goring Charge
goring charge.text: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes. Stride twice, then make a horns Strike. If you moved at least 20 feet from your starting position, your horns Strike also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

gossamer blade.name: Gossamer Blade
gossamer blade.text: Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of your weapon to resonate through its victim. The creature takes 1d6 persistent force damage per damage dice of your weapon.
gossamer blade.requirements: Your previous action was a successful Strike against an off-guard creature.

graceful poise.name: Graceful Poise
graceful poise.text: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion’s stinger. While you are in this stance, if you make your second Strike from Double Slice with an agile weapon, Double Slice counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty

grand dance.name: Grand Dance
grand dance.text: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance. Stride up to your Speed; during this Stride, you can walk on air as if it were solid ground. You can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle. You must end your Stride on a surface that can support you or you fall.
grand dance.requirements: You're in Masquerade of Seasons Stance.

grasping spirits spell.name: Grasping Spirits Spell
grasping spirits spell.text: Gaining substance from your magic, your apparitions increase the range of your spells, which then pull your enemy closer. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range and targets one creature, increase that spell’s range by 30 feet.

grave threat.name: Grave Threat
grave threat.text: You use your imposing demeanor to set up the undead for defeat. Make a Strike against an undead creature using a weapon with which you have master proficiency. If you hit, all Strikes against that creature gain the benefits of Reaper of Repose for 1 round.

green dash.name: Green Dash
green dash.text: The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed. You Stride with a +15-foot status bonus to your Speed. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead if you have the corresponding movement type.
green dash.requirements: You're adjacent to a tree, shrub, or plant that occupies at least a 5-foot square.

greenwatch veteran.name: Greenwatch Veteran
greenwatch veteran.text: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies. Attempt a Recall Knowledge check against the creature you were Tracking.
greenwatch veteran.trigger: Your turn starts, and you're in combat against a creature you spent at least 10 minutes Tracking.

gremlin flight.name: Gremlin Flight
gremlin flight.text: You focus on your wings, allowing you to fly for a brief spurt. You Fly. If you don’t normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren’t on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

grief's fury.name: Grief's Fury
grief's fury.text: A lost love. A broken spear. Rage burning through a hero-god. When a myth speaks of a wounded partner, the hero-god often rejects the future. Too many find themselves on a battlefield, clutching a body that they swore to protect. In that moment, the wellspring of power ignites.
grief's fury.trigger: Your bonded partner gains the dying condition or their dying value would increase.

grievous blow.name: Grievous Blow
grievous blow.text: You know how to deliver focused, powerful blows that bypass your enemies’ resistances. Make an unarmed melee Strike. If this Strike hits, it deals two additional weapon damage dice and ignores an amount of resistance to physical damage (or to a specific physical damage type) equal to your level.

grippli glide.name: Grippli Glide
grippli glide.text: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down (10 feet if you don't have both hands free) and up to 25 feet forward through the air.
grippli glide.requirements: You must have at least one hand free.

grit and tenacity.name: Grit and Tenacity
grit and tenacity.text: You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect. Reroll the triggering save with a +2 circumstance bonus; you must use the second result.
grit and tenacity.trigger: You fail a Fortitude or Will save.

grovel.name: Grovel
grovel.text: You convince your foe you're less of a threat. You attempt to Feint against a creature. Unlike a normal Feint, the creature can be within 30 feet instead of in your melee reach, and you make your check against its Will DC instead of its Perception DC.

grow tool.name: Grow Tool
grow tool.text: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape. You create a one level 0 common simple tool with no intricate parts or written text, such as a crowbar, rope, or shovel.
grow tool.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

growth spell.name: Growth Spell
growth spell.text: You enhance your spell with elemental wood, causing your magic to expand and grow beyond its original limitations. If the next action you use this turn is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that affects an area, expand the area of the spell.

grudge strike.name: Grudge Strike
grudge strike.text: You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges. Make a melee Strike against a creature within your reach. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and deal an additional 2d6 void damage to the target; if the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, this Strike instead deals an additional 2d6 vit…
grudge strike.requirements: Your attuned apparition grants Heraldry Lore or Underworld Lore as an apparition skill.

grudging compliment.name: Grudging Compliment
grudging compliment.text: Every Firebrand can recognize the skill of others, but you've turned it into an art you can wield in combat. You compliment a foe's form or technique, and your unexpected praise distracts them from their surroundings. Attempt a Diplomacy check against that enemy's Will DC.

outcomes.text: The target becomes flat-footed for 1 round.
The target becomes flat-footed against your attacks for 1 round.

grudging compliment.trigger: An enemy within 30 feet damages you or succeeds at a skill check.

gruesome strike.name: Gruesome Strike
gruesome strike.text: Make a Strike against the creature that triggered your champion's reaction. If you hit, double the extra damage the target takes from your reaction, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be drained 1.
gruesome strike.requirements: Your Strikes currently deal extra damage from your champion’s reaction.

guarded advance (guardian).name: Guarded Advance (Guardian)
guarded advance (guardian).text: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution. You Raise a Shield and Step twice, in any order.

guarded advance (knight vigilant).name: Guarded Advance (Knight Vigilant)
guarded advance (knight vigilant).text: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution. You either Step and Raise a Shield or Raise a Shield and Step.

guarded mind.name: Guarded Mind
guarded mind.text: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you. You can reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus, but you must use the new result, even if it’s worse.
guarded mind.trigger: You fail a saving throw against an effect that has the mental trait.

guardian ghosts.name: Guardian Ghosts
guardian ghosts.text: You magically divert some of the harm from an incoming attack away from yourself, forcing your undead companion to take it in your stead. Reduce the damage you take from the triggering Strike by 2 + your level. Your adjacent undead companion loses a number of Hit Points equal to the amount of damage reduced.
guardian ghosts.trigger: You would take damage from a Strike while one of your undead companions is adjacent to you.

guardian lion roar.name: Guardian Lion Roar
guardian lion roar.text: Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion’s powerful roar. All creatures in a 20-foot line from your innovation take 2d8 sonic damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.

guardian's deflection.name: Guardian's Deflection
guardian's deflection.text: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack. This turns the triggering critical hit into a hit, or the triggering hit into a miss. You gain panache until the end of your next turn.
guardian's deflection.trigger: An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss.
guardian's deflection.requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and have your other hand or hands free.

guardian's deflection (fighter).name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
guardian's deflection (fighter).text: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack. This turns the triggering critical hit into a hit, or the triggering hit into a miss.
guardian's deflection (fighter).trigger: An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and the ally gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss
guardian's deflection (fighter).requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.

guardian's embrace.name: Guardian's Embrace
guardian's embrace.text: Your spirit guide discorporates to surround you in an invisible protective shroud. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical attacks until the beginning of your next turn.
guardian's embrace.requirements: You are adjacent to your spirit guide or it is sharing your space.

guide the timeline.name: Guide the Timeline
guide the timeline.text: You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination. Choose an ally or a foe. If you choose an ally, the next time within the next round that ally makes an attack roll or skill check, they roll it twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.

guided by the stars.name: Guided by the Stars
guided by the stars.text: The stars grant you insights that guide your actions. You roll twice and take the better result. If it's night and you can see the stars, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.
guided by the stars.trigger: You are about to attempt a skill check or saving throw.

guided hover.name: Guided Hover
guided hover.text: You guide your draconic companion, whose outstretched wings fill with unseen thermals. Your mount hovers without needing to use a Fly action to stay in place.
guided hover.requirements: Your airborne dragon mount has not used the Fly action this turn.

guided skill.name: Guided Skill
guided skill.text: You ask your spirit guide for aid. For the next 10 minutes, you gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival.

guiding finish.name: Guiding Finish
guiding finish.text: Using your weapon as a lever, you force your opponent to end up right where you want them. Make a Strike with a onehanded melee weapon. If the Strike hits, you can Reposition the target up to 10 feet. You can move the target through your space during this movement. Your Strike gains the following failure effect.

outcomes.text: You can force the creature to move as you would on a success, but you can move the target only 5 feet.

guiding finish.requirements: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

guiding shot.name: Guiding Shot
guiding shot.text: Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point. Attempt a Strike with the required weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circumstance bonus if your S…
guiding shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon.

guiding words.name: Guiding Words
guiding words.text: Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark. Choose an ally within 30 feet and attempt a Diplomacy check. The DC is equal to the hard difficulty DC of the level of your ally.

guillotine blade.name: Guillotine Blade
guillotine blade.text: The echoes of the splinter of finality's original purpose resonate through the artifact. For the next minute, your spectral dagger gains the benefits of a vorpal rune. When you use Snicker-Snack with your spectral dagger, the DC of the Fortitude save is 37, your class DC, or your spell DC, whichever is higher.

gunpowder gauntlet.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
gunpowder gauntlet.text: Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game. As you toy with them and performatively brandish your weapon, you build their tunnel vision, leaving them trapped in a perceptual gauntlet of your own making.

outcomes.text: The target takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.
The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.

gunpowder gauntlet.requirements: You're wielding a loaded one-handed firearm.

gusting spell.name: Gusting Spell
gusting spell.text: You manipulate the currents of your spell's energy, allowing you to gracefully glide with your wings. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the air or electricity trait, you can Fly up to 10 feet before or after the spell is cast.

haft beatdown.name: Haft Beatdown
haft beatdown.text: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown. Strike twice, once with your weapon and once with its haft.
haft beatdown.requirements: You are in Haft Striker Stance.

haft striker stance.name: Haft Striker Stance
haft striker stance.text: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right. You treat the haft of your wielded weapon as a simple weapon dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage. The haft is in the club group and has the agile and finesse traits.
haft striker stance.requirements: You are wielding a two-handed hammer, spear, or polearm.

hail of splinters.name: Hail of Splinters
hail of splinters.text: A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you. Creatures in a 30-foot cone take 1d4 piercing damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.

halfling luck.name: Halfling Luck
halfling luck.text: Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
halfling luck.trigger: You fail a skill check or saving throw

hallowed earth.name: Hallowed Earth
hallowed earth.text: The earth is both where the dead rise from and where they are put to rest. Your presence sanctifies the earth around you. When an unholy creature ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes 2 spirit damage. If it’s an unholy undead creature, it takes an additional 2 vitality damage.

halyard strike.name: Halyard Strike
halyard strike.text: You’ve learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface, and then swing up to twice your Speed. You can make a Strike using a one-handed weapon or unarmed attack at any point during this movement.
halyard strike.requirements: A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.

hammer quake.name: Hammer Quake
hammer quake.text: You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground. Choose a square within your reach, including your own space. If there’s an enemy in the chosen square, you can Strike that enemy with your two-handed weapon.
hammer quake.requirements: You’re wielding a non-finesse melee weapon in two hands.

hampering stance.name: Hampering Stance
hampering stance.text: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you. While you are in this stance, squares in a 5-foot emanation are difficult terrain for your enemies.

hamstringing strike.name: Hamstringing Strike
hamstringing strike.text: You slow your foes with a well-aimed attack. Make a Strike against your hunted prey with a –2 penalty. If you hit your prey, the creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to Speed. If you critically hit your prey, the creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed.

haphazard repair.name: Haphazard Repair
haphazard repair.text: You quickly fix your innovation, at the cost of its stability. You Repair your innovation almost immediately. You don't have to place the innovation on a flat surface, but you do need to be adjacent to it (including holding or wearing it), as well as having a repair kit as normal.

harbinger's claw.name: Harbinger's Claw
harbinger's claw.text: You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune. The target creature must roll the triggering check twice and take the lower result.
harbinger's claw.trigger: A creature within 60 feet is about to attempt an attack roll or skill check.

harden flesh.name: Harden Flesh
harden flesh.text: You fortify your skin with minerals drawn from earth and stone. You gain resistance 3 to physical damage, except adamantine, until the beginning of your next turn. At 12th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 1, to a maximum of resistance 6 at 20th level.
harden flesh.requirements: You're standing on earthen or stone ground.

hardening necrosis.name: Hardening Necrosis
hardening necrosis.text: Your partly undead flesh becomes resistant to the strongest physical attacks. You gain resistance 6 to the triggering damage; this resistance increases to 8 at 13th level, and to 10 at 17th level. However, you are slowed 1 for 1 round as your joints seize up and your hardened flesh makes it difficult to move.
hardening necrosis.trigger: You would take a critical hit that deals physical damage.

hardwood armor.name: Hardwood Armor
hardwood armor.text: Wood and bark grow over your body like armor. This hardwood armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The wooden armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 1; Group wood.

harmonize.name: Harmonize
harmonize.text: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously, typically by performing in multiple ways at the same time, using special vocal techniques to double your voice, or creating occult magic that replicates your song or speech. If your next action is to cast a composition, it becomes a harmonized composition.

harness natural magic.name: Harness Natural Magic
harness natural magic.text: Although it’s often faint, you can sense the presence of magic all around you. Your internal nexus takes in that magic as easy as breathing. You become overflowing as if you have Absorbed Magic.

harrow casting.name: Harrow Casting
harrow casting.text: You draw a card from your harrow deck just before you cast a spell to infuse your magic with its destined potential. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, the suit of the card you draw enhances the spell in one of the following ways.
harrow casting.requirements: You have an active harrow omen.

harrying strike.name: Harrying Strike
harrying strike.text: Your attack prevents a foe from pursuing your allies. Make a melee Strike, adding the following effects in addition to the normal effects of the Strike.

outcomes.text: The target takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.
The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.
The target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.

harsh judgment.name: Harsh Judgment
harsh judgment.text: Choose one creature you can see, and loudly declare the creature's life forfeit by your judgment. That creature becomes your condemned foe until they are defeated, you use Harsh Judgment on a different creature, or the encounter ends.
harsh judgment.source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 64

hasty celebration.name: Hasty Celebration
hasty celebration.text: After even the briefest success, you get caught up in the moment and begin to party, cheering your allies on. You grant all allies within 60 feet a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and damage until the end of your next turn.
hasty celebration.trigger: You critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy, or an enemy critically fails their saving throw against one of your effects.

head of the night parade.name: Head of the Night Parade
head of the night parade.text: You remember the revelry of the Night Parade and call them to your aid in a riotous display. You Perform and cast 8th-level mad monkeys three times, except that the spell calls various apparitions such as dancing tsukumogami or drinking oni rather than monkeys. Each casting can produce a different kind of mischief.
head of the night parade.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 75

head stomp.name: Head Stomp
head stomp.text: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a prone target. If it hits, until the end of your next turn the target is stupefied 1 (or stupefied 2 on a critical hit) and off-guard.

headshot.name: Headshot
headshot.text: You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot. Make a crossbow or firearm Strike. If you've damaged the target within the last minute with the same weapon and you get a critical success on your attack roll, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or die; this is a death and…
headshot.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

healer's halo.name: Healer's Halo
healer's halo.text: Your halo can enhance positive energy. Creatures who have recovered Hit Points from a positive healing effect recover an additional 1d6 Hit Points. Creatures who benefit from this power become temporarily immune to its effect for the next 10 minutes.
healer's halo.trigger: You or allies within 30 feet recover Hit Points while your halo is active.

healing nexus.name: Healing Nexus
healing nexus.text: You metabolize some of the magic you absorb into your internal nexus to stitch together any wounds on the rest of your body. You heal 30 Hit Points. At 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the amount of healing increases by 5. You are no longer overflowing.

healing transformation.name: Healing Transformation
healing transformation.text: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries. If your next action is to cast a noncantrip polymorph spell that targets only one creature, your polymorph spell also restores 1d6 Hit Points per spell rank to that creature. This is a healing effect.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.text: You harness the oncoming flames and twist them into a screen of heat and smoke, granting you concealment until the beginning of your next turn.
heatwave.trigger: An effect would deal fire damage to you, even if you resist all the damage.

heaven's step offense.name: Heaven's Step Offense
heaven's step offense.text: Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III. With a theatrical flourish, the Strike becomes nonlethal, and you can Stride up to half your Speed in a straight line toward another enemy.
heaven's step offense.trigger: Your melee Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points

heaven's thunder.name: Heaven's Thunder
heaven's thunder.text: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body. Until the end of your next turn, your unarmed attacks and weapons you wield that have the monk trait deal additional electricity damage equal to one-half your level and additional sonic damage equal to one-half…

hedge maze.name: Hedge Maze
hedge maze.text: You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges. Up to 10 hedges spring from the ground where you choose in a 30-foot-square area within 120 feet. Each is 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, and 15 feet tall. The hedges grant standard cover, are difficult terrain, and have a Climb DC of 15.

heightened captivation.name: Heightened Captivation
heightened captivation.text: You can infuse your charms and illusions with more power. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip spell granted by captivator archetype feats that’s at least 1 rank lower than your highest-rank non-cantrip captivator spells, that spell is heightened to the highest rank of captivator spell you can cast.

hell of 1,000,000 needles.name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles
hell of 1,000,000 needles.text: The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal. The needles lance into a cube 30 feet on a side within 500 feet. Each creature in the area takes 13d6 piercing damage, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

hell-lancer shot.name: Hell-Lancer Shot
hell-lancer shot.text: Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a fiend, ignoring the fiend's concealed condition and any lesser cover. If this Strike hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

hellbreaker's resolve.name: Hellbreaker's Resolve
hellbreaker's resolve.text: You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. While you have those temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

helpful tinkering.name: Helpful Tinkering
helpful tinkering.text: You don't just tinker with your own innovation, you fiddle with your allies' weapons as well (for their benefit, of course). Choose an ally in your reach and one of their weapons. Attempt a Crafting check against a high DC for your level.

outcomes.text: For 1 minute, the chosen ally's Strikes with the chosen weapon gain the same offensive boost your innovation has.
Your ally takes damage of the type and amount that your offensive boost normally deals on a successful Strike.

helt's spelldance.name: Helt's Spelldance
helt's spelldance.text: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique. Ostentatiously performing, you move across the battlefield, taking foes aback and creating an opening for your spell. Attempt a Performance check against all observers' Perception DCs.

hematocritical.name: Hematocritical
hematocritical.text: You bathe in the arterial fluids of your enemy, drinking deep of their freed essence to empower your magic and increase your spellcasting efficacy. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll, you roll the spell attack roll twice and use the better result; this is a fortune effect.
hematocritical.requirements: Your last action was a Strike that critically hit a creature that isn’t immune to bleed damage.

henge gate.name: Henge Gate
henge gate.text: You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them. The stones each appear in an unoccupied 5-foot space within 30 feet of you and within 15 feet of each other.

herald the hunt.name: Herald The Hunt
herald the hunt.text: You entwine your arrows and spears with fey magic that signals the opening of the hunt. You can Interact to draw a ranged weapon or a weapon with the thrown trait, then you make a ranged Strike against a creature you were tracking.
herald the hunt.trigger: You roll initiative and were Tracking at least one of your enemies in the encounter.

herald's strike.name: Herald's Strike
herald's strike.text: The power of your blows can send your victim hurling through your deity’s realm for a fragment of a second. You activate Herald’s Weapon, ignoring the frequency, and make a Strike with your transformed weapon or unarmed attack against a creature.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target takes 3d10 spirit damage and becomes dazzled for 1 round.
The target takes 6d10 spirit damage and becomes dazzled for 1 round and drained 1.
The target takes 12d10 spirit damage and becomes blinded for 1 round and drained 2.

herald's weapon.name: Herald's Weapon
herald's weapon.text: Your weapon becomes a wrathful instrument of your deity’s power. Choose a weapon you are currently wielding or an unarmed attack, which is wreathed in pure spiritual energy for 1 minute. For the duration, the chosen weapon and unarmed attack deals spirit damage instead of its regular damage.

heraldic proclamation.name: Heraldic Proclamation
heraldic proclamation.text: You proclaim your spell with the might of your god behind you. If the next action you use is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell, then all allies within 30 feet gain Hit Points equal to double the rank of the spell, and all enemies within 30 feet take spirit damage equal to double the rank of the spell (basic Will save against…

heroic defiance.name: Heroic Defiance
heroic defiance.text: Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to all saving throws, both of which last for 1 minute.

heroic presence.name: Heroic Presence
heroic presence.text: The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve. You grant up to 10 willing creatures within 30 feet the effects of a 6th-rank zealous conviction, though the effect automatically ends on a target if you give that target a command they would normall…

heroic recovery.name: Heroic Recovery
heroic recovery.text: The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient. If the next action you use is to cast heal targeting a single living creature and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, the target also gains three bonuses until the end of its next turn: a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed, a +1 status bonus to a…

hey! over here!.name: Hey! Over Here!
hey! over here!.text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. Hey! Don’t listen to that! That’s bad sounds! Listen to me! Would you like to hear about how the high priest of the Abadaran church in Absalom’s Petals District is having an affair with an Urgathoan cleric? Yeah, I’m thinking about calling the…
hey! over here!.trigger: An ally within 30 feet rolls a saving throw against an auditory effect.

hidden paragon.name: Hidden Paragon
hidden paragon.text: When you slip out of sight, you disappear. You become invisible for 1 minute, even if you use a hostile action. Not even revealing light, see the unseen, or similar effects can reveal you, though creatures can still use the Seek action to locate you as normal.
hidden paragon.trigger: You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become hidden from all of your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes

high alert.name: High Alert
high alert.text: You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around. Choose an ally you can see within 30 feet.

high-speed regeneration.name: High-Speed Regeneration
high-speed regeneration.text: Your wounds knit together with barely a thought. You regain Hit Points equal to double your level. When you gain this deviation, the GM secretly selects one type of energy damage or precious material, such as fire or cold iron.

hijack undead.name: Hijack Undead
hijack undead.text: Your clockwork devices can commandeer the bodies of undead, bending them to your will. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent undead creature. On a success, instead of taking damage, the target becomes controlled by you if its level is equal to or lower than your level – 3.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected and temporarily immune for 24 hours.
The target is unaffected.
The undead creature becomes a minion under your control for 1 minute. The control ends if you or an ally attacks the minion undead.
As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

hindquarter kick.name: Hindquarter Kick
hindquarter kick.text: You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides. Shift to talon stance and make two spinning talon Strikes against the grabbed creature. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. You then release the grabbed creature.
hindquarter kick.requirements: You are in claw stance and have grabbed a creature.

history of violence.name: History of Violence
history of violence.text: Your attacks bring with them echoes of previous battles, calling the unquiet victims of your most brutal acts to savage your opponents. Make a Strike. If this Strike hits, you deal additional void damage equal to your key attribute modifier to the target and all enemies within 30 feet.

histrionic injury.name: Histrionic Injury
histrionic injury.text: You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker. The attacker must succeed at a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become stupefied 1 for 1 round (stupefied 2 on a critical failure).
histrionic injury.trigger: A creature you can see damages you with a melee Strike.

hit and run.name: Hit and Run
hit and run.text: Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating. You Stride or Step, then attempt a melee or ranged Strike against a creature. After your Strike, you Sneak away. None of the movement taken as part of this activity triggers reactions.
hit and run.requirements: You are unnoticed or undetected by your target.

hit the dirt!.name: Hit the Dirt!
hit the dirt!.text: You fling yourself out of harm's way. You Leap. Your movement gives you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. Regardless of whether or not the triggering attack hits, you land prone after completing your Leap.
hit the dirt!.trigger: A creature you can see attempts a ranged Strike against you.

holy light.name: Holy Light
holy light.text: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light. The beacon sheds bright light in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on you until the beginning of your next turn.

homing shot.name: Homing Shot
homing shot.text: Your shots zip around corners and fly at impossible angles to reach your target. Make a bow or crossbow Strike against a foe you can see; the ammunition travels to your target, even going around corners. You ignore the target's concealed condition and all cover.

hone claws.name: Hone Claws
hone claws.text: You grind or gnaw a particularly wicked edge onto your claws. The next claws Strike you hit and deal damage with deals an additional 1d6 bleed damage. You cannot have more than one instance of Hone Claws active at a time.

hook 'em.name: Hook 'Em
hook 'em.text: The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface—and then swing up to twice your Speed.
hook 'em.requirements: A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.

hop up.name: Hop Up
hop up.text: Your frog-like agility awakens as soon as you do. You Stand. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

hopping stride.name: Hopping Stride
hopping stride.text: You've internalized the hopping gait of your vampiric forebear. Stride up to a distance equal to your Speed – 10 feet. During this Stride, instead of moving through each space normally, you hop over every other square between your starting space and your ending space.

hot foot.name: Hot Foot
hot foot.text: Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature “dance.” You shoot at the ground near a target's feet, causing them to react involuntarily; even mindless creatures have unconscious responses to dodge an attack, and you can capitalize off those uncontrollable reflexes to achieve your aim.

outcomes.text: The creature can't use reactions, is off-guard, and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves. These effects last until the start of its next turn.
The creature can't use reactions until the start of its next turn.

howling aspect.name: Howling Aspect
howling aspect.text: Pulling your hair loose into flames and gnashing your teeth into ragged fangs, you howl a vow of ire, and your form surges to meet the demands of your deadly promise. For the next minute, you gain two unarmed attacks.

humble spell.name: Humble Spell
humble spell.text: For basic spells, basic movements; you can do without flamboyant gestures or showy signs of power. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell, it loses the manipulate trait and gains the subtle trait.

hungry blade.name: Hungry Blade
hungry blade.text: Once your spectral dagger has tasted an enemy’s soul, your splinter of finality becomes increasingly relentless in its attempts to claim the soul. Your spectral dagger gains the effects of a keen property rune that applies only to Strikes against the target of the required Strike.
hungry blade.requirements: Your previous action was a Strike with your spectral dagger that dealt spirit damage.

hunted shot.name: Hunted Shot
hunted shot.text: You take two quick shots against the one you hunt. Make two Strikes against your prey with the required weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply your multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally
hunted shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0

hunter's aim.name: Hunter's Aim
hunter's aim.text: When you focus on aiming, your attack becomes particularly accurate. Make a ranged weapon Strike against your hunted prey. On this Strike, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore your prey’s concealed condition and any lesser cover.

hunter's defense.name: Hunter's Defense
hunter's defense.text: Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks. The triggering attack roll targets your Nature DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.
hunter's defense.trigger: A creature with the animal, beast, elemental, fey, fungus, or plant trait attacks you, and you can see the attacker.

hunting snag.name: Hunting Snag
hunting snag.text: Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close. Make a claw or talon unarmed Strike on the triggering creature. If it's a critical hit and the trigger is a move action, disrupt that action. If it hits and the creature left a square adjacent to you, you can Step into that square.
hunting snag.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

hurling charge.name: Hurling Charge
hurling charge.text: You make a ranged Strike with your thrown weapon, Stride, and then Interact to draw another weapon. This Interact action doesn't trigger reactions. Special If you are raging and end the Stride adjacent to an enemy, that enemy is off-guard against the next Strike you make against it with the weapon you drew before the e…

hurricane swing.name: Hurricane Swing
hurricane swing.text: Choose either lightning bolt or gust of wind. You Cast the chosen Spell as a 6th-level primal innate spell in the direction of the target of the triggering action.
hurricane swing.trigger: You critically hit a foe with a Strike with a slashing weapon.

hush.name: Hush
hush.text: You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help. You teleport to a square within 60 feet and make a Strike against a creature; if you hit, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The target is otherwise unaffected.
The target takes 10d6 force damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 round.
The target takes 15d6 damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 minute.

hydraulic deflection.name: Hydraulic Deflection
hydraulic deflection.text: Drawing moisture from the atmosphere, you create a disc of hovering water that deflects attacks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

hydraulic maneuvers.name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
hydraulic maneuvers.text: You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings. If the next action you take is an Athletics check to Disarm, Shove, or Trip, that action has a range of 15 feet.

hypnotic lure.name: Hypnotic Lure
hypnotic lure.text: Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment. You stare at a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
On its turn, the target must spend its first action to approach you. It can't Delay or take reactions until it has done so.

The target must use all its actions on its next turn to approach you. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has reached a space that's adjacent to you (or as close to you as possible if it reaches an impassable barrier).

i meant to do that.name: I Meant to Do That
i meant to do that.text: Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets. Roll a Deception check to attempt to Shove, Trip, or Disarm the foe you missed.
i meant to do that.requirements: Your previous action was a ranged weapon Strike that missed a foe within 60 feet.

idol threat.name: Idol Threat
idol threat.text: You brandish the precious object you're holding menacingly, at once mocking it and threatening its safety. Attempt to Demoralize the creature whose precious item you threaten.
idol threat.requirements: You're holding something sacred or precious to a creature, such as a relic or personal depiction of their deity or a precious personal memento.

igneogenesis.name: Igneogenesis
igneogenesis.text: You can create a permanent stone object, either sculpting stone pulled directly from your kinetic gate or manipulating earth and stone around you. It must fit within one 5-foot cube that's adjacent to you and on solid ground, and you can make the object large enough to occupy the square.

ignite the sun.name: Ignite the Sun
ignite the sun.text: The fires of creation become yours to control. You create a miniature sun in a 5-foot burst within 500 feet. A creature takes 7d6 fire damage any time it's in the miniature sun, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. A creature can take this damage no more than once per round.

iivlar's deflection.name: Iivlar's Deflection
iivlar's deflection.text: You’re able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows. Attempt a DC 17 flat check. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
iivlar's deflection.trigger: You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

ill tide.name: Ill Tide
ill tide.text: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck. You might not cause bad luck, but you can certainly keep it going. The next time the triggering creature attempts an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw, it must roll twice and use the worse result.
ill tide.trigger: A creature within 30 feet of you critically fails an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw

illimitable finisher.name: Illimitable Finisher
illimitable finisher.text: Your strikes flow endlessly. Step and attempt a single one-action finisher. This Strike gains the bravado trait, possibly replenishing your panache; if you regain panache, you can immediately attempt another finisher as part of this action, ignoring the restriction of using actions with the attack trait after a finishe…

imbue spell.name: Imbue Spell
imbue spell.text: You pass the energy of your magic onto an ally, allowing another to release the spell. Upon completing the Casting of a Spell, instead of the normal effects of the spell, you imbue the energy of that spell to an ally that’s adjacent to you or within your spellsurge aura.
imbue spell.trigger: Your previous action was to Cast a Spell.

immovable object.name: Immovable Object
immovable object.text: You plant your feet in a wide stance, resisting all movement not of your own volition. While in this stance and on the ground, you are immune to forced movement and if an effect would knock you prone, you aren’t knocked prone and can Step as a free action.

impaling finisher.name: Impaling Finisher
impaling finisher.text: You stab two foes with a single thrust or bash them together with one punch. Make a bludgeoning or piercing melee Strike and compare the attack roll result against the AC of up to two foes.

impaling thrust.name: Impaling Thrust
impaling thrust.text: You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free. Make a melee Strike with a melee weapon that deals piercing damage.
impaling thrust.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon that deals piercing damage.

impassable wall stance.name: Impassable Wall Stance
impassable wall stance.text: You refuse to let foes past your guard. As long as you are in this stance, when you critically hit with an Attack of Opportunity triggered by a move action, you disrupt that move action.

impenetrable fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
impenetrable fog.text: Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you. You call forth a fog bank in a 10-foot burst within 120 feet. All creatures in the fog are concealed, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it.

imperious aura.name: Imperious Aura
imperious aura.text: Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements. Use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.

implausible infiltration.name: Implausible Infiltration
implausible infiltration.text: You find tiny imperfections and somehow fit yourself through them, possibly moving directly through the wall or floor. Your movement attempt fails if the wall or floor is made of something other than wood, plaster, or stone; is thicker than 10 feet; or contains even a thin layer of metal.
implausible infiltration.requirements: You are adjacent to a floor or vertical wall

implement's assault.name: Implement's Assault
implement's assault.text: Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes. Make a Strike with your weapon against each enemy within 30 feet of you. You don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after making all the attacks.

impose order (nephilim).name: Impose Order (Nephilim)
impose order (nephilim).text: You shift the underlying fabric of reality to impose a baseline of order. If the trigger was a skill check, you instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (don’t apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).
impose order (nephilim).trigger: You would critically fail a skill check or suffer an effect with the misfortune trait.

impose order (pactbreaker).name: Impose Order (Pactbreaker)
impose order (pactbreaker).text: You impose the strict language of your folio on those around you. The triggering enemy takes 2d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This damage increases to 3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 13th level, 5d6 at 17th level, and 6d6 at 20th level.
impose order (pactbreaker).trigger: An enemy adjacent to you damages you.

impose order (psychic).name: Impose Order (Psychic)
impose order (psychic).text: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform. Until the end of your turn, instead of rolling dice for damage, count each damage die as average damage rounded up (3 for d4, 4 for d6, 5 for d8, 6 for d10, and 7 for d12).

impossible flurry.name: Impossible Flurry
impossible flurry.text: You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed. Make three melee Strikes with each of the required weapons. Your first attack with each weapon takes the multiple attack penalty as though you had already made one attack this turn. All of the remaining Strikes take the maximum multiple attack penalty.
impossible flurry.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

impossible technique.name: Impossible Technique
impossible technique.text: You execute a maneuver that defies possibility. If the triggering effect was an enemy's attack hitting you, the enemy rerolls the attack roll and uses the lower result. If the triggering effect was you failing a saving throw, you reroll the saving throw and use the higher result.
impossible technique.trigger: An enemy’s attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against an enemy’s ability.
impossible technique.requirements: You are not armored or fatigued.

impossible volley.name: Impossible Volley
impossible volley.text: You fire a volley at all foes in an area. Make one Strike with a –2 penalty against each enemy within a 10-foot-radius burst centered at or beyond your weapon’s volley range. Roll the damage only once for all targets.
impossible volley.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon with the volley trait and reload 0

impressive landing.name: Impressive Landing
impressive landing.text: You slam into the ground, shattering it around you. Treat the fall as 10 feet shorter. You land on your feet. The ground in a 5-foot emanation becomes difficult terrain. Any creature in the emanation when you land takes 5 bludgeoning damage as the debris hits it and is off-guard until the start of its next turn.
impressive landing.trigger: You fall at least 10 feet and land on a solid surface.

imprison foe.name: Imprison Foe
imprison foe.text: Rather than grant your foes the mercy of a swift death, you can consign them to suffer in an extradimensional prison with an appearance of your choosing. Spend 1 Mythic Point to force a creature that you dealt damage to with your last action to attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is…

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is stunned 2.

The target is transported into a cell within your extradimensional dungeon for 1 minute. It is unable to leave or damage the cell in any way. Teleportation effects can’t carry the target outside the cell unless they can also traverse the planes, such as interplanar teleport.
As failure, but the target is stunned for the first round it is imprisoned.

imprison foe.requirements: Your last action dealt damage to a creature.

improvise admixture.name: Improvise Admixture
improvise admixture.text: You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly. Attempt a Crafting check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC for your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances.

outcomes.text: You regain 3 versatile vials.
You regain 2 versatile vials.
You regain 1 versatile vial.
You don't regain any versatile vials.

improvise admixture.requirements: You have fewer than your maximum number of versatile vials, and you’re either holding or wearing an alchemist's toolkit.

improvise strategy.name: Improvise Strategy
improvise strategy.text: You’re a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes. You employ one of these strategies, adding either your choice of the auditory or visual trait.

outcomes.text: The target gains one of the following conditions of your choice until the end of your next turn: clumsy 1, dazzled, off-guard, or stupefied 1. The target can end the effect by using either a single action with the concentrate trait to regain their bearings (if your strategy had the auditory trait) or an Interact action…
As critical success, but the target is temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy.
The target is unaffected.
The target sees through the gambit, leaving you off-guard until the beginning of your next turn.

improvised repair.name: Improvised Repair
improvised repair.text: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs. You patch together a broken item possessed by you or an adjacent willing creature. Until the item takes damage again, it still functions as a shoddy item of its type.

in lightning, life.name: In Lightning, Life
in lightning, life.text: “In lightning, there is life.” This lesson is whispered throughout Lepidstadt, and you can put it to practical use. You have integrated a miniature Stasian coil into your healer’s toolkit.
in lightning, life.requirements: You’re wearing or holding a healer's toolkit.

in the horde's grip.name: In the Horde's Grip
in the horde's grip.text: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh. Weaker foes are caught in their grip. You command your horde to perform a Mobbing Assault.

in tune.name: In Tune
in tune.text: You attune your great skill in performing to another, granting them a small measure of your skill as though anyone could do it. If your next action is casting a composition spell with an emanation area, its area spreads from a willing ally of your choice within 60 feet instead of you.

incorporeal shot.name: Incorporeal Shot
incorporeal shot.text: You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target. Make a bow or crossbow Strike against a foe who is observed or hidden to you (but not undetected).

incredible aim.name: Incredible Aim
incredible aim.text: By spending a moment to focus, you can ensure your attack strikes true. Make a ranged weapon Strike. On this Strike, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target’s concealed condition.

incredible improvisation.name: Incredible Improvisation
incredible improvisation.text: A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience. Gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering skill check.
incredible improvisation.trigger: You attempt a check using a skill you’re untrained in

incredible recollection.name: Incredible Recollection
incredible recollection.text: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to 5 Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.
incredible recollection.source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

incredible ricochet.name: Incredible Ricochet
incredible ricochet.text: After your first shot singles out your opponent’s position, you direct another that ricochets around obstacles and strikes unerringly. Make a ranged weapon Strike against a creature you previously attacked this turn. You ignore the target’s concealed condition and all cover.

incredible sprint.name: Incredible Sprint
incredible sprint.text: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed. You Stride three times.

incriminating spell.name: Incriminating Spell
incriminating spell.text: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target’s mind. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the mental trait, choose a creature within 60 feet that the target can sense.

indomitable shot.name: Indomitable Shot
indomitable shot.text: You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes. Spend 1 Mythic Point, then fire a single shot from your ranged warshard weapon. You inflict your weapon’s damage on all creatures in a line, to a maximum distance equal to your weapon’s maximum range or until the line hits a solid object that’s either thicker th…
indomitable shot.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86
indomitable shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged warshard weapon.

indomitable spirit.name: Indomitable Spirit
indomitable spirit.text: Your soul has accumulated countless particles of quintessence over myriad deaths and rebirths, and for one moment, this raw material from the Great Beyond envelops you and your comrades. Until the end of your next turn, you and any allies adjacent to you get a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and are quickened.

induce imbalance.name: Induce Imbalance
induce imbalance.text: Your blows can disrupt the delicate balance of elemental energies that keep a body in good health. Strike the target using the unarmed attack associated with your current elemental stance. On a success, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC.

infectious joke.name: Infectious Joke
infectious joke.text: Your jokes can get a whole battlefield laughing. A creature within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your Performance DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected, and Infectious Joke ends for all targets.

The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can’t use reactions for the duration of the effect. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it on each of your turns to extend the duration to the end of your next turn, up to a maximum of 1 minute.
As success, but the target is also slowed 1.
As failure, but the target also falls prone.

infernal anguish.name: Infernal Anguish
infernal anguish.text: When you terrify your foes, you implant the fiendish visions of Hell into their mind. The creature you successfully Demoralized takes 4d6 mental damage or 8d6 mental damage if you’re legendary in Intimidation. You then increase the value of your doomed condition by 1.
infernal anguish.requirements: You are doomed, and your last action was a successful Demoralize action.

infernal interference.name: Infernal Interference
infernal interference.text: Your attacks force a foe to glimpse the iron, soul-wrenching landscapes of Hell. Strike an enemy with the required weapon twice. If either Strike hits, the target is stupefied 1 and can't use reactions until the beginning of your next turn. If both Strikes hit, the target is stupefied 3 instead.
infernal interference.requirements: You're wielding your order's favored weapon.

infiltration assassination.name: Infiltration Assassination
infiltration assassination.text: With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them. Make a melee Strike using your gauntlet bow as a gauntlet. If the Strike is successful, you automatically latch onto the target, giving them the grabbed condition, then make a ranged Strike against them with your gauntlet bow.
infiltration assassination.requirements: You're wielding a loaded gauntlet bow.

infiltrator's blitz.name: Infiltrator's Blitz
infiltrator's blitz.text: Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

infiltrator's reload.name: Infiltrator's Reload
infiltrator's reload.text: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration. Interact to reload a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype, then either Hide, Sneak, or Take Cover.

infinite expanse of bluest heaven.name: Infinite Expanse of Bluest Heaven
infinite expanse of bluest heaven.text: An illusion of a limitless expanse with an impossibly blue sky makes all within feel the sensation of falling... forever. The vision appears in a 20-foot burst within 100 feet. The illusion lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is off-guard.

The creature is off-guard. It is fleeing from the illusory sky but is also disoriented; any time it uses an action to attempt to flee, it must succeed at a DC 11 flat check or flee to a space that's still within the illusion.

infused void.name: Infused Void
infused void.text: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell. If this void damage or the spell reduces one or more creatures to 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 Focus Point.

infused with belkzen's might.name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
infused with belkzen's might.text: Your tattoos immortalize the conquests of orc war leaders, such as Belkzen besieging the dwarven Sky Citadel of Koldukar. You can expend one use of your storied skin’s Living History ability to channel this power into your own weapons.

inhale, exhale!.name: Inhale, Exhale!
inhale, exhale!.text: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes. If your next action is to use your Dragonet Breath, add 5 feet to the length of the cone or line. If your breath deals damage, you also deal one additional die of damage.

inked panoply.name: Inked Panoply
inked panoply.text: Your tattoos can briefly animate and extend from your skin, granting you a spectral shieldbearer who protects you from harm. Doing so expends one use of your storied skin, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
inked panoply.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

inner strength.name: Inner Strength
inner strength.text: Your strength is part of your rage. As long as your anger remains, you can gather your strength and rage to overcome any sort of enfeeblement. You reduce your enfeebled condition's value by 1.

inscribed blast.name: Inscribed Blast
inscribed blast.text: Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes. The triggering creature or object takes 2d4 force damage and your inscribed runes fade. You re-inscribe your runes each day during your daily preparations.
inscribed blast.trigger: A creature or object adjacent to you damages you.
inscribed blast.requirements: Your inscribed runes are currently intact.

inspiring marshal stance.name: Inspiring Marshal Stance
