inspiring marshal stance.text: You become a brilliant example of dedication and poise in battle, encouraging your allies to follow suit. When you spend this action, attempt a Diplomacy check. The DC is usually an easy DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

outcomes.text: Your marshal’s aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.
You fail to enter the stance.
You fail to enter the stance and can’t take this action again for 1 minute.

inspiring recitation.name: Inspiring Recitation
inspiring recitation.text: You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission. You gain a +1 status bonus to one skill of your choice until the beginning of your next turn. You can Sustain this effect for up to 1 minute. If you’re an expert in Performance, the bonus increases to +2.

inspiring resilience.name: Inspiring Resilience
inspiring resilience.text: You show defiance in times of hardship and inspire your companions to persevere. Allies within 30 feet of you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their Will save against the triggering effect, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the effect originated from an undead.
inspiring resilience.trigger: You and at least one other creature become the target of a spell or effect with the emotion, fear, or mental trait that allows a saving throw, and you haven't rolled the save yet.

inspirit hazard.name: Inspirit Hazard
inspirit hazard.text: You awaken a spirit of creation within the hazard. You learn the hazard's effects. Once in the next 10 minutes, when you observe a creature take an action that would trigger one of the hazard's reactions or free actions if you hadn't Disabled it, you can use a reaction to rearm the hazard, causing the observed creature…

instant army.name: Instant Army
instant army.text: You keep a reserve cache of thralls ready in case of an emergency. You create up to 20 thralls within 120 feet.

instant backup.name: Instant Backup
instant backup.text: Even as your firearm misfires, you quickly draw a backup. Release the misfired weapon and Interact to draw a different weapon that requires the same number of hands or fewer.
instant backup.trigger: Your attack with a firearm misfires.

instant opening.name: Instant Opening
instant opening.text: You distract your opponent with a few choice words or a rude gesture. Choose a target within 30 feet. It’s off-guard against your attacks until the end of your next turn. Depending on the way you describe your distraction, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.

instant return.name: Instant Return
instant return.text: With a single fluid gesture, you catch a projectile out of the air, load it in your weapon, and shoot it back at the attacker. Interact to load the projectile into your weapon, then make a Strike with the required weapon against the triggering opponent.
instant return.trigger: An enemy misses you with a ranged attack using a type of ammunition appropriate to your weapon (a bullet if you're wielding a firearm).
instant return.requirements: You're wielding an unloaded firearm or crossbow.

instigate psychic duel.name: Instigate Psychic Duel
instigate psychic duel.text: You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature within 100 feet. The target can attempt a Will save against the higher of your spell DC or class DC. If it enters the duel willingly, use the result for a critical failure.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.

The two of you enter a psychic duel, but it ends automatically at the end of your next turn. As normal for a psychic duel, the duel ends if one participant is knocked out, as well as under any other conditions to which both participants agree.
As a success, except instead of ending at the end of your next turn, the target can attempt a new save to end the duel at the end of each of your turns, starting with your next turn.
As a success, except the duel doesn't end until it reaches one of the normal end conditions for a psychic duel.

instinctive obfuscation.name: Instinctive Obfuscation
instinctive obfuscation.text: The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats. An illusory double of you appears in your space for a brief moment. The triggering attacker must roll a DC 10 flat check; on a success, the attack targets you normally; if they fail, the attack targets the double and destroys it.
instinctive obfuscation.trigger: You are attacked by a foe, but they haven’t rolled yet

instinctive support.name: Instinctive Support
instinctive support.text: When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn. After your spell takes place, your companion gains its actions for the turn, as if you Commanded it, and one of the actions must be Support. If the companion has used any other actions already, it can’t Support you, as normal.
instinctive support.trigger: You Cast a non-cantrip spell that targets only your animal companion

instinctual creation.name: Instinctual Creation
instinctual creation.text: You have trained to never be caught without some semblance of necromantic defense. You create two thralls in spaces adjacent to you.

instructive strike.name: Instructive Strike
instructive strike.text: You attack your foe and analyze how it reacts. Make a Strike. On a hit, you can immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the target. On a critical hit, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check to Recall Knowledge.

intensified element stance.name: Intensified Element Stance
intensified element stance.text: You expend the elemental medicine in your body to empower your attacks, though you can’t consume any more elemental medicine until the next day. While in Intensified Element Stance, your strikes and damaging spells deal an additional 1d6 damage against certain creatures, depending on the type of elemental medicine you…
intensified element stance.requirements: You were the recipient of elemental medicine during your last daily preparations.

intensify investiture.name: Intensify Investiture
intensify investiture.text: Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them. If you next action is to activate an invested item that has a saving throw DC, you can use your thaumaturge class DC instead of the item's DC if it is higher.

interfering surge.name: Interfering Surge
interfering surge.text: You overcharge the triggering spell with magic. You expend a spell slot and attempt to counteract the triggering spell using the energy of the expended slot. If the triggering spell is in your repertoire and the spell slot you expended was a high enough level to cast it, you take no penalty.
interfering surge.trigger: A creature you can see Casts a Spell.
interfering surge.requirements: You have an unexpended spell slot and can see the triggering spell's manifestations.

internal dialogue.name: Internal Dialogue
internal dialogue.text: Past experiences or even past selves whisper words of advice and encouragement when you need them. Roll an Incarnation Lore check and use that result instead of your failed skill check result.
internal dialogue.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

interpose.name: Interpose
interpose.text: You put yourself between an ally and danger. Stride up to your Speed. You must end your movement adjacent to an ally. You and your ally then swap positions with each other. After changing positions, you can make a melee Strike against an enemy within your reach.

interrogate.name: Interrogate
interrogate.text: You ask questions you know will be answered. Ask a question of a non-allied creature that you can see and have been conversing with. Attempt an Intimidation check against the creature’s Will DC; if the creature is a member of the same religion as you, or is an undead or werecreature pretending to be a member of your fa…

outcomes.text: The target must directly answer your question. It doesn’t have to answer truthfully, but you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the creature attempts to Lie to you.
As critical success, but the circumstance bonus is +2.
The target can refuse to answer you and becomes unfriendly if they weren’t already unfriendly or hostile.
The target refuses to answer you and becomes hostile if they weren’t already. You can’t use Interrogate on the target again for 24 hours.

interrupt charge.name: Interrupt Charge
interrupt charge.text: You attempt to snag the foe before they run away. Attempt an Athletics check against the higher of the triggering creature's Athletics DC or Fortitude DC.

outcomes.text: You disrupt the movement.

You are able to slow the triggering creature down. It takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for the rest of its triggering movement. This penalty might cause the triggering creature's movement to end immediately based on its affected Speed.
As success, but the creature instead takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

interrupt charge.trigger: A foe within reach attempts to move away from you.

interstitial escape.name: Interstitial Escape
interstitial escape.text: To evade your foe, you shift yourself to another location, teleporting from your current square to another unoccupied square within 30 feet. Additionally, you gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to 5 + your level.
interstitial escape.trigger: You would be hit by a melee or ranged Strike, and you are not off-guard.

interweave dispel.name: Interweave Dispel
interweave dispel.text: You weave dispelling energy into a spell. If your next action is to cast a single-target spell against an enemy, and you either hit the enemy with the spell attack roll or the enemy fails its saving throw, you can cast dispel magic on the enemy as a free action, expending a spell slot as normal and targeting one spell…

intimidating spell.name: Intimidating Spell
intimidating spell.text: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage in an area, any target who fails their saving throw is also frightened 1 (or frightened 2 on a critical failure).

intimidating strike.name: Intimidating Strike
intimidating strike.text: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.

into the fray.name: Into the Fray
into the fray.text: You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury. You Leap, Stride, or Swim. Make two melee Strikes during this movement, one with your one-handed melee weapon and one with your shield or a weapon attached to the shield (like a shield boss or shield spikes).
into the fray.requirements: You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon in one hand and a shield in another hand.

into the future.name: Into the Future
into the future.text: You know your spell will be needed not now but in a few moments, so you cast your magic into the future. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast, the spell's effects occur 1 round later, at the beginning of your next turn, rather than immediately.

intuitive illusions.name: Intuitive Illusions
intuitive illusions.text: Illusion magic comes to you so naturally that you can effortlessly sustain your magical ruses. You immediately gain the effects of a Sustain a Spell action to extend the duration of one of your active illusion spells.

invented vulnerability.name: Invented Vulnerability
invented vulnerability.text: You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they become real. Attempt a Deception check against the enemy's Will DC. Select bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

inventive offensive.name: Inventive Offensive
inventive offensive.text: You can jury-rig your weapons to perform in unexpected ways. When you use this ability, add one of the following weapon traits to a melee weapon you wield: deadly d6, disarm, nonlethal, shove, trip, versatile B, versatile P, or versatile S. You cannot add a trait that the weapon already has.

invigorating breath.name: Invigorating Breath
invigorating breath.text: Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain. You gain 20 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. At 15th level, you instead gain 30 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes.
invigorating breath.requirements: You are adjacent to your spirit guide or it is sharing your space.

invigorating melody.name: Invigorating Melody
invigorating melody.text: You play an energetic tune, begin a call-and-response of a marching song, or otherwise start a performance that enlivens those around you. You and your allies within a 60-foot emanation gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds until the end of your next turn.

invigorating surge.name: Invigorating Surge
invigorating surge.text: You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally. You grant one creature within your spellsurge aura temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for as long as the target is in the aura. Using this ability again cancels the temporary Hit Points from any previous usage.

invincible army.name: Invincible Army
invincible army.text: You enumerate the many virtues and victories of your chosen allies, creating a story of their invincibility so convincing that it is as good as the truth. Choose an ally you can see and attempt a Deception or Diplomacy check against the hard DC for the target's level.

invoke defense.name: Invoke Defense
invoke defense.text: You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type for the duration of your spirit trance.
invoke defense.requirements: You’re under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

invoke movement.name: Invoke Movement
invoke movement.text: You manifest a form of locomotion of the spirits all around, such as the wings of an animal spirit or the watery flow of a nature spirit. Choose a movement type: burrow, climb, fly, or swim.
invoke movement.requirements: You’re under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

invoke offense.name: Invoke Offense
invoke offense.text: You manifest a physical attack of the spirits all around you, such as the claw of an animal spirit or the whipping vine of a nature spirit. You gain an unarmed attack that deals 1d8 spirit damage for the duration of your spirit trance.
invoke offense.requirements: You’re under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

invoke the elements.name: Invoke the Elements
invoke the elements.text: You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning. For 1 minute, you gain concealment against creatures more than 5 feet away, and any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you suffers 1d12 damage (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is…

iomedae's valor.name: Iomedae's Valor
iomedae's valor.text: Though you might not be walking the virtuous path of honor and justice most often associated with Iomedae, you have studied her mortal bravery and can emulate it when you're on the brink of defeat. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point.
iomedae's valor.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

ironblood stance.name: Ironblood Stance
ironblood stance.text: You enter the stance of impenetrable iron, refusing to yield to any blow. You can make iron sweep unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, parry, sweep, and unarmed traits. While in Ironblood Stance, you gain resistance 2 to all damage.

ironblood surge.name: Ironblood Surge
ironblood surge.text: You steel yourself, preparing to resist oncoming attacks and using your muscles to absorb the impact. You gain the benefits of your iron sweep's parry trait (a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn) and your resistance from Ironblood Stance increases to your Strength modifier (if it's higher) fo…

irradiate.name: Irradiate
irradiate.text: You exude an aura of radiation, making everyone around you ill. All creatures in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save or become sickened 1. On a critical failure, they’re also fatigued for 1 minute. You’re immune to your own radiation.
irradiate.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

irresistible bloom.name: Irresistible Bloom
irresistible bloom.text: You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible. All creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Will save with a DC equal to your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher.
irresistible bloom.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

iruxi glide.name: Iruxi Glide
iruxi glide.text: You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

it was me all along!.name: It Was Me All Along!
it was me all along!.text: You discard a disguise and dramatically reveal your true identity, catching your foes off guard. If you created your disguise using magic such as with humanoid form or illusory disguise, you immediately Dismiss the spell as a free action.
it was me all along!.requirements: Your identity is hidden, either by magic or a disguise.

it's not over.name: It's Not Over
it's not over.text: In the world of drama, the finale of any performance doesn’t have to be the end, and for you, this now extends to life itself. When damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you can use this reaction to suddenly spring back into action.

ivy playhouse strike.name: Ivy Playhouse Strike
ivy playhouse strike.text: You've spent so many hours at the Ivy Playhouse or sparring with the Street Performers and Actors' Guild that you've picked up some stage combat techniques. In a fight, you can apply these approaches to make an attack less harmful but more confounding to your foes. Make a melee Strike.

jagged berms.name: Jagged Berms
jagged berms.text: You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth. Each appears in an unoccupied square within 120 feet, fills its square, and provides cover. A mound has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 HP, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. If destroyed, a mound becomes difficult terrain.

jealous grip.name: Jealous Grip
jealous grip.text: You are protective of your hoard, and woe betide anyone who tries to take what’s yours. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the triggering action was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action.
jealous grip.trigger: A creature in your reach that you’re aware of attempts to Disarm you, or damage or Steal an item in your possession.

jellyfish stance.name: Jellyfish Stance
jellyfish stance.text: You relax your posture and loosen your joints, allowing yourself to move with incredible fluidity. You can make stinging lash attacks that deal 1d8 slashing damage. These attacks are in the brawling group, and have the finesse, nonlethal, reach, and unarmed traits.

jester's gambol.name: Jester's Gambol
jester's gambol.text: You adopt a stance that makes your movements carefree and sublimely unpredictable, allowing you to move past impediments with ease and resist the attacks and importunateness of natural threats.
jester's gambol.requirements: You are attuned to an apparition that grants Circus Lore or Fey Lore as one of its apparition skills.

jotun's battle stance.name: Jotun's Battle Stance
jotun's battle stance.text: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn’t have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.

jotun's boost.name: Jotun's Boost
jotun's boost.text: Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 25 feet; if you have two hands free, you can instead toss them into a space within 30 feet.
jotun's boost.requirements: You have at least one hand free and are adjacent to an ally.

jotun's grasp.name: Jotun's Grasp
jotun's grasp.text: You’ve mastered a technique that allows you to close the gap on foes and wrestle them into submission. You Step and attempt an Athletics check to Grapple a creature.

juggernaut charge.name: Juggernaut Charge
juggernaut charge.text: As you move forward in a rush, you put the weight of your armor behind an attack that can drag a foe with you. You Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy, then Stride again.
juggernaut charge.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

juggle.name: Juggle
juggle.text: You can Juggle items and still use your hands between tosses. You can use the Juggle action in several ways. You can start to Juggle with a single stored item, an item you were carrying, or an unattended item within your reach. The item must be of light or negligible Bulk.
juggle.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 76

just a flesh wound.name: Just A Flesh Wound
just a flesh wound.text: You deny the extent of your injuries so convincingly that you fool not just your assailant but your own body. You attempt a Performance check to Lie against the triggering enemy’s Perception DC.

outcomes.text: The enemy’s Strike is a success instead of a critical success, or your saving throw is a failure instead of a critical failure.
You take damage as if the Strike were a success instead of a critical success or the saving throw were a failure instead of a critical failure, but other effects apply as they normally would.
The triggering effect applies to you as it normally would.
As a failure, but your protestations that you weren’t harmed come across as particularly pathetic. You’re off-guard to the triggering enemy until the end of their next turn.

just a flesh wound.trigger: You are critically hit by an enemy’s Strike or critically fail at a basic saving throw against an enemy’s spell or effect.

just as planned.name: Just As Planned
just as planned.text: In the blink of an eye, you calculate your enemy's movements and know exactly where to aim your next blow. If your next action is to Devise a Stratagem, you can roll the d20 twice and take the higher result.

just one more thing.name: Just One More Thing
just one more thing.text: After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.
just one more thing.requirements: Your most recent action was to Demoralize, Feint, or Request, and you failed but didn’t critically fail.

just the tool.name: Just the Tool
just the tool.text: You temporarily change your weapon's shape to assist you in the field. You morph your weapon into a single simple tool, such as a shovel or crowbar, to help with a mundane task. You can't replicate entire toolkits with this ability. You can use this action again to change your mind weapon back to a weapon.

kaiju stance.name: Kaiju Stance
kaiju stance.text: Your encounter with one of the rare forces of nature known as kaiju has imbued you with knowledge of a martial art that allows you to emulate a fraction of their power. When you enter Kaiju Stance, you become Large and are clumsy 1. The only Strikes you can make are shattering earth attacks.

kaleidoscopic entreaty.name: Kaleidoscopic Entreaty
kaleidoscopic entreaty.text: If your next action is to cast entreat spirit, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a 10-foot emanation centered on you. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.

kashrishi revivification.name: Kashrishi Revivification
kashrishi revivification.text: The well of psychic energy held within your mind can exceed the limitations of your physical body. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and unconscious conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal for losing the dying condition.
kashrishi revivification.trigger: You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check. You can use Kashrishi Revivification even if you're otherwise unable to act.

keep pace.name: Keep Pace
keep pace.text: Once you are upon your prey, they can’t escape. Stride up to your Speed, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you’ve moved your full Speed. You can use Keep Pace to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.
keep pace.trigger: Your prey is within reach and attempts to move away from you.

keep the party going.name: Keep The Party Going
keep the party going.text: Though your friends might fall, you're determined to be the last one standing. Attempt a Performance check against a standard DC of your level.

outcomes.text: You grant yourself or one ally within 30 feet of you temporary Hit Points equal to double your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.
As critical success, but the temporary Hit Points are equal to your level.

keep the party going.trigger: An ally you can see is reduced to 0 HP.

keep up appearances.name: Keep Up Appearances
keep up appearances.text: Taldan pride means you never show weakness. Roll a Deception check and compare the result to any observing creatures’ Perception DCs. On a success, that creature believes you were unaffected by the emotion effect.
keep up appearances.trigger: You are affected by an emotion effect.

keep up the good fight.name: Keep up the Good Fight
keep up the good fight.text: Your commitment to protecting others keeps you going, even against insurmountable odds. Instead of being knocked out, you're reduced to 1 Hit Point. You increase your wounded value by 1 and gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 round.
keep up the good fight.trigger: An enemy reduces you to 0 Hit Points but doesn't kill you.

killshot's report.name: Killshot's Report
killshot's report.text: As you drop an enemy, a loud echo issues out as you chain the spell’s energy to a nearby creature. Choose a secondary target within 10 feet of the creature you reduced to 0 HP. This secondary target is affected by the spell you used for your Spellstrike.
killshot's report.requirements: Your Spellstrike reduces an enemy to 0 HP.

kindle inner flames.name: Kindle Inner Flames
kindle inner flames.text: As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures. You shed faint, glowing embers, as do your allies while they're in your kinetic aura.

kinetic dampening.name: Kinetic Dampening
kinetic dampening.text: You feed off energy in your immediate surroundings, allowing you to dampen the force imparted by incoming blows. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain resistance 5 to physical damage. At 10th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 5.

kip up.name: Kip Up
kip up.text: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

kishin rage.name: Kishin Rage
kishin rage.text: Your eyes glow a deep red and your body courses with adrenaline as you obtain a fraction of the power of the kishin oni. You attempt to Demoralize all creatures within a 10 foot radius; you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.

klingegeist.name: Klingegeist
klingegeist.text: Your imprisonment inside a final blade used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder. You project your mind and incorporeal body into an unattended weapon of 2 Bulk or less that deals slashing damage.

kneecap.name: Kneecap
kneecap.text: You deliver a punishing blow to an enemy's knee, shin, or other vulnerable anatomy within your reach. Make a melee Strike with a melee weapons or melee unarmed attack. This attack doesn't deal damage. On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed (or a –15-foot status penalty on a critical hit).

kneel before the rightful heir.name: Kneel Before the Rightful Heir
kneel before the rightful heir.text: You command that your foes bow down before you or face your wrath. All enemies within 40 feet who can see and hear you must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, a creature is then temporarily immune to Kneel Before the Rightful Heir for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes 3d6 persistent mental damage.
The creature takes 6d6 persistent mental damage.
The creature takes 6d6 persistent mental damage and is clumsy 2 for as long as it’s taking that persistent damage.

knight's retaliation.name: Knight's Retaliation
knight's retaliation.text: You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe. You attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the triggering creature.
knight's retaliation.trigger: An undead creature within your reach critically fails a Strike against you.

knock sense.name: Knock Sense
knock sense.text: You attack carefully to knock some sense into a creature whose actions aren't their own. Make a Strike against a confused ally. The Strike is nonlethal and doesn't take a –2 penalty for using a weapon without the nonlethal trait; if you hit and deal damage, your ally automatically succeeds at the flat check to remove t…

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.text: The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the enemy back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. You can follow the enemy as normal for a successful Shove.
knockback.requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike.

knockback spell.name: Knockback Spell
knockback spell.text: You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, emanation, or line; has no duration; and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save, the spell unleashes a forceful blast that pushes creatures away, in additi…

knockback strike.name: Knockback Strike
knockback strike.text: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you. Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, attempt an Athletics check to Shove the target. This attack uses the same multiple attack penalty as your Strike, and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

know oneself.name: Know Oneself
know oneself.text: You center yourself and call to mind the Vudrani monastic ideals of mindfulness and self-knowledge. You fail the save against the emotion effect instead of critically failing.
know oneself.trigger: You roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect.

know thy doom.name: Know thy Doom
know thy doom.text: As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer. And you know that it is not yet your time. You can attempt a recovery check using your dying value before it increases, rolling twice and taking the better result. Regardless of the outcome, reduce your doomed value by 1.
know thy doom.trigger: You are doomed 1 or greater and your dying value would increase.

know your enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
know your enemy.text: You aim to turn knowledge into power against your foes. Attempt a Recall Knowledge check against an enemy you’re observing. Any ally within your aura who’s trained in the skill you use to attempt the Recall Knowledge check can use their reaction to Aid you on the check without having prepared to help first.

knowledge of shapes.name: Knowledge of Shapes
knowledge of shapes.text: Inspiration lets you surpass your preconceptions of your spells' limits. You use Reach Spell or Widen Spell as a free action.

kobold breath.name: Kobold Breath
kobold breath.text: You channel the power of your draconic benefactor to expel a torrent of energy from your mouth that manifests as a 30-foot line or a 15-foot cone, dealing 1d4 damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

kraken's call.name: Kraken's Call
kraken's call.text: You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies. You open a dozen small portals to some lightless, watery abyss in a 30-foot burst within 120 feet. The powerful tentacles of a kraken reach through to grab at each creature in the area.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.

The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a tentacle. A creature that's still grabbed by a tentacle at the end of its turn takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. The tentacles' Escape DC and AC are both equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
As failure, but double damage.

kreighton's cognitive crossover.name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover
kreighton's cognitive crossover.text: Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources. You immediately reattempt the triggering check using the other chosen skill.
kreighton's cognitive crossover.trigger: You gain no information from a Recall Knowledge check (usually because you failed the secret check) using one of the two skills you chose for this feat.

lassoing lash.name: Lassoing Lash
lassoing lash.text: You quickly wrap your lash around an opponent and pull them toward you. Attempt an Athletics check against the Fortitude DC of a target within your lash's reach. Special If you have the Titan Wrestler feat, you can target a creature up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you’re legenda…

outcomes.text: You pull the target to any open space adjacent to you.
You pull the target to the nearest open space adjacent to you.
You misjudge your leverage and fall prone.

lassoing lash.requirements: The target can’t be more than one size larger than you.

lava leap.name: Lava Leap
lava leap.text: You wreath yourself in molten stone and hurtle toward your enemy. Leap up to your Speed. At the end of your Leap, a wave of lava crashes onto all creatures in a 10-foot emanation. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 fire damage, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

lead by example.name: Lead by Example
lead by example.text: You telegraph your next attack to let your allies in on your strategy. Make a melee or ranged Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty. On a hit, the next ally to target the same creature with a Strike gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their attack roll.

lead the way.name: Lead the Way
lead the way.text: You move forward, creating an opening for others to follow. Choose one adjacent ally who has a reaction available. You Stride, and that ally can use their reaction to immediately Stride. The ally must end their Stride adjacent to you.

leading dance.name: Leading Dance
leading dance.text: You sweep your foe into your dance. Attempt a Performance check against an adjacent enemy's Will DC.

outcomes.text: Your foe is swept up in your dance. You both move up to 10 feet in the same direction, remaining adjacent to one another. Your movement doesn't trigger reactions from the target (and the target's movement doesn't trigger reactions because it's forced movement).
As critical success, but you both move only 5 feet.
The foe doesn't follow your steps. You can move 5 feet if you choose, but this movement triggers reactions normally.
You stumble, falling prone in your space.

leading dance.requirements: You are adjacent to an enemy.

leaping hedgehog strike.name: Leaping Hedgehog Strike
leaping hedgehog strike.text: You pounce toward an enemy and then barrel them over with one fluid movement, ending this maneuver with an attack that may catch them off-balance. Leap horizontally toward an enemy you can see; treat your Speed as 30 feet or more for this Leap if it is less than 30 feet.

leech-clip.name: Leech-Clip
leech-clip.text: You are trained to capture deserters, or “leeches.” Make a melee Strike with weapon from the flail group. On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed (or a –15-foot status penalty on a critical hit). The penalty lasts for 1 round.

left-hand blood.name: Left-hand Blood
left-hand blood.text: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous. You deal 1 slashing damage to yourself to poison a weapon you are holding. If you hit with the weapon and deal damage, the target also takes 1d4 persistent poison damage.

legend of combat.name: Legend of Combat
legend of combat.text: You can deliver a lightning-fast series of blows and strikes, bringing all the strength of your legend to bear against those who have yet to experience your prowess. Spend a Mythic Point. For the next minute, you gain an extra reaction at the start of each of your turns. You also gain the Speed of Arms reaction.
legend of combat.trigger: Your turn begins; Effect You make a Strike against one opponent within your reach, or Stride directly towards an opponent. If this is the first time you've struck that opponent during this encounter, the Strike is made at mythic proficiency.

legendary negotiation.name: Legendary Negotiation
legendary negotiation.text: You can negotiate incredibly quickly in adverse situations. You attempt to Make an Impression and then Request your opponent cease their current activity and engage in negotiations. You take a –5 penalty to your Diplomacy check.

leshy glide.name: Leshy Glide
leshy glide.text: Using your own leaves, you can control your descent. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

leshy superstition.name: Leshy Superstition
leshy superstition.text: You notice spirits that inhabit objects, learning which bring good fortune and which are unlucky. You focus on the power of a lucky object, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw against the triggering effect.
leshy superstition.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, but haven’t rolled yet

lesson of mutual gambits.name: Lesson of Mutual Gambits
lesson of mutual gambits.text: You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack. The creature you Feinted is off-guard to the first Strike or spell attack roll your student makes against it before the end of your next turn.
lesson of mutual gambits.requirements: Your last action was a success to Feint.

lesson of sympathetic vulnerability.name: Lesson of Sympathetic Vulnerability
lesson of sympathetic vulnerability.text: You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself. Until the end of your current turn, damage you deal to enemies from Strikes and spells is the same type that triggered the creature's weakness instead of its usual type.
lesson of sympathetic vulnerability.trigger: Your student triggered a creature's weakness to energy damage with a Strike or spell on their previous turn.

lesson of the broken wing.name: Lesson of the Broken Wing
lesson of the broken wing.text: You make yourself appear to be a tempting target to draw an enemy in, distracting them from your student's attacks. Choose an enemy creature within 60 feet that you are aware of.

lesson of the circling gale.name: Lesson of the Circling Gale
lesson of the circling gale.text: You and your student have trained with footwork drills to mirror each other's movements. You Step, and your student can immediately Step as a reaction.

lesson of the splintered aegis.name: Lesson of the Splintered Aegis
lesson of the splintered aegis.text: With your attack, you demonstrate to your student a hole in your enemy's defenses. Before the beginning of your next turn, your student can roll their next Strike or spell attack roll against that same enemy twice and take the better result.
lesson of the splintered aegis.requirements: Your last action was a Strike that dealt damage to an enemy.

lessons of flux.name: Lessons of Flux
lessons of flux.text: You apply the persistence and permutation taught by faydhaans to your failures. You reroll the check and take the second result. If it still fails or critically fails, you can ask a question about the creature you were attempting to Grab, Reposition, Shove, Trip, or Tumble Through as if you had succeeded at a check to…
lessons of flux.trigger: You fail a skill check to Grab, Reposition, Shove, Trip, or Tumble Through.

let's try that again.name: Let's Try That Again
let's try that again.text: You feel a sense of deja vu when you’ve made a mistake, almost as if you weren’t so careless in a past life and could certainly do better if given another chance. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the new result, even if it’s worse than your first roll.

lethal edge.name: Lethal Edge
lethal edge.text: When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by Silent Lenore. You apply one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of your next turn. The target can’t use reactions.The target is enfeebled 1.
lethal edge.trigger: Your Strike with your spectral dagger hits a frightened creature and deals spirit damage.

lethal finisher.name: Lethal Finisher
lethal finisher.text: You stab your foe in a vital organ, possibly killing them outright. Make a Strike. On a success, you forego your precise strike damage from the finisher. Instead, your target takes additional precision damage based on a Fortitude save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: You deal 6 precision damage.
You deal 6d6 precision damage.
You deal 12d6 precision damage.
You deal 18d6 precision damage.

leverage anguish.name: Leverage Anguish
leverage anguish.text: You leverage your emotional turmoil to mend your physical form. You regain 2d8 Hit Points. If you’re a master in Athletics, you regain 4d8 Hit Points instead. If you’re legendary in Athletics, you regain 6d8 Hit Points instead.
leverage anguish.trigger: You fail or critically fail a saving throw against a curse, death, emotion, or fear effect.

levered swing.name: Levered Swing
levered swing.text: You can wrap your lash around a tree branch or railing, then pull yourself where you need to go. Choose a solid anchor point within reach of your lash. You Fly up to your Speed as you pivot around the anchor, ending in an open space where the anchor is still within reach of your lash.

levering strike.name: Levering Strike
levering strike.text: Make a Strike with your staff. As long as you don’t critically fail, the target becomes flat-footed and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its DC against Shove, Trip, and Tumble Through attempts until the start of your next turn.
levering strike.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

ley line conduit.name: Ley Line Conduit
ley line conduit.text: You can draw magic from the ley lines of the world. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don’t expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

liberate soul.name: Liberate Soul
liberate soul.text: The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul. You attempt to counteract a possession effect, or an effect, object, or spell that is imprisoning a soul (such as bind soul, a soul gem, or a devourer's devoured souls).

liberated mind.name: Liberated Mind
liberated mind.text: Your mind won't be held hostage by those who would seek to control you. You reroll the triggering save, taking the new result. If the effect would cause the confused or controlled condition, you gain a +2 status bonus to the reroll.
liberated mind.trigger: You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

liberating dive.name: Liberating Dive
liberating dive.text: You sprout wings with steel feathers, resembling those of the celestial Talmandor. With a powerful flap, the wings propel you across the battlefield, slicing foes and restraints along your path. Until the end of your turn, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 40 feet, whichever is greater.

liberty or death.name: Liberty or Death
liberty or death.text: You have given a despot enough time to think, and now is the time for them to forfeit their control or die. Spend a Mythic Point and make a Strike at mythic proficiency against the required creature.
liberty or death.requirements: A creature has been the target of your Ultimatum of Liberation for at least 1 minute

life leap.name: Life Leap
life leap.text: You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light. You move from your current location to another location that's still adjacent to the same living creature, but on the opposite side or corner of the creature's…
life leap.requirements: You must be adjacent to a living creature

life's blood.name: Life's Blood
life's blood.text: Your journey to enlightenment has made your blood possess nigh-immortal properties, allowing you to heal others. You sacrifice some of your vitality to heal another willing living creature that’s adjacent to you, coating its wounds with your blood.

life-giving magic.name: Life-Giving Magic
life-giving magic.text: The upwelling of innate magic refreshes your body. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.
life-giving magic.trigger: You cast an innate spell from a gnome heritage or ancestry feat.

light paws.name: Light Paws
light paws.text: You can balance on your toes to step carefully over obstructions. You Stride and then Step, or Step and then Stride, ignoring difficult terrain during this movement.

lightning dash.name: Lightning Dash
lightning dash.text: For an instant, you transform yourself into a being of pure lightning and fly forward, shocking anyone in your way. You propel yourself forward in a 30-foot line. You can move through creatures during this movement, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions that are triggered by movement.

lightning qi.name: Lightning Qi
lightning qi.text: Qi flows freely from within you. If your next action is to cast a qi spell that takes at least two actions to cast, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

lightning rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning rod.text: You smash a metal rod into your foe and call lightning to it. Attempt a 2-action melee or ranged Elemental Blast using the metal element. On a hit, the target takes an additional 1d12 electricity damage and is skewered with a metal rod, which gives it a –1 circumstance penalty to AC and saves against electricity; the p…

lightning swap.name: Lightning Swap
lightning swap.text: You have practiced quickly switching between combat styles and the equipment needed for them. You Interact to stow any number of items from your hands, then draw up to two weapons or a shield and a weapon.

lightning tongue.name: Lightning Tongue
lightning tongue.text: Your tongue darts out faster than the eye can see to retrieve loose objects. You Interact to pick up a single unattended object of light Bulk or less within 10 feet of you. If you don't have enough hands free to hold the object, it falls to the ground in your space.

lightspeed assault.name: Lightspeed Assault
lightspeed assault.text: You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant. Stride to an enemy and attempt a Strike against it. If successful, you can add another action to Lightspeed Assault.

live off borrowed time.name: Live Off Borrowed Time
live off borrowed time.text: You tap into the future to steal a bit of time from yourself a few seconds from now that you can use immediately. You become quickened for 1 round, and can use the extra action to take any basic or specialty basic 1-action action. You gain this extra action immediately and can use it this turn.
live off borrowed time.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

live the creed.name: Live the Creed
live the creed.text: You’ve become an unparalleled figure among your faith, able to align your divine abilities with unparalleled swiftness. You cast a battle aura using one of your divine font slots.

living bonfire.name: Living Bonfire
living bonfire.text: Roots and branches of living wood writhe in elemental fire at your command, forming a bonfire fearsome enough to scare off predators in the night. You conjure a bonfire in an unoccupied 10-foot-square space within 30 feet. The bonfire burns for 10 hours, providing all the benefits of a normal campfire.

living for the applause.name: Living for the Applause
living for the applause.text: Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on. The attention reinvigorates you and keeps you from being knocked out. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1.
living for the applause.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points (but not immediately killed) during a combat encounter that has spectators.

lobbed attack.name: Lobbed Attack
lobbed attack.text: You make a thrown ranged Strike with the required weapon, using the weapon’s normal range increment. This attack doesn’t trigger reactions, and if the target has never seen you use this feat before, the target is flat-footed against this attack.
lobbed attack.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74
lobbed attack.requirements: You are Juggling a thrown weapon.

lock down.name: Lock Down
lock down.text: You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach. Strike an enemy within your reach. If you hit and deal damage, that enemy can't use move actions to move beyond the reach of the weapon or unarmed attack you used for the Strike.

lock on.name: Lock On
lock on.text: Aha! You lock on to your enemy's weak point to assist your construct companion in destroying it. When you Lock On, designate an enemy you can see. If your next action is to Command your construct, the construct gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the designated enemy until the end of the turn.

log roll.name: Log Roll
log roll.text: You shuffle your feet to dislodge the surface beneath you or otherwise cause your opponent to become unsteady. Attempt an Acrobatics check against the adjacent creature’s Reflex saving throw DC. On a success, the creature falls. On a critical failure, you fall.
log roll.requirements: You and an adjacent creature are both on a narrow surface or uneven ground and the other creature is flat-footed.

lonely army.name: Lonely Army
lonely army.text: You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity. Strike with a blowgun or sling; if the Strike is successful, the enemy cannot tell where it came from and you remain hidden.
lonely army.requirements: You are in your favored location; you are currently hidden, unobserved, or unnoticed by all enemies; and you are not fatigued.

long-nosed form.name: Long-Nosed Form
long-nosed form.text: You transform into a specific, curious-looking human form. This human form is the same age and body type as your tengu form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as height, though your nose remains as long as your beak and your complexion has red undertones, no matter the skin color of your human form.

longshanks slam.name: Longshanks Slam
longshanks slam.text: Using a technique pioneered by goblins, you conceal your movements from a larger creature and hit them where it hurts. You use Quick Alchemy to create a bomb or quick vial, then Strike an adjacent creature that’s larger than you with it; neither action triggers reactions from the target of your Strike.
longshanks slam.requirements: You’re adjacent to an enemy larger than you.

look again.name: Look Again
look again.text: If your charms or illusions fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again. If your next action is to cast an innate spell with either the illusion or mental trait and it fails to affect any targets, you do not lose the spell.

look but don't touch.name: Look but Don't Touch
look but don't touch.text: Many flowers are beautiful to look upon but deadly to touch—and you're one of them. For 1 minute, any creature that touches you or damages you with a melee weapon without the reach trait or with a melee unarmed attack takes 3d6 poison damage.

looming gait.name: Looming Gait
looming gait.text: You move in long and deliberate steps that take advantage of your height, and transfer that momentum to swing down at targets farther away. You Stride and then Strike. If you move half your Speed or less, this movement doesn’t trigger reactions.

loose cannon.name: Loose Cannon
loose cannon.text: Your unpredictable gunfire often catches enemies off guard or hits unprotected areas. Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a creature that you haven't already attacked on this turn. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage on this Strike equal to the number of weapon damage dice.
loose cannon.source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

outcomes.text: The firearm misfires, but it doesn't cause the other critical failure effects listed below.

The firearm misfires and also explodes. It becomes broken, and it deals its normal weapon damage to all creatures in a 20-foot burst centered on the firearm, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. This damage includes any from the weapon's fundamental and property runes.

lord of the fiends.name: Lord of the Fiends
lord of the fiends.text: You consider every fiend a future subject and can assess them at a glance. Spend a Mythic Point. Attempt a check at mythic proficiency to Recall Knowledge about every fiend you can see.

lose your chains.name: Lose Your Chains
lose your chains.text: You rouse rebellion in the hearts of your allies, inspiring them to break free of their bonds. The triggering ally can make a check to Escape at mythic proficiency.
lose your chains.trigger: An ally gains the grabbed or restrained condition.

lucky escape.name: Lucky Escape
lucky escape.text: Your enemy lies in wait, lines up the perfect shot, and pulls the trigger... then at just the right moment you duck down to notice something scrawled on the cobblestone in chalk, a shiny coin, or some other coincidental distraction, creating an opportunity for the attack to miss.
lucky escape.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack, even if you aren't aware of it.

luminous flash.name: Luminous Flash
luminous flash.text: You release all the light within your body in a dazzling burst. Each creature in a 15-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Then, your natural light is extinguished, and you can’t rekindle it again for 1 hour.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled until the start of your next turn.
The creature is blinded until the start of your next turn and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end the blinded condition.
The creature is blinded for 1 minute and dazzled for 1 hour.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.text: You attack an enemy at the edge of your reach. Make a Strike with a melee weapon, increasing your reach by 5 feet for that Strike. If the weapon has the disarm, shove, or trip trait, you can use the corresponding action instead of a Strike.
lunge.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon

lunging spellstrike.name: Lunging Spellstrike
lunging spellstrike.text: Your spell unwinds the structure of your staff to make it exceptionally long, or even separate it into shards held together by magical power. Make a Spellstrike with a staff, with a spell that isn’t a cantrip or focus spell. Increase the staff’s reach by 5 feet × the spell’s rank.

lunging stance.name: Lunging Stance
lunging stance.text: Your body coiled to strike, you can lash out at distant enemies. While you are in this stance, you can use Reactive Strike against a creature that is outside your reach but within the reach you would have with a Lunge. If you do, you increase your range with the Strike by 5 feet.
lunging stance.requirements: You are wielding a melee weapon

lurching chomp.name: Lurching Chomp
lurching chomp.text: Through your wiles, charm, or a little bit of magic, you lure in a foe for a closer look—and a quick bite! Choose a creature within 30 feet. It must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If the target fails its save, you pull it up to 30 feet.

maelstrom flow.name: Maelstrom Flow
maelstrom flow.text: You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power. The overloaded energy grants your improvised weapon the effect of the astral, corrosive, extending, or frost rune for 1 minute, after which the item is destroyed.

mage hunter.name: Mage Hunter
mage hunter.text: You use your hatred of magic to lash out at a known spellcaster. Make a melee Strike against the required creature. If you hit and deal damage, the target is stupefied 1, or stupefied 2 on a critical hit, until the beginning of your next turn.
mage hunter.requirements: You’ve seen the target Cast a Spell.

mage's field dressing.name: Mage's Field Dressing
mage's field dressing.text: As your spell takes hold on your ally, you use some of its magic to quickly dress their wounds. You use Battle Medicine on one ally affected by the required spell.
mage's field dressing.requirements: Your previous action was to Cast a Spell from a wizard spell slot, and the spell affected an ally within 60 feet.

magical onslaught.name: Magical Onslaught
magical onslaught.text: Your eidolon’s attack provides you an opening for one of your spells. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against a creature, and then you cast a 1- or 2-action cantrip targeting the same creature.

magitaxis.name: Magitaxis
magitaxis.text: You move reflexively toward the source of magic you most consumed as a larva. You Stride, and you must end your movement adjacent to the triggering creature. You then can't use Magitaxis against the triggering creature for 24 hours as your reflexes reacclimate, though you can use it against other creatures.
magitaxis.trigger: A creature you could reach with a Stride action Casts a Spell from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

magnetic field.name: Magnetic Field
magnetic field.text: A magnetic field surrounds you. Choose a polarity when you take this action. You can switch the polarity as a free action at the start of each of your turns while you remain in this stance.

magnetic pinions.name: Magnetic Pinions
magnetic pinions.text: Small pieces of metal fly from you, propelled with magnetism at great velocity. Make ranged impulse attack rolls against up to three creatures within 60 feet of you; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll against any target wearing metal armor or made of metal.

magpie snatch.name: Magpie Snatch
magpie snatch.text: You move quickly, snatching a shiny item that catches your eye. Stride twice, and you can Interact to pick up an unattended object at any point during your movement.

magus's analysis.name: Magus's Analysis
magus's analysis.text: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature, then recharge your Spellstrike. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if you previously hit the creature with a Strike this turn.

maiden's mending.name: Maiden's Mending
maiden's mending.text: You can tap into some of the magic that flows through your blood to give you new life. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.
maiden's mending.trigger: You cast a non-cantrip occult spell or an innate spell from a changeling ancestry feat.

majestic presence.name: Majestic Presence
majestic presence.text: By taking an impressive stance, the full force of your personality cows lesser beings. Each creature in a 20- foot emanation must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to your Majestic Presence for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2.
The creature is frightened 4.

majestic proclamation.name: Majestic Proclamation
majestic proclamation.text: You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display. Attempt to Demoralize all enemies within 30 feet. Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait when used this way.

make do.name: Make Do
make do.text: You sometimes need to act in a pinch, even if you haven't had the time to repair your gear. For the next minute, you ignore the broken condition of the tool or weapon you're holding. You can't use Make Do again on that item for 24 hours.
make do.requirements: You're holding a broken tool or weapon.

makeshift strike.name: Makeshift Strike
makeshift strike.text: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon. You Interact to pick up an unattended object in reach you could use as an improvised weapon, then Strike with that improvised weapon.

malleable form.name: Malleable Form
malleable form.text: You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance. Choose a different battle form of the polymorph spell affecting you, and change to that form instead of the current one. This destabilizes the spell's magic, reducing its duration by 1 round. Use the rank of the spell to determine the statistics, as normal.
malleable form.requirements: You're polymorphed by a spell that has multiple choices of battle form.

malleable movement.name: Malleable Movement
malleable movement.text: You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster. You shift your weapon into a long flexible pole, climbing hook, or similar aid, adding an extra 5 feet to the distance you're able to Leap. As normal, this can't increase the distance of your Leap beyond your Speed.

mammoth charge.name: Mammoth Charge
mammoth charge.text: You Command an Animal to order your megafauna companion to Stride twice. At any point during this movement, you can make a melee Strike against one enemy within reach.
mammoth charge.requirements: You are riding your megafauna companion.

maneuvering spell.name: Maneuvering Spell
maneuvering spell.text: You instantly tap into the magical power of a spell you're casting to quickly pounce around the battlefield. You Step, Leap, or Stand. This action can be before or after you Cast the Spell.
maneuvering spell.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover pg. 223
maneuvering spell.trigger: You begin to Cast a Spell that requires at least 2 actions to cast.

manifold conduit.name: Manifold Conduit
manifold conduit.text: You can manifest multiple spirits at once in a cyclone around you. You gain the entreat the many focus spell.

march of law.name: March of Law
march of law.text: When faced with lawbreakers, you become almost unstoppable, and your purposeful steps instill terror. Stride toward the required target with a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds and ignoring difficult terrain.
march of law.requirements: The target has attempted a hostile action against you since your previous turn.

march of the dead.name: March of the Dead
march of the dead.text: You compel your horde of thralls, overwhelming your enemies. You command any number of thralls within 60 feet to Stride. After all their movement is complete, any enemy adjacent to three or more thralls must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become encumbered and slowed 1 until the start of y…

march the mines.name: March the Mines
march the mines.text: You march through the earth and lead an ally along. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet when you use this activity (if you don't have a higher one), and then you either Stride twice or Burrow twice. You can choose one willing ally adjacent to you at the start of your movement to move with you.

marine jet.name: Marine Jet
marine jet.text: You shoot through the water at a great speed. Swim up to five times, or up to eight times if you used 3 actions. All this movement must be in a straight line (though the GM might allow reasonable variance).

marked for rebuke.name: Marked For Rebuke
marked for rebuke.text: You declare that an enemy is fit for further punishment in the sight of your deity. If the next action you perform is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, one creature of your choice that takes damage from the spell is marked for rebuke until the end of your next turn.

martyr.name: Martyr
martyr.text: You go to extreme lengths to support your allies, even when it means bringing harm to yourself. If your next action is to cast harm or heal to restore Hit Points to a single ally, you can channel your own vitality along with the spell.

martyr's parry.name: Martyr's Parry
martyr's parry.text: You intercede to absorb the triggering attack. Your bonded partner gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC. If the attack still hits, you take the triggering attack’s damage instead of your bonded partner, though the attack still uses your bonded partner’s defenses for the purposes of determining if it hit or critica…
martyr's parry.trigger: A creature attacks your bonded partner.
martyr's parry.requirements: You are wielding a weapon that has the parry trait, and your bonded partner is within reach of one of your melee Strikes with that weapon.

mask of fear.name: Mask of Fear
mask of fear.text: Your warmask burns off of your face, releasing your apprehension. You remove the frightened condition. Your warmask is destroyed, and you can't reapply it until your next daily preparations.
mask of fear.trigger: You start your turn with the frightened condition.

mask of pain.name: Mask of Pain
mask of pain.text: Your mask has grown into a manifestation of your pain, which you can release. The creature you successfully Demoralized takes 2d6 mental damage, or 4d6 mental damage if you're legendary in Intimidation. The target is then temporarily immune to additional damage from Mask of Pain for 24 hours.
mask of pain.trigger: You succeed at a Demoralize check.

mask of rejection.name: Mask of Rejection
mask of rejection.text: Your warmask projects a white-hot fury that attempts to vaporize the offending magic. You reroll the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.
mask of rejection.trigger: You fail a saving throw against an effect from your warmask's magical tradition.

masked casting.name: Masked Casting
masked casting.text: You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects. You Avert your Gaze. While Averting your Gaze in this way, you also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws and checks to disbelieve illusions.

masquerade of seasons stance.name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance
masquerade of seasons stance.text: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn. Choose one of the following traits: water, fire, negative, or cold. You gain resistance 5 to damage dealt by effects with the chosen trait.

master of many styles.name: Master of Many Styles
master of many styles.text: You move fluidly between stances, using your mastery of combat to always adopt the best tactics. You use an action with the stance trait.

master's counterspell.name: Master's Counterspell
master's counterspell.text: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it. If you're a prepared caster, you can expend a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell. If you're a spontaneous caster, you can expend a spell slot.
master's counterspell.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared, and that spell was cast or created with a tradition of magic in which you have master proficiency in spell attack rolls and spell DCs.

meddling futures.name: Meddling Futures
meddling futures.text: You open yourself to the guidance of whatever spirits or powers deign to help you. Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. Your next action must be the type of action the spirit prefers, but you also gain the listed benefit for the action as the spirit guides you.

meditate on this!.name: Meditate on This!
meditate on this!.text: You meditate to alter your qi, coloring it with your resentment and anger. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, or an adjacent creature deals piercing, slashing, or bleed damage to you, the creature that you hit or that damaged you must attempt a Will save against your…

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1.
The creature is frightened 2.
The creature is frightened 3 and fleeing until the end of its next turn.

megaton strike.name: Megaton Strike
megaton strike.text: You activate gears, explosives, and other hidden mechanisms in your innovation to make a powerful attack. You make a Strike, dealing an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice.

megavolt.name: Megavolt
megavolt.text: You bleed off some electric power from your innovation in the shape of a damaging bolt. Creatures in a 20-foot line from your innovation take 3d4 electricity damage, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. The electricity damage increases by 1d4 at 8th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

meld into eidolon.name: Meld Into Eidolon
meld into eidolon.text: Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon. You Manifest your Eidolon, but instead of summoning them into an adjacent open space, you become them. You can also Meld into Eidolon while your eidolon is manifested in an adjacent space.

melodious spell.name: Melodious Spell
melodious spell.text: You subtly weave your spellcasting into a performance. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the shining runes, sparks of magic, and other manifestations that would usually give away your spellcasting.

memory of nothing.name: Memory of Nothing
memory of nothing.text: With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature’s mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions. Choose a target within 30 feet and spend a Mythic Point.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires three or more actions, they take 12d8 mental damage.
For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires two or more actions, they take 12d8 mental damage.
As failure, but the target is also stunned 1 as its mind struggles to function.

memory of skill.name: Memory of Skill
memory of skill.text: Your years of training in a previous life didn’t go to waste with your death, and you can call upon this training when you most need it. Choose one skill. You temporarily increase your proficiency rank with that skill by one step for 1 minute (from untrained to trained, trained to expert, and expert to master).

mental static.name: Mental Static
mental static.text: Your thoughts sting back when a lesser mind tries to invade your own. You deal mental damage equal to your level to the triggering creature. If you so desire, you can also send the creature a single mental image to coincide with the damage, such as a watchful eye or the dread of floating in an infinite sea.
mental static.trigger: You roll a critical success on a Will save against a mental effect from a creature.

mercenary reversal.name: Mercenary Reversal
mercenary reversal.text: Even though the fight seems to be surging against you and your compatriots, you know that a key ally can always turn the tide. Choose a target you are currently observing. You assail it with a list of reasons why it should join you and why its defeat if it does not is surely inevitable.
mercenary reversal.requirements: You and your allies are currently outnumbered by enemies on the battlefield.

merciful elixir.name: Merciful Elixir
merciful elixir.text: You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker's body and mind. The elixir of life attempts to counteract one fear effect or one effect imposing the paralyzed condition on the drinker, using the item's level and a counteract modifier equal to your class DC – 10.
merciful elixir.trigger: You craft an elixir of life using Quick Alchemy, and that elixir is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

merciless rend.name: Merciless Rend
merciless rend.text: Your eidolon rends their foes. They automatically deal the damage from their secondary attack to the enemy.
merciless rend.requirements: Your eidolon hit the same enemy with two consecutive unarmed Strikes this turn and dealt slashing damage with both.

mesmerizing gaze.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
mesmerizing gaze.text: When you meet someone's gaze, they're unable to look away from you. Choose one target creature you can see and that can see you. That creature must succeed at a Will save or be fascinated with you until the end of your next turn; the DC is the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

metabolize element.name: Metabolize Element
metabolize element.text: Your rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy. You gain the quickened condition until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.
metabolize element.trigger: You take damage from a foe's spell or magical ability with a trait of one of the elements in your elemental philosophy.

metal carapace.name: Metal Carapace
metal carapace.text: Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell. The carapace is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The carapace's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 2; Group plate; Armor Traits noisy.

metallic skin.name: Metallic Skin
metallic skin.text: You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine), but you take a –10-foot penalty to Speed.

meteoric spellstrike.name: Meteoric Spellstrike
meteoric spellstrike.text: A trail of energy flows from your target back to you. Make a ranged Spellstrike against a target within your ranged weapon or unarmed attack’s first range increment. The spell you cast for the Spellstrike can’t be a cantrip or focus spell.
meteoric spellstrike.requirements: You’re wielding a ranged or thrown weapon, or have a ranged unarmed attack.

might of the realm.name: Might of the Realm
might of the realm.text: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule. Strike an enemy. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to double the number of your designated knights whom you can see.

mind shards.name: Mind Shards
mind shards.text: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind. You concentrate and unleash a 15-foot cone that deals 3d6 mental damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

mineral deposits.name: Mineral Deposits
mineral deposits.text: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you’re able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks. Choose cold iron or silver and a claw, jaws, or tail unarmed attack that you have.

minor omen.name: Minor Omen
minor omen.text: The stars warn you of danger in the nick of time. Reroll the failed save and use the new result.
minor omen.requirements: You can see the night sky.

miraculous intervention.name: Miraculous Intervention
miraculous intervention.text: Through divine intervention or whispered prayers, you foil an enemy's response. If the triggering creature's level is equal to or lower than yours, you disrupt the triggering reaction.
miraculous intervention.trigger: An adjacent fiend or undead begins to use a reaction.

miraculous repair.name: Miraculous Repair
miraculous repair.text: Geniekin can't grant magical wishes, but some echo of power lingers within you. Faced with a mechanism that is damaged but not destroyed, you can wish it back into a functional state for a period of 10 minutes. The object must be mundane and no larger than 5 Bulk, such as a disabled locking mechanism in a door.

mirror refuge.name: Mirror Refuge
mirror refuge.text: Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell one with stone. You meld into an adjacent mirror. You can hear but not see outside this space, and creatures outside can't see or hear you. You can cast spells while within the mirror, but no effects can cross the mirror.
mirror refuge.requirements: You’re within 5 feet of a mirrored surface.

mirror shield.name: Mirror Shield
mirror shield.text: You reflect the spell back against its caster. Make a ranged attack against the attacker using your highest proficiency with a ranged weapon. If you can cast spells, you can choose to make a spell attack roll instead.
mirror shield.trigger: An opponent casting a spell that targets you critically fails a spell attack roll against your AC

misdirecting composition.name: Misdirecting Composition
misdirecting composition.text: You leverage a performance’s most captivating moments to distract your foes and create an opening for your allies. You Feint using Performance instead of Deception against a target within 30 feet. Feinting this way gains the visual trait.
misdirecting composition.requirements: Your most recent action was to Cast a composition Spell.

mist escape.name: Mist Escape
mist escape.text: As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself. You Turn to Mist. This doesn't expend a use of Turn to Mist, and you can use Mist Escape even if you've already Turned to Mist in the same day.

mistaken identity.name: Mistaken Identity
