mistaken identity.text: You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead, allowing you to shrug off harmful effects. Roll the saving throw twice, and take the higher result. However, subsuming your identity is disturbing, and you're frightened 1.
mistaken identity.trigger: You're about to attempt a saving throw against a mental effect.

misty transformation.name: Misty Transformation
misty transformation.text: Wild mists cover your form. You create a hazy cloud in a 5-foot burst centered on one corner of your space. If your new form is Large or larger, the cloud covers your entire space instead. All creatures within the area are concealed, and all others are concealed to them.
misty transformation.trigger: You transform due to a polymorph effect.

mixed maneuver.name: Mixed Maneuver
mixed maneuver.text: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination. Choose any two of Grapple, Reposition, Shove, and Trip.

mobile finisher.name: Mobile Finisher
mobile finisher.text: You attack in motion. Stride and then Strike. You can use Mobile Finisher while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

mobile magical combat.name: Mobile Magical Combat
mobile magical combat.text: You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon. Stride once. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.
mobile magical combat.requirements: You're wielding a melee weapon and have Cast a Spell requiring at least 1 action this turn.

mobile shot stance.name: Mobile Shot Stance
mobile shot stance.text: Your shots become nimble and deadly. While you’re in this stance, your ranged Strikes don’t trigger Reactive Strike or other reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack. Special If you have Reactive Strike, you can use it with a loaded ranged weapon you’re wielding.

mockingbird's disarm.name: Mockingbird's Disarm
mockingbird's disarm.text: The Mockingbird is a master at running into foes and coming away with their weapons. Mimicking their skill, you strike at a foe's wrist while tumbling past them, weakening their grip. You attempt to Disarm the enemy whose space you moved through. You can use Acrobatics instead of Athletics for this check.
mockingbird's disarm.trigger: You succeed at a check to Tumble Through or use Tumbling Strike, and you moved through an enemy's space.

moisture bath.name: Moisture Bath
moisture bath.text: Your moist skin is especially resistant to damage from temperature-altering effects. Attempt a DC 10 flat check; on a success you recover from any ongoing persistent fire and persistent cold damage. Additionally, you gain fire and cold resistance equal to half your level for 1 minute.

molten wire.name: Molten Wire
molten wire.text: Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires. Make an impulse attack roll against a creature within 15 feet. On a success, the target takes 2d6 slashing damage and is wrapped in molten wire for 1 minute.

moment of clarity.name: Moment of Clarity
moment of clarity.text: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly. Until the end of this turn, you can use actions with the concentrate trait even if those actions don't have the rage trait.

momentary respite.name: Momentary Respite
momentary respite.text: Your sense of destiny manifests as rapid physical healing. Spend a Mythic Point. You regain 8d8 Hit Points and remove any persistent damage condition affecting you.
momentary respite.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78
momentary respite.trigger: You lose Hit Points from persistent damage.

momentous charge.name: Momentous Charge
momentous charge.text: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force. You Climb, Stride, or Leap, then make a ramming horn Strike. On a success, the target of the Strike is pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you. On a critical success, the target is also stunned 1.

momentum strike.name: Momentum Strike
momentum strike.text: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another. Make a melee Strike against an enemy of your size or smaller. If you hit and deal damage, you can move the enemy up to 5 feet (up to 10 feet on a critical hit) in a direction of your choice.

monastic archer stance.name: Monastic Archer Stance
monastic archer stance.text: You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are those using longbows, shortbows, or bows with the monk trait. You can use Flurry of Blows with these bows.
monastic archer stance.requirements: You are unarmored and wielding a longbow, a shortbow, or a bow with the Monk trait.

mooneater.name: Mooneater
mooneater.text: You call on the spirit of the dragon that devoured the moon to temporarily swallow a celestial body and blind onlookers with its visage. You can cast eclipse burst as a primal innate spell once per day. When you Cast the Spell, the sun or moon appears to eclipse to all creatures within 500 feet of you.

moray ambush.name: Moray Ambush
moray ambush.text: Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding. Stride or Swim directly toward the triggering creature and make a melee Strike against it. The target creature is off-guard to this attack.
moray ambush.trigger: You are hidden and a creature who hasn’t detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

mortal shape.name: Mortal Shape
mortal shape.text: You transform into a specific alternate form of a common Small or Medium humanoid ancestry, which you choose when you gain this feat. Most nymphs typically choose an elf or a human form. This form is the same age and body type as your true form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as hair color.

mother's mindfulness.name: Mother's Mindfulness
mother's mindfulness.text: You have the protective instinct your own mother lacks and will gladly suffer in another's place. You interpose yourself in the attack's path. You become the target of the triggering attack and are automatically hit by the attack (or critically hit if the ally was critically hit), suffering the full effects in your all…
mother's mindfulness.trigger: An adjacent ally is hit by an attack.

mountain quake.name: Mountain Quake
mountain quake.text: You stomp, shaking the earth beneath you. Creatures on the ground within a 20-foot emanation take damage equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 0), with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure, they also fall prone. After you use this action, you can't use it again for 1d4 rounds.

mountain stance.name: Mountain Stance
mountain stance.text: You enter the stance of an implacable mountain—a technique created by dwarven monks—allowing you to strike with the weight of an avalanche and block blows with your garments. The only Strikes you can make are falling stone unarmed attacks.
mountain stance.requirements: You are unarmored and touching the ground.

mountain stronghold.name: Mountain Stronghold
mountain stronghold.text: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. Special If you have this feat, the Dexterity modifier cap to your AC while you're in Mountain Stance increases from +0 to +1.

mounting leap.name: Mounting Leap
mounting leap.text: You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it. Leap toward the creature and Mount it.
mounting leap.requirements: You're within 10 feet of a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

muckraking.name: Muckraking
muckraking.text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. It seems like your knowledge has come in handy after all and you have your enemy at your feet.

mug.name: Mug
mug.text: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent enemy. If you hit and deal sneak attack damage, you can also attempt to Steal from the target, even if the target is in combat.

multishot stance.name: Multishot Stance
multishot stance.text: You lock yourself in a stable position so you can fire swiftly and accurately. While you are in this stance, your penalty for Double Shot is reduced to –1. If you move from your position, this stance ends. Special If you have Triple Shot, when you use Double Shot to make three Strikes, the penalty is –2.
multishot stance.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0

mummy's despair.name: Mummy's Despair
mummy's despair.text: You force your mental anguish outward, projecting it upon those around you. You gain an aura of despair in a 30-foot emanation lasting 5 rounds. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critica…

murderer's circle.name: Murderer's Circle
murderer's circle.text: You Strike a target within reach and then Step to any other open space adjacent to that target. Your target is then flat-footed against your next Strike this turn.

muscle mimicry.name: Muscle Mimicry
muscle mimicry.text: Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat. You study the successful maneuver of an enemy and instinctively learn to do it.
muscle mimicry.trigger: An enemy makes a successful Disarm, Escape, Grapple, Shove, or Trip attempt.

musical summons.name: Musical Summons
musical summons.text: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell. You cast summon animal and a one-action composition spell.

mutate weapon.name: Mutate Weapon
mutate weapon.text: Select one unarmed attack you gained with Living Weapon. The damage die for that attack increases by one step until the end of your turn. In addition, choose to either have the attack gain a reach of 10 feet until the end of your turn or for you to gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with the chosen unarmed attack u…

my kingdom, my blood.name: My Kingdom, My Blood
my kingdom, my blood.text: The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably. Stride. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

mystery conduit.name: Mystery Conduit
mystery conduit.text: The power of your mystery enables you access to myriad magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you do not expend a spell slot.

mystical flare.name: Mystical Flare
mystical flare.text: You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light. All creatures within your spellsurge aura become concealed, and all creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. However, you can ignore this concealment.

myth hunter.name: Myth Hunter
myth hunter.text: Your ancestors confronted and bested mythic beasts of Iblydan antiquity. Through a combination of hearing these tales and channeling a hint of those warriors' mythic power, you've developed a knack for bypassing a mythic creature's fabled defenses.
myth hunter.trigger: You successfully Recall Knowledge to identify a creature that has the mythic trait.

mythic allies.name: Mythic Allies
mythic allies.text: You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential. Spend a Mythic Point; the summoned creature gains a +2 status bonus to its attack rolls, a +2 status bonus to all of its defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equa…

mythic casting.name: Mythic Casting
mythic casting.text: You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent. Spend a Mythic Point; if the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, use mythic proficiency to determine your spell attack rolls and save DC for that spell.

mythic containment.name: Mythic Containment
mythic containment.text: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature. Spend a Mythic Point, and attempt a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check at mythic proficiency against the Will DC of a creature within 30 feet to trick, convince,…

mythic counterspell.name: Mythic Counterspell
mythic counterspell.text: You quench and counter your enemy’s magic with potent spellcraft amplified and enhanced by carefully deployed mythic power. Spend a Mythic Point, and expend a prepared spell or unexpended spell slot of the same rank as the triggering spell or higher. You lose your spell slot as if you’d cast the triggering spell.
mythic counterspell.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell, you’ve successfully Recognized the Spell, and you have either a prepared spell or an unexpended spell slot of equal or greater rank.

mythic heightening.name: Mythic Heightening
mythic heightening.text: You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect. Spend a Mythic Point. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, that spell is heightened to the highest spell rank that you can cast. Any spell attack roll is made with mythic proficiency, and the spell’s DC is calculated with mythic proficiency.

mythic refocus.name: Mythic Refocus
mythic refocus.text: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command. Spend a Mythic Point; you immediately recover all your Focus Points, filling your focus pool to its current maximum.

mythic strike.name: Mythic Strike
mythic strike.text: You infuse your weapon or unarmed attack with mythic power before lashing out at an enemy with devastating force. Spend a Mythic Point and then Strike a creature with a weapon you’re wielding or an unarmed attack you have available.

nanite shroud.name: Nanite Shroud
nanite shroud.text: Your nanites fly out of your body, swarming around you in a cloud. You become concealed for a number of rounds equal to half your level. You can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak, as normal for concealment that makes your position obvious.

nanite surge.name: Nanite Surge
nanite surge.text: You stimulate your nanites, forcing your body to temporarily increase its efficiency. You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check. In addition, your circuitry glows, lighting a 10-foot emanation with dim light for 1 round.
nanite surge.trigger: You attempt a skill check requiring three actions or fewer.

natural conduit.name: Natural Conduit
natural conduit.text: You can use an animal as a conduit for your magic. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, the spell uses the animal as its origin point.
natural conduit.requirements: You have line of effect to your animal companion or another friendly animal within 60 feet.

nature's embrace.name: Nature's Embrace
nature's embrace.text: You call on the world to hamper your foes. Plants grab at them, wind or water currents buffet them, the footing shifts under their feet. Your waking world becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until the start of your next turn.

needle in the god's eyes.name: Needle In The God's Eyes
needle in the god's eyes.text: With sinews of bronze and thews of iron, you leap to the heavens, piercing the arrogant eyes of the gods. Leap up to your total Speed, either horizontally or vertically, and Strike twice at any point or points during the Leap.

negate damage.name: Negate Damage
negate damage.text: Your armor innovation activates various devices you prepared ahead of time, and you use one of them to reduce the damage you would take by 15. Unstable Function You activate all the precautions at once, violently repelling the incoming attack to blunt its force.

never tire.name: Never Tire
never tire.text: As long as you have an audience, you can continue to perform even when you are on the brink of collapse. Indeed, you must— you have an obligation to your fans! You delay the effects of the fatigued condition for 1 minute or until you are no longer observed by at least three creatures who aren’t enemies, whichever comes…
never tire.trigger: You would gain the fatigued condition.
never tire.requirements: You are observed by at least three creatures who aren’t enemies.

night's warning.name: Night's Warning
night's warning.text: Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack. The triggering attack roll targets your Occultism DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn’t remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.
night's warning.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.
night's warning.requirements: You can see the night sky.

nightwave springing reload.name: Nightwave Springing Reload
nightwave springing reload.text: Training with the crew of the Nightwave has taught you their technique for reloading while leaping to board another ship. You Leap and then Interact to reload, or Interact to reload and then Leap.

nimble dodge.name: Nimble Dodge
nimble dodge.text: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
nimble dodge.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker

no cause for alarm.name: No Cause for Alarm
no cause for alarm.text: You attempt to reduce panic. Attempt a Diplomacy check, comparing it to the Will DC of creatures in a 10-foot emanation around you who are frightened. Each of them is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

outcomes.text: Reduce the creature's frightened value by 2.
Reduce the creature's frightened value by 1.

no escape.name: No Escape
no escape.text: You keep pace with a retreating foe. Stride up to your Speed, following the enemy and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you've moved your full Speed. You can use No Escape to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.
no escape.trigger: An enemy within reach attempts to move away from you.

no gods, only mortals!.name: No Gods, Only Mortals!
no gods, only mortals!.text: You order the caster to stop their spellcasting. Attempt an Intimidation check to counteract the triggering spell, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank.
no gods, only mortals!.trigger: You successfully Recognize a Spell with the divine trait

no need to fear.name: No Need to Fear
no need to fear.text: With a simple reminder of perseverance, you bolster the bravery of yourself and your allies. You attempt to counteract the triggering effect with a Warfare Lore check, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank.
no need to fear.trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet attempts a saving throw against a fear effect.

no! no! i created you!.name: No! No! I Created You!
no! no! i created you!.text: You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect. Attempt to counteract the effect that confused or controlled your construct companion, using your Crafting modifier for the counteract check and half your level rounded up for the counteract level.
no! no! i created you!.trigger: Your construct companion would become confused or controlled.

no!!!.name: No!!!
no!!!.text: The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth. If your psyche is currently unleashed, you can immediately use a psyche action that takes 1 action or less to use.
no!!!.trigger: A non-minion ally within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

noble bloom.name: Noble Bloom
noble bloom.text: Certain plants and flowers hold a reputation throughout Tian Xia for being strong and upstanding, able to weather adversity. In the moment your ally would succumb to their injuries, you stand tall and bloom proudly, radiating this strength for them.
noble bloom.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

noble sacrifice.name: Noble Sacrifice
noble sacrifice.text: As your knights devote their lives and swords to you, so too do you return their devotion with your own fierce protection. Spend a Mythic Point. The knight Steps as a free action, and you Stride into the space previously occupied by the knight; this movement ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
noble sacrifice.trigger: One of your designated knights is within 15 feet of you and would take damage from an enemy’s Strike.

nonlethal spell.name: Nonlethal Spell
nonlethal spell.text: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.

not so fast!.name: Not so Fast!
not so fast!.text: You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. The Strike gains the following additional results. Critical Success The target's movement is disrupted.
not so fast!.trigger: A creature within your reach leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

not this time.name: Not This Time
not this time.text: You reflexively attempt to cycle a creature’s timeline briefly to a reality where it’s less able to succeed. Spend a Mythic Point. The creature that targets you must then attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC at mythic proficiency, whichever is higher.
not this time.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 83

outcomes.text: The spell or ability affects you normally.

The creature’s attempt to target you is slightly hindered. If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC. If you need to attempt a saving throw, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save.
The creature’s attempt to target you is significantly hindered. If your AC is being targeted, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC, and a critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
The creature’s attempt to target you fails, and the actions it used to make the attempt are wasted.

not this time.trigger: A creature targets you with a single-target spell or ability that you defend against with a saving throw or your AC.

nothing personal.name: Nothing Personal
nothing personal.text: When you’re on a job, you can’t allow anyone to stop you. Designate a single creature you can see as being an impediment to your active course of action. The first time you Strike your impediment in a round, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.

now you see me.name: Now You See Me
now you see me.text: You flash through several possible timelines as you move. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn’t provoke reactions, and you are concealed until the end of your turn. All creatures are off-guard to you until the end of your turn.
now you see me.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

nudge the scales.name: Nudge the Scales
nudge the scales.text: You lay a finger on the scales of life and death to heal a creature, regardless of whether it's living or undead. You restore Hit Points equal to 2 + double your level to one creature within 30 feet. In addition, you can mediate during your daily preparations to place yourself on one side of the scales.

null field.name: Null Field
null field.text: You understand the frequency of energies that have damaged you and can extend the magical network of power in your internal nexus to diffuse incoming attacks. Choose one type of energy damage you have taken within the last minute. You gain resistance to that energy type equal to half your level for 1 minute.
null field.requirements: You are overflowing and have taken energy damage within the last minute.

ocean's balm.name: Ocean's Balm
ocean's balm.text: A blessing of the living sea salves wounds and douses flames. Touch a willing living creature. It regains 1d8 Hit Points and gains resistance 2 to fire for 1 minute. If it has persistent fire damage, it can attempt a flat check to remove it with especially appropriate help.

ocular flesh.name: Ocular Flesh
ocular flesh.text: You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble. You can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to look through any of your eyeballs until the start of your next turn. An eyeball can be manipulated like a marble, such as being rolled or thrown.

oil fire.name: Oil Fire
oil fire.text: Your armor includes flame-resistant gauntlets with oil-filled finger joints. These joints can split apart, dousing your opponent in flammable oil and then igniting it. The opponent must attempt a Reflex save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: The grab ends.
The grab ends, and the target takes 1 persistent fire damage.
The target takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level.
The target takes persistent fire damage equal to your level.

olethros's decree.name: Olethros's Decree
olethros's decree.text: You have a connection to olethroses, the enigmatic psychopomps who successfully swayed the yamaraj to permit the creation of the first duskwalkers. You place a finger on fate's scales by wrapping silk around your bow.

omnikinesis.name: Omnikinesis
omnikinesis.text: You can realign your kinetic gate with a thought. Replace one of your impulse feats using the same process as reflow elements. You can replace only one, even if you have double reflow.

on borrowed time.name: On Borrowed Time
on borrowed time.text: You accelerate a foe's personal timestream, which causes them to experience time at a faster rate, putting a terrible strain on their mind and body. A creature you target within 30 feet takes 3d6 persistent mental damage with a basic Will save.

on my best day.name: On My Best Day
on my best day.text: Be they in your current life or your previous one, you’ve had many heroic moments that continue to inspire you. Even past failures or humiliations can become a source of inspiration—or at least, an opportunity to make up for a past error on this new day.
on my best day.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

outcomes.text: You gain a +3 status bonus to AC and resistance to physical damage equal to your level until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain this effect for up to 1 minute.
As critical success, but the status bonus is +2 and the resistance is equal to half your level.
You gain a +1 status bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.
You gain a +1 status bonus to AC against the next attack made against you until the end of your next turn.

one for all.name: One For All
one for all.text: With precisely the right words of encouragement, you bolster an ally's efforts. Designate an ally within 30 feet; this action counts as sufficient preparation to Aid that ally. When you use the Aid reaction to help that ally, you can roll Diplomacy in place of the usual check and the action gains the bravado trait.

one with the spirits.name: One with the Spirits
one with the spirits.text: The spirits you’ve invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal. For 1 minute, you gain fast healing 5 and you become concealed.
one with the spirits.requirements: You’re under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

one-inch punch.name: One-inch Punch
one-inch punch.text: You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow. Make an unarmed Strike. If you spend two actions and this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. You can instead spend 3 actions to perform an even more powerful attack, dealing a second additional die of weapon damage on a hit.

one-on-one.name: One-on-One
one-on-one.text: Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent. You attempt to Feint and then Strike an adjacent creature with an Aldori dueling sword. The Feint attempt must be against the same target as your Strike.

one-toed hop.name: One-Toed Hop
one-toed hop.text: Assuming a peculiar stance, you make a short hop on each toe. You make a vertical Leap without triggering reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square.

oni form.name: Oni Form
oni form.text: Your horns flash briefly as you grow in size and ferocity. Your size increases to Large, and you’re clumsy 1. This doesn’t change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here.

oni rampage.name: Oni Rampage
oni rampage.text: Nothing invigorates you more than your own freshly spilled blood. You gain the effects of haste for 1 minute.
oni rampage.trigger: You're reduced to less than half your maximum Hit Points by a creature within your reach.

open the blazing eye.name: Open the Blazing Eye
open the blazing eye.text: Thanks to your diligence in the study of divine and occult mysteries, you can focus to temporarily attain a perception beyond the ordinary. A lightless flame appears in the center of your forehead. For 1 minute, you gain the benefits of a see the unseen spell.

opening stance.name: Opening Stance
opening stance.text: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought. Use a stance action.

opening stance (fighter).name: Opening Stance (Fighter)
opening stance (fighter).text: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought. Use an action that has the stance trait.

opportune backstab.name: Opportune Backstab
opportune backstab.text: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction. Make a Strike against the triggering creature.
opportune backstab.trigger: A creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies

opportune opening.name: Opportune Opening
opportune opening.text: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe. You make a melee Strike against the same creature your ally just hit. The creature is off-guard against this Strike.
opportune opening.trigger: An ally lands a critical hit on a creature within your melee reach.

opportune throw.name: Opportune Throw
opportune throw.text: You make a thrown ranged Strike with the required weapon against the triggering creature. If you critically succeed and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count against your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.
opportune throw.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74
opportune throw.trigger: A creature within 10 feet of you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.
opportune throw.requirements: You are Juggling a thrown weapon.

opportunistic grapple.name: Opportunistic Grapple
opportunistic grapple.text: You use an opening to capture your prey. You attempt an Athletics check to Grapple your prey.
opportunistic grapple.trigger: Your prey critically fails on an attack roll against you with a melee Strike.
opportunistic grapple.requirements: Your prey is within your reach, you have one free hand, and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

oppurtune trickster.name: Oppurtune Trickster
oppurtune trickster.text: You aren't above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack. Attempt a Deception check against the Perception DC of the creature that's the target of the triggering attack.

outcomes.text: The target is off-guard (including against the triggering attack) until the end of your ally's turn.
The target is off-guard against the triggering attack.
You lose your balance in your attempt to assist your ally and fall prone.

oppurtune trickster.trigger: An adjacent ally makes a melee Strike against a creature.
oppurtune trickster.requirements: You’re adjacent to both your ally and the creature.

oracular warning.name: Oracular Warning
oracular warning.text: You have a premonition about impending danger that you use to warn your allies. Each ally within 20 feet gains a +2 status bonus to their initiative roll and gains temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, which last for 1 minute.
oracular warning.trigger: You are about to roll for initiative.

orbiting runestone.name: Orbiting Runestone
orbiting runestone.text: You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object. The runestone has 10 Hit Points. Each time a creature successfully Strikes you, attempt a DC 11 flat check.

orc ferocity.name: Orc Ferocity
orc ferocity.text: Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1.
orc ferocity.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed

orc superstition.name: Orc Superstition
orc superstition.text: You defend yourself against magic by relying on techniques derived from orc cultural superstitions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw against the triggering spell or magical effect.
orc superstition.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, and have not yet rolled

orchard's endurance.name: Orchard's Endurance
orchard's endurance.text: Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies. You and your allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing damage. In addition, you and your affected allies roll flat checks to recover from persistent damage twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.

ostentatious arrival.name: Ostentatious Arrival
ostentatious arrival.text: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.

ostentatious reload.name: Ostentatious Reload
ostentatious reload.text: Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery. Make a Performance check against an easy DC for your level as you spin your guns around and juggle ammunition to reload them.

outcomes.text: You Interact to reload up to two firearms you are currently wielding.
You Interact to reload a single firearm you are currently wielding.
You drop one of the required firearms and a round of ammunition on the ground in your space.
You drop both firearms and two rounds on the ground in your space.

osteo armaments.name: Osteo Armaments
osteo armaments.text: If you have bones, you have a weapon. You create a +1 striking weapon in which you are proficient, made of bone and sinew. If this weapon requires ammunition, mundane bone ammunition is created when you reload it.

otherworldly prowl.name: Otherworldly Prowl
otherworldly prowl.text: You sink deeper into the shadows, drawing fey magic around yourself to stalk your prey unseen. You become invisible until you leave the source of your concealment or cover.
otherworldly prowl.requirements: You’re being concealed by, or gaining cover from, a natural source such as foliage or mist.

overburdening spell.name: Overburdening Spell
overburdening spell.text: You have learned how to weigh down your enemies’ life essence. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that targets a single creature, unless the target is unaffected by the spell, the target takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round (this penalty is doubled for climb, fly, and swim Speeds).

overclock senses.name: Overclock Senses
overclock senses.text: Your senses speed up to the point that time seems to stand still, allowing you to catch details and incoming attacks. You Seek. After you Seek, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against ranged attacks and to Reflex saving throws until the beginning of your next turn.

overdrive ally.name: Overdrive Ally
overdrive ally.text: You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly. Choose an ally within 30 feet. Until the end of their next turn, that ally's Strikes deal additional damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier, or your full Intelligence modifier if you were in critical overd…

oversized throw.name: Oversized Throw
oversized throw.text: With a great heave, you seize a piece of your surroundings, such as a boulder, log, table, wagon, or chunk of earth, and hurl it at your foes. The object must be your size or one size smaller than you, and it must not have too much Bulk for you to lift it in the first place.
oversized throw.requirements: You have one or more hands free.

overwhelming blow.name: Overwhelming Blow
overwhelming blow.text: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable. Make a melee Strike. This counts as three attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you get a critical hit.

overwhelming breath.name: Overwhelming Breath
overwhelming breath.text: You control your breathing and align it with your qi, exhaling with controlled force in order to overcome your opponent's resistance. If you use your next action to Cast a Spell that has the monk trait and no duration, the spell and any Strikes you make as a result of casting it ignore an amount of the target's resista…

overwhelming energy.name: Overwhelming Energy
overwhelming energy.text: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell ignores an amount the target's resistance to energy damage equal to your level.

overwhelming spellstrike.name: Overwhelming Spellstrike
overwhelming spellstrike.text: You pierce through your foe’s resistance. Make a Spellstrike. The spell you cast as part of the Spellstrike ignores an amount of the target’s resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to your level.

pack movement.name: Pack Movement
pack movement.text: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy. You and your animal companion both Stride. If both of you end your movement within reach of the same creature, you and your animal companion each make a melee Strike against the creature.

pack of the beast lord.name: Pack Of The Beast Lord
pack of the beast lord.text: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power. Spend a Mythic Point. Your united companion becomes Gargantuan for 1 minute.

pack performance.name: Pack Performance
pack performance.text: When you and animals sing together, your words ring even brighter and bolder, cutting through disruptions. The animal assisting you can Stride and Strike the triggering creature. If the attack succeeds, your action isn't counteracted or disrupted.
pack performance.trigger: A creature counteracts or disrupts the spell you're casting.
pack performance.requirements: You have an animal minion within 30 feet of you.

pack takedown.name: Pack Takedown
pack takedown.text: The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target. If you and both of your active companions threaten the same creature, each of you makes a melee Strike against it. The creature is off-guard against all of these attacks.

pain is temporary.name: Pain is Temporary
pain is temporary.text: Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation. Bolstered by this understanding, you’ve learned to temporarily steel yourself against all forms of pain.

painful spell.name: Painful Spell
painful spell.text: Your spells carry agonizing shadowy barbs. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, has no duration, and isn’t a cantrip, it deals an additional 1d4 nonlethal mental damage per spell rank.

paired shots.name: Paired Shots
paired shots.text: Your shots hit simultaneously. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two ranged weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If both attacks hit, combine their damage and then add any applicable effects from both weapons.
paired shots.requirements: You're wielding two weapons, each of which can be either a loaded one-handed firearm or loaded one-handed crossbow.

pandemonium eruption.name: Pandemonium Eruption
pandemonium eruption.text: You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity. Each creature within 15 feet of you takes 14d6 acid, electricity, or sonic damage, chosen randomly for each target.

paragon's guard.name: Paragon's Guard
paragon's guard.text: Once you’ve had a moment to set your stance, you always have your shield ready without a thought. While you are in this stance, you constantly have your shield raised as if you’d used the Raise a Shield action.

paralyzing jewel.name: Paralyzing Jewel
paralyzing jewel.text: Your dedication to the ideals of art and beauty allows your head gem to access the power of the waning moon. While you possess your head gem, you can overwhelm foes with a sense of reverent wonder. Enemies within a 15-foot emanation must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The enemy is unaffected.
The enemy is fascinated for 1 round.
The enemy is stunned 1.
The enemy is paralyzed for 1 round.

paralyzing slash.name: Paralyzing Slash
paralyzing slash.text: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds. Strike with your claw or jaws. If you hit a living non-elf creature, it becomes paralyzed unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

parting shot.name: Parting Shot
parting shot.text: You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise. You Step and then make a ranged Strike with the required weapon. Your target is off-guard against the attack.
parting shot.requirements: You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon or a ranged weapon with reload 0

pass through.name: Pass Through
pass through.text: Filtering your form through the substance of an object, you can pass through walls, doors, and more. You Fly up to your Speed. During this movement, you can try to move through one object. Attempt an Acrobatics check as you try to enter its space.

outcomes.text: You move through the object, treating the square within it as difficult terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, you can move out of it only if you Pass Through again or use some other means of moving through a solid object.
Your movement ends, and you trigger reactions as if you moved out of the square you started in.

pass vengeful judgement.name: Pass Vengeful Judgement
pass vengeful judgement.text: To prevent yourself from frivolously calling down the terrible power of divine wrath, you have vowed to do so only with the assent of your mortal hierophant. If your hierophant successfully Strikes a target, they can spend a single action to invoke your wrath.
pass vengeful judgement.requirements: Your hierophant invoked your judgment on their previous turn

path of iron.name: Path of Iron
path of iron.text: With a burst of effort and speed, you weave a nimble path through your many enemies, striking each in turn as you move past them. You Stride; this movement doesn’t trigger reactions. You can attempt a melee Strike up to three times at any point during your movement, each against a different enemy.

patronize the arts.name: Patronize the Arts
patronize the arts.text: A true aristocrat knows how to encourage their best hirelings, ensuring loyalty and future excellence. You praise the triggering ally, granting them one of the following benefits. The ally is then immune to this ability for 1 day.
patronize the arts.trigger: An ally within 30 feet of you critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check.

pattern flight.name: Pattern Flight
pattern flight.text: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it. Make a ranged Strike against a target within your weapon’s first range increment. Because of the erratic nature of its flight, this Strike ignores any circumstance bonus to AC from cover.

peafowl stance.name: Peafowl Stance
peafowl stance.text: You enter a tall and proud stance while remaining mobile, with all the grace and composure of a peafowl. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are melee Strikes with the required sword. Once per round, after you hit with a monk sword Strike, you can Step as a free action as your next action.
peafowl stance.requirements: You are wielding a sword that has the monk trait in one hand.

peafowl strut.name: Peafowl Strut
peafowl strut.text: You slowly move across the battlefield with dangerous grace. Step twice and then Strike. The Strike must be made with the sword required by Peafowl Stance.

penetrating fire.name: Penetrating Fire
penetrating fire.text: You blast a bullet through one foe and into another. Choose two targets, one of which would give the other lesser cover against your ranged attacks. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against both targets. This attack ignores any lesser cover the nearer target provides the other.
penetrating fire.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

penetrating projectile.name: Penetrating Projectile
penetrating projectile.text: Your projectiles are unhindered by flesh and bone. Make a ranged Strike with a ranged or thrown weapon that deals piercing damage against each creature in a 30-foot line (this uses only one projectile despite the number of Strikes). These Strikes ignore all cover granted by creatures.
penetrating projectile.requirements: You are wielding a ranged or thrown weapon that deals piercing damage

penetrating shot.name: Penetrating Shot
penetrating shot.text: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey. Choose a target that is giving lesser cover to your hunted prey. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against the chosen target and your hunted prey. This attack ignores any lesser cover the chosen target provides your hunted prey.
penetrating shot.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon

pennant of victory.name: Pennant of Victory
pennant of victory.text: You wave your banner in victory, signaling to your allies that the fight is won. You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner gain a +4 status bonus to attack and damage rolls, a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, and 40 temporary Hit Points.

peony's flourish.name: Peony's Flourish
peony's flourish.text: As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies. Stride twice and then attempt a Performance check against the Will DC of each creature you passed adjacent to.

outcomes.text: The creature is stunned 3 and dazzled for as long as they’re stunned.
The creature is stunned 1 and dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to further uses of Peony’s Flourish for 24 hours.

peony's flourish.requirements: You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

perfect clarity.name: Perfect Clarity
perfect clarity.text: You burn out all your rage to ensure that your attack lands and your mind remains free. Reroll the triggering attack roll or Will save with a +2 circumstance bonus, and use the better result. You then immediately stop raging.
perfect clarity.trigger: You fail or critically fail an attack roll or Will save.

perfect distraction.name: Perfect Distraction
perfect distraction.text: You use clever tactics to mislead your foes as you sneak away. You Sneak while leaving a decoy behind. The decoy acts as the spell mislead, though you aren’t invisible, just undetected. You can continue to concentrate to move your decoy, as with the spell, whether or not you remain hidden throughout the duration.

perfect dive.name: Perfect Dive
perfect dive.text: You dive into the water with exceptional skill and connection to the waves, urging the water itself to cushion your fall. You intentionally Leap or otherwise fall into the water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance.
perfect dive.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 394

perfect finisher.name: Perfect Finisher
perfect finisher.text: You focus your panache into an impeccable assault. Make a Strike, rolling the attack roll twice and using the better result.

perfect shot.name: Perfect Shot
perfect shot.text: After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against your hunted prey. If you hit, the Strike deals maximum damage. After the Strike, your turn ends.
perfect shot.requirements: You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon with reload 1 or more, and you have not reloaded your weapon since your last turn

perfume cloud.name: Perfume Cloud
perfume cloud.text: You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect, but all other creatures in a 10-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC (wh…

outcomes.text: No effect.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.
The creature is blinded for 1 round.

perplex.name: Perplex
perplex.text: You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within 30 feet that can hear you, and attempt a Diplomacy check against its Will DC. The creature is then immune to Perplex for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The target is stupefied 3 and confused for 1 round.
The target is stupefied 1 for 1 round.
The target is unaffected.

person of interest.name: Person of Interest
person of interest.text: Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation. Choose a creature that you can see who isn't, to your knowledge, tied to any of your current investigations. For the next minute, you can Devise a Stratagem against that creature as a free action.

pesh skin.name: Pesh Skin
pesh skin.text: Your plant form sprouts hundreds of spines, and your blood causes mild hallucinations in creatures exposed to it. Each time a creature touches you, hits you with an unarmed attack, or hits you with a melee weapon attack while adjacent to you, that creature takes 1d6 piercing damage.
pesh skin.source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 78
pesh skin.requirements: You are transformed into a plant by a polymorph spell.

petrifying gaze mimicry.name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry
petrifying gaze mimicry.text: Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with. You stare at a creature you can see within 30 feet. The creature attempts a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to your Petrifying Gaze Mimicry for 24 hours.
The creature is slowed 1 for 1 round.
The creature is slowed 1 for 1 round and immobilized
The creature is slowed 2 for 1 round and immobilized until it Escapes.

phalanx breaker.name: Phalanx Breaker
phalanx breaker.text: You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against a target within the weapon's first range increment.
phalanx breaker.requirements: You're wielding a two-handed firearm or a two-handed crossbow.

phantom charm.name: Phantom Charm
phantom charm.text: You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate. You negate the misfortune effect and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering check.
phantom charm.trigger: You attempt a check that would be subject to a misfortune effect.

phantom visage.name: Phantom Visage
phantom visage.text: You cloak yourself in illusions to mask your nature. Your Phantom Visage is a specific alternate form of a Small or Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), though it doesn’t need to have analogous physical features to your natural goblin form.

phase bullet.name: Phase Bullet
phase bullet.text: You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target. Attempt a crossbow or firearm Strike against a foe who’s observed or hidden to you (but not undetected).

phase out.name: Phase Out
phase out.text: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force, spirit, and vitality) equal to half your level. They’re not incorporeal, but can’t use Strikes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip.

pheromonal message.name: Pheromonal Message
pheromonal message.text: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus. You send a brief message to one ally within 60 feet, or 120 feet in water. No other creature can understand the message.

pierce the eye.name: Pierce The Eye
pierce the eye.text: You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe’s eye, blinding them in the process. Make a ranged Strike. On a hit, the target additionally takes 2d8 persistent bleed damage. The target must also attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC with the following effects.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is blinded until the end of its next turn.
The target is blinded for as long as they are taking the persistent bleed damage and for 1 additional round thereafter.

As failure, but the target also takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the flat check to remove the persistent bleed damage; a creature Administering First Aid to stop this persistent bleed damage takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the Medicine check.

pierce the eye.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon.

piercing doom.name: Piercing Doom
piercing doom.text: You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise. Make a melee Strike; on a success, the target takes an additional 1d10 void damage and your doomed value is reduced by 1.

piercing jab.name: Piercing Jab
piercing jab.text: Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike with their primary attack. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is grabbed by your eidolon until it successfully Escapes, your eidolon attacks with their primary attack again, or your eidolon is no longer mani…
piercing jab.requirements: Your eidolon’s primary attack deals piercing damage.

pin to the spot.name: Pin to the Spot
pin to the spot.text: You Strike a target within reach. If you hit and deal damage, the target is also restrained as if you had critically succeeded at an Athletics check to Grapple.

pinning fire.name: Pinning Fire
pinning fire.text: You target your opponent's clothing, equipment, or loose flesh with a series of piercing projectiles to pin them to the ground or a nearby surface. If both your attacks hit, the target must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or become immobilized until it or an adjacent creature succeeds at a DC 10 Athletic…
pinning fire.trigger: You use Flurry of Blows to make two ranged piercing weapon Strikes against the same target.

pirouette.name: Pirouette
pirouette.text: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you, you can immediately Step.
pirouette.trigger: An enemy targets you with a Strike.
pirouette.requirements: You're in Masquerade of Seasons Stance.

pistol twirl.name: Pistol Twirl
pistol twirl.text: Your quick gestures and flair for performance distract your opponent, leaving it vulnerable to your follow-up attacks. You Feint against an opponent within the required weapon’s first range increment, rather than an opponent within melee reach.
pistol twirl.requirements: You're wielding a loaded one-handed ranged weapon.

pistolero's challenge.name: Pistolero's Challenge
pistolero's challenge.text: With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel. Choose an opponent within 30 feet who you can perceive and can hear you, and make your choice of a Deception or Intimidation check against the target's Will DC.

outcomes.text: Both you and the opponent gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with Strikes made against each other. If you're a master in the skill you used for the check, the status bonus to damage rolls increases to +3, and if you're legendary, it increases to +4.
You become frightened 1 and can't use this ability again for 1 minute.

piston punch.name: Piston Punch
piston punch.text: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row. Make a single bludgeoning or piercing dynamo Strike and compare the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes.

pit of snakes.name: Pit of Snakes
pit of snakes.text: Mundane serpents obey your summons. You call forth a writhing mass of snakes, raising your hands to cause the snakes to emerge from the ground in a 20-foot burst within 120 feet. The snakes appear on all squares of the ground in the area and remain for 1 minute.

pivot strike.name: Pivot Strike
pivot strike.text: You Leap and then Strike using your staff. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage for the Strike equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. Regardless of whether your Strike hit, you can then attempt to Shove or Trip the target.
pivot strike.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

planar sidestep.name: Planar Sidestep
planar sidestep.text: You shift your body briefly between planes, reducing the damage from your foe's attack. You gain resistance 25 to all damage against the triggering attack. Observers simply see you shimmer with elemental energy for a moment, just as the attack lands.
planar sidestep.trigger: A creature hits you with a melee Strike.

planar traveler.name: Planar Traveler
planar traveler.text: You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period. Your Strides become augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location.

plane hop.name: Plane Hop
plane hop.text: The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways. You instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed.

plane step.name: Plane Step
plane step.text: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn. You remain clearly visible while stepping outside of a plane in this way and you can’t use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

plane-stepping dash.name: Plane-Stepping Dash
plane-stepping dash.text: You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey. Stride once; this Stride does not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement. Once this Stride is complete, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed until the start of your next turn.

plant banner.name: Plant Banner
plant banner.text: You plant your banner to inspire your allies to hold the line. Plant your banner in a corner of your square. Each ally within a 30-foot burst centered on your banner immediately gains 4 temporary Hit Points, plus an additional 4 temporary Hit Points at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

plant evidence.name: Plant Evidence
plant evidence.text: You can put a single item you’re holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC. If you have the ruffian racket, you can do this as a free action when you successfully Shove a target.

plate in treasure.name: Plate in Treasure
plate in treasure.text: Precious metal flows from your fingers to plate an object. This has the effects of a clad in metal spell with a rank equal to half your level rounded up. While you're wearing or holding an item of light Bulk or greater that's Plated in Treasure, any metal created by one of your impulses is plated with the metal.

play dead.name: Play Dead
play dead.text: You lie prone and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton. As long as you don't move or take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, another creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge (typically using Religion o…

play to the crowd.name: Play to the Crowd
play to the crowd.text: You show off for the crowd. Attempt a Performance check; the DC is determined by the GM but is typically the standard DC for your level or the DC to Make an Impression on the spectators, whichever is higher.
play to the crowd.trigger: You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points during a combat encounter with spectators.

pluck from the sky.name: Pluck From the Sky
pluck from the sky.text: The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them. Make a Strike against a flying creature. If the attack deals damage, the target must attempt a Reflex save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: No effect.
The target falls 15 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.
The target falls 30 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.
As failure, but the target takes falling damage.

plum deluge.name: Plum Deluge
plum deluge.text: You have learned to saturate an area with poison in imitation of the techniques of your rival, Blue Viper. As part of this ability, you Interact to draw three vials of the same contact poison and throw them in the air, where they shatter and spread a poisonous deluge affecting a 20-foot burst within 60 feet.
plum deluge.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 76
plum deluge.requirements: You have at least three of the same contact poison.

point blank stance.name: Point Blank Stance
point blank stance.text: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly. When using a ranged volley weapon while you are in this stance, you don’t take the penalty to your attack rolls from the volley trait.
point blank stance.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon

poison drinker.name: Poison Drinker
poison drinker.text: You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest. You regain Hit Points equal to the level of the poison (or double the spell’s rank if the poison was caused by a spell), and you gain as much nourishment as one square meal.
poison drinker.trigger: You critically succeed on a Fortitude save against a poison effect.

poison weapon.name: Poison Weapon
poison weapon.text: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action. This poison can be one of the simple injury poisons you can create due to this feat (see Special), or another contact or injury poison you’ve acquired (such as those in…

poisoner's twist.name: Poisoner's Twist
poisoner's twist.text: Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves. You know how to take advantage of such weaknesses. You deal 1d6 damage of the required Strike's damage type and 1d6 poison damage to the target.
poisoner's twist.requirements: Your last action was a successful melee Strike that dealt damage against a target afflicted by a poison, and you know which poison.

polished distraction.name: Polished Distraction
polished distraction.text: You take pride in the sheen of your armor, and how useful it is at distracting your enemies when you reflect light from it. Creatures within a 5-foot emanation that can see you must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC. Once a creature attempts a save against this effect, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for
The creature is blinded for 2 rounds and dazzled for 1 minute.

polished distraction.requirements: You aren't in dim light or darkness.

pollinate.name: Pollinate
pollinate.text: As you’re hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight. You become concealed until the beginning of your next turn. Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
pollinate.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

polymorphic escape.name: Polymorphic Escape
polymorphic escape.text: You polymorph into a tiny vermin, a cloud of leaves, or another shape that allows you to escape. Attempt a DC 16 flat check; on a success, you ignore the triggering effect and can Step. You then return to your humanoid shape.
polymorphic escape.trigger: You would become grabbed, immobilized, prone, or restrained.

ponpoko-pon!.name: Ponpoko-pon!
ponpoko-pon!.text: Whether it’s because you play especially vigorously or are simply off-key, the music of your belly drum can physically wound your foes. You deal 7d4 sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a basic Fortitude save equal to your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher.

portentous spell.name: Portentous Spell
portentous spell.text: Your spellcasting is rife with strange lights, mild fumes, and other captivating effects that befuddle your foes. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, any creature that attempts to use a reaction triggered by your Cast a Spell activity takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and skill checks rolled as…

portents of the haruspex.name: Portents of the Haruspex
portents of the haruspex.text: Although the divinations of a haruspex traditionally require organs and lengthy interpretation, you've learned how to glimpse the future in a more simple fashion by reading creatures' wounds. The glimpse of the future gives guidance on what tools are best to use next.
portents of the haruspex.trigger: A creature within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points in a way that doesn't destroy their body.

positioning assault.name: Positioning Assault
positioning assault.text: With punishing blows, you force your opponent into position. Make a Strike with the required weapon. If you hit, you Reposition the target 5 feet.
positioning assault.requirements: You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon and your target is within your reach

pounce mimicry.name: Pounce Mimicry
pounce mimicry.text: You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable. You Stride and then Strike. If you began this action hidden, you remain hidden until after the Strike.
pounce mimicry.requirements: You’re unarmored or wearing light armor

pouncing transformation.name: Pouncing Transformation
pouncing transformation.text: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles. You Change Shape or Dismiss the change then Stride. Any creature adjacent to you at the end of your movement is off-guard until the end of your turn and is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

pounding leap.name: Pounding Leap
pounding leap.text: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air. Strike with your fist unarmed attack and then attempt a High Jump or Long Jump; you count as having a running start and do not need to Stride before this activity to avoid failure.

power slide.name: Power Slide
power slide.text: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear. You Drive with a –2 penalty to your piloting check, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Power Slide.

powerful lash.name: Powerful Lash
powerful lash.text: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs. The damage die of your lash increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4 and it gains the sweep trait.

practiced opposition.name: Practiced Opposition
practiced opposition.text: You've battled more undead than you care to remember, often with little time to prepare between foes, forcing you to rely on experience and muscle memory to guide your blade. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about an undead you can see and then Strike that undead.

prayer attack.name: Prayer Attack
prayer attack.text: You've mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis. Attempt to Feint an enemy within 30 feet. If your Feint is successful, when you use Prayer Attack on subsequent turns you automatically make the target flat-footed against your melee attacks for that turn without rolling a check to Feint, so long as y…
prayer attack.requirements: You are wielding a sawtooth saber in each hand.

prayer-touched weapon.name: Prayer-Touched Weapon
prayer-touched weapon.text: You coat a weapon you're wielding in prayers and the divine power given to you by your deity. Until the end of your turn, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 positive damage. As usual for positive damage, this damage harms only undead and creatures with negative healing.
prayer-touched weapon.requirements: Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip divine spell.

precious ammunition.name: Precious Ammunition
precious ammunition.text: You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material. You enchant a piece of ammunition on your person with the magical essence of a precious material, allowing you to leverage certain creatures' weaknesses.

predator's growl.name: Predator's Growl
predator's growl.text: You give a throaty growl to attempt to Demoralize a creature you just found. You don't take the –4 penalty for not sharing a language with the creature.
predator's growl.trigger: You successfully Seek a hidden or undetected creature.

predator's pounce.name: Predator's Pounce
predator's pounce.text: You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react. You Stride up to your Speed and make a Strike at the end of your movement.
predator's pounce.requirements: You are unarmored or wearing light armor.

predictable!.name: Predictable!
predictable!.text: By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it. Choose one target and attempt a Perception check to Sense Motive against the foe’s Deception DC or a hard DC of the foe’s level, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: You precisely discern the target's strategy, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn and a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.
You deduce the gist of the target's strategy; as critical success, except the circumstance bonus is only +1.
You fail to discern the target's strategy and gain no benefit.

You misinterpret the target's strategy and take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn, and a –1 circumstance penalty to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.

preemptive reconfiguration.name: Preemptive Reconfiguration
preemptive reconfiguration.text: Your body anticipates the blow. The impact area briefly reorganizes into a strengthened tissue lattice that blunts the attack. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage type, which applies against the triggering damage.
preemptive reconfiguration.trigger: You would take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

premonition of avoidance.name: Premonition of Avoidance
premonition of avoidance.text: Your deity grants you a moment’s foresight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw.
premonition of avoidance.trigger: You are about to roll a saving throw against a hazard

premonition of clarity.name: Premonition of Clarity
premonition of clarity.text: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks. Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus. You must use the second result, even if it’s worse.
premonition of clarity.trigger: You fail a saving throw against a mental effect

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.text: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities. You gain one additional reaction, which you can use before the beginning of your next turn for any rogue reaction.

prescience.name: Prescience
prescience.text: Mythic power floods through your mind, filling you with visions of possible futures, events that might or might not happen, and warnings of things that might be. Spend a Mythic Point and roll your initiative check using mythic proficiency.

prescient parry.name: Prescient Parry
prescient parry.text: Spend a Mythic Point. Your warshard weapon intervenes at the last second, rising to deflect the incoming blow. For this attack, calculate your AC at mythic proficiency, then add any item bonus from your weapon to that value.
prescient parry.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87
prescient parry.trigger: You are targeted by a melee or ranged Strike with a weapon.
prescient parry.requirements: You are wielding your warshard weapon.

preserve the horde.name: Preserve the Horde
preserve the horde.text: The act of summoning additional undead minions doesn't make you lose the focus required to maintain the animation of your horde. You Sustain your horde.

preserve the moment.name: Preserve the Moment
preserve the moment.text: Sometimes, your actions are so successful and impressive that it’s worth going back to them. Note the actions you took during the turn that just ended (excepting the reaction you used to trigger Preserve the Moment), including the die roll results (not the actual check results).
preserve the moment.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

pressure change.name: Pressure Change
pressure change.text: You sink or rise rapidly alongside your target, altering their internal pressure. You Swim up to your swim Speed either up or down, and the required creature moves with you and must attempt a Fortitude save. For this movement, swimming up or down isn’t difficult terrain.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected
The target is sickened 1.
The target is sickened 2.

pressure change.requirements: You have a swim Speed, are underwater, and have a creature grabbed or restrained.

preternatural parry.name: Preternatural Parry
preternatural parry.text: You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the triggering effect until the start of your next turn.
preternatural parry.trigger: You’re targeted by a Strike or a spell attack, or you’re about to roll a saving throw against a spell effect.
preternatural parry.requirements: You have one or more hands free.

prevailing position.name: Prevailing Position
prevailing position.text: Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself. You leave the stance you were in, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your AC against the triggering attack.
prevailing position.trigger: You are targeted by an attack or attempt a Reflex saving throw against a damaging effect, and you are in a stance.

pride in arms.name: Pride in Arms
pride in arms.text: With a shout of triumph, you grant inspiration to an ally fight on. The triggering ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier until the end of their next turn.
pride in arms.trigger: An ally within 30 feet brings an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

primadonna.name: Primadonna
primadonna.text: The spotlight should always be on you and you alone. Attempt a Performance check against the Will DCs of all enemies within 30 feet who can see or hear you. On a success, the targets focus on you and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to hit you, but they’re off-guard to all creatures other than yourself.

profane bargain.name: Profane Bargain
profane bargain.text: You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature. That creature promises to never take hostile actions against you, to never lie to you, to never speak of this bargain, and to either perform, or refrain from performing, one other specified task, such as paying you a specified sum every year, gifting yo…

project persona.name: Project Persona
project persona.text: Where others etch their armor to serve as a conduit for their imaginations, your vivid mind and bold personality allow you to project a more fitting persona over your lackluster armor. You change the shape and appearance of your armor to appear as ordinary or fine clothes of your imagining.

promise of pain.name: Promise of Pain
promise of pain.text: You call out to an enemy in distress, promising them a future of unending pain. Choose an enemy with the sickened condition that you can see within 120 feet. That creature takes 10d4 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

prompt pratfall.name: Prompt Pratfall
prompt pratfall.text: You play a prank on a larger creature as you pass by, causing it to topple over. You Stride or Fly (if you have a fly Speed). Once at any point during this movement, you can Trip a creature up to three sizes larger than you (or four, if you’re legendary in Performance), and you can use your Performance modifier rather…

propelled leap.name: Propelled Leap
propelled leap.text: Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air. Swim toward the surface at up to twice your swim Speed, then attempt a DC 30 Athletics check to propel yourself out of the water. If you do not swim at least 10 feet, you automatically fail.

outcomes.text: You Leap up to 15 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.
You Leap up to 10 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.
You Leap up to 5 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.
You're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

propulsive leap.name: Propulsive Leap
