sacrifice armor.text: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack. Reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to twice your armor's level. Your armor becomes broken, reducing its Hit Points to its Broken Threshold. If your armor was already damaged, it is destroyed instead.
sacrifice armor.trigger: You are hit by a Strike that deals physical damage.

safeguard spell.name: Safeguard Spell
safeguard spell.text: You are inured to the effects of your own spells. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell with an area, you aren't affected by the spell even if you are within the area.

sailfish strike.name: Sailfish Strike
sailfish strike.text: You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack. At the top of your Propelled Leap, you can make a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction instead of choosing to Grab an Edge. Your Strike gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. After your attack, hit or miss, you fall back into the water.
sailfish strike.trigger: You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.

sanctify armament.name: Sanctify Armament
sanctify armament.text: You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity. For 1 round, that weapon gains your holy or unholy trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait. For example, if you are holy, the weapon would deal an extra 2d6 spirit damage to unholy creatures.

sanctify water.name: Sanctify Water
sanctify water.text: You imbue water with your deity's blessing. Choose a container of water with light Bulk possessed by you or an ally within your reach. Until the end of your next turn, it becomes holy water or unholy water.

sand snatcher.name: Sand Snatcher
sand snatcher.text: A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. You can choose to make it Small or Medium size, and it can flank. When the sand snatcher appears, you can have it attempt to Grapple one creature adjacent to it that's no more than one size larger than it.

sanguine evasion.name: Sanguine Evasion
sanguine evasion.text: You avoid death by turning into a spray of red mist. You remain at 1 Hit Point and transform into a vaporous state with the effects of vapor form, except your fly Speed is equal to your land Speed and you can occupy the same space as another creature. Creatures in the same space as you in this form are concealed.
sanguine evasion.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 Hit Points and are not already wounded.

sanguine transference.name: Sanguine Transference
sanguine transference.text: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall. You learn the sanguine transference grave spell.

sanguivolent roots.name: Sanguivolent Roots
sanguivolent roots.text: Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet. Each living enemy in the area has its blood drained, taking 3d6 piercing damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.

saoc astrology.name: Saoc Astrology
saoc astrology.text: The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy. You recall the stars’ predictions about your current situation. If your next action requires you to attempt one or more skill checks, roll 1d8.
saoc astrology.requirements: You must spend 10 minutes just after your daily preparations examining the sky or consulting a star chart or you can’t use this action that day.

sapping symbol.name: Sapping Symbol
sapping symbol.text: Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker’s strength to weakness. Attempt a Religion check against the triggering creature’s Will DC. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

outcomes.text: The creature is enfeebled 2 until it spends at least 1 action moving away from you.
As critical success, but enfeebled 1.

sapping symbol.trigger: While you have your symbol raised, you are about to take damage from a melee attack

saving slash.name: Saving Slash
saving slash.text: You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack. Attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, the attack becomes a normal hit, instead of a critical hit.
saving slash.trigger: An opponent critically hits you with a melee attack.

savor the hunt.name: Savor The Hunt
savor the hunt.text: Watching horror take hold of your victims is a delicious sustenance to you. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level rounded up, which last until the start of your next turn.
savor the hunt.trigger: You cause a creature you can see to become frightened.

sawtooth grapple.name: Sawtooth Grapple
sawtooth grapple.text: Your sawtooth saber training enables you to pin down an enemy using your twin blades. Make a Strike with each weapon against the same creature. If you deal sneak attack damage, you can immediately attempt to Grapple the creature, even if you don’t have a hand free.
sawtooth grapple.requirements: You’re wielding two weapons, at least one of which is a sawtooth saber.

say that again!.name: Say that Again!
say that again!.text: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that opponent.
say that again!.trigger: An opponent gets a critical failure when attempting to Demoralize you or Lie to you.

scamper.name: Scamper
scamper.text: You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. You must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.
scamper.requirements: You are adjacent to at least one enemy.

scampering sabotage.name: Scampering Sabotage
scampering sabotage.text: When someone big and stomp-y comes up to you, it’s in your best interests to be somewhere else and find a way to hurt them back. You Stride and must end this movement in a space that isn’t adjacent to any enemy.
scampering sabotage.requirements: You’re adjacent to at least one enemy.

scapegoat parallel self.name: Scapegoat Parallel Self
scapegoat parallel self.text: Seeing Syndara superimpose creatures with similar metaphysical properties, you've realized a way to manipulate the effects of your oracular curse. You immediately change your curse to its minor, moderate, or major stage, or back to its mild form, exchanging the curse effect with that of a parallel version of yourself i…
scapegoat parallel self.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 76
scapegoat parallel self.trigger: Your turn starts or your oracular curse would advance.

scare to death.name: Scare to Death
scare to death.text: You can frighten foes so much, they might die. Attempt an Intimidation check against the Will DC of a living creature within 30 feet of you that you sense or observe and who can sense or observe you. If the target can't hear you or doesn't understand the language you are speaking, you take a –4 circumstance penalty.

outcomes.text: The target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Intimidation DC. On a critical failure, it dies. On any other result, it becomes frightened 2 and is fleeing for 1 round. The critical failure effect has the death trait.
The target becomes frightened 2.
The target becomes frightened 1.
The target is unaffected.

scars of steel.name: Scars of Steel
scars of steel.text: When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage. You gain resistance to the triggering attack equal to your Constitution modifier plus half your level.
scars of steel.trigger: An opponent critically hits you with an attack that deals physical damage.

scatter blast.name: Scatter Blast
scatter blast.text: You pack your weapon with additional shot and powder, creating a risky but devastating wave of destruction. Make a ranged Strike with the firearm. The firearm's range increment increases by 20 feet and the radius of its scatter increases by 20 feet. The Strike gains the following failure conditions.

outcomes.text: The firearm misfires, but it doesn't cause the other critical failure effects listed below.

The firearm misfires and also explodes. It becomes broken, and it deals its normal weapon damage to all creatures in a 20-foot burst centered on the firearm, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. This damage includes any from the weapon's fundamental and property runes.

scatter blast.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm that has the scatter trait.

scatter swarm.name: Scatter Swarm
scatter swarm.text: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats. A swarm that shares a space with your familiar takes damage equal to the swarm's weakness to area damage.

scattering charge.name: Scattering Charge
scattering charge.text: You charge into a group of enemies to send them flying. Stride up to your Speed. At the end of your movement, you can Shove up to three creatures within your reach. You don't need a hand free to do so.
scattering charge.requirements: You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

scattering in spring.name: Scattering in Spring
scattering in spring.text: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy’s tactics in your favor. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you, you can immediately attempt a Feint or Shove against the triggering attacker; if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
scattering in spring.trigger: An enemy within your reach targets you with a melee attack, and you're aware of the attack.

scattering shout.name: Scattering Shout
scattering shout.text: With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you. Each enemy within a 10-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.
The creature is pushed 10 feet away from you and takes 8d6 sonic damage.
The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you and takes 16d6 sonic damage.

scholar's hunch.name: Scholar's Hunch
scholar's hunch.text: Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.
scholar's hunch.trigger: You fail a Lore or Occultism skill check.

scintillating spell.name: Scintillating Spell
scintillating spell.text: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that doesn’t have the darkness trait, has no duration, and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex save, the spell explodes in a spray of scintillating lights, in addition to its other effects.

scorching column.name: Scorching Column
scorching column.text: With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat. The cylinder is 10 feet in diameter and 30 feet high, and the bottom must be within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

scorching disarm.name: Scorching Disarm
scorching disarm.text: You make a weapon unbearable to hold. Attempt an Athletics check to Disarm a target creature. You don't need to have a hand free to make this Disarm attempt. If the Disarm attempt succeeds, the target takes 4d6 fire damage unless it drops the weapon, and on a critical success, it takes 4d6 fire damage and drops the wea…

scoundrel's surprise.name: Scoundrel's Surprise
scoundrel's surprise.text: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target. After you Impersonate someone else using a disguise kit, you can remove your disguise with a dramatic gesture.

scour the library.name: Scour the Library
scour the library.text: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan. Make a check to Recall Knowledge (using an appropriate skill) about one creature within 60 feet.

scouring rage.name: Scouring Rage
scouring rage.text: You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger. Each enemy within 20 feet takes damage equal to your level (basic Fortitude save against your class DC) of the same type as your additional damage during that Rage.

scout's charge.name: Scout's Charge
scout's charge.text: You meander around unpredictably, and then ambush your opponents without warning. Choose one enemy. Stride, Feint against that opponent, and then make a Strike against it.

scout's pounce.name: Scout's Pounce
scout's pounce.text: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes. Stride up to your Speed, then Strike twice. If you were hidden or unnoticed by the target of these Strikes, the target is off-guard against both attacks. Your multiple attack penalty applies normally for both attacks.
scout's pounce.requirements: You are hidden from or undetected by all of your opponents, and you aren't within 10 feet of any enemy.

scout's warning.name: Scout's Warning
scout's warning.text: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you're using the Scout exploration activity. Depending on whether you use gestures or call out, this action gains either the visual or the auditory trait, respectively.
scout's warning.trigger: You are about to roll a Perception or Survival check for initiative

scrap barricade.name: Scrap Barricade
scrap barricade.text: Ragged pieces of metal weld together into a ramshackle structure. The barricade is up to 30 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1/2 inch thick. It must form within 120 feet in a straight line in an unbroken open space that doesn't pass through any creatures or objects, or the impulse fails.

sculpt shadows.name: Sculpt Shadows
sculpt shadows.text: You coax nearby shadows into the shape of a simple weapon or a simple tool or item, using a tiny piece of your shadow to make it solid; in doing so, you lose 1 Hit Point.

scurry! (awakened animal).name: Scurry! (Awakened Animal)
scurry! (awakened animal).text: Your instincts to move to safety are strong. You Stride; you must end your movement in a location where you have cover from at least one enemy you can see, and you can't take this action if it's impossible for you to do so. You can Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

scurry! (gremlin).name: Scurry! (Gremlin)
scurry! (gremlin).text: Gremlins have a deep, instinctual drive to run and hide whenever someone shows up. A bit like cockroaches, really. You Stride; you must end your movement in a location where you have cover from at least one enemy you can see, and you can't take this action if it's impossible for you to do so.

sea glass guardians.name: Sea Glass Guardians
sea glass guardians.text: Eerily beautiful elemental water beings race around you, eager to protect and heal you and your allies. Their forms vary and might include eels formed of undulating water or ice crystals whirling in the shape of a jellyfish. The guardians flow around combatants and don't occupy a space.

seal of the golden dragon.name: Seal of the Golden Dragon
seal of the golden dragon.text: Your familiar coils around you, protecting you with its magical resistance. You gain the benefits of your familiar’s resistance ability until the start of your next turn. If your familiar has any upgrades to this ability, such as major resistance, you gain them as well.
seal of the golden dragon.trigger: You would take acid, cold, electricity, poison, fire, or sonic damage.
seal of the golden dragon.requirements: Your familiar has the resistance ability and is adjacent to you.

searing restoration.name: Searing Restoration
searing restoration.text: They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools… Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs.

seasoned command.name: Seasoned Command
seasoned command.text: Allies intuitively follow your orders. Choose an ally within 30 feet and then attempt a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against a hard DC for that ally’s level. This counts as a preparatory action to Aid that ally.

outcomes.text: You immediately gain an additional reaction that can be used only to Aid the chosen ally, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check or attack roll to Aid.
As critical success, but you don’t gain the circumstance bonus.
You don’t gain an additional reaction.

second shield.name: Second Shield
second shield.text: You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself. You Interact to draw a shield on your person or an unattended shield within your reach.
second shield.trigger: Your Shield Block causes your shield to break or be destroyed.

second sight.name: Second Sight
second sight.text: You peer into the next several seconds to watch the potential timelines around a nearby creature unfold. Spend a Mythic Point, then make a check to Recall Knowledge at mythic proficiency about a creature you can see. This check gains the following additional effects.
second sight.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

outcomes.text: You learn all the actions the creature will take on its next turn (or in the first round of combat if combat hasn’t begun), such as “Stride toward Seelah” or “Cast shield.” These actions are locked in and the creature must attempt them, even if the situation changes, though it need not perform the actions in the order…
You gain one additional piece of information about the creature, as if you had critically succeeded at the Recall Knowledge check.

second sting.name: Second Sting
second sting.text: You read your prey’s movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other. Make a melee Strike with one of the required weapons against your hunted prey. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

outcomes.text: You deal the damage the other required weapon would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, not just weapon damage dice.)

second sting.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

second thoughts.name: Second Thoughts
second thoughts.text: When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else. You can Cast the triggering Spell a second time, targeting a different creature, without expanding an additional spell slot.
second thoughts.trigger: You cast a mental spell that targets one creature, and it critically succeeds at its Will save

secondary detonation array.name: Secondary Detonation Array
secondary detonation array.text: You divert some of your spell’s energy into an unstable runic array. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, has no duration, and affects an area, a glowing magic circle appears in a 5-foot burst within that area.

see you in hell.name: See You in Hell
see you in hell.text: You aren’t sure if you’ll be reincarnated again, so you might as well take this foe with you. A blast of spiritual energy lashes out from the depths of your soul, targeting the creature who attacked you.
see you in hell.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 Hit Points by a creature but not immediately killed.

seize.name: Seize
seize.text: You seize your foe and pull it close. The foe you hit is grabbed as if you succeeded at an Athletics check to Grapple the foe.
seize.requirements: Your last action was a successful fist Strike against a creature no more than one size larger than you.

seize advantage.name: Seize Advantage
seize advantage.text: You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself. You Step or Stride up to your Speed.
seize advantage.trigger: Your student critically succeeds at a Strike or spell attack roll.

seize an advantage.name: Seize an Advantage
seize an advantage.text: You take any momentary advantage you can when fighting dirty. You make a ranged Strike or Interact to Reload; doing so does not trigger any reactions from the required foe.
seize an advantage.requirements: Your last action this turn was to attempt a Dirty Trick against a foe.

self-destruct.name: Self-Destruct
self-destruct.text: You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away. When you activate the device, your reanimated construct companion explodes, dealing 2d6 fire damage per level to all creatures in a 30-foot radius.
self-destruct.trigger: Your reanimated clockwork companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
self-destruct.requirements: You're within 60 feet of your reanimated clockwork companion.

semblance of life.name: Semblance of Life
semblance of life.text: You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life. This has the effects of illusory disguise, except you can appear only as yourself while you were a living humanoid.
semblance of life.trigger: You deal damage to a living creature with your fist Strike or with Desiccating Inhalation.

seneschal spell.name: Seneschal Spell
seneschal spell.text: You can channel even complex spells through your connection to your charge. If your next action is to Cast a Spell and your charge is within 30 feet, you can have the spell originate from your charge instead.

sense alignment.name: Sense Alignment
sense alignment.text: You read the body language of an intelligent creature within 30 feet and pick up on subtle cues to detect its general propensity for good or evil and law or chaos. The GM rolls a secret Perception check, comparing the result against the target's Deception DC.
sense alignment.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

outcomes.text: You ascertain the target's alignment.
You ascertain the target's alignment, but only along one axis (your choice of either the good-evil axis or the lawful-chaotic axis).
You do not learn the target's alignment.
You incorrectly ascertain the target's alignment, misidentifying their alignment along either one axis or both (GM's choice).

sense iniquity.name: Sense Iniquity
sense iniquity.text: Your Hellknight training gives you the ability to focus your senses and root out those who would attempt to deceive or hide from you. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to Create a Diversion, Feint you, or Lie to you.

sense the strike.name: Sense the Strike
sense the strike.text: You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge. The triggering attack targets your Survival DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn’t remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.
sense the strike.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

sense the unseen.name: Sense the Unseen
sense the unseen.text: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin. Even though you failed at the triggering check, you automatically sense any undetected creatures in the area where you’re Seeking, making them merely hidden to you.
sense the unseen.trigger: You fail a check to Seek

sepulchral sublimation.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
sepulchral sublimation.text: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice. Instantly destroy one undead minion within 60 feet that is permanently under your control. If your next action is to cast a necromancy spell from a spell slot, you don't expend the slot.
sepulchral sublimation.requirements: You have at least one undead minion that you permanently control.

serpentcoil slam.name: Serpentcoil Slam
serpentcoil slam.text: Your people's ancient and storied rivalry with garudas led you to develop special techniques against flying foes. Make a melee Strike against a flying creature up to one size larger than you; if you hit, you use your neck or coils to smash the creature into the ground.

set-up strike.name: Set-up Strike
set-up strike.text: Your attack makes it difficult for your enemy to defend themselves against your allies' attacks. Attempt a Strike against an enemy. If the Strike is successful, the target is off guard against the next attack that one of your allies attempts against it before the start of your next turn.

sever magic.name: Sever Magic
sever magic.text: You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell. Make a Strike against an enemy. If you hit and deal damage, you attempt to counteract a single spell active on the target (your choice).

sever space.name: Sever Space
sever space.text: You destroy the space between you and your targets, allowing you to strike with your melee weapons at great range. Make a melee Strike with the required weapon or unarmed attack. The attack gains an 80-foot reach for this Strike.
sever space.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 77
sever space.requirements: You are wielding a weapon that deals slashing damage or have an unarmed Strike that deals slashing damage.

shadow blending.name: Shadow Blending
shadow blending.text: You draw shadows close to create a shroud. Increase the DC of the flat check by 2.
shadow blending.trigger: A creature attempts a flat check to target you while you’re concealed or hidden due to dim light or darkness.

shadow sight.name: Shadow Sight
shadow sight.text: You draw on your connection with the Netherworld to see through all but the deepest darkness. You gain greater darkvision for 1 minute.

shadow spell.name: Shadow Spell
shadow spell.text: You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell that has the shadow trait, choose one creature affected by the spell. This creature either gains a +2 status bonus to Stealth or takes a –2 status penalty to Perception (your choice).

shadow tempo.name: Shadow Tempo
shadow tempo.text: As your ally moves past you, you match your movements to their rhythm, following them across the battlefield. You Stride up to your Speed but must follow the same path that the triggering ally takes.
shadow tempo.trigger: An ally within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action they're using.

shadowpiercing charge.name: Shadowpiercing Charge
shadowpiercing charge.text: You charge into the fray on horseback, and those that lurk in the shadows will feel your wrath. You Command an Animal to have your mount Stride up to double its Speed. You can make a melee Strike at up to two enemies that are within your reach at any point during your mount's movement.
shadowpiercing charge.requirements: You're riding your horse and wielding a melee weapon.

shadowplay.name: Shadowplay
shadowplay.text: As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy. You attempt to Tumble Through the opponent’s space, with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. If you succeed, your shadow rises up from the ground, flanking your opponent until the beginning of your next turn.
shadowplay.requirements: Your last action was a melee Strike that damaged your opponent.

shadows within shadows.name: Shadows Within Shadows
shadows within shadows.text: Your apparition possesses a furtive and elusive nature that can influence and blend with your spiritual energy to form a protective and nearly impenetrable shroud of nondetection around you. The enemy must reroll the triggering check and take the lower result.
shadows within shadows.trigger: You would be detected by an enemy Seeking you, or an enemy would succeed at a counteract check against a spell making you hidden, concealed, or undetected.
shadows within shadows.requirements: Your attuned apparition grants Hunting Lore or Underworld Lore as one of its apparition skills.

shake it off.name: Shake It Off
shake it off.text: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save to recover from the sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), b…

shake off the gods.name: Shake Off the Gods
shake off the gods.text: Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god. You can attempt a new saving throw against the required effect with a +2 status bonus to the save. You can't get a worse result than your original saving throw.
shake off the gods.requirements: You're under an effect with the divine trait that required a saving throw.

shamble.name: Shamble
shamble.text: You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering. Stride twice, or three times if you spent 3 actions to Shamble. During this movement, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain. You can choose to ignore all circumstance and status penalties to your Speed when you Shamble.

shame the sin.name: Shame the Sin
shame the sin.text: Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them. In addition to doing the normal damage for your critical hit, the demon also suffers the effects of its special vulnerability.
shame the sin.source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80
shame the sin.trigger: You critically hit a demon with a Strike.

shard strike.name: Shard Strike
shard strike.text: Jagged metal shards form in the air and lash out from you. You choose shards or spines, which changes the area, damage type, and critical failure effect. Each creature in the area attempts a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

share burden.name: Share Burden
share burden.text: You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state. Instead of affecting your ally, the triggering curse or misfortune effect affects you.
share burden.trigger: An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but are an eligible target for the effect.

share rage.name: Share Rage
share rage.text: You stoke an ally's fury. While you are raging, one willing creature within 30 feet gains the effects of the Rage action, except it can still use concentrate actions. It doesn't get any added benefits from your instinct, feats, or the like.
share rage.requirements: You haven’t used this ability since you last Raged.

share tincture.name: Share Tincture
share tincture.text: You use Quick Tincture, and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn. Then you can Interact to pass the item to another creature. If you pass it by throwing it, your ranged attack automatically succeeds. You must have a versatile vial to use Quick Tincture, as normal.

share weakness.name: Share Weakness
share weakness.text: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you.
share weakness.requirements: You are Exploiting a creature's Vulnerability using mortal weakness.

shared focus.name: Shared Focus
shared focus.text: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point. Choose a willing ally within 30 feet who also has a focus pool. The target gains 1 temporary Focus Point until the start of your next turn, at which time it’s lost, even if not spent.

shared sight.name: Shared Sight
shared sight.text: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip spell that affects one or more of your allies, all affected allies gain your spiritsense for 1 minute.

shared tide.name: Shared Tide
shared tide.text: You Swim up to twice the normal distance. Any ally you pass within 30 feet of during that movement gains your swim Speed until the beginning of your next turn.

shark attack.name: Shark Attack
shark attack.text: Your swimming skills enable you to lunge through the water in a sudden attack. You Swim twice. At any point during this movement, you Strike.

sharpened senses.name: Sharpened Senses
sharpened senses.text: Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously. You Seek. If you use one of your senses from Natural Senses, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

shatter defenses.name: Shatter Defenses
shatter defenses.text: Your offense exploits your enemy’s fear. Make a melee Strike against a frightened creature. If you hit and deal damage, the target becomes off-guard until its frightened condition ends.
shatter defenses.requirements: A frightened creature is in your melee reach

shattering shot.name: Shattering Shot
shattering shot.text: You fling a bomb into the air and then shoot it with your gun before it falls, raining destruction down over a wide area. If necessary, you Interact to draw the bomb and regrip your weapon. You throw your bomb to the corner of a square within your firearm's first range increment and shoot it with your firearm.
shattering shot.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm or loaded crossbow and are wearing or holding an alchemical bomb.

shattering spellstrike.name: Shattering Spellstrike
shattering spellstrike.text: You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage. Make a Spellstrike against a target with your improvised weapon. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 2d6 force damage as your improvised weapon breaks.
shattering spellstrike.requirements: You’re in Arcane Cascade stance and wielding an improvised weapon.

shattering strike (monk).name: Shattering Strike (Monk)
shattering strike (monk).text: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike. Make an unarmed Strike. It bypasses the target's resistances. If the target has Hardness, the Strike treats the Hardness as if it were half its value.

shattering strike (weapon improviser).name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)
shattering strike (weapon improviser).text: The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel. This extra damage you apply on the critical hit doesn't double from the critical hit, as normal.
shattering strike (weapon improviser).trigger: An improvised weapon you are wielding becomes broken as a result of a critical success on an Improvised Pummel.

shattershields.name: Shattershields
shattershields.text: Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. When any creature with this bonus would take damage from a physical attack, one of the plates reduces the damage by its Hardness of 5.

shed tail.name: Shed Tail
shed tail.text: You can shed a portion of your tail to escape. You cease being grabbed, then Stride without triggering any reactions from the creature that grabbed you. It takes 1 day for your tail to fully grow back. Until it does, you can't use your tail unarmed attack, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to Balance.
shed tail.requirements: You have a fully grown tail.

sheltering hand.name: Sheltering Hand
sheltering hand.text: Animals, plants, and the earth itself rush to protect you from harm, interposing themselves between you and danger. You and your allies in your waking world gain cover from enemies you are aware of until the start of your next turn. The cover is based on the number of actions you spend.

sheltering pulse.name: Sheltering Pulse
sheltering pulse.text: You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies. Choose an unoccupied square within 15 feet. The nexus appears in a 15-foot emanation around that square and lasts for 3 rounds.

sheltering wing.name: Sheltering Wing
sheltering wing.text: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn. If you have Dragon’s Flight, this bonus increases to +2 as your large wings provide greater protection.

shield block.name: Shield Block
shield block.text: You snap your shield in place to ward off a blow. Your shield prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to the shield’s Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.
shield block.trigger: While you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) from an attack.

shield from arrows.name: Shield from Arrows
shield from arrows.text: You place your shield in the path of an oncoming projectile. Your adjacent ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you have deflected it with your shield.
shield from arrows.trigger: An adjacent ally is the target of a physical ranged Strike.
shield from arrows.requirements: You can see the attacker, you are not off-guard, and you have Raised your Shield.

shield of reckoning.name: Shield of Reckoning
shield of reckoning.text: When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further. You use the Shield Block reaction to prevent damage to an ally and also use your champion's reaction against the enemy that attacked your ally.
shield of reckoning.trigger: An enemy’s attack against an ally matches the trigger for both your Shield Block reaction and your champion’s reaction.

shield spell reinforcement.name: Shield Spell Reinforcement
shield spell reinforcement.text: You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield. If your next action is to cast the shield cantrip, you use your shield as a locus to cast the spell, raising a magical barrier in the form of a large force projection of your worn shield.

shield the faithful.name: Shield the Faithful
shield the faithful.text: You and those closest to you are protected by your deity’s power. For 1 minute, you and all allies within 10 feet of you gain a +1 item bonus to AC and resistance 10 to spirit damage.

shield wall.name: Shield Wall
shield wall.text: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade. Both you and the triggering creature have standard cover as long as you remain adjacent to each other and you both have your shields raised; when this is no longer the case, the effect ends.
shield wall.trigger: Your shield is raised and an adjacent ally Raises a Shield.

shield wallop.name: Shield Wallop
shield wallop.text: Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes. Make a shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is stupefied 1 until the start of your next turn (stupefied 2 on a critical hit).

shielded attrition.name: Shielded Attrition
shielded attrition.text: You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving. Raise your Shield, then choose whether to Stride up to half your Speed. This movement triggers enemies' reactions as normal.

shielding taunt.name: Shielding Taunt
shielding taunt.text: By banging loudly on your shield, you get the attention of even the most stubborn of foes. Raise a Shield, and then Taunt a creature. Your Taunt gains the auditory trait.

shift horde.name: Shift Horde
shift horde.text: With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place. You Sustain your horde, dispersing the current group of undead and replacing them with a different type of undead to which you have access.

shift spell.name: Shift Spell
shift spell.text: You move the spell's area to a new location within 120 feet. The spell's remaining duration is reduced by half. The spell no longer affects its previous area.
shift spell.requirements: You have an active spell that affects an area and you are within the spell's range.

shift the little ones.name: Shift the Little Ones
shift the little ones.text: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends. You have learned to move in such a way that it gives others the chance to make room for you. Stride up to your Speed.

shifting terrain.name: Shifting Terrain
shifting terrain.text: You slam your fist into the ground or twirl your arms about to cause the terrain around you to shift and ripple, potentially throwing others off balance. Each creature within your area of difficult terrain from Rough Terrain Stance must attempt a Reflex saving throw against your spell DC with the following effects.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is clumsy 1 for 1 round.
The creature is clumsy 2 for 1 round.
The creature is clumsy 2 for 1 round and falls prone.

shifting terrain.requirements: Your terrain attunement matches the terrain you're in and you're in Rough Terrain Stance.

shining glory.name: Shining Glory
shining glory.text: With a righteous word, your divine aura inspires your allies to great heroics and causes foes to tremble. Spend 1 Mythic Point. All allies in the bright light of your nimbus gain a +3 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks, and the status bonus they receive to saving throws against fear increases to +3.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is frightened 1, but can immediately Step as long it moves away from you.
The creature is frightened 2 and you are concealed to that creature while it has the frightened condition.
The creature is frightened 3 and you are hidden to that creature while it has the frightened condition.

shooting stars stance.name: Shooting Stars Stance
shooting stars stance.text: You enter a stance that lets you throw shuriken with lightning speed. While in this stance, you can use your monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with shuriken instead.

shore gift.name: Shore Gift
shore gift.text: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger. You're still recognizably yourself, as the Shore Gift doesn't change your upper body.

shoulder catastrophe.name: Shoulder Catastrophe
shoulder catastrophe.text: You’ve trained to protect your allies by diverting the worst attacks to yourself. The enemy doesn’t double the damage from the triggering Strike but instead applies the normal damage to both you and your ally.
shoulder catastrophe.trigger: An enemy critically succeeds at a Strike against an adjacent ally.

shoulder check.name: Shoulder Check
shoulder check.text: You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance. Make a fist Strike even if you don't have a hand free; if you're wielding a gauntlet or spiked gauntlet, you can make a Strike with one of those weapons instead. The Strike gains the following additional results.

shove down.name: Shove Down
shove down.text: You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move. You attempt to Trip the target, even if the target is no longer in your reach.
shove down.requirements: Your last action was a successful Shove

shoving sweep.name: Shoving Sweep
shoving sweep.text: You swing your weapon at your foe, rebuffing them back. You attempt to Shove the triggering creature, ignoring the requirement that you have a hand free. Unless you critically succeed at your check, the creature continues its movement after the Shove.
shoving sweep.trigger: An enemy within your reach leaves a square during a move action it’s using.
shoving sweep.requirements: You’re wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

show-off.name: Show-Off
show-off.text: As is the tradition with many Firebrands, you call your shot and look to impress with an extra bit of panache or a greater stunt. Attempt the triggering check again, using the second result.
show-off.trigger: You succeed at an Acrobatics or Athletics check deemed suitably challenging and meaningful by the GM.

shrink down.name: Shrink Down
shrink down.text: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces. Your eidolon reduces to a smaller size of your choosing, to a minimum of size Small. They can Dismiss this action to return to their normal size. Their reach becomes 5 feet, or 10 feet if shrinking to Large with Towering Size.

sickening pollen.name: Sickening Pollen
sickening pollen.text: Your wound emits a cloud of disorienting pollen. The triggering creature must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be sickened 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure).
sickening pollen.trigger: A creature critically hits you with a melee Strike.

sidestep.name: Sidestep
sidestep.text: You deftly step aside and gently redirect an attack. You redirect the triggering attack to a creature of your choice that is adjacent to you and within the attack's reach or maximum range. The attacker rerolls the Strike’s attack roll against the new target.
sidestep.trigger: The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails or critically fails

siege celerity.name: Siege Celerity
siege celerity.text: You push yourself and your light mortar beyond your limits. You are quickened for this turn. You can use the extra action to Load or Launch your light mortar. This doesn't allow you to bypass the normal limit of one Launch per round.

silence the profane (avenger).name: Silence the Profane (Avenger)
silence the profane (avenger).text: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have mastered and adapted. Make a Strike with your deity's favored weapon against the triggering creature. On a success, the target is off-guard until the end of your next turn.
silence the profane (avenger).trigger: A creature you can observe within reach of your deity’s favored weapon casts a spell.
silence the profane (avenger).requirements: You are wielding your deity’s favored weapon

silence the profane (vindicator).name: Silence the Profane (Vindicator)
silence the profane (vindicator).text: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have mastered and adapted. Make a Strike with your deity’s favored weapon against the triggering creature. On a success, the target is off-guard until the end of your next turn.
silence the profane (vindicator).trigger: A creature you can observe within reach of your deity’s favored weapon casts a spell.
silence the profane (vindicator).requirements: You are wielding your deity’s favored weapon.

silencing strike.name: Silencing Strike
silencing strike.text: A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. If it hits, the enemy must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.

The target is dazed and can barely vocalize. It's stunned 1 and its speech is raspy and hard to understand. It must succeed at a DC 11 flat check to use linguistic actions or Cast a Spell, unless the spell has the subtle trait.
As failure, but the creature is stunned 3 instead of stunned 1.

silent step.name: Silent Step
silent step.text: You Step, then Hide or Sneak. You still need to meet the requirements to Hide or Sneak, as normal.

silent sting.name: Silent Sting
silent sting.text: You quickly hide your weapon to make it difficult to pin the attack on you. You attempt to Conceal an Object to hide the triggering weapon. Your Stealth check is compared to the Perception DC of all creatures within 30 feet that can see you. You automatically succeed against creatures farther than 30 feet.
silent sting.trigger: You make a Strike with a weapon of light bulk.

silk bracelet.name: Silk Bracelet
silk bracelet.text: Taking inspiration from Desna’s image as a giant silk moth in Tian Xia, you’ve attached a bracelet to your innovation that generates ultra-strong silk strands mixed with venom. You can unleash this substance as part of an attack. Make a melee Strike.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The silk imposes a –10 foot status penalty to all the target’s Speeds for 1 round.
As success, and the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent poison damage. The poison damage increases to 2d4 at 12th level and 3d4 at 18th level.
As failure, and the target is immobilized until the end of their next turn.

silo crop.name: Silo Crop
silo crop.text: You draw a little attention to yourself to take the pressure off of another. You Create a Diversion, and the benefits of a successful check apply to up to two members of your crop instead of you.

simple mastery.name: Simple Mastery
simple mastery.text: Other casters’ never-ending hunger for new magic prevents them from truly understanding just how far simple magic can be pushed when truly mastered. If your next action is to Cast a spell you prepared from your keepsake, you Cast the Spell as though it is 1 rank higher, up to the highest rank spell you can cast.

simultaneous strike.name: Simultaneous Strike
simultaneous strike.text: Moving in unison, you and your student unleash an attack against a foe. Strike a creature, and your student can use their reaction to make a Strike against the same creature. If both attacks are successful, total the damage for the two attacks for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

sinbladed spell.name: Sinbladed Spell
sinbladed spell.text: You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic. If the next spell you cast is a non-cantrip sin or curriculum spell that affects a single target, and you either succeed on your attack roll or the target fails its saving throw against the spell, a wound in the shap…

sing to the steel.name: Sing to the Steel
sing to the steel.text: You strike magical tones that can turn the tide of combat. You and your allies within 30 feet gain the effects of one of the following runes until the end of your next turn: corrosive, disrupting, flaming, frost, ghost touch, shock, or thundering.
sing to the steel.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

siphon life.name: Siphon Life
siphon life.text: Experiences with necromantic energy have left a permanent mark on you, casting you in a deathlike pallor, chilling your body temperature to be ice-cold, turning your very blood black, and giving you the power to rip out an enemy's life force. Strike with an unarmed attack.

outcomes.text: The target takes no additional void damage and becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.
The target takes half the additional void damage.
The target takes full additional void damage.
The target takes double the additional void damage.

siphon magic.name: Siphon Magic
siphon magic.text: You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe’s blood. You regain one expended spell slot that must be of a lower rank than the highest rank spell you can cast. You become drained 1 or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.
siphon magic.requirements: Your last action was to Harvest the Blood of a creature that can cast spells

siphon power.name: Siphon Power
siphon power.text: You draw upon the reservoir of your patron’s magic that resides within your familiar. During your turn, you can cast one spell your familiar knows that was granted by your patron or lessons without spending a spell slot to do so (or even having it prepared).
siphon power.requirements: You haven’t acted yet on your turn

siren song.name: Siren Song
siren song.text: You can beguile and bewitch with your song. All creatures in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Will save against your Performance DC. On subsequent rounds, you can Sustain the song, causing each creature in the area currently affected by your song to attempt another Will save.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected and becomes immune to your Siren Song for 24 hours.
The target is fascinated with you until the end of your next turn.
As success, and the target is stupefied 1 for as long as it's fascinated.
As success, and the target is stupefied 2 for as long as it's fascinated.

six pillars stance.name: Six Pillars Stance
six pillars stance.text: You stand firm, steeling your mind and body, allowing you to use your magic unperturbed. While in this stance, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by using actions with the concentrate or manipulate traits.
six pillars stance.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover pg. 223

skeletal extension.name: Skeletal Extension
skeletal extension.text: You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths. If the next action you take is to cast a grave spell that destroys a thrall, pieces of the thrall fuse with you to extend the length of your limbs.

skeptic's defense.name: Skeptic's Defense
skeptic's defense.text: You don't believe in any mental twaddle, and you're certainly not afraid of it. You scoff and verbally refute the triggering effect, attempting a counteract check using your Intimidation modifier with a counteract rank of half your level rounded up.
skeptic's defense.trigger: You are targeted by or are in the area of a mental spell or effect.

skim scroll.name: Skim Scroll
skim scroll.text: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt. You Interact to draw a scroll, then use Trick Magic Item on the scroll.

skin split.name: Skin Split
skin split.text: You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin. You immediately end all persistent damage from effects that coat your skin (such as fire and most persistent acid damage).

skirmish strike.name: Skirmish Strike
skirmish strike.text: Your feet and weapon move in tandem. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

sky and heaven stance.name: Sky and Heaven Stance
sky and heaven stance.text: You enter a stance perfected by past champions of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven, allowing you to make jagged strikes like flashes of lightning through the sky. The only Strikes you can make are skyward slash unarmed attacks.

skyseeker.name: Skyseeker
skyseeker.text: You Leap toward an opponent. At any point in the Leap, you can make a single Strike against a creature within your reach. At 12th level, if you hit with this Strike, instead of finishing your Leap, you can immediately attempt a second Leap from the space where you struck the target of your Strike.
skyseeker.requirements: You are in Sky and Heaven Stance.

slam down.name: Slam Down
slam down.text: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them. Make a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to Trip the creature you hit.

slay.name: Slay
slay.text: You finish your target with a vicious attack. Make a Strike against the target. If you hit, the target takes 4d6 extra precision damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. If the target critically fails, they die. This is an incapacitation effect.
slay.requirements: Your target is doomed 2 or greater.

slayer's strike.name: Slayer's Strike
slayer's strike.text: You've dedicated yourself to studying ancient techniques and memorized minor prayers against undead to swiftly dispatch them. Make a Strike against a creature you know is undead. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

sleek reposition.name: Sleek Reposition
sleek reposition.text: While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a finesse weapon or polearm.

outcomes.text: The target becomes off-guard until the end of your current turn.

sleek reposition.requirements: You are wielding a finesse weapon or polearm

sleeper hold.name: Sleeper Hold
sleeper hold.text: You pinch crucial points of your target's nervous system, impeding its ability to function. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the creature, with the following success and critical success effects instead of the usual effects.

outcomes.text: The target falls unconscious for 1 minute, though it remains standing and doesn't drop what it holds.
The target is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

sleeper hold.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

slice and swipe.name: Slice and Swipe
slice and swipe.text: You attempt a melee Strike with the required weapon. If you hit and deal damage and the result of your attack roll exceeds the target's Perception DC, you Steal a small object from the target (as if you had succeeded at that task using the Thievery skill).
slice and swipe.requirements: You're wielding a melee weapon that deals slashing damage and you have a free hand.

slingshot maneuver.name: Slingshot Maneuver
slingshot maneuver.text: You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement. You move the ally 15 feet into a square of their choice that is within reach of your lash. If the ally has movement remaining, they can continue their movement after completing the Slingshot Maneuver.
slingshot maneuver.trigger: A willing ally enters a space within your lash’s reach using a move action.

slip the grasp.name: Slip the Grasp
slip the grasp.text: You have some feature that allows you to quickly evade effects that restrain you. Attempt a check to Escape. If you succeed, you can Stride, Step, or make a Strike with a melee unarmed attack targeting the creature you Escaped from. If you fail, you instead attempt to Escape a second time.
slip the grasp.requirements: You are grabbed, immobilized, or restrained.

slowing strike.name: Slowing Strike
slowing strike.text: You wound your enemy so they can’t move nimbly. The target must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the beginning of your next turn.
As success, but the penalty lasts for 1 minute.

slowing strike.trigger: Your Strike hits an off-guard creature and deals damage.

slurp up.name: Slurp Up
slurp up.text: Your tongue darts out in search of refreshment. Choose a liquid container of up to light Bulk within reach of your lash, such as a potion or elixir. The container must be held or in the open, not stowed in a pack or bandoleer.

smite.name: Smite
smite.text: You single out one enemy to destroy in your deity's name. Designate one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that enemy gain a +3 status bonus to damage, increasing to +4 if you have master proficiency with the weapon or unarmed attack you're using for the Strike.

smoke curtain.name: Smoke Curtain
smoke curtain.text: You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke. You make a Strike with your firearm and create a cloud of smoke in a 20-foot emanation centered on your location.
smoke curtain.requirements: You're wielding a loaded firearm and are wearing or holding a dose of black powder.

smooth hover.name: Smooth Hover
smooth hover.text: You remain airborne through sheer effort. You don't fall, even if you didn't use Fly or a similar action this turn.
smooth hover.trigger: You’re airborne at the end of your turn.

smoothing stomp.name: Smoothing Stomp
smoothing stomp.text: You stomp and unleash a wave of the magic of creation in a 30-foot emanation that transforms non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain into normal terrain. This terrain transformation remains in place for 1 minute, after which the terrain returns to its original state.

snagging strike.name: Snagging Strike
snagging strike.text: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach. Make a Strike while keeping one hand free. If this Strike hits, the target is off-guard until the start of your next turn or until it’s no longer within the reach of your hand, whichever comes first.
snagging strike.requirements: You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand

snakebird's shadow.name: Snakebird's Shadow
snakebird's shadow.text: Ganhil developed this technique through observing the sharp-beaked darters fishing Prada Hanam’s waters, seeking to match their speed and suppleness with the elemental flash of his blade.
snakebird's shadow.requirements: You are in Waterfowl Stance and are wielding a monk weapon from the sword group.

snap falling fruit.name: Snap Falling Fruit
snap falling fruit.text: Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you knock it out of the air.
snap falling fruit.trigger: You or an ally within reach of your lash is the target of a physical ranged attack.

snap out of it!.name: Snap Out of It!
snap out of it!.text: You give a quick shout, hoping to shake the fog clouding your ally’s thoughts. Choose one target ally in your marshal’s aura who is affected by a mental effect that allowed a Will save and has a duration of no longer than 1 minute.

snap out of it! (pathfinder agent).name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
snap out of it! (pathfinder agent).text: Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses. Attempt a Medicine check on an adjacent ally who is fascinated, frightened, stunned, or stupefied and choose one of those conditions. The DC is the DC for the effect that caused the condition.

outcomes.text: Reduce the value of the chosen condition by 2. If you chose fascinated, that condition ends.
Reduce the value of the chosen condition by 1. If you chose fascinated, that condition ends.
The target is unaffected.
You increase the value of the chosen condition by 1. If you chose fascinated, increase the duration by 1 round instead.

snare commando.name: Snare Commando
snare commando.text: Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight. If you have expert proficiency in Deception, you can Create a Diversion against the triggering creature. If you have expert proficiency in Intimidation, you can instead Demoralize the triggering creature.
snare commando.trigger: A creature fails or critically fails a save against your snare.

sniper's aim.name: Sniper's Aim
sniper's aim.text: You take an extra moment to carefully sync your aim and breathing, then fire a shot with great accuracy. Make a ranged weapon Strike. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this Strike's attack roll and ignore the target's concealment.

snowdrift spell.name: Snowdrift Spell
snowdrift spell.text: The howling wind and precipitation of your magic turn to thick snow. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the air, water, or cold trait, and that does not have the fire trait, select one creature affected by the spell on the ground.

soaring flight.name: Soaring Flight
soaring flight.text: You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

solar detonation.name: Solar Detonation
solar detonation.text: Blinding flames explode in a swirling sphere! The detonation fills a 20-foot burst within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes 6d6 fire damage, plus 2d6 vitality damage if it has void healing, and can become dazzled or blinded depending on the result of its Reflex save.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage and is dazzled until the start of your next turn.
The creature takes full damage and is blinded until the start of your next turn.
The creature takes double damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

solidarity.name: Solidarity
solidarity.text: You bestow some of your own life energies to mend damage. You touch a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less, and you restore Hit Points to the target equal to twice your level. You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

song of glorious invocation.name: Song of Glorious Invocation
song of glorious invocation.text: You weave the true names of several runes you’ve drawn into a beautiful song, invoking them all simultaneously. Choose up to three rune-bearers within 30 feet and Invoke one Rune on each of them.

song of grace and speed.name: Song of Grace and Speed
song of grace and speed.text: You instill great swiftness into your allies. You and all allies within 30 feet become quickened for 1 minute and can use the additional action to Strike, Stride, or Step.
song of grace and speed.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

sonic dash.name: Sonic Dash
sonic dash.text: You bounce up and down once, then sprint forward. You Stride twice in a straight line. You can use Sonic Dash while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

sonic strafe.name: Sonic Strafe
sonic strafe.text: You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air. Fly twice. Any creature that is adjacent to you at any point during your movement takes 10d6 sonic damage (basic Fortitude save against your class DC). On a critical failure, the creature is also deafened for 1 hour.
sonic strafe.requirements: You currently have a fly Speed.

soothing song.name: Soothing Song
soothing song.text: You perform a song that applies a balm to the soul, soothing listeners and preparing them to keep moving. The fatigued condition is suppressed for you and all allies within a 30-foot emanation until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the aura up to 1 minute.

soul flare.name: Soul Flare
soul flare.text: You strive to change the outcome with sheer zeal. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll if making an attack or to your AC if you were hit. This can change the outcome of the roll. If this bonus turns your missed attack into a hit or the hit against you into a miss, attempt a DC 5 flat check.
soul flare.trigger: An attack you made with a soulforged weapon misses a creature, or a creature hits you with an attack while you’re either wearing manifested soulforged armor or have your soulforged shield raised.

soul oubliette.name: Soul Oubliette
soul oubliette.text: Your mortal strike wrenches the soul from your victim’s body and imprisons it in your splinter of finality, with the effects of seize soul. The splinter of finality can only hold one soul at a time, but you can release a trapped soul as a free action.
soul oubliette.trigger: You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with an attack from your spectral dagger.
soul oubliette.requirements: Your splinter of finality's doesn’t contain a trapped soul.

soul thief.name: Soul Thief
soul thief.text: You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute. Attempt an Occultism check against the hard DC of the target’s level. On a success, you capture its soul and solidify it into a gem that keeps the soul contained.

soul well.name: Soul Well
soul well.text: Your brush your fingers across your splinter of finality, momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape. For the next minute, incorporeal undead treat all squares within 30 feet of you as difficult terrain and living creatures within the same area die from the dying condition a…

sovereign's blade.name: Sovereign's Blade
sovereign's blade.text: As you raise your weapon into the air, it begins to shed a bright light that pierces darkness and calls your knights to your side. Spend a Mythic Point; you automatically counteract any magical darkness whose counteract rank is 7 or lower.

sow spell.name: Sow Spell
sow spell.text: You fold your spell into a seed. If your next action is to Cast a Spell using 1 action or 2 actions, the spell instead plants itself in an adjacent square. You must make all decisions regarding the spell at the time you cast it.

space-time shift.name: Space-Time Shift
space-time shift.text: You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination. Your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Stride instead of traversing normally to the location.

spark fist.name: Spark Fist
spark fist.text: You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent. The resulting pops of flame harm both you and your enemy. Until the end of your next turn, your fist loses the nonlethal trait and deals an additional 1 fire damage on a successful Strike.

spark of independence.name: Spark of Independence
spark of independence.text: You touch a creature with the minion trait and share the heightened sense of autonomy you've discovered. The minion is quickened for 1 round and is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. It can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

spear dancer.name: Spear Dancer
spear dancer.text: You favor weapons that allow you to lash out viciously while keeping enemies at bay, giving you an opportunity to strike without fear of reprisal. You Step and then Strike with a spear or polearm you are wielding, or Strike with the spear or polearm and then Step.
spear dancer.requirements: You are wielding a weapon from the spear or polearm group

spear of doom.name: Spear of Doom
spear of doom.text: The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend. You enter the spear of doom stance.
spear of doom.requirements: An enemy hit you with an attack dealing the same damage type as your cursed weakness within the last round, and you are doomed 1 or greater.

spectral dagger.name: Spectral Dagger
spectral dagger.text: By touching the splinter of finality in your neck, you conjure a spectral dagger into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt. This weapon acts like a +1 ghost touch dagger, and each successful Strike with it deals 1 additional spirit damage.
spectral dagger.requirements: You have a hand free and aren’t already wielding a spectral dagger.

spell crash.name: Spell Crash
spell crash.text: Instead of blending a spell into an attack, you can funnel the spell’s magic into a pure blast that expands out from you. You smash your weapon or fist into the ground and expend a spell prepared in one of your spell slots.

spell network.name: Spell Network
spell network.text: Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands. While you’re in this stance, an ally within your spellsurge aura can treat any other ally within the aura as the point of origin for a spell they cast, calculating range and cover from the other creature’s space instead of their own.

spell parry.name: Spell Parry
spell parry.text: You infuse magical power into your body or armaments to parry both physical and magical assaults. You raise your guard, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn, as long as you continue to meet the requirements.
spell parry.requirements: You have one or more hands free.

spell protection array.name: Spell Protection Array
spell protection array.text: You inscribe a circle of arcane runes that dampen enemies’ magic. You create a glowing magic circle in a 5-foot burst within 30 feet. Creatures in the circle gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic.

spell relay.name: Spell Relay
spell relay.text: You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range. Your ally can use you as the point of origin for their spell, calculating range and cover from your space instead of their own.
spell relay.trigger: An ally Casts a Spell and you are within that spell’s range.

spell retaliation.name: Spell Retaliation
spell retaliation.text: Battling other spellcasters is one of your major focuses, and harnessing magic from spells you defend against gives you everything you need to fight back. You recharge your Spellstrike.
spell retaliation.trigger: You succeed at a saving throw against an enemy’s spell, or an enemy fails a spell attack roll against you.

spell shroud.name: Spell Shroud
spell shroud.text: Your spell shrouds you in a billowing cloud. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that targets you, you surround yourself in a 15-foot emanation of dense magical mist that lasts until the start of your next turn.

spell swipe.name: Spell Swipe
spell swipe.text: You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit. Make a Spellstrike, but roll separate Strikes to attack two creatures, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other.

spell tinker.name: Spell Tinker
spell tinker.text: You’ve learned to alter choices you make when casting spells on yourself. After casting a spell on only yourself that offers several choices of effect (such as resist energy or a polymorph spell that offers several potential forms), you can alter the choice you made when Casting the Spell (for instance, choosing a diff…

spellbinding speech.name: Spellbinding Speech
spellbinding speech.text: All the time you’ve spent discussing esoteric theses and performing spell incantations has made your words magical even when you aren’t casting a full spell. Choose a creature within 30 feet who can hear and understand you, and attempt an Arcana check against their Will DC.

spelldrinker.name: Spelldrinker
spelldrinker.text: You temporarily add a 3rd-rank spell to your spell repertoire, as determined by the type of creature whose blood you just drank. If the creature has more than one of the listed traits, choose one and gain the appropriate spell.
spelldrinker.requirements: Your last action was to Harvest Blood.

spellmaster's tenacity.name: Spellmaster's Tenacity
spellmaster's tenacity.text: You call upon the power of your spells to protect you from the worst of the magic headed your way. You fail your saving throw instead of critically failing. For 1 minute, increase the circumstance bonus to saving throws from the Spellmaster's Resilience feat to +2, and increase the resistance to damage it grants to 10.
spellmaster's tenacity.trigger: You critically fail at a saving throw against a foe's spell, and that spell was cast or created with the tradition of magic you selected with the Spellmaster's Resilience feat.

spellshape channel.name: Spellshape Channel
spellshape channel.text: Deep understanding of divine revelations into the nature of vital essence allows you to freely manipulate the energy of life and death. Use one spellshape action you can perform that normally takes 1 action and can be applied to the harm or heal spell.

spike skin.name: Spike Skin
spike skin.text: You touch a willing creature, causing its skin to harden and form spiky protrusions. The target gains resistance 4 to all physical damage (except adamantine). Whenever a creature damages the target with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon, the attacking creature takes 2 piercing damage.

spinebreaker.name: Spinebreaker
spinebreaker.text: You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple a creature you have grabbed or restrained, with the following additional effects if you succeed.

outcomes.text: The target is clumsy 2 until the end of its next turn and then is clumsy 1 for 1 minute.
The target is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

spinebreaker.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

spinning release.name: Spinning Release
spinning release.text: You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them. You release your opponent, sending them wobbling 10 feet in a direction of your choice; this is forced movement. Your opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC, with the following effects.

outcomes.text: The target is confused until the end of their next turn. They are then temporarily immune to being confused or sickened by Spinning Release for 10 minutes, though the ability can still be used to move them.
As failure, but the target is also sickened 1 from being spun around.

spinning release.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained with your lash.

spinning stand.name: Spinning Stand
spinning stand.text: You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position. You enter talon stance if you weren't in it already, make a spinning talon Strike against an enemy in reach, and then Stand.

spiral sworn.name: Spiral Sworn
spiral sworn.text: You trace a spiral in the air while intoning prayers to Pharasma, gaining her blessing for a time. For 3 rounds, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage against undead, creatures in possession of an imprisoned soul, or creatures you have witnessed create or command undead.

spirit guide form.name: Spirit Guide Form
spirit guide form.text: You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power. This effect lasts 1 minute; you can end it early as a free action. During this time, you can’t use any other actions granted by this archetype.

spirit of the blade.name: Spirit of the Blade
spirit of the blade.text: You charge your blade with spiritual energy, allowing it to cut through spirits and fiends with fearsome efficiency. The next Strike you make with a melee weapon or fist unarmed attack deals an additional 1d6 spirit damage. This bonus damage is lost if you don’t attempt a Strike before the start of your next turn.

spirit's absolution.name: Spirit's Absolution
spirit's absolution.text: You purify a spirit by absolving it of its sins and regrets. This cathartic experience restores your Hit Points or those of an adjacent ally. If you expend a spirit wisp, the target recovers 1d4 Hit Points per level you have.
spirit's absolution.requirements: You are holding your spirit dwelling.

spirit's anguish.name: Spirit's Anguish
spirit's anguish.text: You purify a spirit by coaxing it to release its anguish in a final cathartic howl. This deals sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If you expend a spirit wisp, this deals 1d4 sonic damage per level you have.
spirit's anguish.requirements: You are holding your spirit dwelling.

spirit's sacrifice.name: Spirit's Sacrifice
