spirit's sacrifice.text: Your attuned apparition gathers all of the energy it can through your shared bond and uses that power to disperse itself while channeling the energy back into you, saving your life. You can use Spirit’s Sacrifice even while unconscious or otherwise unable to act.

spirit's wrath.name: Spirit's Wrath
spirit's wrath.text: You call forth an ephemeral spirit, typically the apparition of an ancestor or a nature spirit, which takes the form of a wisp. The wisp makes a melee wisp rush unarmed attack against an enemy within 120 feet of you.

spirits' interference.name: Spirits' Interference
spirits' interference.text: You call forth protective spirits to ward off ranged attacks. Until your rage ends, anyone making a ranged attack against you must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack misses with no effect.

spiritual expansion spell.name: Spiritual Expansion Spell
spiritual expansion spell.text: Your apparitions manifest to scatter the energy of your spell. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, increase the area of that spell.

spiritual guides.name: Spiritual Guides
spiritual guides.text: Though no one sees them and only you can hear them, the spirits around you constantly chatter, save when you are raging. Sometimes they're even helpful, and their guidance can even cut through the haze of your rage. Reroll the triggering check, using the second result even if it's worse.
spiritual guides.trigger: You fail, but don’t critically fail, a Perception check or a skill check.

spiritual secret.name: Spiritual Secret
spiritual secret.text: You gain deeper insights into your patron’s abandoned power, allowing you to draw on that power more directly. If your next action is to cast a witch cantrip or witch spell that deals damage, it deals spirit damage instead of its normal type.

spiritual spellshape stance.name: Spiritual Spellshape Stance
spiritual spellshape stance.text: You feed excess magical power into your apparition, allowing it to grow ethereal limbs it can use to help shape and focus your spells. Once per turn while in this stance, you can use a spellshape feat that normally requires one action as a free action instead, but only to affect spells that deal spirit, vitality, or vo…

spiritual strike.name: Spiritual Strike
spiritual strike.text: Your spirit guide enhances your attacks with occult power. Make a Strike with a weapon that has at least one fundamental rune. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. The Strike has the effects of the ghost touch property rune and deals an additional 2d6 force damage.
spiritual strike.requirements: You are wielding a weapon with at least one fundamental rune and your familiar is adjacent to you or in your space.

spit-take.name: Spit-take
spit-take.text: You spit out something you drink as a comical, exaggerated bit. You Interact to drink from the item. If the item is a potion, elixir, or similar item, you can Activate it, provided it takes 1 action to do so.

outcomes.text: The target is dazzled for 1 minute.
The target is dazzled for 1 round.
The target is unaffected.
You choke a little, becoming sickened 1.

spit-take.requirements: You’re holding an item you can drink from (such as a potion or a waterskin).

spiteful rake.name: Spiteful Rake
spiteful rake.text: Your instincts sing of spite and malice, and you've learned a devastating trick: go for the eyes. You make a claw Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is dazzled for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target is instead blinded for 1 round and dazzled until restored to maximum hit points.

split hex.name: Split Hex
split hex.text: You siphon some of the power from an offensive hex you cast to direct it at a second target as well. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell to cast a harmful hex with a single target, reduce its rank by 2 (making it 2 ranks lower than the maximum spell rank you can cast).

split shot.name: Split Shot
split shot.text: You fragment a ranged spell. If your next action is to Cast a Spell without a duration that requires an attack roll against a single target, you can choose a second target within range. You roll a single attack roll and compare the result to the AC of both targets.

split spellstrike.name: Split Spellstrike
split spellstrike.text: Like knives slicing through magic itself, both your weapons carry your spell, delivering it to separate foes. Make a Spellstrike with a spell that can target at least 2 creatures or that has an area.
split spellstrike.requirements: You’re wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand, and your Spellstrike is charged.

spore cloud.name: Spore Cloud
spore cloud.text: You unleash a cloud of pollen or similar spores. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation around you must attempt a Fortitude save using your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) with the following results. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect.

outcomes.text: No effect.
The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.
The creature is blinded for 1 round.

sportlebore choke.name: Sportlebore Choke
sportlebore choke.text: Like nefarious sportlebores, a species of insect that plague adventurers by hiding in their rations as counterfeit food, your swarm can crawl down throats. The sportlebores attempt to force their way into the mouth of each creature in your swarm's space.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage and is sickened 1 as it spits out most of the offending sportlebores.
The sportlebores crawl down the creature's throat. The creature takes full damage and is sickened 1.
As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is sickened 2.

sportlebore choke.requirements: Your swarm is outside your body.

spot translate.name: Spot Translate
spot translate.text: You bridge a language gap, repeating the message in a different language that you know. Choose a language you understand to repeat the message in. The linguistic effect counts as both languages, rather than only the language the triggering creature is using, potentially allowing it to affect a wider range of creatures.…
spot translate.trigger: Another creature within 60 feet uses a linguistic effect in a language you understand.

spray ink.name: Spray Ink
spray ink.text: Your body provides you with natural defenses common to other creatures of the sea. You spray ink against the triggering creature. The creature becomes dazzled while the ink remains. The creature can use an Interact action to remove the ink.
spray ink.trigger: A creature hits you with a melee Strike.

spring from the shadows.name: Spring from the Shadows
spring from the shadows.text: You leap from hiding and assail your target. You Stride up to your Speed, but you must end your movement next to an enemy you’re hidden from or undetected by. You then Strike that enemy; you remain hidden from or undetected by that creature until after you Strike.

springboard.name: Springboard
springboard.text: You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent. You Leap, which doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy you struck. If you land within melee reach of an enemy, you can choose to make a spinning talon Strike against them.
springboard.requirements: Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.

sprinting spellstrike.name: Sprinting Spellstrike
sprinting spellstrike.text: Magic propels you across the battlefield as you speed toward your target. Make a Spellstrike, casting a spell that has a line area. Before making your Strike, you Stride in a straight line to a distance up to the line’s length; you can move through enemies during this movement, and your movement doesn’t trigger reactio…

sprout fruit.name: Sprout Fruit
sprout fruit.text: The plants covering your body sprout a single, ripe fruit. A creature other than you who eats this fruit as a three-action activity (1 Interact action to pluck the fruit and 2 Interact actions to eat it) is healed 1d4 Hit Points for every 2 levels you have.
sprout fruit.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

spy's countermeasures.name: Spy's Countermeasures
spy's countermeasures.text: You’ve learned how to analyze and fake your responses to the most common magic used against spies. You can attempt to identify the effect via Identify Magic using the magical tradition skill of the effect or Espionage Lore, even if you didn’t notice the spell being cast.
spy's countermeasures.trigger: You succeed at a save against a detection, mental, or scrying effect

squawk!.name: Squawk!
squawk!.text: You let out an awkward squawk, ruffle your feathers, or fake some other birdlike tic to cover up a social misstep or faux pas. You get a failure on the triggering check, rather than a critical failure. All creatures that witnessed you Squawk are temporarily immune for 24 hours.
squawk!.trigger: You critically fail a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against a creature that doesn't have the tengu trait.

squirm free.name: Squirm Free
squirm free.text: You're used to slipping out of a bigger creature's grasp or escaping a child's overly enthusiastic hug. You attempt to Escape.
squirm free.trigger: A creature grabs, immobilizes, or restrains you.

stab and blast.name: Stab and Blast
stab and blast.text: You slice or smash your opponent with the melee portion of your weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range. Make a melee Strike with the required weapon. If the Strike is successful, you can immediately make a ranged Strike against the same target with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.
stab and blast.requirements: You're wielding a firearm with an attached bayonet or reinforced stock, a fire lance, or a combination weapon.

staff sweep.name: Staff Sweep
staff sweep.text: You sweep your foes away with your staff. Roll an Athletics check to Shove or Trip, and compare the result to the appropriate DCs of up to two foes, each of whom must be within your reach and no more than 5 feet apart.
staff sweep.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

staggering blow.name: Staggering Blow
staggering blow.text: You've trained your megafauna companion to stagger its enemies, impeding their ability to fight back. You Command an Animal to order your megafauna companion to spend both its actions making a single, powerful Strike.
staggering blow.requirements: You're riding a megafauna companion that has a melee Strike.

staggering fire.name: Staggering Fire
staggering fire.text: You've learned how to fire at enemies to slow them down, allowing innocents and fellow knights alike time to escape. Make a ranged Strike with a weapon in the bow weapon group.

stalwart mind.name: Stalwart Mind
stalwart mind.text: When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion. Attempt a new Will save against the triggering effect.

stalwart song.name: Stalwart Song
stalwart song.text: As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching. Your mountain-like resilience and courage draw strength from the centuries-old traditions of dwarven song.
stalwart song.trigger: You’re about to attempt a saving throw against a fear effect.

stand back, i'm a doctor!.name: Stand Back, I'm a Doctor!
stand back, i'm a doctor!.text: You have mastered techniques to aid those at the brink of death, even if they use dangerous Stasian technology. Attempt a Medicine check on the dying creature as you deliver it a powerful shock. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of a level equal to the target.
stand back, i'm a doctor!.requirements: You are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free; a creature with the dying condition is in your reach.

stand firm.name: Stand Firm
stand firm.text: Your words help your ally shake off unease and terror. You shout a bolstering comment at an ally within 30 feet of you who has the fleeing or frightened condition and can hear you. That ally reduces the value of their frightened condition by 2 (to a minimum of 0).

stand for the fallen.name: Stand for the Fallen
stand for the fallen.text: You protect your allies at the cost of your own blood, but your deity shields you from the worst of the harm. Stride twice to be adjacent to the triggering ally. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
stand for the fallen.trigger: An ally takes damage that would bring them to 0 Hit Points.

stand still.name: Stand Still
stand still.text: You strike out when your foe tries to flee. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a move action, you disrupt that action.
stand still.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

standard-bearer's sacrifice.name: Standard-Bearer's Sacrifice
standard-bearer's sacrifice.text: Seeing an enemy take aim at your ally, you bravely flourish your banner to redirect their attention to you. The triggering opponent must attempt a Will save against your class DC. Success The opponent completes its attack against your ally. Failure The opponent targets you with the triggering attack instead.
standard-bearer's sacrifice.trigger: An opponent targets an ally with a ranged attack, you are observing both of them, and you are also in range of the attack.
standard-bearer's sacrifice.requirements: You are holding or wielding your banner.

starlight armor.name: Starlight Armor
starlight armor.text: You armor yourself in the light of distant suns, shielding yourself from harm. The armor grants you resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage. The armor also sheds bright light for 20 feet (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

starshot arrow.name: Starshot Arrow
starshot arrow.text: The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky. You draw an arrow (or other ammunition), whisper a short invocation over it, and then Strike with a ranged weapon.

start the festival!.name: Start the Festival!
start the festival!.text: No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party. You whistle and point, and 808 tanuki, in their raccoon dog forms, somehow appear from the surrounding terrain and fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet.

startling appearance.name: Startling Appearance
startling appearance.text: You can startle foes who are unaware of your presence. Make a Strike against your target. That creature is off-guard against this Strike, as normal. If your Strike hits, the target remains off-guard for the rest of your turn and is frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical hit).
startling appearance.requirements: You are unnoticed by the target creature.

stasian smash.name: Stasian Smash
stasian smash.text: You've modified your dynamo with Stasian coils, allowing you to make a powerful attack that crackles with electricity. Make a dynamo Strike. On a success, the Strike deals an additional 1d12 electricity damage to the target, as well as 1d4 electricity damage to up to two other foes within 10 feet as sparks leap across…

statement strut.name: Statement Strut
statement strut.text: You have an eye for fashion and know how to sell attitude and confidence with your walk. You Stride up to your Speed. All enemies within 30 feet of your movement are enraptured by your performance: they must succeed at a Will saving throw or become unable to use reactions until the end of your next turn.

statue.name: Statue
statue.text: Your body and equipment appear to be made of stone as you hold perfectly still. Until the next time you act, you appear to be a statue and do not need to eat, drink, or breathe, but you are flat-footed.
statue.source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

stay down!.name: Stay Down!
stay down!.text: You have ways of keeping your foes down. Attempt an Athletics check against the triggering foe’s Fortitude DC. On a success, the action is disrupted, causing the creature to remain prone. On a critical success, the creature also can’t Stand until its next turn.
stay down!.trigger: A prone foe within your reach Stands

stay here!.name: Stay Here!
stay here!.text: You topple your foes with your legs and attack them while they’re down. You Trip a creature within reach without needing a free hand. If you succeed, you can make a melee Strike against that creature. Your multiple attack penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both the Trip and Strike.

steal death.name: Steal Death
steal death.text: As a harbinger of daemonkind, you gain authority to delay the death of others if it serves your purposes, and in doing so, you bolster the well-being of both you and your mount to allow you sow further havoc. The triggering creature reduces their doomed or dying condition by 1.
steal death.trigger: Another creature within 30 feet gains the doomed or dying condition or their doomed or dying condition increases.

steal essence.name: Steal Essence
steal essence.text: Being in the presence of the aeon orbs as they deteriorated has taught you how to siphon energy, and you do so with the required magic item. The DC to steal the properties of a magic item is equal to the DC for the item's level or the normal DC to Steal the item, whichever is higher.
steal essence.requirements: A magic item is within your reach.

steal for the depths.name: Steal for the Depths
steal for the depths.text: You reach out and grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the creature. On a success, if the creature is on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, you pull the creature into the water in a space adjacent to you.
steal for the depths.requirements: You are swimming in water at least 10 feet deep.

steal magic's breath.name: Steal Magic's Breath
steal magic's breath.text: Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely. You become overflowing as if you had Absorbed Magic.
steal magic's breath.trigger: You are the target or within the area of a damaging spell or ability with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait.

steal time.name: Steal Time
steal time.text: You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time. Select a creature within 30 feet. That creature attempts a Fortitude saving throw against your chronoskimmer DC. The creature takes the effects of slow based on the result of its saving throw.

steam knight.name: Steam Knight
steam knight.text: You shape your kinetic aura into swirling armor of steam that scalds your enemies and propels you on super-heated jet streams. A creature can take damage from Steam Knight only once per round. Your steam armor has the following effects.

steam spell.name: Steam Spell
steam spell.text: You transform your fire spells into steam, making them more effective underwater. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fire trait, you can cast it underwater. When you do so, it takes the form of scalding steam.

steed's toppling strike.name: Steed's Toppling Strike
steed's toppling strike.text: Those who defy your cause feel the powerful attacks of your mount. You Command an Animal to order your steed to Strike the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction. Your steed's unarmed attack deals one extra damage die for this Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked prone.
steed's toppling strike.requirements: An enemy triggered your champion's reaction since the end of your last turn.

steel your resolve.name: Steel Your Resolve
steel your resolve.text: Regain Stamina Points equal to half your maximum.

steel yourself!.name: Steel Yourself!
steel yourself!.text: You encourage an ally to toughen up, giving them a fighting chance. Choose one ally in your marshal’s aura. The ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier and a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves. Both benefits last until the start of your next turn.

stella's stab and snag.name: Stella's Stab and Snag
stella's stab and snag.text: You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement. Stride up to your Speed; this movement does not trigger reactions triggered by movement. At any point during this movement you can Strike an opponent within reach.
stella's stab and snag.requirements: You are wielding a piercing or slashing melee weapon.

step lively.name: Step Lively
step lively.text: You are an expert at avoiding the lumbering footsteps of larger creatures. You Step to another space adjacent to the enemy.
step lively.trigger: A Large or larger enemy ends a move action adjacent to you

step through the realm before.name: Step Through The Realm Before
step through the realm before.text: You quickly pass through the First World to reach a nearby destination. You instantly teleport to an empty space that you can see up to 40 feet away. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the action is lost.

stepping stones.name: Stepping Stones
stepping stones.text: Disks of rock fly to points that you designate to make a new path. You can set them horizontally to make a path across the ground or atop a liquid, or anchor them into a vertical surface to make steps. The path can be up to 20 feet (4 squares) long, and steps can extend up to 10 feet up the side of the surface.

stir allies.name: Stir Allies
stir allies.text: You shout a command for your allies to scramble. Allies within 30 feet can use a reaction to Step. If you’re legendary in Diplomacy, they can instead Stride.

stoic as hell.name: Stoic as Hell
stoic as hell.text: Like the archdevil Dispater, you maintain an unshakable poise even under impossible stress. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your Will DC against the triggering effect.
stoic as hell.trigger: You’re targeted by an emotion effect or effect that would give you the controlled condition.

stoked flame stance.name: Stoked Flame Stance
stoked flame stance.text: You enter a stance of fast, fiery movements. You can make flashing spark attacks that deal 1d8 slashing damage. They are in the brawling group and have the forceful, nonlethal, sweep, and unarmed traits.

stolen spell.name: Stolen Spell
stolen spell.text: As you perfectly counter a spell, you re-aim its magic to use it yourself. You gain the ability to cast the triggering spell one time before the end of your next turn, even if it’s not on your spell list or is of a higher rank than you can cast. This doesn’t cost you a spell slot or other resource.
stolen spell.trigger: You critically succeed at a saving throw against an enemy’s spell, or an enemy critically fails a spell attack roll against you.

stomp ground.name: Stomp Ground
stomp ground.text: You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes. Each creature in a 5-foot emanation must attempt a Reflex saving throw against your class DC. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is off-guard until the end of your turn.

stone blows.name: Stone Blows
stone blows.text: You harden your skin into a powerful weapon. Make a melee unarmed Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This additional damage increases to 2d6 at 10th level and to 3d6 at 18th level.

stone body.name: Stone Body
stone body.text: Emulating the great defenders throughout dwarven history, you close your mind to the sensation of pain, becoming as resolute as stone itself. You gain resistance 10 to all damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or immediately upon being critically hit.

stone bones.name: Stone Bones
stone bones.text: Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries. Attempt a DC 17 flat check. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
stone bones.trigger: You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage

stone forge of the first.name: Stone Forge of the First
stone forge of the first.text: You conjure forth a massive stone forge within 30 feet that occupies a 15-foot cube in empty spaces on the ground. The forge lasts for 1 minute before crumbling into dust. The forge amplifies the power of runes in a 60-foot emanation.

stone passage.name: Stone Passage
stone passage.text: Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through. Stride up to your Speed. You can move through stone or rock objects, such as walls, as if they were unoccupied spaces.

stonewall.name: Stonewall
stonewall.text: The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body. You become petrified until the end of the current turn. You don't take any damage from the triggering effect or any other ill effects that couldn't affect stone.
stonewall.trigger: An enemy or hazard’s effect hits you or you fail a Fortitude save against one

stoney deflection.name: Stoney Deflection
stoney deflection.text: You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to any defenses against being Shoved or Tripped until the beginning of your next turn.
stoney deflection.source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

storied companion.name: Storied Companion
storied companion.text: Your companion is an integral part of your story, and you can expend your mythic power to protect it, defying events that would prevent it from being so. Spend a Mythic Point; your companion rerolls the triggering save at mythic proficiency and gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 minute…
storied companion.trigger: Your animal companion or pet would fail a saving throw.

storm of claws.name: Storm of Claws
storm of claws.text: You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork. Strike three times, with your multiple attack penalty increasing as normal. After each attack that hits and deals damage, you can Step.
storm of claws.requirements: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.

storm retribution.name: Storm Retribution
storm retribution.text: You lash out, directing a burst of storming fury toward a creature that has harmed you. You cast tempest surge on the triggering opponent and push that creature, moving it 5 feet away from you if it fails its Reflex save, or 10 feet if it critically fails. This movement is forced movement.
storm retribution.trigger: An opponent adjacent to you critically hits you with a melee weapon or melee unarmed attack
storm retribution.requirements: You have at least 1 available Focus Point

storm shroud.name: Storm Shroud
storm shroud.text: You become surrounded by a swirling storm of rain, sand, snow, or clouds, whichever of those suits your bound terrain. This activity has traits appropriate to the storm you create— typically earth for sand and water for rain, snow, or clouds. You become concealed for 1 minute.

storm spiral.name: Storm Spiral
storm spiral.text: Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air. The storm appears in a 20-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes 3d12 electricity damage and 1d10 sonic damage, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

storming breath.name: Storming Breath
storming breath.text: You spit out a freezing breath or sonic scream. You deal 4d6 damage, plus 1d6 damage for every level you have beyond 6th, to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a basic Reflex save.

storming gaze.name: Storming Gaze
storming gaze.text: You can open or energize a notable third eye on your forehead to strike with storming power. You deal 3d4 electricity or sonic damage in a 15-foot cone; Storming Gaze gains this trait. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

strafing breath.name: Strafing Breath
strafing breath.text: You urge your dragon mount forward, wreathed in magical power. Your mount Strides three times. If your mount has a fly Speed, it can substitute a Fly action for any of these Stride actions. As it moves, your dragon companion’s magical breath billows around you.

strain mind.name: Strain Mind
strain mind.text: You strain your body beyond its limits to use an amp even when your mental power is depleted. You add an amp that costs 1 Focus Point to the spell. Instead of paying the normal Focus Point cost, you lose Hit Points equal to four times the spell rank of the amped psi cantrip as you bleed from your nose or suffer some ot…

strangle.name: Strangle
strangle.text: You squeeze the breath out of your foe. Make an unarmed melee Strike against the creature you have grabbed or restrained. On a success, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice, and the target can barely speak until the start of your next turn or until it Escapes, whichever come…
strangle.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

stranglehold.name: Stranglehold
stranglehold.text: You choke a victim so that they can barely speak. The creature you have grabbed or restrained takes bludgeoning damage equal to twice your Strength modifier and it can barely speak until the start of your next turn or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.
stranglehold.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

strategist stance.name: Strategist Stance
strategist stance.text: You find the most strategic options for you and your allies. When you use this action, attempt a Society or Warfare Lore check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances.

outcomes.text: Your marshal’s aura increases to a 20-foot emanation, and it grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to Reflex saving throws. Once per turn, when you succeed or critically succeed at a Recall Knowledge check to gain information about an enemy creature, the target of the Recall Knowledge check becomes off-guard to the n…
As critical success, but your aura’s size doesn’t increase.
You fail to enter the stance.
You fail to enter the stance and can’t take this action again for 1 minute.

stretching reach.name: Stretching Reach
stretching reach.text: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.

strix vengeance.name: Strix Vengeance
strix vengeance.text: You dedicate yourself to destroying those who harm your kin. Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 1d6 precision damage on Strikes against the triggering enemy. The bonus increases to 2d6 if you use a striking weapon or unarmed attack and 3d6 if you use a major striking weapon or unarmed attack.
strix vengeance.trigger: You, or a strix ally you can see, are damaged by an enemy’s critical hit.

stumbling finisher.name: Stumbling Finisher
stumbling finisher.text: Your excellent display of fighting prowess leaves your opponent stumbling back. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target is pushed 5 feet back (or 10 feet on a critical hit).

stumbling stance.name: Stumbling Stance
stumbling stance.text: You enter a seemingly unfocused stance that mimics the movements of the inebriated—bobbing, weaving, leaving false openings, and distracting your enemies from your true movements. While in this stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Feint.

stunning finisher.name: Stunning Finisher
stunning finisher.text: You attempt a dizzying blow. Make a melee Strike. If you hit, your foe must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC with the following results; the save has the incapacitation trait.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target can't use reactions until its next turn.
The target is stunned 1.
The target is stunned 3.

stunning surprise.name: Stunning Surprise
stunning surprise.text: You quickly move in to bring your foe down with a single blow. You move up to your Speed then make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, your foe must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature is stunned 1 and can’t use reactions until its next turn.
The creature is stunned 3 and can’t use reactions until its next turn.
The creature falls unconscious for 1 minute.

stunning surprise.requirements: You must be undetected by the target creature.

stunt performer stance.name: Stunt Performer Stance
stunt performer stance.text: You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar’s Monastery of the Seven Forms. Kemen controversially shunned monastic life and instead used his martial skills as a death-defying stunt performer, winning acclaim for exhibitions that saw hi…

stymie the gods.name: Stymie the Gods
stymie the gods.text: By exerting your will as a nascent god present in the mortal realms, you can hold off the influences of most distant entities, even ones much older and more powerful than yourself. Either you or your hierophant are able to use this action.

subjugation.name: Subjugation
subjugation.text: You have managed to gain a degree of control over the runelord’s ancient soul within your mind, enough that you can project this invasive influence into the minds of others. Spend a Mythic Point. You attempt to send your runelord’s influence into the mind of a creature you can sense within 30 feet.
subjugation.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 74

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.

The creature is slowed 1 as it fights off your runelord’s influence. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as if you achieved a critical success on a Recall Knowledge check to identify the creature.
The creature relinquishes control of its faculties and abilities. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as success. You control the creature until the end of its next turn.
As failure, but you control the creature for 1 minute.

submerged stillness.name: Submerged Stillness
submerged stillness.text: With a mix of magic and physical training, you have learned to render yourself invisible while hiding underwater. You mimic the subtle movement of water so as not to disturb its surface, and you change your skin color to blend in with your surroundings.

submission hold.name: Submission Hold
submission hold.text: Your iron grip saps your opponent’s strength. Attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the creature you have grabbed or restrained, with the following additional effects if you succeed.

outcomes.text: The target is enfeebled 2 until the end of its next turn and then is enfeebled 1 for 1 minute.
The target is enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

submission hold.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

submit to shadow.name: Submit To Shadow
submit to shadow.text: In a final gambit, you fill yourself with umbral energy in a gruesome display of shadowy tentacle that disquiets all but the hardiest foes. You remain conscious and regain 6d8 Hit Points.

subtle shank.name: Subtle Shank
subtle shank.text: You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion. Interact to draw the weapon, Strike with that weapon, and then Conceal it with a Stealth check. The target is flat-footed for this attack.
subtle shank.requirements: You have a melee weapon of light bulk Concealed on your person via the Stealth skill, and the target isn't aware of it.

such a disgrace!.name: Such a Disgrace!
such a disgrace!.text: You expect the same level of urbane sophistication from your allies as you possess, so whenever one of them succumbs to egregious behavior from a mental effect, you're immediately mortified.
such a disgrace!.trigger: An ally within 30 feet fails a Will saving throw against a mental effect.

sudden charge.name: Sudden Charge
sudden charge.text: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing. Stride twice. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

sudden leap.name: Sudden Leap
sudden leap.text: You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar. Make a Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump and attempt one melee Strike at any point during your jump. Immediately after the Strike, you fall to the ground if you're in the air, even if you haven't reached the maximum distance of your jump.

sudden mindfulness.name: Sudden Mindfulness
sudden mindfulness.text: Your mind retains full awareness despite the best attempts of others, and your focus throws others off-balance. You get a critical success on the triggering saving throw, and if the triggering effect was caused by a creature, that creature is flat-footed to you until the end of your next turn.
sudden mindfulness.trigger: You roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that would make you fascinated or dazzled.

sudden terror.name: Sudden Terror
sudden terror.text: You leverage your body’s amorphous nature to spook others. Attempt to Demoralize a creature within 30 feet. Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don’t take a penalty if the creature doesn’t understand your language.

summon mythic power.name: Summon Mythic Power
summon mythic power.text: You call upon fate, divinity, or whatever other power has carried you this far, demanding that it carry you just a little bit farther. You regain 1 Mythic Point.

summoner's call.name: Summoner's Call
summoner's call.text: In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side. Your eidolon teleports to an open space adjacent to you. Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
summoner's call.trigger: You or your eidolon take damage from a foe or hazard.
summoner's call.requirements: Your eidolon is manifested and is more than 5 feet away from you.

sunbird glare.name: Sunbird Glare
sunbird glare.text: By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be dazzled for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).

sunder spell.name: Sunder Spell
sunder spell.text: You draw upon your superstitious fury to destroy a spell. Make a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack against a creature, object, or a spell manifestation (such as the wall created by wall of fire or the guardian from spiritual guardian).

sundown street posturing.name: Sundown Street Posturing
sundown street posturing.text: Whether in the salon or on the street, you've captured the attention of everyone around you. In this moment, they're all hanging on your next word or anticipating your next move. You capture the moment by striking an unforgettable pose, one that your friends find alluring and your foes find alarming.

sunless slide.name: Sunless Slide
sunless slide.text: Buoyed by living darkness, you glide out of reach as you prepare a spell. You Step, then Cast a Spell that requires 2 or fewer actions.
sunless slide.requirements: You’re in dim light or darkness.

superimpose time duplicates.name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
superimpose time duplicates.text: You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat.

suplex.name: Suplex
suplex.text: Flexing your entire body, you heave your opponent over your head and slam them into the ground. Make an unarmed melee Strike against the creature you have grabbed or restrained. On a success, the target lands prone, and on a critical success, the target lands prone and takes an additional 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
suplex.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

supreme psychic center.name: Supreme Psychic Center
supreme psychic center.text: With the merest thought, you realign your mental defenses to your duel's circumstances. You Recenter.
supreme psychic center.trigger: Your turn in a psychic duel begins.

surface rush.name: Surface Rush
surface rush.text: You make a dedicated dash to enter the water or emerge onto land. If you begin on land when using this ability, you Stride, then Swim twice if you are in water. If you begin in water when using this ability, you Swim, then Stride twice if you are on land.

surface tension.name: Surface Tension
surface tension.text: You encase the pieces of your broken weapon together with water you pull from the surrounding environment. The weapon’s broken condition is temporarily suppressed, and the weapon deals an additional amount of bludgeoning damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice; this damage can’t be changed to any other t…

surgical shock.name: Surgical Shock
surgical shock.text: With a few well-placed jabs with your fist or weapon, you render your opponent disoriented or ungainly. Attempt a Medicine check against the Fortitude DC of a target within your reach. The result of your check determines the severity of the condition you inflict.

outcomes.text: The target is either clumsy 3 or stupefied 3 until the end of your next turn. The target is then immune to Surgical Shock for 1 hour.
As critical success, but the target is either clumsy 2 or stupefied 2.
The target is minorly inconvenienced. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next attack action you attempt against it before the end of your turn.
The target is unaffected and you overextend yourself, triggering reactions as if you had used a manipulate action.

surging focus.name: Surging Focus
surging focus.text: When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power. You instantly regain 1 Focus Point.
surging focus.trigger: An ally you can see falls to 0 Hit Points

surging interference.name: Surging Interference
surging interference.text: You absorb the scattered energy of others’ failed spells, using it to recharge your own magic. You attempt to counteract the spell. If you’re successful, you absorb the dispersed magical energy, regaining one spell or spell slot of 8th rank or lower of your choice.
surging interference.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell within your spellsurge aura.

surging might.name: Surging Might
surging might.text: You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell ignores an amount of the target's resistance equal to your level against the following types of damage: spirit, vitality, and void.

surging smash.name: Surging Smash
surging smash.text: Lashing forward, your weapon becomes an extension of your nexus, washing your enemies in a torrent of magical fury. Make a melee Strike. Regardless of the result, you create a 30- foot cone of magical energy dealing 3d6 force damage with a basic Fortitude save against your nexus DC.

surprise snare.name: Surprise Snare
surprise snare.text: You install one prepared snare for deployment in a space that's occupied by an enemy. It must be a snare that normally takes 1 minute or less to Craft. The snare automatically triggers.

surprising leap.name: Surprising Leap
surprising leap.text: Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe. Your eidolon makes a Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump and attempts one melee Strike at any point during that jump. Immediately after the Strike, your eidolon falls to the ground if they’re in the air, even if they haven’t reached the maximum distance of their jump.

suspect of opportunity.name: Suspect of Opportunity
suspect of opportunity.text: Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close. You use Person of Interest against the triggering creature. This doesn't allow you to use Person of Interest more frequently than normal.
suspect of opportunity.trigger: A creature who isn’t, to your knowledge, tied to any of your active investigations takes a hostile action against you in combat.

sustaining steel.name: Sustaining Steel
sustaining steel.text: You pull magic from the surrounding area into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy. You regain Hit Points equal to the triggering spell’s rank and roll to end any persistent void damage you have.
sustaining steel.trigger: You Cast a Spell using a spell slot.

swaggering initiative.name: Swaggering Initiative
swaggering initiative.text: You swagger readily into any fight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll and can Interact to draw a weapon. If you are the first to act in combat, you gain panache.
swaggering initiative.trigger: You are about to roll initiative.

swamp stealth.name: Swamp Stealth
swamp stealth.text: In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water. You Take Cover and then use that cover to Hide.
swamp stealth.source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80
swamp stealth.requirements: You are in a swamp environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to Take Cover.

swan dive.name: Swan Dive
swan dive.text: You soar through the air and into the water, using your momentum to propel yourself forward. You intentionally Leap or otherwise fall into a body of water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance, and then Swim up to your Speed.

swap reflections.name: Swap Reflections
swap reflections.text: You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage. You send your own reflection to forcibly swap places with the reflection of an enemy, pulling each of you through opposite ends and switching places.

outcomes.text: The spell has no effect.
You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever your target prefers.
You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever you prefer.

You instantaneously swap positions with your target, and the target becomes trapped in its own reflection for 1 minute. Once on each of its turns, the target can spend 1 action to attempt another Will save to escape. If the save succeeds, the effect ends early.

sweeping fan block.name: Sweeping Fan Block
sweeping fan block.text: You leap up on one leg, snapping your fans open alongside your head before sweeping them across your body. When you’re the target of an attack using ammunition (such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size) while wielding two fans, whirl your fans to disrupt the incoming attack with gusts of…
sweeping fan block.trigger: You're targeted by a ranged attack that uses ammunition.
sweeping fan block.requirements: You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

swift application.name: Swift Application
swift application.text: You expertly combine the motions of attacking and coating your weapon with venom. You Envenom a weapon or piece of ammunition, and then Strike with that weapon. This counts against your uses of Envenom normally and can't be used if your venom is exhausted.

swift banishment.name: Swift Banishment
swift banishment.text: The force of your blow sends your victim back to its home plane. You expend a banishment spell you have prepared, affecting the creature you critically hit without needing to cast the spell. The creature can attempt to resist the spell as normal.
swift banishment.trigger: You critically hit a creature that is not on its home plane
swift banishment.requirements: You have a banishment spell prepared

swift elusion.name: Swift Elusion
swift elusion.text: Attempt an Acrobatics check against the foe’s Reflex DC. If you succeed, either Stride to a different space adjacent to the foe or move the foe to a different space adjacent to you.
swift elusion.trigger: A foe ends its movement adjacent to you

swift guardian.name: Swift Guardian
swift guardian.text: When danger appears, you quickly send away your active companion and call in a different animal ally. You use Call Companion. The new animal companion typically arrives in the same location as the one that departed, though the GM might adjust this depending on the circumstances and Speeds of the animals.

swift intervention.name: Swift Intervention
swift intervention.text: You're burdened with noticing potential threats at all times. Because of this, you've learned that a well-placed shot can prevent disaster. You make a shot to either pin an ally's clothing to stop a fall or secure them against a ledge, or you bounce an attack off their armor to correct their course as they stumble whil…
swift intervention.trigger: An ally within your overwatch field fails in their attempt to Arrest a Fall, Balance, Grab a Ledge, or Maneuver in Flight.
swift intervention.requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon.

swift leap.name: Swift Leap
swift leap.text: Your undead physiology allows you to leap quickly toward or away from your opponent. You Leap. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. If you are satiated, you can choose to end your satiation to instead High Jump or Long Jump without triggering reactions, as you take a quick, enormous jump before any foe can react to…

swift river.name: Swift River
swift river.text: You flow like water, avoiding all restraints. End one status penalty to your speed, or end one immobilized or slowed condition affecting you.
swift river.trigger: Your turn ends and you have a status penalty to your Speed or are immobilized or slowed.

swim through earth.name: Swim Through Earth
swim through earth.text: The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your land Speed and can immediately Burrow once. You don't gain the ability to breathe while in the earth, so you must hold your breath. The impulse ends at the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

swimming charge.name: Swimming Charge
swimming charge.text: You swim directly into a foe, attempting to push them out of the way. Swim up to your Speed, attempting to enter the space of a foe that’s your size or smaller. Roll an Athletics check and compare the result of the Fortitude DC of the target creature.

outcomes.text: The target takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level plus twice your Strength modifier and must move into the empty space directly behind it; you move into the space it vacated. The target must move even if doing so places it in harm’s way.
As critical success, but the damage is equal to your level plus your Strength modifier.
The target takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier and you end your movement before entering its space.
The target is unaffected and you end your movement before entering its space.

swipe.name: Swipe
swipe.text: You make a wide, arcing swing. Make a melee Strike and compare the attack roll result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. A Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

swipe souvenir.name: Swipe Souvenir
swipe souvenir.text: When you wriggle free from an enemy’s grasp, you take something of theirs with you. You attempt to Escape from being grabbed or restrained by a creature. If you succeed, you can also attempt to Steal from the creature, even if the creature is in combat.
swipe souvenir.requirements: You’re grabbed or restrained by a creature

swiping trace.name: Swiping Trace
swiping trace.text: You prepare a rune on the end of your weapon so that it transfers to your enemies. Make a melee Strike and compare the attack roll to the AC of up to two enemies within your melee reach. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.text: You attempt to deftly swap places with an adjacent enemy to avoid the attack. Choose an adjacent enemy and attempt to Reposition it. Instead of the normal results of Reposition, use the following.

outcomes.text: You swap places with the target enemy and the enemy becomes the target of the triggering attack.
As critical success, except the target has lesser cover against the triggering attack, and you lose your panache.
You lose your panache.
You become off-guard against the triggering attack, and you lose your panache.

switcheroo.trigger: You are targeted by a ranged attack.
switcheroo.requirements: You are adjacent to an enemy and have panache.

sword of sealing.name: Sword of Sealing
sword of sealing.text: Your spiritual power pierces both body and soul, pinning your foe in place. Make a melee Strike with a one-handed, agile, or finesse weapon, or your fist unarmed attack. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC, or become immobilized.

sword-light wave.name: Sword-light Wave
sword-light wave.text: You channel spiritual energy through your weapon, unleashing it as a torrent of devastating power. Make a ranged Strike against an opponent within 60 feet using a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon, or your fist unarmed attack.

sympathetic strike.name: Sympathetic Strike
sympathetic strike.text: You collect your patron’s magic into one of your witch armaments, causing them to shine with runes, light, or another signifier of your patron. Make an unarmed Strike with one with your witch’s armaments. If you hit, you establish a sympathetic link with the target, making it easier for your patron to affect them.

synchronous slither.name: Synchronous Slither
synchronous slither.text: You’ve learned to travel at your ally’s rhythm and use their movement to adjust your own position. You Stride up to half your speed. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions from the enemy your ally moved adjacent to.
synchronous slither.trigger: An ally within your reach leaves a square during a move action they're using and ends their movement adjacent to an enemy.

synergistic spell.name: Synergistic Spell
synergistic spell.text: You combine your synergy and spells into a fantastic web of magic, allowing you to cast two spells at once. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from one of your halcyon spell slots, after that spell resolves, you can Cast another Spell as a free action.

tactical entry.name: Tactical Entry
tactical entry.text: You Stride. This movement doesn’t trigger any reactions.
tactical entry.requirements: You rolled Stealth for initiative in this encounter, and neither you nor any enemies have acted yet

tag team.name: Tag Team
tag team.text: Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike. If you used Tag Team after your spotter missed the triggering Strike, make a ranged Strike against the same target with a –2 penalty.
tag team.trigger: You or your spotter misses with a Strike against a creature, and the creature is within the other's melee reach or first range increment.

tail guard.name: Tail Guard
tail guard.text: Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit, the movement is disrupted.
tail guard.trigger: A creature enters a square that would flank you.

tail snatch.name: Tail Snatch
tail snatch.text: You can whip your tail around to lash items from the unwary's grip. You attempt to Disarm a creature, ignoring the requirement that you must have at least one hand free. As normal, your tail can't hold the items it disarms.

tail spin.name: Tail Spin
tail spin.text: You excel at using your tail as a weapon to upend your foes. Attempt a single Athletics check to Trip up to two adjacent creatures. If you roll a success against a target, you get a critical success against that target instead.

take flight.name: Take Flight
take flight.text: Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

take in the catch.name: Take in the Catch
take in the catch.text: Your skills in marine fishing can also be applied to combat. Attempt to Grapple a creature with your net, with the normal results. Then you Step, Interact to draw a weapon, and Strike the creature you attempted to grapple. If you succeeded on your check to Grapple, the creature remains grabbed after your Step.

take the wheel.name: Take the Wheel
take the wheel.text: Diving into a moving vehicle and seizing the controls is nothing new for you. You Board and Take Control of the adjacent vehicle.
take the wheel.requirements: You are adjacent to a vehicle's point of entry.

talmandor's shout.name: Talmandor's Shout
talmandor's shout.text: After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize, comparing the result to the Will DC of each enemy within a 60-foot emanation; this Demoralize attempt doesn’t take any penalty for not sharing a language.
talmandor's shout.requirements: You witnessed a creature deal damage to an ally within 30 feet since your last turn.

talon sweep.name: Talon Sweep
talon sweep.text: Your long clawed legs let you catch enemies to either side. You shift to talon stance if you weren't in it already. If the Strike misses, you can make a spinning talon Strike against any creature flanking you.
talon sweep.trigger: A creature attempts to Strike you while it’s

tamper.name: Tamper
tamper.text: You tamper with a foe's weapon or armor, using a free hand. Choose either a weapon held by an enemy in your reach or a suit of armor worn by an enemy in your reach. Attempt a Crafting check against the enemy's Reflex DC.

outcomes.text: Your tampering is incredibly effective. If you tampered with a weapon, the enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls with that weapon. If you tampered with armor, the armor hampers the enemy's movement, making the enemy flat-footed and inflicting a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds.
Your tampering is temporarily effective. As critical success, but the effect ends at the start of your next turn, even if the enemy doesn't Interact to end it.
Your tampering backfires dramatically, creating a small explosion from your own tools or gear. You take fire damage equal to your level.

tandem movement.name: Tandem Movement
tandem movement.text: You and your eidolon move together. You each use a single action to Stride. Either of you that has the corresponding movement type can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.

tandem strike.name: Tandem Strike
tandem strike.text: You and your eidolon each attack, seamlessly targeting the same foe without interfering with each other’s movements. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike, and then you make a melee Strike against the same creature. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
tandem strike.requirements: A creature is in reach of both you and your eidolon.

tangle of battle.name: Tangle of Battle
tangle of battle.text: Your vicious strike pulls your foe closer, giving you the opportunity to grab them. Attempt to Grapple the triggering enemy.
tangle of battle.trigger: You critically hit an adjacent enemy.

tangled forest rake.name: Tangled Forest Rake
tangled forest rake.text: You reposition foes with raking attacks. Make a lashing branch Strike. If you hit and deal damage, you can Reposition the target up to 10 feet. You can move the target through your space during this movement.
tangled forest rake.requirements: You are in Tangled Forest Stance.

tangled forest stance.name: Tangled Forest Stance
tangled forest stance.text: You extend your arms like gnarled branches to interfere with your foes' movements. You can make lashing branch unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

tap into blood.name: Tap Into Blood
tap into blood.text: The power in your blood allows you to perform minor feats of magic. You can perform one of the following actions depending on the tradition of your bloodline. Arcane Your mind temporarily opens to the secrets of the world.
tap into blood.requirements: You are benefiting from a blood magic effect

tap vitality.name: Tap Vitality
tap vitality.text: You tap into the entity's life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity's personality bleeding into your own. You recover a number of Hit Points equal to four times your level.

target of opportunity.name: Target of Opportunity
target of opportunity.text: You capitalize on your ally’s attack and use the opportunity to secure a blow of your own, adding to the oncoming barrage. Make a ranged Strike with a –2 penalty against the opponent targeted by the triggering attack.
target of opportunity.trigger: An ally succeeds at a ranged Strike against an opponent in your weapon’s first range increment.
target of opportunity.requirements: You have a ranged or thrown weapon in hand.

targeted redirection.name: Targeted Redirection
targeted redirection.text: You aim a shot at your spotter, intending for your spotter to redirect that shot off their own weapon or shield to hit your foe from a better angle, and avoid your foe's cover. If your next action is to make a ranged Strike, you treat your spotter's position as your own for the purposes of determining cover and range.

targeting finisher.name: Targeting Finisher
targeting finisher.text: Your attack harms and hinders your foe. Choose a particular part of your foe from the list below and Strike. If you hit and damage the target, apply the effect corresponding to the chosen part. This hindrance lasts until the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, you also apply a lesser effect lasting for 1 minute.

targeting shot.name: Targeting Shot
targeting shot.text: You carefully track your prey’s position and defenses, allowing you to follow up around obstacles that block your shot. Make a ranged weapon Strike against your hunted prey. You ignore the target’s concealed condition and all cover.

taste blood.name: Taste Blood
taste blood.text: You retain not only your vampiric parent's taste for blood but their ability to gain vitality from it. You drink fresh blood from a living humanoid creature, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to the target's level that last for 10 minutes.

taunting strike.name: Taunting Strike
taunting strike.text: The force of your blow causes your enemy to focus their attention on you. Make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you Taunt the target. Your Taunt gains the visual trait.

tear tendons.name: Tear Tendons
tear tendons.text: You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength. Make two frenzied claw attacks against the same target, increasing the multiple attack penalty normally.
tear tendons.requirements: You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

tears of pearl.name: Tears of Pearl
tears of pearl.text: You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them. All creatures adjacent to you must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The pearls dissolve at the start of your next turn, turning into salt water.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it covets the pearls or reaches for them.

The target is slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it grabs for the pearls, and if it doesn't have a free hand (or similar appendage), it must spend its first action on its next turn to Release one item it's holding.
As failure, but the target is slowed 2 instead of slowed 1.

tectonic stomp.name: Tectonic Stomp
tectonic stomp.text: You cause minor tremors that topple your enemies. All creatures in a 30-foot emanation who are touching the ground take 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 2 levels you have, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that fails its save also falls prone.

telekinetic slip.name: Telekinetic Slip
telekinetic slip.text: A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free. You gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Escape from whatever has you grabbed or restrained. This bonus lasts until either you're no longer grabbed or restrained, or you fall unconscious.
telekinetic slip.trigger: Your turn begins, and you're grabbed or restrained.

telling blow.name: Telling Blow
telling blow.text: Your determination empowers a telling blow to defeat your most powerful enemies. Spend a Mythic Point. Make a Strike at mythic proficiency. If the Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.
telling blow.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

tempest-sun redirection.name: Tempest-Sun Redirection
tempest-sun redirection.text: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots that damages other creatures, you can bend some of that spell’s offensive energy, protecting allies in the area and boosting your own defenses against certain foes.

tempest-sun shielding.name: Tempest-Sun Shielding
tempest-sun shielding.text: You transform unrealized spell energy into a protective shield. If you’re a spontaneous spellcaster, expend a spell slot; if you’re a prepared spellcaster, expend a spell prepared in a spell slot. Reduce the triggering damage by an amount equal to four times the level of the expended slot or spell.
tempest-sun shielding.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage.

tempo duelist.name: Tempo Duelist
tempo duelist.text: You move with an unpredictable tempo, shifting between unnervingly slow and rapid movements. You are concealed for 1 round. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

tempo shift.name: Tempo Shift
tempo shift.text: You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments. When you return to the initiative order after you Delay, you do so in an unpredictable way.

temporal fury.name: Temporal Fury
temporal fury.text: You shift and skip through time, vanishing during your movement to appear in unexpected and advantageous locations for combat. Spend a Mythic Point. Strike, then Step up to 10 feet.
temporal fury.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

tenacious blood magic.name: Tenacious Blood Magic
tenacious blood magic.text: You have learned how to invest magic more deeply by witnessing Aroden's works. The triggering blood magic effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round.
tenacious blood magic.trigger: You apply an effect from your blood magic that lasts for 1 round.

tender ministrations.name: Tender Ministrations
tender ministrations.text: Your gentle magic eases even the most skittish of souls, a gift that almost guarantees you popularity among parents and farmers alike. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets a single creature, you can reduce the target’s frightened condition by 1.

terraforming spell.name: Terraforming Spell
terraforming spell.text: You capture transformative fragments of magic and slam them into the ground, creating a shock wave that alters your surroundings. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip transmutation Spell, either each space adjacent to you becomes difficult terrain, or each space adjacent to you is no longer difficult terrain.

terraforming trickery.name: Terraforming Trickery
terraforming trickery.text: You know how to channel the transformative aspects of your blood magic to alter your surroundings. You know the following blood magic effect. Blood Magic—Terraforming Trickery Either each space adjacent to you becomes difficult terrain, or each space adjacent to you is no longer difficult terrain.

terrain form.name: Terrain Form
terrain form.text: You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the gaseous form spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form. The substance you're formed of depends upon your bound terrain, and the action gains the corresponding trait or traits.

terrain shield.name: Terrain Shield
terrain shield.text: You're so attuned to the land that it rises up to protect you from a potentially fatal blow in a seeming coincidence. For instance, a branch suddenly falls from a nearby tree to take the brunt of a sword swing or a surprising change of current disrupts an enemy's attack.
terrain shield.requirements: You gained a terrain attunement benefit since the start of your most recent turn and that attunement matches the terrain you're in.

terrifying countenance.name: Terrifying Countenance
terrifying countenance.text: You can erect a magical cowl that terrorizes your enemies. Once per day, you can cast mask of terror as an innate occult spell, targeting yourself. If you critically hit a creature that's temporarily immune to the spell, the creature's temporary immunity ends.
terrifying countenance.source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

terrifying croak.name: Terrifying Croak
terrifying croak.text: You release a haunting croak that reminds those around you of their fears. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize a creature within 30 feet; you do not take a penalty to this check for not speaking a language. If the check is successful, the target cannot reduce their frightened condition below 1 for 1 round.

terrifying howl.name: Terrifying Howl
terrifying howl.text: You unleash a terrifying howl. Attempt Intimidation checks to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet: you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each target is then temporarily immune to Terrifying Howl for 1 minute.

terrifying invocation.name: Terrifying Invocation
terrifying invocation.text: You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name. You attempt to Demoralize a single target within 30 feet and then Invoke one Rune upon that target. You don't take a penalty to your check if the creature doesn't understand your language.

terrifying transformation.name: Terrifying Transformation
terrifying transformation.text: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform. Attempt Intimidation checks to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. This Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if a creature doesn't understand your language.

that was a close one, huh?.name: That was a Close One, Huh?
that was a close one, huh?.text: You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle.
that was a close one, huh?.requirements: Either you used Accidental Shot and hit your opponent with the Strike this turn, or you used Lucky Escape since your last turn and the triggering attack missed you.

that's not natural!.name: That's Not Natural!
that's not natural!.text: Your mastery at surviving in the wild has given you a sort of sixth-sense when it comes to noticing creatures that aren't part of the natural order. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all initiative checks made at the start of a battle in which at least one of your enemies is an aberration, fey, mutant, or undead, or…

the bigger they are.name: The Bigger They Are
the bigger they are.text: With reckless speed, you dash, jump and swing around a creature to find a more vulnerable spot. Attempt to Tumble Through a creature at least one size category larger than you, using the following effects.

outcomes.text: You move through the enemy's space, treating the squares in its space as difficult terrain (every 5 feet costs 10 feet of movement). If you don't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space, you get the same effect as a failure.
As success, but the weakness applies only against the next attack you make against the target.
Your movement ends, and you trigger reactions as if you had moved out of the square you started in.
As failure, and you fall prone.

the cycle continues.name: The Cycle Continues
the cycle continues.text: Death is as natural as breathing to you, and you can move past it as easily as the other troubles in your life. You prevent yourself from dying and regain Hit Points equal to 6d8 plus half your level.
the cycle continues.trigger: You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the dying condition or would otherwise die.

the dead walk.name: The Dead Walk
the dead walk.text: You beseech warrior spirits to come forth and aid you. Two ghostly warriors manifest within a 30-foot emanation of you and each attempt a Strike against an adjacent enemy, using your spell attack modifier.

the shattered mountain weeps.name: The Shattered Mountain Weeps
the shattered mountain weeps.text: A massive sphere of rock explodes, unleashing a cataclysm of falling debris and deadly shrapnel. Its destruction falls in a 20-foot burst within 120 feet. Creatures in the area take 9d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. Those who fail are knocked prone.

the tyrant falls!.name: The Tyrant Falls!
the tyrant falls!.text: You've reached the apex of the Crimson Oath's power. The oath's power is overwhelming—too much for a mortal frame—but victory is worth any price. When you use this feat, you cry out the final line of the Crimson Oath, unleashing unbridled power for 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.

the world devours.name: The World Devours
the world devours.text: The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a 20-foot burst, the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a 30-foot burst or…

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.
The creature takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC.

The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and slowed 1, and takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect.

the world whispers.name: The World Whispers
the world whispers.text: Your waking world tells you about the unseen creatures it holds. You Seek in your waking world. If you succeed or critically succeed against a creature that was undetected by you, you Point Out the creature to any allies in your waking world.

their master's call.name: Their Master's Call
their master's call.text: In a pinch, you pull one of your inactive companions from their rest to provide a companion's support benefit. A fragment of your companion materializes or assembles itself in an unoccupied square of your choice within 30 feet of you, grants you its support benefit, and then disappears on your next turn.

theoretical acumen.name: Theoretical Acumen
theoretical acumen.text: You study a creature’s form and behavior to hypothesize likely means of overcoming its strengths. Once before the end of your next turn, you can use the skill modifier from the triggering check in place of your saving throw modifier against one of the creature’s abilities, in place of your Perception modifier to Seek t…
theoretical acumen.trigger: You succeed at a skill check to Recall Knowledge to identify a creature.

thermal nimbus.name: Thermal Nimbus
thermal nimbus.text: You direct waves of warmth into or out of your kinetic gate to drastically shift the temperature around you. Choose cold or fire. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance equal to your level to damage of that type.

think twice.name: Think Twice
think twice.text: You make a sudden threat toward a creature about to attack you that makes them flinch, throwing off their aim. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. This reaction can’t be triggered by the same creature again for 1 day.
think twice.trigger: A creature that’s frightened targets you with an attack.

thousand visions.name: Thousand Visions
thousand visions.text: You open your senses to numerous visions of the immediate future. The visions grant you subtle details of your immediate surroundings within 30 feet. Within this range, you don't need to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature, you're not off-guard to creatures that are hidden from you (unless you're off…

thousand-year grudge.name: Thousand-Year Grudge
thousand-year grudge.text: You can call upon your former lives and project all of your accumulated frustration, failure, and despair through your eyes at a target, overwhelming their senses. One creature you successfully Demoralized becomes sickened instead of frightened, with the same condition value.
thousand-year grudge.trigger: You succeed at a Demoralize check.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.text: You thrash your foe around. An enemy you have grabbed or restrained takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier plus your weapon specialization damage plus your Rage damage, with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.
thrash.requirements: You have an enemy grabbed or restrained.

threatening pursuit.name: Threatening Pursuit
threatening pursuit.text: You emit a terrifying growl and snort, stamping your hooves for all to hear so that they know that you hunt them. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize all enemies within 30 feet, and you do not take a penalty for not sharing a language.
threatening pursuit.requirements: You are not observed by any enemies within 60 feet.

through spell.name: Through Spell
through spell.text: Spells you cast can transform briefly into vital essence, traveling harmlessly through living and undead creatures between you and your target, blocked only by solid objects.

throw and catch.name: Throw and Catch
throw and catch.text: You hurl your warshard weapon at an opponent, even though the weapon isn’t designed to be thrown. Spend a Mythic Point. Your weapon gains the thrown trait with a range increment of 40 feet; if your weapon already has the thrown trait, increase its range increment by 40 feet.
throw and catch.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87
throw and catch.requirements: You are wielding a melee warshard weapon.

thunder clap.name: Thunder Clap
