thunder clap.text: You slam your hands together to unleash a deafening blast. Creatures in a 15-foot cone take 3d6 sonic damage, with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. Creatures that critically fail their save are also deafened for 1 minute.
thunder clap.source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

thunderclap spell.name: Thunderclap Spell
thunderclap spell.text: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the electricity trait or deals electricity damage, has no duration, and requires creatures to attempt a saving throw, the force of the spell’s lightning creates a thunderclap, in addition to its other effects…

thundering surge.name: Thundering Surge
thundering surge.text: Your magic explodes in bursts of excess energy, creating thunderous waves. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, attempt a DC 5 flat check.

outcomes.text: Enemies within a 10-foot radius burst centered on the target of the spell or within the spell’s area of effect take sonic damage equal to twice your level (basic Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). Those who fail the save are also knocked prone.

Enemies within a 10-foot radius burst centered on the target of the spell or within the spell’s area of effect take sonic damage equal to your level (basic Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). Those who critically fail the save are also knocked prone.

All creatures within a 10-foot radius burst centered on you take sonic damage equal to your level (basic Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). Those who fail the save are also knocked prone.

thunderous landing.name: Thunderous Landing
thunderous landing.text: You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing. You Fly and, if you end your movement on a solid surface, your landing sends out a shock wave of air. Each creature within 10 feet of your landing position must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be pushed 10 feet away. This is forced movement.
thunderous landing.requirements: You currently have a fly Speed and are airborne.

thwart evil.name: Thwart Evil
thwart evil.text: You react instinctively when you sense evil forming, thrusting your spiritual energy toward the source to snuff out evil before it fully manifests. Attempt to counteract the triggering spell or ability using your Religion modifier as your counteract modifier.
thwart evil.trigger: A creature you can see uses a spell or ability that has the evil or negative traits.

tidal hands.name: Tidal Hands
tidal hands.text: With an emphatic gesture, you create waves that rush out from you in the shape of your hands. You either form two 15-foot cones that don't overlap or you combine the hands into one 30-foot cone. Each creature in a wave takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

tidal shield.name: Tidal Shield
tidal shield.text: You conjure the force of the tides to gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. Any allies adjacent to you during the duration gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC as long as they remain adjacent to you. You can Sustain the effect to a maximum duration of 5 rounds.

tidal wave.name: Tidal Wave
tidal wave.text: Like the ocean in a storm, you overwhelm your opponents with speed and force. Move up to your Speed and make two Strikes. These Strikes can happen at any point during your movement. If either Strike reduces a target to 0 Hit Points, you gain the quickened condition for 1 round.

tiger slash.name: Tiger Slash
tiger slash.text: You make a fierce swipe with both hands. Make a tiger claw Strike. It deals two extra weapon damage dice (three extra dice if you're 14th level or higher), and you can push the target 5 feet away as if you had successfully Shoved them.

tiger stance.name: Tiger Stance
tiger stance.text: You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits. On a critical success with your tiger claws, if you deal damage, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

tight follower.name: Tight Follower
tight follower.text: You keep up as a protector. Stride up to your Speed closer to your designated ally. Your movement must end within 10 feet of your designated ally.
tight follower.trigger: Your designated ally moves and ends that movement more than 10 feet from you.

tikling bird twirl.name: Tikling Bird Twirl
tikling bird twirl.text: You trained your footwork by dancing to music between snapping bamboo poles, and your increased mobility helps you succeed when hunting dangerous beasts or fighting multiple opponents. This style of bobbing and weaving and alternating fight and flight disorients your enemies and allows you to choose your engagements.
tikling bird twirl.trigger: You roll a critical hit on a melee Strike against an enemy.

timber sentinel.name: Timber Sentinel
timber sentinel.text: A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood. You conjure a tree within 30 feet, as a protector tree spell of a rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends, and an ordinary tree remains.

time dilation cascade.name: Time Dilation Cascade
time dilation cascade.text: You borrow a bit of time from the future to act now. Make six Strikes. Your multiple attack penalty applies normally to these Strikes. If you successfully hit a creature with multiple Strikes, combine those Strikes' damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
time dilation cascade.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 77

timeline-splitting spell.name: Timeline-Splitting Spell
timeline-splitting spell.text: You invest in two futures, then choose the one to make a reality. You Cast two Spells that each take 1 or 2 actions to cast. These can't be the same spell heightened to two different ranks. You expend the resources for both spells, such as spell slots, Focus Points, and costs, such as gp or valuables.

titan swing.name: Titan Swing
titan swing.text: Your limbs tense as you deliver a mighty swing. Make a melee Strike. If it hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage and push the target back by 5 feet. If you’re at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice and push the target by 10 feet, and if you’re at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice an…

to battle!.name: To Battle!
to battle!.text: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive. Choose one ally in your marshal’s aura who has a reaction available. If you spend 1 action, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Stride. If you spend 2 actions, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Strike.

to me!.name: To Me!
to me!.text: Two lives spent in adventuring groups has given you a special gift for bolstering party morale and pushing your allies to achieve greater ends when they work as a team. Spend a Mythic Point to rally your allies to your side to regroup or push your advantage. Stride and then make a melee Strike.
to me!.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

to thine own self.name: To Thine Own Self
to thine own self.text: Awareness of your past perils protects you from those who would manipulate your thoughts. Attempt to counteract the triggering effect using your Incarnation Lore modifier as your counteract modifier and half your level as your counteract rank.
to thine own self.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78
to thine own self.trigger: You fail a saving throw against an effect that would alter your memory or cause you to become controlled by another creature.

to war!.name: To War!
to war!.text: You inspire your allies to greater battle prowess while trampling enemies in your way. You Command your apocalypse mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim, if it has the corresponding movement type), moving through the space of any foes in your path up to one size smaller than your apoc…
to war!.requirements: You are riding your apocalypse mount.

token of inspiration.name: Token Of Inspiration
token of inspiration.text: You grant an adjacent ally a token of your goodwill, most commonly a strand of your hair. For the next hour, that ally gains a +1 status bonus to Crafting checks, Performance checks, and Will saving throws. When the duration ends, they become immune to Token of Inspiration for 24 hours.

tongue disarm.name: Tongue Disarm
tongue disarm.text: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe. You attempt to Disarm a creature within 10 feet, ignoring the requirement that you must have at least one hand free.

too angry to die.name: Too Angry to Die
too angry to die.text: You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed. For you, such a brush with death is less something to fear and more a thing to become infuriated by. As you stand up, you roar in defiance and can attempt to Demoralize a foe.
too angry to die.trigger: you stand up from prone after waking up from being unconscious

too much to swallow.name: Too Much to Swallow
too much to swallow.text: While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice. You cast untamed form. If you took on a new form that's too large for the effect, you automatically escape. Otherwise, you attempt to Escape.
too much to swallow.trigger: You’re subject to an effect you could attempt to Escape.

topple foe.name: Topple Foe
topple foe.text: You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet. Attempt an Athletics check to Trip the target of the triggering attack.
topple foe.trigger: An ally succeeds at a melee Strike against an enemy you are both adjacent to.

topple the titans.name: Topple the Titans
topple the titans.text: Even the greatest titans of the world are easier to kill when they’re lying on the ground. You’ve made it your mission to topple such giants and can make others fall with a force that shakes the very earth.
topple the titans.source:
Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
 pg. 79
topple the titans.requirements: Your previous action was a successful or critically successful Trip against a creature at least one size larger than you, and the enemy became prone.

toppling transformation.name: Toppling Transformation
toppling transformation.text: You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature. You attempt to Shove or Trip an adjacent creature. For the purposes of determining what size creature you can affect, use your final size after the triggering effect.
toppling transformation.trigger: Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

torch goblin.name: Torch Goblin
torch goblin.text: You’ve spent enough time on fire that you know how to use it to your advantage. You can light yourself thoroughly on fire with a held torch, a bottle of alchemist’s fire, or a similar incendiary, dealing yourself 1d6 persistent fire damage.

torrent in the blood.name: Torrent in the Blood
torrent in the blood.text: A healing wave splashes across creatures in a 30-foot cone, its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body. Each creature in the area regains 3d8 Hit Points and can attempt a new save against one poison or disease affliction affecting it; on a failed save, the condition doesn't worsen.

torrential backlash.name: Torrential Backlash
torrential backlash.text: Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you. All creatures within your curse maelstrom emanation except you take 1d6 void damage for each level you have, with a basic Fortitude save, using the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
torrential backlash.requirements: You’re in a curse maelstrom state.

touch focus.name: Touch Focus
touch focus.text: You can redirect a spell's power through you to deliver it within striking distance. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with 1 or more targets and a range farther than touch, you can change the range to touch. If the altered spell requires a spell attack roll, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack.

tough cookie.name: Tough Cookie
tough cookie.text: Though you've taken a lot of punishment, you aren't easily brought down. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your maximum Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
tough cookie.requirements: Your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or less.

towering presence.name: Towering Presence
towering presence.text: You tap into your planar heritage and momentarily grow larger through force of will. Increase your size to Large until the beginning of your next turn. Your equipment grows with you but returns to its original size if removed. You become clumsy 1.

towering transformation.name: Towering Transformation
towering transformation.text: The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core. Each enemy smaller than your new size within 30 feet of you must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature becomes frightened 1.
The creature becomes frightened 2, and you can push it up to 10 feet from you. This is forced movement.

towering transformation.trigger: Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

tracing trance.name: Tracing Trance
tracing trance.text: Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct. You become quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Trace a Rune (including to supply 1 action if using the 2-action version of Trace Rune). Focused on the act of creation, you can’t use invocation actions this turn.

tragic lament.name: Tragic Lament
tragic lament.text: You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker. The Strike deals normal damage rather than critical damage as your foe relents on their attack at the last moment as they’re moved by your words, though other effects that happen on…
tragic lament.trigger: A creature you’re aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.

trample.name: Trample
trample.text: You know how to leverage your size and momentum when using your horns attack, and can use your movement speed to overrun your foes. You Stride up to double your Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller than you, Trampling each creature whose space you enter.

trample (centaur).name: Trample (Centaur)
trample (centaur).text: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm. Stride up to double your Speed; you can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample.

trample mimicry.name: Trample Mimicry
trample mimicry.text: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample Mimicry.

trampling charge.name: Trampling Charge
trampling charge.text: You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path. You command your mount to Stride up to double its Speed (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim, if it has the corresponding movement type), moving through the spaces of any foes in your path up to one size smaller than your mount.
trampling charge.requirements: You are riding a mount that has a melee Strike using its legs (claw, talons, hoof, etc.).

trance of celerity.name: Trance of Celerity
trance of celerity.text: Your feet move faster, almost out of your conscious control. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds for 1 minute. If you become cursebound 2 at any point during this duration, the bonus increases to a +10-foot status bonus.

transcendent deflection.name: Transcendent Deflection
transcendent deflection.text: You charge your weapon with spiritual energy and intercept the attack. The weapon becomes broken, and the target is unharmed by the attack. If you’re carrying another one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon, you can immediately Swap it for the broken weapon.
transcendent deflection.trigger: An enemy within your reach would damage you or your ally with an attack.
transcendent deflection.requirements: You're wielding a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon.

transfusion.name: Transfusion
transfusion.text: You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself. You touch a willing creature and grant them fast healing 1 for 5 rounds. You can spend an additional 5 sanguimancy Hit Points to increase the fast healing by 1, to a maximum of 8.

transpose.name: Transpose
transpose.text: You switch places with your eidolon. You each teleport to the other’s position. Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

transpose etching.name: Transpose Etching
transpose etching.text: With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere. You move any one of your runes within 30 feet to a different eligible target within 30 feet.

treacherous earth.name: Treacherous Earth
treacherous earth.text: You have the power to shatter the earth into a shape of your devising. You crack the ground beneath you, creating difficult terrain in a 5-foot burst centered on one corner of your space.

treat condition.name: Treat Condition
treat condition.text: You treat an adjacent creature in an attempt to reduce the clumsy, enfeebled, or sickened condition. If a creature has multiple conditions from this list, choose one.

outcomes.text: Reduce the condition value by 2.
Reduce the condition value by 1.
Increase the condition value by 1.

treat condition.requirements: You are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free.

tree of duality.name: Tree of Duality
tree of duality.text: An ephemeral tree bursts forth, floating on air in an unoccupied square of your choice within 60 feet. Blooming flowers and fungal growths shed pollen and spores, which a swirling gust of air spreads in a 10-foot emanation around it.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.text: You unleash a small, localized tremor in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails is knocked prone. Earth and stone in the area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

trespass teleportation.name: Trespass Teleportation
trespass teleportation.text: You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation. You teleport along with the enemy, appearing the same direction and distance from it as you were before it teleported (or the nearest unoccupied space if your destination is occupied).
trespass teleportation.trigger: The target of your Exploit Vulnerability is within 120 feet and uses a teleportation effect.
trespass teleportation.requirements: You are benefiting from Exploit Vulnerability.

trial by skyfire.name: Trial by Skyfire
trial by skyfire.text: Your lips murmur as you portend a great disaster, one you hope you survive. A rain of blazing bolts begins to fall from the heavens in a 10-foot emanation, centered on you, that deals 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in the emanation at the end of each of your turns (basic Reflex save); you can't exclude yourself from…

triangle shot.name: Triangle Shot
triangle shot.text: You string three arrows to your bow and fire them all at once. Make three ranged Strikes against a single target with the required weapon, each using your current multiple attack penalty, and you take an additional –2 penalty.
triangle shot.requirements: You are in Monastic Archer Stance and wielding a bow usable with that stance.

tributary circulation.name: Tributary Circulation
tributary circulation.text: Never distant from water’s succoring presence, your refined breathing techniques focus your awareness and control of water inward. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves and saves against poison until the beginning of your next turn.

trick magic item.name: Trick Magic Item
trick magic item.text: You examine a magic item you normally couldn't use in an effort to fool it and activate it temporarily. For example, this might allow a fighter to cast a spell from a wand or allow a wizard to cast a spell that's not on the arcane list using a scroll.

outcomes.text: For the rest of the current turn, you can spend actions to activate the item as if you could normally use it.
You can’t use the item or try to trick it again this turn, but you can try again on subsequent turns.
You can’t use the item, and you can’t try to trick it again until your next daily preparations.

trick shot.name: Trick Shot
trick shot.text: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby. Make a Strike with your firearm against an AC equal to an easy DC for your level. On a success, instead of hitting your foe, your attack hits an object behind or to the side of your target, creating one of the following effects.
trick shot.requirements: You're wielding a loaded crossbow or firearm.

trickster's ace.name: Trickster's Ace
trickster's ace.text: Whether from jury-rigged magic items, deduction from the study of magical interactions, or other means, you have a contingency in your back pocket for desperate situations. When the trigger occurs, you cause the spell to come into effect.
trickster's ace.trigger: You specify the trigger when you make your daily preparations.
trickster's ace.requirements: When you make your daily preparations, you must specify a trigger for this reaction using the same restrictions as the triggers for the Ready action. You also choose a single spell from the arcane, divine, occult, or primal list of 4th level or lower. The spell can’t have a cost, nor can its casting time be more than 10 minutes. The spell must be able to target a single creature, and you must be a valid target for it.

triggerbrand blitz.name: Triggerbrand Blitz
triggerbrand blitz.text: You dance through your foes, stabbing and shooting. You Stride, making up to three Strikes with your combination weapon at any point during your movement, each against a different target.

triggerbrand salvo.name: Triggerbrand Salvo
triggerbrand salvo.text: You slice, stab, or batter your opponent with the melee portion of your combination weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range. Make a melee Strike with your combination weapon.

tripkee glide.name: Tripkee Glide
tripkee glide.text: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down (10 feet if you don't have both hands free) and up to 25 feet forward through the air.
tripkee glide.requirements: You must have at least one hand free.

triumphant inspiration.name: Triumphant Inspiration
triumphant inspiration.text: With a triumphant shout, you inspire your allies. You cast a composition cantrip you know that normally takes a single action to cast.
triumphant inspiration.trigger: You critically hit a foe with a melee weapon Strike or a melee unarmed attack

true gaze.name: True Gaze
true gaze.text: When you focus your eyes carefully, your gaze can pierce through all obfuscations, even magical ones. When you use True Gaze, you gain the effects of a 6th-level true seeing spell, using your Perception modifier for the counteract check.

true hypercognition.name: True Hypercognition
true hypercognition.text: Your mind works at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to five Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can’t use them for these actions.

true senses.name: True Senses
true senses.text: Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions. You can heighten your senses to non-magically gain the effects of a 6th-rank truesight spell for 10 minutes. The ability to “see through” illusions and polymorph effects applies to any precise sense you possess.

tumbling diversion.name: Tumbling Diversion
tumbling diversion.text: Attempt to Tumble Through an opponent's space. If you succeed or critically succeed and don't end your movement adjacent to that opponent, you can attempt to Create a Diversion to distract that opponent.

tumbling lumber.name: Tumbling Lumber
tumbling lumber.text: A slew of logs eject from the Plane of Wood and slam into your enemies. They roll in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line. Non-magical difficult terrain on any ground the logs roll over is smashed flat; greater difficult terrain remains.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage.
The creature takes full damage and is pushed out of the line in the most direct path available.
The creature takes double damage and is knocked prone.

tumbling opportunist.name: Tumbling Opportunist
tumbling opportunist.text: You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back. You attempt to Trip the enemy whose space you moved through. You can use Acrobatics instead of Athletics for this check.
tumbling opportunist.requirements: Your most recent action was to Tumble Through or Tumbling Strike, and you successfully moved through an enemy’s space.

tumbling strike.name: Tumbling Strike
tumbling strike.text: You deftly dive through a gap left by a foe to deliver an advantageous blow. Attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of an enemy adjacent to you.

outcomes.text: You move through the enemy’s space to an unoccupied space on the other side of the enemy from your starting position. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions. You can’t move farther than your Speed, and you must end your movement adjacent to the enemy whose space you moved through.
As critical success, but the enemy isn’t off-guard against the Strike.
You remain in your original space but can still Strike.
You neither move nor Strike.

tumbling strike.requirements: You are adjacent to an enemy.

tunnel roll.name: Tunnel Roll
tunnel roll.text: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball. You roll up and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling.

tunnel wall.name: Tunnel Wall
tunnel wall.text: Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone. You Raise a Shield and become anchored for 1 round. While anchored, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DC to Tumble Through your space.

turn away misfortune.name: Turn Away Misfortune
turn away misfortune.text: You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck. Turn Away Misfortune's fortune trait cancels out the misfortune effect, causing you to roll normally.
turn away misfortune.trigger: You would attempt a roll affected by a misfortune effect.

turn back the clock.name: Turn Back the Clock
turn back the clock.text: After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again. You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus as you apply your experience from your last attempt. You must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.
turn back the clock.trigger: You fail a skill check or saving throw.

turn the wheel of seasons.name: Turn the Wheel of Seasons
turn the wheel of seasons.text: The seasons shift rapidly. This impulse affects a cube 100 feet in each dimension within 1,000 feet. Choose the starting season. The impulse lasts for 4 rounds, proceeding to the next season at the start of each of your turns. You can't use this impulse again until the previous one ends.

turn to mist.name: Turn to Mist
turn to mist.text: You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of gaseous form.

tut-tut.name: Tut-Tut
tut-tut.text: The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do. From that vigilante's techniques, you've learned how to pull a deadly blow at the last moment, threatening your target instead of striking them.
tut-tut.trigger: You hit a creature with a melee attack roll.

twin feint.name: Twin Feint
twin feint.text: You use an attack with one weapon to distract your foe from a second attack coming at a different angle. Make one Strike with each of your two melee weapons, both against the same target. The target is automatically off-guard against the second attack. Apply your multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.
twin feint.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

twin parry.name: Twin Parry
twin parry.text: You use your two weapons to parry attacks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if either weapon has the parry trait. You lose this circumstance bonus if you no longer meet this feat’s requirement.
twin parry.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

twin riposte.name: Twin Riposte
twin riposte.text: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon. Make a melee Strike or Disarm action against the triggering opponent.
twin riposte.trigger: A creature within your reach critically fails to Strike you
twin riposte.requirements: You are benefiting from Twin Parry

twin shot knockdown.name: Twin Shot Knockdown
twin shot knockdown.text: You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance. Make two Strikes against the same target, one with each of the required weapons. If both Strikes are successful, the target is also knocked prone.
twin shot knockdown.requirements: You're wielding a loaded crossbow or loaded firearm in each hand.

twin takedown.name: Twin Takedown
twin takedown.text: You swiftly attack your hunted prey with each of your weapons, potentially combining their damage into a single devastating attack. Make two Strikes against your hunted prey, one with each of the required weapons. If both hit the same hunted prey, combine their damage for the purpose of its resistances and weaknesses.
twin takedown.requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

twin weakness.name: Twin Weakness
twin weakness.text: As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh. Make a melee Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability.
twin weakness.requirements: You're holding an implement and a weapon, you are using Exploit Vulnerability with mortal weakness or personal antithesis, and the target creature is within reach of both your implement and weapon.

twinned defense (fighter).name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)
twinned defense (fighter).text: You’re always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you. While you are in this stance, you constantly gain the benefits of the Twin Parry action.
twinned defense (fighter).requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

twirling strike.name: Twirling Strike
twirling strike.text: Your fans, one raised up alongside your head and the other alongside your hip, become a blur as you twirl across the battlefield. Attempt to Tumble Through an enemy’s space using Performance; on a success, you can make a melee Strike against the enemy with a fan you’re wielding at any point during the movement.

twirling throw.name: Twirling Throw
twirling throw.text: Your thrown weapons seem to defy physics as they soar through the air and spin back to you after a strike. Make a thrown weapon Strike, ignoring the penalty for making ranged attacks within the second and third range increment.

twist the knife.name: Twist The Knife
twist the knife.text: After stabbing your opponent in a weak spot, you tear the wound open. You deal persistent bleed damage to the target equal to your number of sneak attack damage dice.
twist the knife.requirements: Your last action was a melee Strike that dealt sneak attack damage to an off-guard target

twisting petal stance.name: Twisting Petal Stance
twisting petal stance.text: Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them. You can make gale blossom strikes that deal 1d6 slashing damage. These strikes are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits.

two-element infusion.name: Two-Element Infusion
two-element infusion.text: Slamming one element into another, you combine their strengths. If the next action you use is an Elemental Blast, choose two of your kinetic elements instead of one. The blast gains the traits of both elements and uses the highest range and damage die among the two elements.

two-truths.name: Two-Truths
two-truths.text: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself. When you use this action, you alter your thought processes to your progenitor or from your progenitor back to yourself.

two-weapon flurry.name: Two-Weapon Flurry
two-weapon flurry.text: Using the momentum of your prior attack, you lash out with both your weapons in a sudden frenzy. Strike twice, once with each weapon.
two-weapon flurry.requirements: You are wielding two weapons, each in a different hand

two-weapon fusillade.name: Two-Weapon Fusillade
two-weapon fusillade.text: You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage. Strike twice, once with each weapon.
two-weapon fusillade.requirements: You're wielding two weapons, each in a different hand. At least one of these weapons must be a loaded firearm or loaded crossbow.

ultimate prank.name: Ultimate Prank
ultimate prank.text: You play the ultimate prank on your foe, causing their blow to strike their own ally as you reveal you were somewhere else entirely. Choose a creature within 30 feet other than the triggering enemy; you switch places with that creature, and the triggering attack is resolved against it as if it were the original target.…
ultimate prank.trigger: An enemy targets you with a Strike.
ultimate prank.requirements: There’s at least one creature other than the triggering creature within 30 feet.

umbra ally.name: Umbra Ally
umbra ally.text: Regardless of the prevailing light conditions, your shadow begins to dance around your enemies, flummoxing their ability to defend themselves. Until the start of your next turn, your shadow darts around your foes, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach.

unbalancing appearance.name: Unbalancing Appearance
unbalancing appearance.text: When you attack from the shadows, your foes are thrown off balance. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If your Strike hits, the target remains off-guard for the rest of your turn and is clumsy 1 (clumsy 2 on a critical hit) until the beginning of your next turn.
unbalancing appearance.requirements: A creature within your reach is off-guard to you, and you are unnoticed by that creature.

unbalancing finisher.name: Unbalancing Finisher
unbalancing finisher.text: You attack with a flashy assault that leaves your target off balance. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

unbalancing sweep.name: Unbalancing Sweep
unbalancing sweep.text: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you. Choose up to three enemies within your reach and choose whether to Shove or Trip all three of them.

unbelievable interception.name: Unbelievable Interception
unbelievable interception.text: You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy’s attack. Spend a Mythic Point; stride twice directly toward the triggering enemy. If you end within the attack’s range or reach, you become the target of the triggering Strike, using the original attack roll and comparing the result to your AC.
unbelievable interception.trigger: An enemy you’re observing attempts to Strike an ally you can also observe.

unbreakable resolve.name: Unbreakable Resolve
unbreakable resolve.text: The experience of coming back after death has granted you a strong sense of resolve; devilish words, slick spells, and conniving trickery can’t easily catch you unprepared. Reroll the triggering save, using the second result only if it’s better.

unbreaking castle.name: Unbreaking Castle
unbreaking castle.text: You’re the bulwark that doesn’t break. Spend a Mythic Point, and Raise a Shield or position the required weapon to parry; for the next minute, whenever you Raise a Shield or position a weapon to parry (including when you first use this ability), all allies you can see gain the shield or weapon’s circumstance bonus to A…
unbreaking castle.requirements: You’re wielding a shield or a weapon with the parry trait.

uncanny prediction.name: Uncanny Prediction
uncanny prediction.text: You have an eerie ability to guess the next move of creatures you've Sized Up. You inform a foe that you know exactly what it'll do next, momentarily shocking it into inaction.
uncanny prediction.requirements: You're benefiting from the bonuses of Size Up.

underhanded assault.name: Underhanded Assault
underhanded assault.text: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally. You Sneak up to a foe adjacent to one of your allies. You can roll against the foe you’re Sneaking up on, even if it’s currently observing you, as though you were hidden. You take a –2 penalty on your Stealth check.

unerring runic attraction.name: Unerring Runic Attraction
unerring runic attraction.text: Your runes act as beacons for your arrows and bolts. Make a ranged Strike against a foe you’re aware of that’s currently bearing a rune and within your first range increment. The ammunition homes in on your target, even going around corners.

unexpected shift.name: Unexpected Shift
unexpected shift.text: Your supernatural connection sometimes causes you to phase from reality when under threat, disappearing for split seconds before reappearing—often surprising you as much as your enemies. Roll a DC 16 flat check.
unexpected shift.trigger: You would take damage from an attack, spell, or other effect.

unfaltering ranks.name: Unfaltering Ranks
unfaltering ranks.text: You know all too well the dangers of succumbing to fear, and you know how to remove this weakness from your allies. Attempt an Intimidation check, comparing it to the Will DC of allies in a 60-foot emanation who can hear you. Each of them is temporarily immune to this ability for 10 minutes.

outcomes.text: The ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that remain for 1 round. The ally gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to their Speeds for 1 round. Reduce the ally’s frightened value by 2. If the ally wasn’t frightened, they instead gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear for 1 minute.
The ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level that remain for 1 round. The ally gains a +5-foot circumstance bonus to their Speeds for 1 round. Reduce the ally’s frightened value by 1.

unfazed assessment.name: Unfazed Assessment
unfazed assessment.text: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers. Choose a creature within 30 feet who you’re aware of, and attempt a Perception check against that target’s Will DC.
unfazed assessment.source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

unfetter sight.name: Unfetter Sight
unfetter sight.text: You release the magic within your mask in an invisible burst, allowing it to temporarily flow into your allies' minds. Each of your allies within a 30-foot emanation gains the benefits of Signifer's Sight for 1 minute, as if they were wearing a signifer's mask.

unfettering strike.name: Unfettering Strike
unfettering strike.text: With a damaging blow, you cause a foe to loosen their grip on an ally they're holding down. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If you hit and deal damage, your ally can attempt to Escape from being grabbed or restrained as a free action.
unfettering strike.requirements: A creature within your reach has an ally grabbed or restrained.

unified stance.name: Unified Stance
unified stance.text: You and your companion enter a unified fighting style that allows you to fight in tandem more succinctly. When you enter this stance, your united companion gains the quickened condition and, when Commanded, can use the extra action to Stride or Strike.

united assault.name: United Assault
united assault.text: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies. Make a Strike. Your Strike gains a circumstance bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of other different creatures that damaged the target since the end of the target's last turn, to a maximum of a +4 circumstance bonus.

universal longevity.name: Universal Longevity
universal longevity.text: You’ve perfected your ability to keep up with all the skills you’ve learned over your long life, so you’re almost never truly untrained at a skill. You reflect on your life experiences, changing the skill you selected with Ancestral Longevity (and the skill you selected with Expert Longevity if you have that feat).

unkillable.name: Unkillable
unkillable.text: You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart. You are reduced to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. You must succeed at a DC 6 flat check or your body deteriorates.
unkillable.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 HP.

unleash the blight.name: Unleash the Blight
unleash the blight.text: You unleash the rot infecting you, spreading the blight to those nearby. All living creatures in a 60-foot emanation take 1d6 void damage for every 2 levels you have, with a basic Fortitude save.
unleash the blight.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

unlimited potential.name: Unlimited Potential
unlimited potential.text: The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

unnerving expansion.name: Unnerving Expansion
unnerving expansion.text: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom. The radius of the emanation of your curse maelstrom state increases by 5 feet until the end of your curse maelstrom state. The outpouring of the curse is unnerving.

unnerving prowess.name: Unnerving Prowess
unnerving prowess.text: Your incredible skill with your blade unnerves your foes. You attempt to Demoralize the target of your Strike or Disarm. This Demoralize attempt does not have the auditory trait, nor do you take a penalty to the check if the target doesn't understand your language.
unnerving prowess.trigger: You critically succeed at a Strike or Disarm with your Aldori dueling sword, or succeed at a Strike or Disarm attempt with your Aldori dueling sword against an opponent during your first turn of an encounter.

unnerving terror.name: Unnerving Terror
unnerving terror.text: You let out a mighty howl, chant of death, or speak with eerie repetition that plants fear in others. All enemies within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is frightened 1.
The target is frightened 1 and off-guard.
The target is frightened 2 and off-guard.

unobstructed shot.name: Unobstructed Shot
unobstructed shot.text: With a quick use of brute force, you remove an obstacle and take a calculated shot as part of the same motion. Attempt to Shove or Trip one adjacent creature, then make a ranged Strike with a bow or crossbow you're wielding.

unrivaled performer.name: Unrivaled Performer
unrivaled performer.text: Your skill in the performing arts is unmatched, a culmination of both your innate fey talents and an undying lifetime of refinement. If your next action is to Perform, you do so with a +4 circumstance bonus. If you fail the check to Perform, you instantly recover the use of Unrivaled Performer.

unrivaled retort.name: Unrivaled Retort
unrivaled retort.text: You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack. Spend a Mythic Point and attempt the triggering save at mythic proficiency.
unrivaled retort.trigger: You are about to attempt a Fortitude or Reflex save against an area effect and are wielding a ranged weapon.

unseat.name: Unseat
unseat.text: With a mighty blow from atop your companion, you attempt to knock an opponent off their mount. Make a melee Strike against a mounted creature. If your attack hits, attempt an Athletics check against the target’s Fortitude DC.
unseat.requirements: You are riding your mount and wielding a Jousting weapon.

unsheathing the sword-light.name: Unsheathing the Sword-Light
unsheathing the sword-light.text: Honed through 10,000 battles, your sword’s mere light can shatter ambitions and break armies. Make a melee Spellstrike with a sword, with a spell that isn’t a cantrip or focus spell.
unsheathing the sword-light.requirements: Your Spellstrike is charged, and you're wielding a one-handed weapon in the sword group.

unstable gearshift.name: Unstable Gearshift
unstable gearshift.text: You shift your body into a higher gear, your speed compounding further and further. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

unstable redundancies.name: Unstable Redundancies
unstable redundancies.text: You've built triple redundancies into your innovation and added all sorts of buffers to protect it from the harm of your unstable experiments. You automatically succeed at the triggering flat check. You can't rely on your Unstable Redundancies again until you spend 10 minutes setting them back up.
unstable redundancies.trigger: You would attempt the flat check for an unstable action, but you haven't rolled the flat check yet.

unsteadying strike.name: Unsteadying Strike
unsteadying strike.text: Your attack makes your opponent more susceptible to follow-up maneuvers from your allies. Make a melee Strike against an enemy within your reach. If the Strike is successful, the enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their Fortitude DC to resist being Grappled, Repositioned, or Shoved and a –2 circumstance penalty t…

unusual composition.name: Unusual Composition
unusual composition.text: You can translate the emotion and power of a composition to other mediums. If your next action is to cast a composition spell that is auditory or visual, you can have it affect creatures who can witness it with any sense, not just those the traits indicate, even including special senses like tremorsense.

unwind death.name: Unwind Death
unwind death.text: Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death. Attempt a DC 40 Crafting check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds.
unwind death.requirements: The target's body must be mostly intact.

upset balance.name: Upset Balance
upset balance.text: You lean into your foe's attack, using the weight of your body and armor to send them reeling. Attempt an Athletics check against the creature's Reflex DC. On a success, the target becomes clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn (clumsy 2 on a critical success).
upset balance.trigger: You are damaged by a melee Strike.

urgent upwelling.name: Urgent Upwelling
urgent upwelling.text: Defeat lets you to tap into your wellspring. Attempt the flat check for wellspring magic. If you critically succeed, you can choose to forgo gaining a temporary spell slot to instead have the triggering enemy undergo a wellspring surge.
urgent upwelling.trigger: An enemy reduces you to 0 HP, an enemy critically hits you, or you critically fail a saving throw against an enemy's effect.

ursine avenger form.name: Ursine Avenger Form
ursine avenger form.text: You draw the Ursine Avenger Hood over your head and its fur over your arms, assuming an ursine form that has traits of your original form as well as that of a bear.

usurp the lunar reins.name: Usurp the Lunar Reins
usurp the lunar reins.text: The moon has always been connected to the tides, and now you can grasp that connection. You can create massive amounts of water and control these tides, subverting even the moon's sovereignty over the oceans and seas.

uzunjati recollection.name: Uzunjati Recollection
uzunjati recollection.text: You tell a story spontaneously from nearly forgotten facts, delving into your memory and entertaining your audience in the process. Recall Knowledge with a skill in which you have master proficiency, then use Uzunjati Storytelling with the same skill.

uzunjati storytelling.name: Uzunjati Storytelling
uzunjati storytelling.text: You tell a quick story or begin telling a longer tale. This is most useful when you want to prove your scholarly credibility or impress someone quickly. Roll a check with a skill that can be used to Recall Knowledge in which you have expert proficiency, using the result entry for the Perform action.

vacate vision.name: Vacate Vision
vacate vision.text: You cause your eyes to liquefy and run out of your eye sockets, leaving them empty. You get a success on the save against the triggering effect, but you are blinded for the duration the effect would have had on a failure. At that time, your eyes regrow and your normal vision returns.
vacate vision.trigger: You fail (but don't critically fail) a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait.

vampiric spell.name: Vampiric Spell
vampiric spell.text: Your magic drains the life from your enemy. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the initial damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage from the spell.

vaulting gallop.name: Vaulting Gallop
vaulting gallop.text: You've trained your mount to vault over obstacles at high speeds. You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride twice. During this movement, your mount can Leap over obstacles of its size and smaller as well as creatures up to its size, though it must end this movement on solid ground.

veil of the first world.name: Veil Of The First World
veil of the first world.text: With a burst of movement, you partially phase into the First World for defense. You become concealed until the end of your next turn. You remain visible while stepping into the First World this way, so you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

vengeance strike.name: Vengeance Strike
vengeance strike.text: You lash out at the foe who dared to attack you. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy. If you hit and deal damage, the enemy is off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.
vengeance strike.trigger: An enemy damages you and is within your reach.

vengeful spirit deck.name: Vengeful Spirit Deck
vengeful spirit deck.text: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards. Draw a card from a harrow deck, then select a target within 60 feet. The card flies through the air to strike at that target, inflicting 4d6 damage, with a basic saving throw against your class DC.
vengeful spirit deck.requirements: You have an active harrow omen.

vengeful strike.name: Vengeful Strike
vengeful strike.text: When struck by an enemy, you respond in turn. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical success, you can use Vengeful Strike as a free action instead of a reaction.
vengeful strike.trigger: A creature within your reach succeeds at an attack against you.
vengeful strike.requirements: You’re under the effect of Come and Get Me.

vengful remnant.name: Vengful Remnant
vengful remnant.text: You wreathe yourself in the tatters of all the souls claimed by your blade. Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality, doubled if the source of the damage is non-magical.

venipuncture.name: Venipuncture
venipuncture.text: A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward, lacerating foes in a 30-foot emanation. The needles deal piercing damage equal to double the number of sanguimancy Hit Points you spent, to a maximum of 80 damage.

venom purge.name: Venom Purge
venom purge.text: You produce a specialized venom that burns out other toxins and impurities in your body. For each disease or poison currently affecting you, attempt a Medicine check to counteract that disease or poison. As normal, your counteract level is equal to half your level rounded up.

verbose distraction.name: Verbose Distraction
verbose distraction.text: Nethys Note: This is a part of the April Fool's content from Paizo's blogs. You talk so much it can be distracting to your enemies and you’re often quick to remind your enemies that you’re just a little guy! You don’t need to be targeted! You don’t need to be the focus of their frustrations! Have they tried writing to…
verbose distraction.trigger: You are the target of a physical melee attack.

verdant presence.name: Verdant Presence
verdant presence.text: The life-giving properties of the aeon orbs flourish within you. Small plants or fungi magically appear on all surfaces in a 60-foot emanation around you. This life withers after 1 day unless the environment can support it. You can choose one of the following options each time you use this feat.
verdant presence.trigger: You take damage or cast a primal spell.

verduran ambush.name: Verduran Ambush
verduran ambush.text: You prepare to ambush a foe. You Ready an activity that takes 2 actions, though that activity must either be Death from Above or an activity with the requirement that you be hidden or undetected by all your opponents (such as Scout’s Pounce). After using the reaction, you cannot use this feat again for 10 minutes.

vermilion threads.name: Vermilion Threads
vermilion threads.text: Your Arcane Cascade sends threads to the four directions, creating a web of strings dyed by your skill and your enemies’ blood. The web fills a 15-foot burst centered on you and is difficult terrain.

vessel's form.name: Vessel's Form
vessel's form.text: You symbiotically combine your form with that of the entity within you, taking a powerful hybrid form to temporarily boost your abilities in combat while maintaining control. For 1 minute, you gain the following effects.

vexing tempest.name: Vexing Tempest
vexing tempest.text: Your familiar channels elemental air around it to unleash a disruptive gust that sends creatures flying. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has the air trait, all creatures within a 15-foot emanation of your familiar must attempt a Reflex save against your spell DC or be pushed 10 feet away.

vexing tumble.name: Vexing Tumble
vexing tumble.text: You tumble around your foes, expertly avoiding their reactions. Stride up to half your Speed and roll an Acrobatics check. Compare the result to the Reflex DC of each enemy whose reach you began in or enter during the movement, in sequence.

outcomes.text: This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy, and the enemy is off-guard to you until the end of your turn
This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy.
Your movement immediately stops when you enter the creature's reach; if you began in the creature's reach, you don't move.

vicious critique.name: Vicious Critique
vicious critique.text: You have an eye for detail and a mouth for pointing out flaws, which makes it all the easier to convince the merchants and crafters of King's Heart to help you. You quickly analyze the triggering creature's wares in hopes of finding something useful in your coercion and attempt a Crafting check.

outcomes.text: You have plenty to work with and can leave your target shocked with your analysis. If you a roll a success on your Intimidation check, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
As critical success, but you only gain the benefits when rolling a success on your Intimidation check.
You misjudge the wares, which makes you come across as unknowledgeable and less intimidating. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to your Intimidation check to Coerce.
As failure, but the penalty is –2.

vicious critique.trigger: You are about to attempt to Coerce a merchant or crafter.

vicious evisceration.name: Vicious Evisceration
vicious evisceration.text: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is drained 1, or drained 2 on a critical success.

vicious swing.name: Vicious Swing
vicious swing.text: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady. Make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.

vicious venom.name: Vicious Venom
vicious venom.text: The venom you produce is exceptionally potent and difficult to overcome. Your vishkanyan venom gains the virulent trait, requiring two consecutive saves to reduce the venom's stage by 1. A critical success reduces your venom's stage by only 1 instead of by 2.

victorious vigor.name: Victorious Vigor
victorious vigor.text: Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier until the end of your next turn.
victorious vigor.trigger: You bring a foe to 0 Hit Points.

vigil's walls rise anew!.name: Vigil's Walls Rise Anew!
vigil's walls rise anew!.text: As part of daily preparation, you can drill with a number of allies up to your Charisma modifier. These allies must be present and listening during this time, but this does not otherwise impede their own preparation.

vigorous anthem.name: Vigorous Anthem
vigorous anthem.text: You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack. If your next action is to cast the courageous anthem composition cantrip, you and all affected allies gain temporary HP equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier that last for 1 minute.

vindictive thoughts.name: Vindictive Thoughts
vindictive thoughts.text: Those who seek to do you personal harm with magic must suffer the same misfortune. Before you attempt your saving throw, spend a Mythic Point. You make this saving throw at mythic proficiency.
vindictive thoughts.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 75
vindictive thoughts.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a spell

vine lash.name: Vine Lash
vine lash.text: A long vine sprouts from your arm, which you can temporarily wield like a whip. Make a melee attack roll against a creature within 30 feet. If you succeed, the vine deals 1d6 slashing damage for every 2 levels you have to the target, or double damage on a success.
vine lash.source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

violent unleash.name: Violent Unleash
violent unleash.text: The force of your mind unleashing itself releases a violent shock wave that batters your enemies. You deal 2d6 force damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation, with a basic Reflex save. At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
violent unleash.requirements: Your previous action was to Unleash your Psyche.

viper strike.name: Viper Strike
viper strike.text: You move and attack with a swiftness that most can't follow. You Stride and then Strike. Your movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement.

virulent strike.name: Virulent Strike
virulent strike.text: Those afflicted by certain maladies are closer to death in your presence. Make a Strike against a creature. If your attack hits, the target must attempt a new saving throw against the highest-level disease or poison that is currently affecting it, possibly progressing it to a higher stage even if the affliction’s inter…

vision of foresight.name: Vision of Foresight
vision of foresight.text: You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities. Once before the end of your next turn, you can call upon these predictions before you roll a saving throw or skill check. You can roll the saving throw or skill check twice and take the better result.

vital compound invocation.name: Vital Compound Invocation
vital compound invocation.text: You can invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy to restore flesh. You Invoke two Runes—one must be a divine rune, and one must be a primal rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature that’s within 30 feet of both invoked runes regains Hit Points equal to 5 + double your level.

vitality-manipulating stance.name: Vitality-Manipulating Stance
vitality-manipulating stance.text: You have learned to attack meridians and pressure points like your rival Shino Hakusa. You gain a vitality blast ranged unarmed Strike that deals 1d4 negative damage, has a range of 30 feet, and has the unarmed and versatile positive traits.
vitality-manipulating stance.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 77

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.

The target's muscles become temporarily weaker. For 1 round, the target is enfeebled 2, and any time it attempts to take an action with the manipulate trait, the action is disrupted unless it succeeds at a flat check with a DC equal to 5 + its enfeebled value.
As success, but the duration is 1 minute.
As success, but the duration is 1 minute, the flat check is DC 11, and the target takes –10-foot status penalty to all Speeds for the duration.

vivacious afterimage.name: Vivacious Afterimage
vivacious afterimage.text: You move so quickly that you create a short-lived afterimage, looks exactly like you, in front of you or behind you. You Stride. At any point along your movement, you leave an afterimage of yourself behind. Alternatively, you can stop moving and send your afterimage forward instead, up to the remainder of your Speed.
vivacious afterimage.source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 77

vivacious bravado.name: Vivacious Bravado
vivacious bravado.text: Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier that last until the start of your next turn.

voice cold as death.name: Voice Cold as Death
voice cold as death.text: Channeling the energy of the Crimson Oath into your voice, you pronounce a threat in a tone so icy it freezes the blood. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize; you don't suffer a penalty if the target doesn't understand the language you're speaking, but this otherwise functions as normal.

void siphon (necromancer).name: Void Siphon (Necromancer)
void siphon (necromancer).text: You open your body to absorb void energy. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering void damage. After you take the triggering damage, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 round.

volcanic escape.name: Volcanic Escape
volcanic escape.text: Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you. The triggering enemy takes 1d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. You Leap up to half your Speed in any direction; this movement doesn't trigger reactions. Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d6.
volcanic escape.trigger: An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

vomit stomach.name: Vomit Stomach
vomit stomach.text: In dire circumstances you can vomit out your stomach to expel toxins. Reduce your sickened condition by 2 and immediately attempt a saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus against any ingested poisons you have been exposed to within the last minute.
vomit stomach.trigger: You gain the sickened condition or fail a saving throw against an ingested poison.

vow of mortal defiance.name: Vow of Mortal Defiance
vow of mortal defiance.text: Having seen the wreckage left by the gods and their servitors as they play in their great war of good and evil, you’ve come to the only reasonable conclusion: they all must be cut from their silken thrones. You swear a vow to defeat one creature within 60 feet that has the holy or unholy trait.

wailing dead.name: Wailing Dead
wailing dead.text: The voices of the spirits you command spark fear in the hearts of your enemies. You Sustain your horde and command those spirits to shriek in unison. Each living enemy within a 20 foot emanation from your horde takes 5d10 mental damage, depending on its Will saving throw against your spell DC.
wailing dead.requirements: Your horde is raised and consists of spirits.

wake and tremble.name: Wake and Tremble
wake and tremble.text: You have the world wake with a great convulsion. All other creatures in the area when you Rouse the World must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature falls and lands prone.
As failure, but the creature also becomes sickened 1.

wake to strife.name: Wake to Strife
wake to strife.text: You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe. The required creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC as elemental water confounds their senses; if the creature is prone, they can Stand as a free action.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target is sickened 1.
The target is sickened 2. If you have a free hand and they are not larger than you, you can attempt an Athletics check to Grapple them as a free action.
As failure, but if you succeed at the Athletics check to Grapple them, you get a critical success instead.

wake to strife.requirements: A creature within your reach is prone or swimming.

walk the plank.name: Walk the Plank
walk the plank.text: You frighten a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank. Attempt to Demoralize an opponent. On a success, in addition to the normal effects, you can also force the target to Stride up to its Speed immediately.

walk through the conflagration.name: Walk Through the Conflagration
walk through the conflagration.text: You fall through your own kinetic gate, leaving behind an effigy of flame and reappearing majestically near another fire. You instantly transport yourself, and any items you're wearing and holding, from your current space to a clear space within 120 feet you can observe that's adjacent to an open flame or a creature ta…

wall run.name: Wall Run
wall run.text: You defy gravity, traversing vertical planes as easily as the ground. Stride up to your Speed. You must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, you can run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at your full Speed.

wandering thoughts.name: Wandering Thoughts
wandering thoughts.text: When your Psyche is Unleashed, each burst of magic you cast also folds space around you, and you travel through one of those folds. You teleport 15 feet to a square you can see.
wandering thoughts.requirements: You used your most recent action to Cast a Spell.

war rider stance.name: War Rider Stance
war rider stance.text: Your dragon’s constant breath threatens your foes. While in this stance, your dragon companion has an aura in a 5-foot emanation. Each creature that starts its turn in the aura takes the damage listed under the dragon’s support benefit with a basic Reflex save against your mount’s Athletics DC.

ward casting.name: Ward Casting
ward casting.text: You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell. You reduce the DC of the flat check for Steady Spellcasting from 15 to 10.
ward casting.trigger: You attempt a flat check for Steady Spellcasting, but you haven’t rolled yet.

ward mind.name: Ward Mind
ward mind.text: To protect the knowledge within your mind from intrusion or erasure, you ward yourself against a mental attack, temporarily delaying its effects. Until the end of your next turn, you ignore a single mental effect that meets the requirement.
ward mind.requirements: You're currently affected by a mental effect that you gained by failing, but not critically failing, a saving throw.

warden's boon.name: Warden's Boon
warden's boon.text: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in Hunt Prey and your hunter’s edge to an ally until the end of their next turn. Depending on whether you call out or use gestures, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.

warden’s reload.name: Warden’s Reload
warden’s reload.text: Your mastery of magic and weapons like the crossbow allow you to wield both with equal ease. Interact to reload a weapon you are currently wielding.
warden’s reload.requirements: Your last action or activity this turn was to cast a warden spell

warning shot.name: Warning Shot
warning shot.text: Who needs words when the roar of a gun is so much more succinct? You attempt to Demoralize a foe by firing your weapon into the air, using the firearm's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.

warp likeness.name: Warp Likeness
warp likeness.text: You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own. The creature you hit must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

outcomes.text: The target is unaffected.
The target resists the effect but its form twists in the process. It's clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.
The target's body briefly warps to resemble yours. It's clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn and sickened 1.
The target’s body warps to resemble yours for a significant time. It’s clumsy 1 for 1 minute and sickened 2.

warp likeness.requirements: You hit a creature with a melee Strike on your last action.

warp path.name: Warp Path
warp path.text: You fold space around you, transporting yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. When you arrive, make a melee Strike against one creature within your weapon's reach. On a critical success, you remain veiled until the end of your next turn or until you take another hostile action.

warped constriction.name: Warped Constriction
warped constriction.text: The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness.
warped constriction.requirements: You have an enemy grabbed or restrained.

warped reflection.name: Warped Reflection
warped reflection.text: Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most. You shift your appearance to resemble a creature within 30 feet but with an unsettling, horrifying twist. Though this transformation is momentary, witnessing it gives the target deep existential dread.

watch and learn.name: Watch and Learn
watch and learn.text: Pathfinder agents serve as members of diverse teams with complementary skill sets. You are practiced at following the example of a more skilled ally to accomplish a wide variety of tasks. For the next minute you can add your level as a proficiency bonus to the observed skill check, even though you are untrained.
watch and learn.trigger: An ally you can see succeeds or critically succeeds at a Strength- or Dexterity-based skill check, using a skill in which you are untrained.

watch this!.name: Watch This!
watch this!.text: A common saying among Firebrands is, “There's always a fool who thinks they can do it better—and they're often right.” You verbally commit to using an action on your next turn to make a melee Strike against the same enemy your ally has missed.
watch this!.trigger: An ally misses or critically misses an enemy you can see with their attack.

watch your back.name: Watch Your Back
watch your back.text: You menace the target, stoking their fears and drawing their attention. Attempt an Intimidation check against the Will DC of a target within 30 feet. If you succeed, for 1 minute, that target gains a +2 status bonus to Perception checks against you, but it takes a –2 status penalty to Will saves against fear effects.

watcher on the wall.name: Watcher on the Wall
watcher on the wall.text: You claim a patron’s symbol that you can etch onto any surface. Etch a symbol onto an adjacent surface; you can see and hear what you could from the symbol’s location as long as you are on the same plane. This effect lasts until you place another symbol or the surface is destroyed.

watchful gaze.name: Watchful Gaze
watchful gaze.text: You use your many eyes to look in all directions at once, making you extremely observant for a short period of time. You gain all-around vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.

water strider.name: Water Strider
water strider.text: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface. Stride up to your Speed. During your movement, you can move across liquids that don't support your weight. If you end your movement on a surface that can't support you, you fall into the liquid at the end of your movement.

waterfowl stance.name: Waterfowl Stance
waterfowl stance.text: In your hands, swords dance like rainfall over the waves; who can tell where the storm ends and the sea begins? Developed by Swordmaster Ganhil to compete with the House of Untwisting Iron, this stance integrates fluid swordplay into even the simplest movements.

waters of creation.name: Waters of Creation
waters of creation.text: Water is the source of life, and you draw upon this primordial force to heal your allies' wounds. A gentle ring ripples out from you in a 15-foot emanation, restoring 5d6 Hit Points to creatures in the area. At 12th level and every two levels thereafter, the amount restored increases by 1d6.

wave dashes rocks.name: Wave Dashes Rocks
wave dashes rocks.text: You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave. Make a melee Strike against the required creature, after which they are no longer grabbed or restrained by you. This Strike must be made with an unarmed attack or a monk weapon.
wave dashes rocks.requirements: You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

wave spiral.name: Wave Spiral
wave spiral.text: You dip and spin, unleashing a wide whirlpool of water. Make an Athletics check to Trip each creature standing on the ground in a 10-foot emanation. These attacks all count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you make all the attacks.

wave the flag.name: Wave the Flag
wave the flag.text: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear. Each ally presently benefiting from your Cavalier's Banner feat reduces their current frightened condition by 1 and can choose to immediately attempt a new saving throw against any one mental effect currently affecting them.

we're on the list.name: We're on the List
we're on the list.text: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same. Attempt a Society check to Aid your ally.
we're on the list.trigger: An ally you can see and hear is about to attempt a Deception check to Impersonate someone or Lie.

we've met before.name: We've Met Before
we've met before.text: Your ability to discern information about those you interact with is without peer. Spend a Mythic Point to gain a Lore skill specific to the required creature for the next 24 hours; you have mythic proficiency with that skill and can use it to Recall Knowledge about the creature, Decipher Writings created by the creatu…
we've met before.requirements: You’ve spent at least 1 minute in mutual conversation with a creature.

weakening assault.name: Weakening Assault
weakening assault.text: With a barrage of blows, you diminish an enemy's strength. Strike an enemy affected by your Taunt twice. If either Strike hits, the target is enfeebled 1 until the beginning of your next turn. If both Strikes hit, the target is enfeebled 3 instead.

weapon infusion.name: Weapon Infusion
weapon infusion.text: With a signature flair, you shape blasts of elemental power into the form of a weapon, such as a sword made of whirling wind or a bow that shoots flames. If your next action is an Elemental Blast, choose a weapon shape for it to take.

weaver's web.name: Weaver's Web
weaver's web.text: Your swarm can spin dense webs much like those left by stone-gray weaver spiders under eaves and in derelict city buildings, especially along the coasts of Varisia. When your swarm ends its turn, it fills all surfaces in its space with sticky webs that last for 1 minute. The webs are difficult terrain.
weaver's web.requirements: Your swarm is outside your body.

webslinger.name: Webslinger
webslinger.text: Your natural ability to create silken webs blends with your magical powers, allowing you to create impossibly large webs with great frequency. This has the effects of a 2nd-level web spell using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

weft and warp.name: Weft and Warp
weft and warp.text: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks. Stride up to half your speed toward an enemy; if you end this movement adjacent to them make a melee Strike against that foe. If you hit, you can Reposition the target into your square at the same time that you Step into their square.

weight of stone.name: Weight of Stone
weight of stone.text: A packed cloud of thundering boulders descends from the sky, beating down everyone in its path. The rain of stone falls in a cylinder 20 feet in diameter and 80 feet high, and the bottom must be within 120 feet of you.

outcomes.text: The creature is unaffected.
The creature takes half damage.

The creature takes full damage and is pushed downward 40 feet without taking falling damage. If it reaches the bottom of the cylinder or the ground, the push ends. If the creature is pushed to the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.
As failure, but double damage and the distance the creature is pushed is 80 feet.

well of potential.name: Well of Potential
well of potential.text: Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

well-armed.name: Well-armed
well-armed.text: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility. You Interact to remove your arm and wield it in the other one, increasing your reach by 5 feet for any one-handed weapon held in that arm.
